TEXT_FISHERY_BOTTOM_FISHERYSHOP_01_DESC.text: A little shop for all your fishing needs.

TEXT_FISHERY_BOTTOM_FISHERYSHOP_02_DESC.text: A little shop for all your fishing needs.

TEXT_FISHERY_BOTTOM_FOREST_01_DESC.text: A wooden decoration that is supposed to be the mini version of the Hyro Forest

TEXT_FISHERY_BOTTOM_MINIFISHERY_01_DESC.text: Mini fishing spot for a fishing mania who needs to be in action all the time. A chair and a nice big umbrella are bonus.

TEXT_FISHERY_BOTTOM_NOTICE_01_DESC.text: An important sign for fishermen looking for fishing spots.

TEXT_FISHERY_BOTTOM_RODCRADLE_01_DESC.text: A rack to organize your fishing rods.

TEXT_FISHERY_CENTER_CLOUD_01_DESC.text: A cloud decoration. You could express your mood with it.

TEXT_FISHERY_CENTER_SUN_01_DESC.text: A sunny decoration. You could express your mood with it.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_BUNGFISHBREAD_DESC.text: A bread baked in the shape of a carp. Contrary to the norm, this one contains actual carp to lure fish more easily.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_EVENTROE_DESC.text: Eggs laid by salmon that have returned to the stream where they have hatched. They can be used as effective bait, playing on the species' characteristic behavior to bury their eggs in a safe place.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_JUNGARI_DESC.text: A refrigerated sardine. You picked out the smaller ones to use as bait.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_KOIBREAD_DESC.text: A golden bread that contains more glutinous rice and fat and is chewier than carp bread.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_KRILL_DESC.text: A small and nutritious crustacean that constitutes the diet of many other organisms, serving as the very foundation of marine ecosystems. It is also the popular choice for many fishermen as both freshwater and deep sea bait. Should not be confused with shrimps.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_OJINGA_DESC.text: A squid used for bait. Before using it, you must cut it into appropriate portions according to the fish you are trying to catch. It is rather tough and difficult to cut.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_SPINNER1_DESC.text: A small object that comprises of a ball bearing at its center, around which you can spin the object to your heart's content. For some reason, spinning it calms you and relieves your anxiety.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_SPINNER2_DESC.text: The upgraded version of Spinner MK1. The edges have been sharpened to improve its performance. Fish will surely lose their minds upon seeing this bad boy spin!

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_START_DESC.text: A homemade bait made by mixing water and ground insect or grain and then shaping the resulting paste into a round ball. It isn't very good for the environment.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_TOPBLACK_DESC.text: A bait series designed by the Hasla Fishing Association. The black color, symbolizing death and despair, invokes fear in the heart of all fish that see it.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_TOPBLUE_DESC.text: A bait series designed by the Hasla Fishing Association. The blue color, which also symbolizes the sorrow of defeated fish, will entice all kinds of fish to bite.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_TOPRED_DESC.text: A bait series designed by the Hasla Fishing Association. The red color emits out a warning to all fish that a serious fisherman is in town.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_TOPYELLOW_DESC.text: A bait series designed by the Hasla Fishing Association. The yellow color cheerily taunts fish into biting.

TEXT_FISHING_BAIT_WORM_DESC.text: The most popular - and perhaps even famous - choice of bait. It belongs to the biological kingdom of Animalia.

TEXT_FISHING_FEST_CAPTURE_REWARD_LOCK.text: You can receive rewards after catching at least {0} fish.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_BEGINNER_DESC.text: A durable float that reacts sensitively to bites and doesn't get easily trapped between rocks.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_BRONZE_DESC.text: A bronze float made in the shape of a fish.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_ELECTRIC_DESC.text: A float in the shape of a lightbulb. It lures in fish with light.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_EXPERT_DESC.text: A quality float made by an experienced artisan with fine materials.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_GOLD_DESC.text: A gold float made in the shape of a fish.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_LOVERDUCK_DESC.text: A float designed in the shape of a duck by a prominent artist. Gazing at it, you feel at peace.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_MIDDLE_DESC.text: A float for more experienced fishermen.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_SEIREN_DESC.text:
A float that looks like Seiren, handmade by a couple in the south.
Has a reasonable price for a handmade item.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_SHYPOD_DESC.text: A state-of-the-art float specially designed by the Hasla Fishing Association. It lures in fish with vibrations and sound.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_SILVER_DESC.text: A silver float made in the shape of a fish.

TEXT_FISHING_FLOAT_START_DESC.text: An ordinary float that is a part of the starter kit given to you by Fishernyan. You should probably get a new one before long.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_BAMBOO_DESC.text: A rod made out of bamboo and some string. Classy.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_BORON_DESC.text: A rod made out of boron, a blackish metal that is said to rival diamonds in strength.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_CARBON_DESC.text: A rod made out of carbon fiber. Durable, flexible, and light enough for every fishing scenario you can think of. We hope.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_GLASS_DESC.text: A rod made out of glass fiber. It is extremely durable, being resistant to both heat and wear.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_GOLD_DESC.text: A rod made out of pure gold. Good for fishing, better for showing off.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_IRON_DESC.text: A rod made out of steel. It's quite durable, but a little heavy.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_KEVLAR_DESC.text: A rod made out of kevlar, a synthetic fiber five times stronger than steel. Only a few companies possess the patent to this material.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_PREMIUM_DESC.text: A high-performance rod with a metal body and a wooden grip.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_START_DESC.text: An ordinary rod that is a part of the starter kit given to you by Fishernyan. You should probably get a new one before long.

TEXT_FISHING_ROD_TITANIUM_DESC.text: A rod made out of titanium, a material stronger yet lighter than steel. It is difficult to produce and thus expensive.

TEXT_FISH_ALL_BOOTS_DESC.text: A threadbare rubber boot that has been wandering the seas for some time. You probably shouldn't put it on.

TEXT_FISH_ALL_CAN_DESC.text: An empty can that you fished out. People need to recycle!

TEXT_FISH_ALL_NET_DESC.text: An abandoned fishing net, often called a "ghost net." Even at this very minute, countless fish and other marine creatures are dying after becoming trapped in such nets, through starvation or suffocation.

TEXT_FISH_ALL_PEARL_DESC.text: The elegant jewel of the sea. Its iridescent hue reminds you of sunlight breaking on the waves.

TEXT_FISH_ALL_TIRE_DESC.text: A rubber tire that you fished out. It seems as if it had been in the water for a long time.

TEXT_FISH_AUTOFISHING_STOP_DESC.text:
Stop Auto Fish?
Your current fishing progress will be lost.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_BAIT_HELP.text: Can be obtained only during Fishing Events

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_CATBOX_DESC.text: A mysterious cat chest. Open it and there's - tada - another cat chest!

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_CAN_DESC.text: As much as we find a couple's picnic adorable, you should always remember to pick up your trash behind you. Protecting the environment is important!

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_GRILLEDFISH_DESC.text: These two fish could not bear the boiling lava of the Volcano... conveniently making up a set dinner menu.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_GUPPY_DESC.text: These guppies were made for each other. Their favorite pastime is acting, but you can tell that their trust for each other is real.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_HALFMOON_DESC.text: A Halfmoon couple of different scale colors. Who knew these colors would look so beautiful together?

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_MIGGURAGI_DESC.text: So are they are aren't they a thing? It's hard to know with these two loaches.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_NORMALFROG_DESC.text: Frogs hopping together in unison. When you hop alone, you hop to get somewhere. When you hop together, however, hopping becomes meaningful in itself.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_NUPCHI_DESC.text: Even if one wakes up from a nightmare, the other flounder will always be close by to comfort it at night.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_COUPLE_OJINGA_DESC.text: Squids sure are lucky to have ten tentacles to hold together.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_LONELY_BOKFISH_DESC.text: The holidays won't be lonely for the Lonely Pufferfish! Or that's what he thought when he first began planning a Christmas party, anyway. When no guests arrive at his party due to the cold weather, the Lonely Pufferfish is left to sob over the pile of presents he prepared for his friends. However, he still manages to put them to good use: whenever he is caught by a fisherman and let go "since it's Christmas," the Lonely Pufferfish gives them one of his Christmas presents in gratitude. It seems it won't be such a lonely Christmas for the Lonely Pufferfish after all.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_LONELY_GOLDFISH_DESC.text: This goldfish was actually planning to attend the pufferfish's party, but after seeing that nobody else had come, it took all of three seconds for him to quietly make a beeline for the door.

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_SALMON_DECOY_DESC.text: Salmon figurines had to be ordered for the latest Fishing Competition due to the sudden decrease in the salmon population. If this continues, we may have to change the annual 'Salmon Fishing Contest' to the 'Plastic Figurine Fishing Contest.'

TEXT_FISH_EVENT_SALMON_DESC.text: An anadromous species that return to the icy waters of Nosgard to reproduce. Like the Nosgardian salmon, Fishernyan hopes to return to meet his Hasla friends very soon.

TEXT_FISH_EXCHANGE_DESC.text: You can trade Fish Coins for various items at the Trading Post.

TEXT_FISH_FAIL_2.text: It looks like you didn't catch anything...

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ALIGATORGAR_DESC.text: A primitive species that is usually found in swamps. It resembles its namesake, while bigger members of this species even eat alligators when the opportunity arises.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_AROWANA_DESC.text: A large tropical fish that can live even in the most hostile of environments with hardly any oxygen. It is popular as aquarium fish, and its price spans a great range in accordance with its color and species.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BAEKRYUNFISH_DESC.text: A species of carp that is classified as an invasive species due to its threatening size and high reproduction rate.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BASS_DESC.text: A type of bass that belongs to the sunfish family. It spawns in weedy waters and eats smaller fish and insects. Along with the bullfrog and the bluegill, it is categorized as an invasive species.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BLACKAROWANA_DESC.text: A species of arowana. While it can be bred as aquarium fish, it is highly susceptible to stress and tends to die unexpectedly.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BLUEGILL_DESC.text: A freshwater fish that is found in the slower waters of streams and rivers. Due to its high reproduction rate and voracious appetite for smaller fish and shrimp, it is classified as an invasive species. The thorns on its dorsal fin are quite sharp, so be careful.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BROWNSONGA_DESC.text: A nocturnal freshwater species that is native to colder waters, and feeds on smaller fish and insects. Breeding this fish in artificial hatcheries is notably difficult.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BUDDLEBUNGFISH_DESC.text: Recognized for its long fin, this exotic aquarium fish changes the color of its fins and the pattern of its scales according to its mood.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BULLFROG_DESC.text: A large type of frog that often threatens the ecosystem with its massive appetite and aggressive breeding behavior. Its characteristic croak, as well as its ample size, can prove to be surprisingly frightening.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_BUNGFISH_DESC.text: A fish belonging to the Cyprinid family found in lakes, swamps, rivers, and other bodies of water. It is uncommonly resilient to environmental change and pollution.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_CANDIRU_DESC.text: While this fish may resemble loaches, it is actually a type of catfish. A parasitic species, it enters a host fish's body through its gills and feeds off its flesh.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_CHOFISH_DESC.text: As can be inferred from its name, this freshwater fish has a big appetite for grass and other aquatic plants. If you see round fish excrement with a diameter of approximately 1 centimeter, it won't be long before you see a grass carp darting before your path.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_CHULGAPSHARK_DESC.text: A primitive fish whose major characteristics have remained unchanged for a long time. Contrary to its fierce appearance, this species possesses a meek and tame disposition. Its eggs are widely recognized as a delicacy, going by the name of caviar.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_COELACANTH_DESC.text: A species that was once thought to be extinct but was recently discovered. It is a rare species considered a living fossil, possessing the DNA of both fish and mammal.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_COLORINGFISH_DESC.text: A decorative species of carp selectively bred for their characteristic scale color and pattern. It must follow a specific diet to maintain their color, or its color will change back to its natural state. The best species of koi are traded at surprisingly high prices.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_DONGJAGAE_DESC.text: A freshwater fish that has many nicknames, dubbed for the quirky noise it makes when caught. While normally consumed as food, it has recently been bred for decorative purposes.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ELECTRICEEL_DESC.text: Eletric eels can generate up to 850V of electricity, which they use to hunt their prey. Their tail takes up 80% of their entire length.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_GAJAE_DESC.text: A type of a crustacean found in fresh water. Legend says that it was once a shrimp that envied the hard shells and claws of crabs.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_GOLDENSSOGARI_DESC.text: A beautiful and rare species of temperate perch that is famous for its golden scales, which are the result of a coloring mutation. It falls under the same species as the ordinary mandarinfish.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_GOLDFISH_DESC.text: One of the most common aquarium fish. Despite the popular myth that goldfish have a memory that spans all of three seconds, experiments prove that it actually remembers simple facts for up to 24 hours. Turns out that "having the memory of a goldfish" is actually a compliment in disguise.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_GOLDHALFMOON_DESC.text: A species of halfmoon that glows golden. It is rare as it is beautiful, and can only be seen, much less caught, with luck on your side.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_GUPPY_DESC.text: A species of tropical fish that lives in freshwater, characterized by the colorful patterns of its scales and caudal fin that make it a popular aquarium fish. It is called by different names according to its pattern. Its diet is mainly constituted of mosquito larvae.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_HALFMOON_DESC.text: A freshwater fish well known for its big and beautiful fins, which make it a popular aquarium fish. Bettas don't only have a pretty face, however - they have a long history as fighting fish due to their belligerent nature.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_HYANGFISH_DESC.text: A type of carp that became a separate species after two successive mutations. It has less scales and is plumper than the common carp, and can be eaten raw as sashimi.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_KINGCATFISH_DESC.text: A colossal catfish that is said to be bigger than a human being. Many legends have been derived from its sinister shadow swimming under the surface.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_LUNGFISH_DESC.text: A fish that can breathe air through its lungs. Due to this ability the lungfish can live both in and out of water, and is regarded as the ancestor of amphibians and reptiles. Its versatility helps it survive in the dry desert.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_MIGGURAGI_DESC.text: Loaches can live in dirty water as they can breathe through the surface of the water. Apparently, loaches and weatherfish are different species from each other. In Korea, chueo-tang (loach soup) and fish porridge are popular dishes made with loach.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_MINMOOLNABIGOGI_DES.text: A fish with memorable pectoral fins. It is a different species from its marine relative, the butterflyfish.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_MORAEMOOJI_DESC.text: A freshwater fish that lives in clean water. It dwells at the sandy bottom of the river and helps cleanse the water.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_NORMALFROG_DESC.text: The poster child for amphibians and hibernation. Disclaimer: kissing it will not change it to a member of royalty.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_DESERTCATFIS.text: A catfish with scales the color of sand. An extreme glutton, it greedily swallows the smaller fish of the oasis with its undiscriminating mouth.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_DESERTDRAGON.text: A species of arowana that is native to the desert. Arowanas are popular aquarium fish, and are called various names that include the word "dragon" according to their color.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_DESERTEEL_DE.text: A species of eel that has survived in the hostile desert thanks to its camouflage, which makes it resemble the surrounding sand.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_FIREFISH_DES.text: A fish that is literally on fire. It is small and thus not much of a threat, although you will get a burn if not careful.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_FIREGAEBOKCH.text: A species of mola mola that breathes fire. Yes, you read that right. Unfortunately, every time it releases its impressive flames, the fumes propels it backwards so rapidly that it can never find its way back home.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_FIRESAILFISH.text: A species that is similar to the common sailfish but has burning gills. A formidable predator of volcano lakes, it swims at high speeds in even the hottest of lava.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_FLAMEAROWANA.text: A species of arowana with flaming scales. While coveted by collectors for its exquisite beauty, it is extremely hard to come across, as it can only live in hot lava.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_GRILLEDFISH_.text: Oops, it seems like this fish didn't make it in the boiling waters of the volcanic lake. It smells delicious.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_LAVAICEFISH_.text: No one knows how this particular species of smelt, which originally inhabited the icy streams of the northern mountains, came to be found in the lakes of the Primal Volcano. Most Lava Smelts, whose flesh is made of ice, end up getting extinguished in the hot lava. Needless to say, they have a short lifespan.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_LAVATUNA_DES.text: A fish native to the lava lakes of Hasla. The belly of this particular species of tuna is made of hard basalt - bad news for all sushi lovers out there.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_MAGMAGUPPY_D.text: The Great Magma Guppy - known to all aquatic creatures as the wrath of the Volcano, the bane within the flames - was once too an ordinary fish. A small fry at the bottom of the food chain, it had had to flee to the hottest lava lake of the Primal Volcano to survive. Soon afterwards, news traveled near and far of a fish that knew no fear. It had returned. It was strong. It was alive. It was the Great Magma Guppy, who could cook other fish into delicious steak with a single slam of its body.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_STEAMBUSHIRI.text: A species of amberjack that breathes out steam from its gills. It turns a reddish color when it swims at high speeds.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_ORIGIN_THEONEFISH_D.text:
A mysterious fish born in the fires of the Primal Volcano.
One Fish to rule them all, One Fish to find them, 
One Fish to bring them all and in the lava bind them...

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_PACU_DESC.text: While this fish may resemble the vicious piranha, it has squarer teeth and feed on fruit that falls from trees into the water.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_PADDLEFISH_DESC.text: A primitive fish that retains most of its prehistoric characteristics. The electroreceptors on its rostrum help it detect electric fields that reveal the presence of potential prey.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_PIRAMI_DESC.text: A popular choice for bait and other fish's meals. What a sad life.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_PIRANHA_DESC.text: A carnivorous freshwater fish with surprisingly sharp teeth. Piranhas hunt their prey in large groups - called schools - and attack not only members of their own species, but also large mammals that unluckily cross their path.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_PIRARUCU_DESC.text: One of the largest freshwater fish in the world, the red pirarucu (literally meaning "red fish") is the natural predator of piranhas. It must swim up to the surface every 15 minutes to breathe and save oxygen within its air bladder.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_RAINBOWSONGA_DESC.text: A trout notable for its rainbow scales - hence its name. It is commonly bred for food.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_REDTAILCATFISH_DESC.text: A massive type of catfish that inhabits large rivers. It has a meek temper, but like many other catfish, swallow everything in its path with its large and tough mouth. It is sometimes bred as aquarium fish in bigger tanks.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_SNAKEHEAD_DESC.text: A large freshwater fish that can live anywhere - swamps, mud flats, ponds, lakes, rivers, you name it - as long as it has enough food and space. It is used for a variety of purposes, including food, medicine, and postpartum care products.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_SSOGARI_DESC.text: A freshwater fish that is recognized by its colorful patterns resembling apricot blossoms. It is a nocturnal species and can be found in streams with clear water and rapid currents. Upon feeling threatened, the mandarinfish will raise the dorsal fin on its back.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_TIGERFISH_DESC.text: A large freshwater fish that is as extremely predatory as its name and appearance suggest. Its hunts alone, chomping on smaller fish with its menacing teeth.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_TILAPIA_DESC.text: This omnivorous fish is commonly seen in a variety of habitats due to its rapid reproduction rate and high versatility.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_TRUEBUNGFISH_DESC.text: A species of catfish commonly seen in streams and fords. It is easily recognized by the dark lateral line cutting across its body.

TEXT_FISH_FRESHWATER_WELSCATFISH_DESC.text: A large catfish species that lives in slow-flowing rivers and lakes. It is characterized by a flat and broad head, a wide mouth, and a scaleless body. The wels catfish's sharp sense of hearing and touch make up for its poor eyesight.

TEXT_FISH_HERO_SELECT_DESC.text: Select the Hero to go fishing.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_1_CHOCOLATECHIPSTARFISH_DE.text: Don't be fooled - the brown spots on this starfish may LOOK like chocolate chips, but they taste like... well, starfish.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_2_BLUEDAMSEL_DESC.text: The blue damselfish may be small, but it is highly territorial and has a short temper worth cautioning. Known to form schools with other members of its species, it lives protected by the coral which it inhabits.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_2_BLUERINGEDOCTOPUS_DESC.text: A small octopus identified by, as its name suggests, the pattern of blue rings that decorate its flesh. Contrary to their cute appearance, they are very venomous. Watch out!

TEXT_FISH_SEA_3_CLOWNFISH_DESC.text: Clownfish share a symbiotic relationship with sea anemones: as they are immune to the venom of sea anemones, they nestle within their tentacles and so are protected against outside dangers. The most famous member of this species is - you guessed it, his name starts with 'N.'

TEXT_FISH_SEA_3_HASELADAMSEL_DESC.text: A sparkling red damselfish found only in the waters of Hasla. It 'wields' pieces of coral with its mouth and teams up with other members of its species to attack other fish.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_4_BLUETANG_DESC.text: A species that spends its entire day wading through coral reefs, nibbling on seaweed. It is easily identified by its beautiful blue color, but its beauty belies its aggressive nature that allows it to dominate any aquarium.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_5_COPPERBANDBUTTERFLY_DESC.text: A species of butterflyfish known for its beautiful stripes.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_5_YELLOWTANG_DESC.text: Known for its beautiful yellow color, the yellow tang uses its long snout to feed on algae growing among coral.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_6_EMPERORANGEL_DESC.text: One of the most eye-catching fish in the coral reefs, the Emperor Angelfish is a popular species in aquariums.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_6_FLAMEANGEL_DESC.text: A species of angelfish that catches one's eye with its fiery red scales and black stripes.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_AGWI_DESC.text: A wide, ovoid fish that uses the bulb-like lure on its dorsal fin to attract prey. Surprisingly, it is considered a delicacy despite its ugly appearance.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BAEKSANGARI_DESC.text: The fearsome predator of the seas, feared for its sharp teeth and strong jaw. Despite its reputation, smaller members of this species are occasionally hunted by killer whale pods.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BALLROCK_DESC.text: A species that inhabits shallow waters around rocks and reefs. Even amateur fishermen can easily catch this fish, as it is easily lured by all kinds of bait. It even tastes good and is used in a variety of dishes.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BANGEDOM_DESC.text: A blackish brown fish. Its richness in fat makes it a popular delicacy, but the largescale blackfish is difficult to catch due to its surprising agility and intelligence. Fishermen have dubbed it the nickname of "the black knight of the seas."

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BARRACUDA_DESC.text: A predatory fish with a very bad temper. It will perceive anything that glitters as food and attack. Watch out for its sharp teeth!

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BIGEYETUNA_DESC.text: A species of tuna that inhabits warmer waters. It is widely consumed around the world as sashimi, canned products, and other dishes.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BOKFISH_DESC.text: A species that normally inhabits tropical estuaries. When surprised or attacked, it inflates its body in self-defense. One pufferfish possesses enough poison to kill 33 human adults.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_BUMGORAE_DESC.text: Don't be fooled by the orca's cute looks! While called the "wolf of the seas" for its aggressive disposition and tendency to hunt in groups, the killer whale is also a very social creature; it lives in matrilineal communities structured around the matriarch, and communicates with members of the pod through vocalized "songs."

TEXT_FISH_SEA_CHAMDOM_DESC.text: Called the "beauty of the seas" for its attractive appearance and good taste, the red seabream is said to bring good luck.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_CHAMTUNA_DESC.text: A species that travels in large shoals at speeds of up to 90km/h. Famous for its good taste, it has continuously been overfished around the world, resulting in a rapid decline of its population.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_CHUNGFISH_DESC.text: A species that feeds on small crustaceans, such as plankton. It forms very large schools in abundant numbers, but is still easy prey and the main source of diet for a variety of predators.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_CHUNGSAECHI_DESC.text: A large species that has a sharp, spear-like bill. It is strong enough to pull out fishhooks when caught.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_COPPERBAND_DESC.text: A species that inhabits the shallower waters of oceans and coral reefs. It is a popular aquarium fish due to its bright and colorful pattern and elegant shape.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_DAEGU_DESC.text: A large fish that can be found living in schools in deeper waters. Rich in vitamins and widely consumed as food, it is also the main ingredient of fish and chips.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_DOLDOM_DESC.text: A fish recognized by its black vertical stripes. While considered the best of the "four seabreams" it is notoriously difficult to catch, as it is not only vigilant but also tends to dwell at the bottom of the sea.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_DOTSAECHI_DESC.text: A big species of billfish that is characterized by its dorsal fin, which covers the span of its tail and is often called a "sail" for that reason. It can swim at speeds up to 110 km/h, making it the fastest marine creature known to humankind.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GAEBOKCHI_DESC.text: Also called the ocean sunfish, the mola mola is a strangely shaped fish with developed dorsal and ventral fins and lack of tail. Before diving down into deeper waters, it has a tendency to "surface bask" - or float on the surface of the water to save enough heat for the dive - becoming temporarily vulnerable to the prying hands of fishermen.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GALCHI_DESC.text: A fish characterized by a long silvery body, hence its name. It is nocturnal.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GAMSUNGDOM_DESC.text: One of the "four seabreams" along with the red seabream, striped beakfish, and largescale blackfish, the black porgy is a popular catch among fishermen. Its sharp dorsal fin and strong jaw require caution.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GASHIBOK_DESC.text: A fish with sharp spines all over its body. If it feels threatened, it will "puff" its stomach to a round shape and point its spines, much in the resemblance of a menacing chestnut.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GGONGCHI_DESC.text: Also called the mackerel pike. It is one of the most popular fish consumed by humans as food, as it is rich in fat and nutrients. It can be widely found in waters where the cold and warm currents meet.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GGOTGAE_DESC.text: A type of crab that can be commonly found in shallow waters or mud eddies. It is commonly consumed as food.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_GODEUNGFISH_DESC.text: A common species belonging to the tuna and mackerel family. It inhabits clear waters between the epipelagic and middle zones of the ocean. Rich in Vitamin B2, iron, and fatty acids such as Omega-3, it is widely caught for consumption.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_HWANGSAECHI_DESC.text: A large fish with scales tinted bronze. Considerably bigger than other species of fish, the swordfish is recognized by its elongated body shape and lack of scales, which they lose when they reach adulthood. Its "sword," which takes up more than half of its entire length, can be used to injure and kill even whales.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_IMYEONSOO_DESC.text: A species of mackerel that inhabits colder waters. Many fishermen and divers have praised the beauty of mackerel schools swimming in open sea. If you have more culinary interests, grilling or frying it without removing its skin will result in a tasty dish.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_JOGI_DESC.text: A migratory fish that follows warm currents to reproduce. It normally moves in large schools and is characterized by the loud croaking sound it makes. Its skull bone is extremely durable - classifying the fish as a "hardhead" - and has medicinal uses.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_JUGGUMI_DESC.text: A species of octopus that resides on the sandy bottoms of shallow waters. It is distinguished from long arm octopuses by the golden ring around the base of its third leg.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_JUNGARI_DESC.text: A great source of protein, calcium, and other vitamins, sardines are a favorite meal of bigger fish - especially mola mola.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_MINFISH_DESC.text: A species that resides primarily on the sandy bottom of shallow waters. It creates a characteristic croaking sound through its air bladder.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_NONGFISH_DESC.text: A migratory fish normally caught and eaten in the summer.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_NUPCHI_DESC.text: Also called a halibut, the olive flounder is characterized by its flat body and askew eyes. The eyes of this fish are normally set during its smolt stage, but gradually move to the side as the fish matures.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_OJINGA_DESC.text: A cephalopod widely found in both shallow and deep waters. It feeds on small fish and other creatures with the suction cups of its tentacles and its toothy mouth. It dies shortly after mating.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_PEPPERMINT_DESC.text: A type of angelfish with beautiful vertical stripes. It is an extremely rare and expensive species that is difficult to breed.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_REDBARRACUDA_DESC.text: A species recognized by its sharp and pointed mouth. It feeds on a variety of prey including smaller fish, octopus, shrimp, and crab.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_SAEWOO_DESC.text: A crustacean found all over the world in a variety of habitats, in both freshwater bodies and oceans. It is an important source of food for many countries for its richness in protein and calcium, and is also widely used as animal feed and fish bait.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_SALMON_DESC.text: Salmon eggs hatch in freshwater streams, after which smolts travel to the open ocean. In autumn, mature salmon swim upstream back to their natal streams to lay their eggs.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_SAMCHI_DESC.text: A fish belonging to the mackerel family. It feeds on small fish, drawn especially by fast-moving prey. Its tender meat makes it a popular source of food.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_SANGALCHI_DESC.text: A gigantic species that is the motif of many legends and myths throughout the lands due to its size and beauty. It usually stays in deeper waters, but is sometimes swept to the shore by a strong current.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_SOONGFISH_DESC.text: A fish native to both tropical and temperate regions. It is also capable of living in fresh water, and will sometimes swim upstream in search for food.

TEXT_FISH_SEA_WOORUCK_DESC.text: A commonly found fish that is often eaten raw as sashimi. Although born black, it changes color to gray or white as it matures.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_ANCIENREGIME_SKILL_DESC.text:
Ancient Regime attacks to defend his beloved city, according to the color used.
Red: Ancient Regime tackles Heroes, according to the chain number used.
Blue: Ancient Regime summons powerful thorns, according to the chain number used.
Yellow: Upon using a 3-chain, Ancient Regime heals himself.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_ANCIENREGIME_STORY.text: The beautiful capital of Trista has been abandoned to chaos and mayhem by the light fanatics, led by a particular Hero Captain. Ancient Regime must protect his beloved city - even if only its ruins remain.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_ANUBISIS_SKILL_DESC.text:
Anubisis gives off a certain energy to Heroes, according to the color used.
Red: Anubisis runs towards Heroes with open paws, according to the chain number used.
Blue: Anubisis expresses even more affection towards Heroes, according to the chain number used.
Yellow: Anubisis affectionately licks Heroes, according to the chain number used.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_ANUBISIS_STORY.text: Imagine the werewolf process but backwards.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_MATAHARI_SKILL_DESC.text:
Matahari shows off her moves to Heroes, according to the color used.
Red: Matahari summons and shows off her adorable pets, according to the chain number used.
Blue: Matahari uses her whip as a ribbon to show off impressive rhythmic gymnastics moves, according to the chain number used.
Yellow: Upon using a 3-chain, Matahari dances to show off the Soleil Dance.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_MATAHARI_STORY.text: How Matahari has longed for an audience for her dancing! Yet nobody in the great city seems interested in the lonely dancer. When she hears a rumor that some Heroes are coming to see her, Matahari hurries to greet them in the hopes that somebody will recognize her artistic talents at last.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_OMEGA_SKILL_DESC.text:
Omega blocks Heroes from raiding the Temple, according to the color used.
Red: Omega attacks Heroes with an elegant kick, according to the chain number used.
Blue: Omega shoots a heartfelt beam from his chest, according to the chain number used.
Yellow: Upon using a 3-chain, Omega heals himself and and grants himself a buff.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_OMEGA_STORY.text: Omega may be making ends meet by working as a security guard at the Temple of Illusions, but he will never stop pursuing his lifelong dream to become the next greatest ballerino. It seems that he will have to practice his pirouettes some other time, however, seeing as some villains have invaded the Temple.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_RESIDULLION_SKILL_DESC.text:
The Abandoned Lion warmly greets Heroes, according to the color used. Don't move, and you'll be safe!
Red: The Lion dashes forth to warmly greet Heroes, according to the chain number used.
Blue: The Lion leaps up to give Heroes a hearty embrace. 
Yellow: Upon using a 3-chain, the Lion courteously performs a ritual of the Order to express his deepest respect and admiration.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_RESIDULLION_STORY.text: The Abandoned Lion, now a living coat of armor and the sole guardian of the Hidden Palace, still retains his warm heart from his living days of flesh and bone. To this day he waits for his colleagues who left for the Holy City, warmly greeting any visitors who will visit the Palace in the meantime.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_WINDWALKER_SKILL_DESC.text:
Windstrider shoots a powerful arrow to protect his tribe, according to the color used.
Red: Windstrider shoots an arrow imbued with the power of wind to knock back the enemy, according to the chain number used.
Blue: Windstrider shoots an arrow imbued with the power of wind to knock back the enemy, according to the chain number used. Windstrider then evades attacks from Greedy Heroes.
Yellow: Windstrider shoots a powerful flurry of arrows according to the chain number used.

TEXT_FOOLSDAY_WINDWALKER_STORY.text: When greedy Heroes invade the peaceful forest of Goblins, the war-scarred veteran Windstrider wields his bow once more to protect his beloved tribe and family.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_3_11.text:
There's no returning to my former life.
The devils need... a king to lead them.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_3_3.text:
We Elves have all the time in the world!
I'll get in someday!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_1.text:
Foxy, where are you?!
Gon is here!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_10.text:
You there! Human! I will bestow you with the honor
to personally greet the noble captain of the Golden Archers!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_11.text:
We refuse to be victims any longer.
Rise, Devils!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_12.text:
It is a noble's duty to fight for his country.
I will bring honor for our family, Father.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_13.text:
Here comes Atalante, master hunter!
I'll make sure that you have meat on your table every night!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_15.text:
I don't care if Mom doesn't approve!
I'll become the best dancer in Chen!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_16.text:
Mom, Dad...
Wherever you are, please be safe.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_18.text:
Why does everybody want to fight when there's so much more to do?
How should I spend my day today~?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_19.text:
Master...
I vow to fight for your honor.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_2.text:
Subscribe to Hanzo's Delivery Service
for the quickest deliveries right to your door!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_20.text:
My two eyes may have lost their light,
but I will continue walking the way of the warrior.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_21.text:
I should get paid
for keeping those idiots from dying.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_22.text:
Ugh... I shouldn't be wasting my time
at a country church like this...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_23.text:
Oh, Elizabeth.
Why aren't you eating? Bamboo shoots are your favorite!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_24.text:
This power of mine is convenient, to say the least.
But others don't appreciate my... changed appearance.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_25.text:
Trista is pretty much conservative when it comes to class issues,
but I'll show you some of us are pretty cool!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_26.text:
Who am I?
I seem to have... lost all my memories.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_28.text:
Mamba... that idiot.
When he comes back, I'll make him sorry that he ever left!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_29.text:
(True strength comes from survival, not brute force.
What matters is staying alive.)

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_30.text:
I wonder what my patron is like...
I'm certain he or she is a wonderful person.
When I grow up, I'll make sure to pay them back.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_31.text:
Don't you know who I am? I'm the son of Ares, THE Senator
of the Olympian Council! Get out of my way, commoner girl!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_32.text:
I wonder if the other guys managed to reach safety.
Fireaxe... Where did you go?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_33.text:
... No matter how hard I try, I don't seem to be getting any better.
I need to think of some other way...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_4.text: I will judge the evil of the world with my bow!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_6.text:
Can she be simply a dream?
A spirit whose ghostly smile still haunts my mind?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_7.text:
I'm a little nervous...
But as long as my sister is with me, I'll try not to worry too much.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_8.text: Those vile wolves will be dead before they know it.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_4_9.text: Take me to my liege and lord.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_1.text:
Foxy, come back!
I promise not to eat you!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_10.text:
Sigh... How much lack of self-respect must you have in order to
unceremoniously munch on those foul things called 'wood chips'?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_11.text: Let's leave... and find our own paradise.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_12.text: Rebecca... Does your heart truly belong to me...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_13.text: Who knew lions made such expensive pets...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_14.text:
Commander Viper... gave me good things to eat.
He must be a good person-woopa...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_15.text:
Do you see me now, Mom? I've been accepted as an Imperial Dancer!
I'll be dancing before the Emperor himself tomorrow!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_16.text:
I can never forget the archery of my people,
my only inheritance.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_17.text:
I only wish other people...
could hear ghosts talk...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_18.text:
Don't underestimate me just because I come from the countryside.
I'm still a princess!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_19.text:
Master is not bald!
He simply suffers from male-pattern alopecia!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_2.text:
Receive a free gift of a shuriken set
with all new subscriptions!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_20.text:
There are some things you can only see
by opening the eyes of the mind.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_21.text:
Don't flatter yourself. I've only come all this way 
so that I can get my hands on that book of magic.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_22.text:
Hahaha! Did you brats just see that?
I don't have such terrible aim!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_23.text:
I'll do anything
if I can help my son get better!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_24.text:
It's better to keep to yourself. Without family, without friends...
I have no one who will accept me for what I am.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_25.text:
This country is rotten to the core.
Dad, I guess I was wrong.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_26.text:
A gentle blue light... A kindness I've felt before...
I know this voice.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_28.text:
I'm the new warchief?
I didn't ask for this!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_29.text: (I can't trust anyone. I will be alone, forever...)

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_3.text:
What most people don't know is that arrows can be EXPENSIVE.
That's why you need to have good aim and waste as few as possible.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_30.text:
Captain Magnus...
He was much kinder than the rumors described him.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_31.text:
Salamander? Hmm...
This thing doesn't bite, right?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_32.text:
Huh, who ever thought I would be a 'valuable asset' to
the revolutionary army? I'm glad I watched all that TV.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_33.text:
Rainbow Delivery, the quickest delivery witch service in Pumpkin City!
... This is how I can be of help to other people!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_4.text:
... The arrows of the Green Apple
will never forgive corrupt nobles!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_5.text:
Code : R-1.
Test data analysis complete. Processing upgrade.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_6.text: 'Half Moon'? I have no interest in petty titles.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_7.text:
Without my sister,
I don't think I'm worth anything... Am I?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_5_9.text:
The enemy of my lord...
I will never forgive him.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_1.text:
Foxy is friend, not food.
Foxy is friend, not food...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_10.text:
I have chosen to grace your Heroes with my honorable presence.
You would do well to bring me some wood chips of the highest quality!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_11.text:
To fight against the Order for my people,
I must grow stronger.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_12.text: I wish to see her once more.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_13.text: The moonlight shall guide our way!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_14.text:
I am a warrior of the Woopa tribe.
But... it is also my destiny to follow Commander Viper.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_15.text:
... This isn't at all what I dreamed of
when I said I wanted to become the empire's best dancer...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_16.text:
Let's go, Yumir!
I'll introduce you to my family this time!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_17.text:
Shh... Don't be scared...
They're very nice, once you get to know them...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_18.text:
I want to meet someone and fall in love -
a pretty, dreamy, cherry-blossom kind of romance!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_19.text:
Train as you would fight on the battlefield!
Welcome to the Zodiac Army.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_2.text:
Hanzo's Delivery Service!! Like a fast and furious ninja,
you won't know what hit you!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_20.text:
I have fought countless battles to become who I am now.
And I have lain my eyes on the battlefield of only the first.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_21.text: Necromancy... The lost art of the forgotten kingdom.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_22.text:
Haha...
A hero? I'm not what you think I am - Oh, darnit.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_23.text:
The rabbit princess of Han... A formidable foe.
But I will succeed in hunting her yet!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_24.text:
Lady Athena told me... With great power comes great responsibility.
What? What do you mean by, 'parody'?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_25.text:
Justice is achieved by persisting against those who try
to silence your voice. I'll be keeping order around here from now on!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_26.text:
I am Haerang, the Oracle of Water.
Long have I failed to carry out my duties.
From now on, I shall protect all of you.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_28.text:
So you've forgotten me? Huhu... Huhuhuhu....
I won't forgive you until the day I die!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_29.text:
(I will become the white raven of death,
delivering death throughout this kingdom of Nosgard.)

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_3.text: Demons, devils - none shall dodge my arrow!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_30.text:
Oh, Captain Magnus!
Have you been visiting the Silver Archers again?!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_31.text: Father... I'm sorry to let you down.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_32.text:
A bounty on my head?
I'll be remembering you, tank commander.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_4.text:
Everything shall be as King Alexander wills it.
My bow for his glory!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_6.text:
What use is glory and fame to a man
when he fails to protect the one love of his life?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_7.text:
I'll love and trust myself like my sister loves and trusts me.
I can be my own person. I know I can!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_8.text: The cold rage of the snowy mountains shall cover all in deadly frost...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_6_9.text:
If I use his own son against him...
Yes... There's nothing else to be done.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_LIMITED_4_1.text: I'm going to become the queen of fireworks!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_LIMITED_5_1.text:
Chin up, Jin-Kyung!
We'll each do our best to reach our goals.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GG_4_1.text:
Hire me?
No, I'll be the one hiring you.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_4_.text:
No fairy can resist a good laugh.
Hmm, teasing Princess Delrien could be fun.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_5_.text:
Your Majesty! Cough...
Your knight follows your command... Pfft!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_AR_LIMITED_GOGI_6_.text:
O-oh no. What have I gotten myself into?
I need to stop that delusional princess!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_1_1.text: My dream is to become a sheriff and protect the people!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_1_11.text:
The man whom I once called 'Father,' and who abandoned me here...
I don't want to see him ever again.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_2_1.text:
One shot, one kill!
You won't find a sharpshooter better than me in the wildlands.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_2_11.text:
I was just hungry.
I didn't mean to kill him...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_3_1.text:
I was aiming to become a sheriff,
but I suppose a musketeer isn't too far off the mark.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_3_11.text:
Even if I die out here in the wild,
I'll never give up.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_1.text:
I refuse to leave behind my comrades on the battlefield,
especially if they are injured!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_10.text:
Thisi raid shouldn't be too dangerous, right?
Well... I need the money, so I guess I can't go around asking questions.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_11.text:
If it wasn't for Mel,
by now I would be...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_12.text:
Sigh... Don't wanna move... Don't wanna do anything...
Everything is meaningless...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_13.text:
Assassinate who?!
This is supposed to be my very first mission!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_15.text:
What's that, you say?
A special potion that will turn me into a skilled sleuth?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_16.text:
At this rate, I won't be able to afford my next meal, 
let alone the next excavation. Perhaps I should publish something...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_17.text:
There is nothing more detrimental to the world than pirates.
I'll arrest every last one of them!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_18.text:
So this is a gun? Looks neat.
How does it work?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_19.text:
I'll ask for nothing more
if I can live in peace with my animal friends.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_2.text:
At this rate, we'll be needing more prison cells.
Guess there is such a thing as being TOO competent!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_20.text:
The heathens who killed my family...
Who killed them...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_21.text:
This lunchbox... It's simply divine!
Even the best chefs back in the capital could learn from this!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_22.text:
My first mission, at last!
I'll carry it out perfectly. I've got it all planned out...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_23.text:
A dragon hunt? Time for me
to become a legend, like the heroes of old!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_24.text:
Bounty hunting?
Sounds like there's some money to be made.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_25.text: I'll become the best soldier in Heaven's Cavalry!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_26.text:
The name of the target... Sasquatch.
The mission itself doesn't seem particularly difficult.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_28.text:
You annoy me, but... Jarvis specially asked me to behave,
so I will. For his sake!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_29.text:
That blasted tiger sure eats a lot.
I'll have to take care of him - in a different way.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_3.text:
Ksssh...
I will follow you... Ksssh... Commander Viper.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_31.text:
My dear sister! I'm so proud of you!
I'll always cheer you on!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_32.text:
To continue dreaming or make compromises,
that is the question!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_33.text:
One day... I will become
a better chief than that Woomparoom Woopa!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_34.text:
Support for the family of all enlisted soldiers...
Neth ROTC? This is it!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_36.text:
Hey! You wanna piece of me?
We're ending things here and now!
Huh? Don't run away! I'm not done yet!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_4.text:
If it is for the sake of the Empire,
it's a necessary evil.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_6.text:
I will never forgive the demons...
who murdered my family.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_7.text:
For the strength to avenge my comrades...
I will make a pact with the devil!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_8.text:
Activating healthcare robot - code : Sentinel.
Activating health che-....
... EXTERMINATION.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_4_9.text:
I'll become a superhero and save people, just like in comic books!
... If only I can get registered in the Superheroes of Hasla Association.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_1.text:
Oh, a fan letter from the Eastern Kingdom 'Han'...
What does this word mean? 'Waifu'?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_10.text:
Argh! My eyes...!
I-I... I can't see!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_11.text:
No! It's a lie!
Mel isn't dead! She can't be!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_12.text:
Oda, your friendship
makes life bearable.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_13.text: When in doubt, always disguise yourself as a maid!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_14.text:
I can't remember anything from the past,
but I don't mind as long as I'm with you, sir!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_15.text: Woof?! I've turned into a dog-human, woof!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_16.text:
Farewell to cheap equipment and going without dinners!
Now I can spend all my time and money on my research!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_17.text:
What? Drake, a duke? I can't allow it!
Once a pirate, always a dirty scum of a pirate.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_18.text:
Fine, fine, you won! Geez...
I'll leave you to your boring old ways!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_2.text:
Hear me out. We can arrest tons of criminals at once with this strategy -
which I'm calling 'Cattle Drive.'

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_20.text:
I must become an inquisitor
if I want to avenge the deaths of my family.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_21.text:
The taste of that lunchbox still lingers on my tongue...
I'll become a Musketeer if it means I can eat it every day!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_22.text:
Me, a double agent working for Chen?
No! I've been set up!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_23.text: An entire village demolished, and it's my fault...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_24.text:
Once you're marked,
you're dead meat.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_25.text:
Me... In second place?
This is a nightmare!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_26.text:
You know that I was going to hunt down and kill you, like an animal.
How can you look at me with such innocent eyes?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_28.text:
You banished Jarvis...? How could you, Mom?!
I'm going to blow up the mansion, Daddy. You'll see!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_29.text:
Those weren't meant to be edible!
Let's see who wins in the end!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_3.text:
Ksshhh...
The casualties at the borders... Ksssh.... are my fault.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_30.text:
I might have become a monster,
but I'll use these powers for justice!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_31.text:
The assassin... was my own sister Matahari?
It can't be...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_32.text: This isn't it! This isn't the music I hear in my soul!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_33.text:
This voice...!
Is it you, o mighty Quaxolotl?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_34.text:
How can I be a wanted criminal,
when all I did was fight for my family's sake?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_36.text:
This is it, the moment of revolution...
Nothing can stop me, not even weak constitution
I'll show you what I'm made of, gonna keep my resolution!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_4.text:
That bomb was meant to kill me.
Has the Empire... abandoned me?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_6.text:
I can't let my sworn enemy kill me, too.
I must become stronger.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_7.text:
Samiel...
Your prey appears before you once more.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_8.text:
Warning: critical.
Unable to process... Energy levels critically high.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_5_9.text:
Two years waiting to be registered, three training as an apprentice...
I've had enough! I need action, NOW!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_1.text:
As a noble Muskeeteer of the Kingdom of Trista,
I must set an example for others.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_10.text:
Only his death will lessen
the pain in my left eye.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_11.text:
The Order of the Goddess...
I'll find my own freedom from now on.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_12.text:
Demon Lord of the Sixth Heaven?
Oda, you've got to be kidding me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_13.text:
I did it! I've been promoted to Lady Victoria's lady's maid
within just five years! I finally completed my...
What was my mission again?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_14.text: I love you, Commander Spyro, sir!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_15.text:
Sniff, sniff... So, smells like you need a private detective, woof.
How did I know, you ask? Elementary!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_16.text:
This book is only the beginning.
I will find out the truth behind this continent's forgotten history!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_17.text:
Pirate scum,
I'll be seeing you in hell.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_18.text:
I need a change of scene
where I can test out my newest babies!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_19.text:
I'm rich! Look at all this gold -
I can finally buy my animal friends better snacks!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_2.text:
Ooh. This horse head is a bit heavy,
but it's so... vintage. It could be 'my thing.'

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_21.text:
A man can't be satisfied eating the same thing day after day.
I need a taste of something new.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_22.text:
If the Empire insists on making me a traitor,
I'll become one.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_23.text:
I will become a dragon hunter
not to achieve glory, but to right my wrongs.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_24.text:
I can't stop now.
It's your bad luck that you got noticed by me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_25.text:
Our match isn't over yet!
I'm supposed to be the best!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_26.text:
To atone for the sins of my past...
Sasquatch, I will protect you from now on.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_28.text:
Jarvis, where are you?
Hey, stop getting in my way - or I'll shoot you!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_3.text:
Ksssh... Viper, you betrayed the Empire...
You betrayed me. Ksssh... I will not forgive you...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_30.text:
Me... The sixth Gacha Ranger?
Are you sure?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_31.text:
Don't touch her... I'll do anything in my sister's place
if it means I can save her.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_32.text: Did you hear me? My soul and heart! My ultimate spirit of rock!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_33.text: No, I must lead my people out of the jungle...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_34.text:
I'll show you how it feels to be a wanted criminal.
Just you wait, Miel!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_36.text:
YO, XO-CREW-TESS is on the floor!
Clean out your ears 'cuz we goin' hardcore
and your gal Tess gonna raise the roof for sure!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_4.text:
I realize only now that the peace I fought for
was but an impossible dream.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_6.text:
I will slay all demons of Hasla.
Only their deaths will fill this hole in my heart.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_7.text:
Another nightmare.
... It is time to return to the battlefield.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_8.text:
Confirming new module.
Activating personality module - code : R.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_6_9.text:
It's a dog-eat-dog - no, hero-eat-hero world!
If you can't stay in the game, don't you think it's about time you retire?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_BEARS_4.text:
Uwuh... Huh?
Can it be that I have finally acquired the intellectual capability
that has long been limited to the race of humans?
I am finally awake, uwuh!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_BEARS_5.text:
Better to remain dull and ignorant
than enlightened for a single season of bittersweet autumn. 
How to preserve my hard-won intelligence...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_BEARS_6.text:
What fools they are, the human race.
You shall all sacrifice to me offerings of the freshest and juiciest salmon!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_COUPLE_.text: What a stupid expression! THIS is the first thing I see on my arrival to the mundane world? Poor me!
Oh, what adorable little fairies! They won't even make a single morsel!
I dreamt a dream of yesterday... Walking the sea of stars that fade away...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_FOURWEE.text:
Monsters in the deep?
They're made-up stories. I'd like to see one if it exists.

Huhuhu... This power is intoxicating.
Is this how the 'Elder Sister of the Sea' feels all the time?

I-I can't move my hands or my fins.
Something is... in my head... Get... out...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_GG_4_1.text:
Look, I brought the marriage certificate!
Huh? This is supposed to be a Hero contract?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_GOGI_4_.text:
I can't understand why Daddy and the other fairies
refuse to see the outside world!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_GOGI_5_.text:
Go, my brave knight Almael!
Fly forward and fight!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_HU_LIMITED_GOGI_6_.text:
Hrrmph! Yes, bow before your mighty Queen of Fairies
as you rightfully should!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_1_11.text:
The Order can't teach me anything.
I want to go outside!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_1_5.text:
Siegfried is the only one in this wide world
to whom I can entrust my life.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_2_11.text:
That will teach those morons to think
before messing with the holy church ever again.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_3_11.text:
Saintess Maria...
If this means I can stand by your side...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_1.text:
It's... freezing...
The cold strangely seems to strike the top of my head.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_10.text:
R-0's replacement?
I'm a better model than her!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_11.text:
If you turn a blind eye to injustice,
what kind of justice are you fighting for?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_13.text:
Athena... You were the first person in my life
to treat me with kindness.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_14.text:
My friends!
We only have one life. So why not live it to the fullest?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_18.text:
Those blasted poachers.
I'll make them sorry that they ever ventured into these woods!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_19.text:
The full moon scares me...
Daddy, what do I do?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_2.text:
The 'mythical seas' that lie to the east!
One day, I will expand my kingdom to its borders
and see it with my very own eyes!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_20.text:
Ugh! I'm busy enough as it is!
Take your complaining elsewhere!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_21.text:
Hmm... I followed my teacher's advice,
but I don't think it was necessary for me to become a knight.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_22.text:
Father! I don't want to become a minister!
I hate reading!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_23.text:
Oho.
All that treasure will go wasted if it remains buried in the Sanctuary.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_24.text:
Number one idol Yuna enters the stage!
(You there! Production crew! Hurry up and move it!)

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_25.text:
Lady Victoria...
Allow me to fight by your side!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_26.text:
Is that all you can do, Thor?
Did I yield the throne... for this?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_28.text:
Ever since the day I saw that Colosseum tournament on TV,
I've wanted to become a gladiator!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_29.text: Hello there! Call me Shuwen. So you’re the Hero Captain who hired me, eh? That calls for introductions, especially if we’re to fight side-by-side for a long time! I personally believe that it’s important to know what kind of person your comrade is if you want to have a good workplace relationship. You agree with me, don’t you? I told you my name, now what else… At four stars I am fifteen years old. Oh, did I just say ‘four stars’? Please forget I ever said anything of the sort! Must have been out of my mind just now. I was specifically asked not to make any ‘meta-statements’ but I forgot for a moment back there. You know, breaking the fourth wall kind of thing? Anyway… Uh, and… My hobby is running, my favorite food is grilled chicken, and I don’t particularly dislike anything. I’m a simple kind of man, doesn’t take a lot to satisfy me. Favorite color blue, haven’t taken the MBTI test, and my motto is to be clear and concise and say only what needs to be said! There are some people who tell me I talk too much, but that can’t be true. I’m careful to say only what I need to. Never gossiped in my entire life. Sincerity is the most important thing to a man if he wishes to make a place for himself in the world and find friends who will last a lifetime. Sincere is how I treat my challengers when they come searching for a fight, too. Oh, I should have told you earlier that my specialty is martial arts. I don’t want to be vain but I’ve been known for my strength ever since I was a teeny lad in a countryside village, and I was in charge of dealing with the invading monsters which I did without much trouble. That led to me meeting ol’ Drunken Fist and training under him – Drunken Fist was the local drunkard but he was also a great fighter… And well as you’ve already signed my contract, I’ll see you soon in my ‘story menu’! Ah, was this another one of those ‘meta-statements’?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_3.text:
Hahaha! No weapon in the world
can leave a scratch on me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_30.text:
Young man, the only weapon befitting a man
is his own two fists.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_31.text:
A new religion worshipping 'El Thalnos'?
That is heresy.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_32.text:
No, no, no... This tail... These horns...
I'm turning into one of those dirty demons!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_33.text:
Nothing puts a bad taste in one's mouth
like a tall-tale kid who lives off his daddy's name!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_35.text:
Where am I... Who am I...?
I cannot remember anything
save my own name...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_36.text: If you can feel the beat, you're welcome to join me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_4.text:
I may be a pirate, but I am a pirate who serves
the kingdom of Valencia!
I don't attack vessels that belong to our kingdom!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_5.text:
You shall not lay a finger
on Siegfried.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_6.text:
Hasla... What a strange dimension.
How can the weak dominate the strong?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_7.text:
This demonic power...
could be the key.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_8.text:
Good, the complete Sentinel
should be able to treat all formerly incurable diseases!
That should win me an award or two, right? Heehee.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_4_9.text:
What greater tragedy is there
than the fate of a small kingdom endlessly ravaged by war?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_1.text:
This helm... Sob...
Thank you, my dear people of Nosgard.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_10.text:
That arrogant android...
I received two updates, too! I'll show her how good I've become!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_11.text:
I became a knight
for Saintess Maria!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_12.text:
You're the first boy who hit me with an arrow!
That means something special, right?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_13.text:
Lady Athena,
I will protect you until the end of my days.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_14.text:
The laws of war are dictated not only by victory,
but by our code of honor.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_18.text:
A summon from the Royal Guards?
Now that's an honor! I'll have to hurry to the capital!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_19.text:
That monster in the dark...
She feels familiar, for some reason.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_2.text:
Now that I've entrusted my kingdom to reliable vassals,
it's time for me to fulfill an old dream of mine.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_20.text:
Huh? A monster broke in and stole all the food?
That's it! I'm giving it a taste of my cleaver!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_21.text:
Thanks to that child of an emperor,
I've reached the eastern end of the world.
I want to retire now but... I'm not sure he'll let me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_22.text:
I'll single-handedly win a battle...
And then maybe Father will finally approve of me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_23.text:
There's no treasure here, only weird ice ghosts.
... Huh?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_24.text:
Surrender, or else!
What do I mean by 'else,' you ask?
Well... Do you want to find out?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_25.text:
Lady Victoria's gaze was the only reason
I could bear my flag on the battlefield without fear.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_26.text:
Nosgard must stand alone.
Only then can we achieve true greatness.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_28.text:
Sigh... I succeeded in becoming a gladiator,
but I sometimes wonder whether it's my true calling.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_29.text: Hello there! Call me Shuwen. So you’re the Hero Captain who hired me, eh? That calls for introductions, especially if we’re to fight side-by-side for a long time! I personally believe that it’s important to know what kind of person your comrade is if you want to have a good workplace relationship. You agree with me, don’t you? I told you my name, now what else… At five stars I am thirty years old. Oh, did I just say ‘five stars’? Please forget I ever said anything of the sort! Must have been out of my mind just now. I was specifically asked not to make any ‘meta-statements’ but I forgot for a moment back there. You know, breaking the fourth wall kind of thing? Anyway… Uh, and… My hobby is running, my favorite food is grilled chicken, and I don’t particularly dislike anything. I’m a simple kind of man, doesn’t take a lot to satisfy me. Favorite color blue, haven’t taken the MBTI test, and my motto is to be clear and concise and say only what needs to be said! There are some people who tell me I talk too much, but that can’t be true. I’m careful to say only what I need to. Never gossiped in my entire life. Sincerity is the most important thing to a man if he wishes to make a place for himself in the world and find friends who will last a lifetime. Sincere is how I treat my challengers when they come searching for a fight, too. Oh, I should have told you earlier that my specialty is martial arts. I don’t want to be vain but I’ve been known for my strength ever since I was a teeny lad in a countryside village, and I was in charge of dealing with the invading monsters which I did without much trouble. That led to me meeting ol’ Drunken Fist and training under him – Drunken Fist was the local drunkard but he was also a great fighter… And well as you’ve already signed my contract, I’ll see you soon in my ‘story menu’! Ah, was this another one of those ‘meta-statements’?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_3.text:
Victory is mine!
Soldiers, follow my lead!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_30.text:
Hmm. Let's see how far you've come
from that sniveling little boy, Achilles.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_31.text:
T-they may have strayed from the light,
but they're still the sisters I've prayed with for years.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_32.text:
It's a lie! I haven't lost my divine powers!
I... I can't be a demon!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_33.text:
Gotta say, Boss, you're a man who knows his deal.
I can't find a reason to refuse your offer of becoming sworn brothers.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_35.text:
That emblem... That face...
He bears a strong resemblance to my friend and trusty vassal.
They even smell similar.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_36.text: Welcome to the Forest of Spirits, where one can dance and sing with joy for all eternity!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_4.text:
Hmm... A duchy title?
For someone who spends all his time on his ship,
it seems quite a useless offer.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_6.text:
Your gilded pride doesn't interest me.
I only seek a good fight with the strong!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_7.text:
My kingdom of Trista.
Your rightful prince has returned!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_8.text:
You stupid, smelly old man!
What did you turn MY Sentinel into?
I won't forgive you!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_5_9.text:
Your Majesty,
I shall repay your kindness with victory on the battlefield.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_1.text:
To protect my proud and noble people,
I will gladly bear this shining stigma.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_10.text:
R-0...! The more I think about you,
the harder it becomes to control... my... anger!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_11.text:
The path of light is the only way -
Wait! Saintess Maria! Where are you wandering off to?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_12.text:
Mister Crow,
please take me to my boyfriend!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_13.text:
The seal of Manacar has been broken.
If we don't stop it in time, Roman will fall in grave danger...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_14.text:
The Saintess of the Battlefield? An excessive epithet.
Please call me Athena.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_15.text:
It seems I woke up during chaotic times.
I sleep no more. It is time to raise my spear
and return to the battlefield.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_18.text:
Another poacher? Didn't they learn their lesson? Wolfgang
shall teach them again and again that they're not welcome here!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_19.text:
These shackles helped me to overcome my fear.
Is it too late to thank that alchemist...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_2.text:
The one who rules over the mythical seas of the East
refuses to let me look upon its waters.
Then I shall return to my life as the emperor of this land.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_20.text:
Whether you're a human or a monster,
you'll have to think twice if you don't want to end up deep fried!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_21.text:
Welcome to the Iron Hand Workshop. I'll make you a companion
that will fight with you for the rest of your lives.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_22.text: Father! Did you see me? Did you see what I did?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_23.text:
Centuries have already passed...?
B-but... What about my family? My friends?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_24.text:
I should have thrown away my act a LONG time ago.
It feels good to say what's on my mind!
Hey, you! Get lost before I beat you up, loser!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_25.text:
Lady Victoria, I will be guarding the Cobalt Knights
until your return.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_26.text:
Thor... Renounce the throne, you coward.
If you cannot do it, I, Odin of Nosgard,
shall restore glory to our snow-laden kingdom.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_28.text:
Never mind, winning is the best!
As expected of Achilles. He knows something!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_29.text: Hello there! Call me Shuwen. So you’re the Hero Captain who hired me, eh? That calls for introductions, especially if we’re to fight side-by-side for a long time! I personally believe that it’s important to know what kind of person your comrade is if you want to have a good workplace relationship. You agree with me, don’t you? I told you my name, now what else… At six stars I am sixty years old. Oh, did I just say ‘six stars’? Please forget I ever said anything of the sort! Must have been out of my mind just now. I was specifically asked not to make any ‘meta-statements’ but I forgot for a moment back there. You know, breaking the fourth wall kind of thing? Anyway… Uh, and… My hobby is running, my favorite food is grilled chicken, and I don’t particularly dislike anything. I’m a simple kind of man, doesn’t take a lot to satisfy me. Favorite color blue, haven’t taken the MBTI test, and my motto is to be clear and concise and say only what needs to be said! There are some people who tell me I talk too much, but that can’t be true. I’m careful to say only what I need to. Never gossiped in my entire life. Sincerity is the most important thing to a man if he wishes to make a place for himself in the world and find friends who will last a lifetime. Sincere is how I treat my challengers when they come searching for a fight, too. Oh, I should have told you earlier that my specialty is martial arts. I don’t want to be vain but I’ve been known for my strength ever since I was a teeny lad in a countryside village, and I was in charge of dealing with the invading monsters which I did without much trouble. That led to me meeting ol’ Drunken Fist and training under him – Drunken Fist was the local drunkard but he was also a great fighter… And well as you’ve already signed my contract, I’ll see you soon in my ‘story menu’! Ah, was this another one of those ‘meta-statements’?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_3.text:
So I'm not invincible after all.
Huh. I've had a few close calls
that could have ended VERY badly...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_30.text: Ugh... My back is acting up again...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_31.text:
The current Order has been corrupted.
The true path of light lies elsewhere.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_32.text:
How many people have I sacrificed due to my blindness...?
I must repent - until the day I die...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_33.text:
I've been doing this for far too long.
Maybe it's time to reconsider that retirement plan.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_35.text:
Ah... Elder Edda.
I will finally rebuild the city
I have so long been dreaming of.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_4.text:
Hrrmph. I've had my share of life on land.
I won't set another foot on firm ground
until the day death takes me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_6.text:
Hasla is a good place.
Many come begging to be beaten up!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_7.text:
Abel...
So you still dwell among the living.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_8.text: I'm receiving Sentinel's signals from 'this timeline'...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_6_9.text:
The Five Tiger Generals will be back, someday.
Until then, I shall postpone our match.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_4_1.text: Hmm, I may be better with my spear than I thought.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_5_1.text:
Day after day... I will strive
to become a general worthy of being recorded in history.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_6_1.text:
Hong-Ran...
Finally, I found a companion with similar aspirations.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_APFOOL_.text:
What world have I arrived at this time?
I only hope they won't bother an old lady like me too much.

Hmm. This reminds me of when I defeated
that evil what's-his-name in the other dimension.

I can sense that 'goddess' around here somewhere...
Did she not die?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_GG_4_2.text:
Okay, I'm still confused about a few things, but...
I won't hold back!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_LIMITED_LASTSOU.text:
Wah... What's 'revenge'?
Gimme fertilizer! Me hungry!

Kekeke... Tremble in fear,
witches of Pumpkin City!

The wrath of the pumpkin patch...
gives me endless power...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_UNIQUE_5_UMRAT.text:
Name... Knowledge... All things that I lost...
I desire more. I desire them again...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PA_UNIQUE_6_UMRAT.text: The strength of Habaek... It is finally mine.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_1_11.text:
Why won't adults believe me
when I tell them about the black ghost?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_1_2.text:
Isn't it only natural to help your neighbors?
Don't thank me; I only did what I should!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_2_11.text:
I can't let anyone know about my true powers.
I... I can't trust anyone.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_2_2.text:
If you ever need help,
come visit me at my chapel!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_3_11.text: Can my powers... save those in need?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_3_2.text: I can reach out to more people this way!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_11.text:
Demona... and my 'evil powers.'
The Order of the Goddess... Is it only what it claims to be?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_13.text: If looks could kill, I'd been executed a long time ago.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_14.text:
Lionel... You're not a kid anymore.
Do I really have to scold you for running away from home?
