TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_16.text:
... I'm not a child anymore, Sien.
I can take care of myself.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_17.text:
Woah, there are so many interesting things on 'land'!
I wish I could go and take a look.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_18.text:
I'll be the knight to bring some life
to this dull city of Elandia!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_19.text: I wonder what the Flower Fields of the Heavens will be like?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_2.text:
I don't know much about being a Saintess,
but I'll do my best!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_20.text:
... I'm only a small squirrel shikigami.
The human world is too complicated for me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_21.text:
Hasla will soon fall in danger...
We have to... Zzz...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_22.text:
I ONLY came on this student exchange program
because Neth produces the highest quality computers.
So would you please leave me alone?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_23.text:
Heim... I'm not sure it's a good idea
to be treasure hunting in the Sanctuary...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_24.text:
Being TOO lucky takes out the fun out of most things.
Is there nothing that will give me some challenge?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_25.text:
The judging eyes of other people
frighten me much more than the attacks of monsters.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_26.text:
An old book...
Why is it so alluring?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_27.text:
My artistic soul that I once gave up
is burning brightly again!!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_29.text:
Cano, you shouldn't be so full of yourself
just because you can sing a little.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_3.text:
This new life that has been given to me by Saintess Maria...
I will dedicate it to others.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_30.text:
If only I could further develop
the potency of the mandragora plant...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_31.text:
Sob... Everyone is so mean.
I'm not being weak on purpose!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_32.text:
'The Complete Tome of Alchemy'?
The author sure seems proud of themselves. I like it!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_33.text:
I'm way too cool for school.
I'm already the perfect hero!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_35.text:
I'm Hera, the new Senator of Olympian Council!
I'll do my best to fulfill my duties!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_4.text:
I can't let anyone know my true identity
before I become a real human.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_5.text:
Oh, I'm not a suspicious person at all!
Just your average, run-of-the-mill nurse here.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_7.text:
The prophecy of the gods?
I refuse. I want to become a general!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_8.text:
Those idiots don't understand the greatness of my work!
But that other man... He will see the genius in me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_4_9.text:
Grandpa's noodle recipe is too delicious
for me to let it disappear like this!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_1.text: Nya?! Can it be true? I've turned into a cat-human, nya!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_10.text:
Not dancing and keeping still while closing your eyes and saying 'ohm'
is interesting, too!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_11.text:
The Order is the one walking the path of evil.
I must leave to find my own justice.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_12.text:
To banish all demons
from this continent of Hasla...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_13.text:
Athena... You're the first person in my life
to resist my charming good looks!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_14.text:
Sigh... There's no stopping you, Lionel.
I'll help you. Let's go together.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_15.text: I can no longer watch the fall of my own savior.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_16.text:
... I can't let the sole meaning of my life
fade into the darkness like that.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_17.text:
Help! I'm thirsty... hungry...
Please, someone give me something to eat...
... Blegh...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_18.text:
Hnn... It's much more fun watching other people train
than actually training...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_19.text:
I can't let a flower wilt before my eyes
simply because I'm searching for a field of my dreams.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_2.text:
If you ever need help to fight back evil,
you can rely on me anytime.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_20.text:
I wonder if there are rules about shikigami
summoning other shikigami?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_21.text:
If nobody agrees to believe me,
I'll just take another nap...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_22.text:
Hmm. How strange, this classified file restricts all form of access.
Okay, I gotta get in. Can't resist a challenge!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_23.text: I knew I had a bad feeling about this!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_24.text:
I thought so: all bark and no bite.
Even the famous 'Spade Queen' should be no different!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_25.text:
Echidna.
You shouldn't listen to suspicious strangers.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_26.text:
I can feel the gaze of the Abyss.
Please, o wise book, impart to me knowledge of the darkness...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_27.text: The whole city is my canvas!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_29.text:
Tsk. I didn't want to make my debut
as a third-rate popstar's backing vocalist... but I have no choice.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_3.text:
Even if the horrors of war blind us to the truth...
We must seek out the light.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_30.text:
I only wanted for everyone to get a chance
to enjoy Royal Beans together.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_31.text:
Sansami, huh. We're similar, you and me.
I won't eat you. Go wherever you want.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_32.text:
Here you go: Lazie's All-Purpose Potion!
Success or Great Success guaranteed! No such thing as failure!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_33.text: So this... This is the true power of the ring!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_35.text:
I wish for a world
where no one gets hurt or sick.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_4.text:
Would he be happy as well,
if I succeed in becoming a human?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_5.text:
You should dedicate yourself to your mission  - agent work or otherwise.
I'm going to become a top nurse, too!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_7.text:
The heir of Kurenai...
I have no interest in such a vain and vague title.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_8.text:
Would the pupil have achieved anything
if not for their teacher's guidance?
That's why I'll be borrowing Sentinel for some time, Stanya!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_5_9.text:
Mr. Baek's cooking competition? Winner receives a food truck
fully equipped with Neth appliances? This is it!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_10.text:
My happiness lies in adventure, song, and dance -
not in mediating at a temple!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_11.text:
The Black Order is open to all Devils
and any who suffer under the power of the darkness.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_12.text:
A century has passed,
yet evil still remains in these lands.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_13.text:
All beautiful things have thorns.
And it seems like yours have pricked me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_14.text:
Edenberg.
That's where your destiny awaits, Lionel.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_15.text:
Our roads may have diverged,
but I know we once dreamt of the same future.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_16.text: Sien... Where did you disappear to?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_17.text:
I want to show that 'red-haired human'
my gratitude!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_18.text:
Welcome to Elandia, the Holy Capital of Hasla!
I'll give you a tour around the city!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_19.text:
Close your eyes and breathe in.
Can you smell the scent of this white flower without a name?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_2.text:
The Goddess has decreed
for me to cleanse this land of all darkness.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_20.text: Yuki... That shikigami was you all along?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_21.text:
The nun I met in my dreams...
She was pretty.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_22.text:
Huh? A list of club members?
Booooring. ...Or... I could tweak this a little to stir things up.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_25.text:
Why are you trying
to return to a cruel and dangerous world?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_26.text:
As the darkest Abyss wills it,
I shall depart for pilgrimage.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_27.text:
This is tyranny!
Give me back my friends!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_29.text: Erm, Cano? About that last time we performed... I-I-I'm... sor-

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_30.text:
A gigantic plant?
Sounds fascinating! I'm on my way!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_31.text:
Sob... Humans burnt down my mountain.
Is there no other mountain saint to help me?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_32.text:
Stupid nobles! My potions are perfect,
but they can't heal stupidity!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_33.text:
As if I'd let a mere ring control my fans!
I'm in charge here, and I mean to keep it that way!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_35.text: Zeus, thanks for helping me out every time!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_5.text:
Maybe my calling in life
was to become a nurse, not a spy...?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_6.text:
One can only cultivate oneself through fine music and literature.
Would you like me to recommend a book for you?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_7.text:
Becoming a priestess
is no reason to stop one's training.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_8.text:
Muhahaha! It's... ALIVE!
I only have to gather and register more test data! AND I discovered
a dimensional portal in the process. I knew I was a genius!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_6_9.text:
Grandpa! I won!
I won the competition with your recipe!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_APFOOL_.text:
Oi, is this one of those 'isekai reincarnations'
that you always hear about? Noice!

Yeah! I'll take over this otherworld with my ultimate cheats!
This is how it should go!

Something doesn't feel right. Did I do something wrong?
And this world kinda sucks. Like it's half-made.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_AUTO_4_.text: Christmas is a lie created by an ethically repulsive company!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_AUTO_5_.text:
Ugh... I was so close!
I guess this is why a good reputation is important...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_AUTO_6_.text:
You're on my 'naughty' list!
Have a lump of coal!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_AUTUMN_.text:
Huh, I picked up a human girl!
What should I do with her?

I'm 'Kaede the Ninja'! 
Don't worry! I'll keep you safe!

I-I need to confess something. I'm actually a raccoon in disguise!
I'm sorry for lying to you all this time!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_EAST_4_.text:
Frederick!
I'll save you, I promise!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_EAST_5_.text:
It hurts...
But I can't give up, not now.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_EAST_6_.text:
Chamber of Blessing? Hypocrites.
I'll show them the true darkness within their own hearts.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMITED_GG_4_1.text: Come on, tell me that you want me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_LIMTED_SEVENTH_.text: One day, I'll become a great gladiator like Dad!
I'll be right there! One Chocolat's Chocolate Donut Set coming right up!
A new recipe, a new me! Let's continue doing our best, Captain!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_UNIQUE_4_ELLIE.text:
You're my favorite person in the whole world, Captain!
That's why... you're my 'darling'!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_UNIQUE_5_ELLIE.text:
Please tell Prestina that I'm sorry.
Thank you for everything, darling!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_PR_UNIQUE_6_ELLIE.text:
A dream of a giant bird...
Darling, I knew we would meet again.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_1_1.text:
Leave everything to me, THE great Leon!
... Well, everything except carrying fragile objects.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_1_11.text:
More years of service?
By the Goddess, no.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_2_1.text:
An ogre in the forest?
Won't be a match for me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_2_11.text:
Time is slow to pass in the army.
And where could be the ladylove of my dreams?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_3_1.text:
You've heard the songs singing my praise, right?
I'm famous, if you haven't noticed!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_3_11.text:
D'Artagnan...
I have finally found the lady of my destiny,
to whom I may sacrifice my life to be used as she sees fit!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_1.text:
Let's go back to basics, Leon.
Being a Hero should be about helping people, not fame and riches.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_10.text:
If I don't want to lose my body to evil spirits,
I'll need to find a cure.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_11.text:
An eye for the love of my lady?
Not a bad deal at all, I must say.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_12.text: The seas of this kingdom lie under my watch.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_13.text:
Talent before bloodline.
The people shall realize before long.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_14.text:
The sins of my ancestors of the House of Ferdinand
is my burden to bear, my repentance.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_15.text:
I am so sleepy...
Yet I can't sleep...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_16.text:
Faust! It's such a nice day outside -
come on, let's go on a picnic! Your research can wait!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_17.text:
Muhahahaha! You weaklings! I will kill every last one of you!
... That sounds too cruel, doesn't it?
Acting the part of villain is difficult.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_18.text:
Ghosts do not care
for the woes of the living.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_19.text:
Cowards.
What's so scary about humans?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_2.text:
I must become a knight,
for I must restore honor to my family's name.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_20.text:
Ares... Ares...!
May you rot in hell!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_21.text:
Oh, Set!
Stop bothering Osiris so much!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_22.text:
'Not meant to lead'? 'Don't have the leadership'?
We'll see about that!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_23.text:
Ah, a foe worthy of the blade of Einherjar.
You shall raise my glory.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_24.text:
Oh, Professor. For a genius like me,
this seal is child's play.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_25.text:
Sorry, Sfera!
But it's so boring here, without any friends!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_26.text:
Simcheong~!
Fetch me a glass of water! I may die of thirst if I wait any longer!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_27.text:
Maybe Thjalfi will finally acknowledge my presence
when I bring back treasure from this expedition.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_29.text:
Ooh, the holy sword of Elanuma!
I wish I was the knight destined for it.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_3.text:
Serves them right
for calling me 'commoner scum'!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_30.text:
Is it not obvious I'm superior to everyone else?
I deserve to be crowned the next emperor.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_31.text:
It is my duty to guard the throne
until the return of the rightful king.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_32.text:
Sigh... What has gotten into me?
This anger that overcomes me... It doesn't seem normal.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_33.text:
Erm, everyone?
Please stop fussing over me so much!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_34.text:
I-it's rude to ask about a lady's past!
Everyone is bound to have some secrets they'd rather not tell!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_35.text:
Wolfgang, was it?
What is the secret to your might and valor?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_36.text: I'll become strong. Strong enough not to lose anyone ever again.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_4.text:
Can't believe Dad would actually kick me out.
I mean, it's not like I have to get a job! Sheesh.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_6.text: I wonder if Hikari's doing alright.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_8.text:
Alisha...
Do you know how I feel for you?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_4_9.text:
My father, who abandoned my mother...
I shall abandon my father and his ways.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_1.text:
I won't avoid the hardships that come my way.
I'll face my destiny as a Hero!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_10.text:
No... With my own hands...
No...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_11.text:
You underestimate
the years behind my blade.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_12.text: You are too kind to call me thus.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_13.text:
Today's victory belongs to us all,
for we fought as one.
Isn't that right, Caeneus?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_14.text:
Aria...
Sometimes, I can't see the path I must take.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_15.text:
I must find the witch
who cursed me with this eternal insomnia.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_17.text:
Hmm... You get a lot of attention even as a henchman.
Hey! Erm, stupid humans! Look at me! Pretty please?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_18.text:
That Death Messenger is proving to be
quite troublesome these days.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_19.text:
A human pupil, huh?
She won't last a week, not under my watch.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_2.text:
Until when must I hide my true self
under a heavy coat of armor?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_20.text:
The ecstasy of battle and bloodshed...
No, must... resist...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_21.text:
Set is an idiot.
Who else would take care of Osiris if not for me?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_22.text:
Sigh... I never knew living on your own could be so expensive.
I could hunt down wanted criminals for the money...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_23.text:
Nothing is more important
than the traditions of the Einherjar.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_24.text:
The wisdom this blade whispers to me...!
It is a whole world unveiled before your eyes!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_25.text:
Woah, Elf Mask!
Take me with you!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_26.text:
H-hmm? Sermon of the Enlightened Otter?
I don't need any se-
Ack! Get your hands off me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_27.text: No! I need to return to my brother!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_28.text:
Everything is gone.
Even my own memories...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_29.text:
The Order of Lion has changed.
Am I still fighting for true justice?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_3.text:
It's not enough being strong...
I must learn ways of the court if I want to help our Priestess.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_30.text: Victoria... That idiot of a girl...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_31.text:
The throne is not mine to claim.
The true king... shall return someday.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_32.text:
Hahaha!
The glory of the battlefield all belongs to me, the great Ares!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_34.text:
Sob...
I'm not even making minimum wage.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_35.text:
Hahaha!
I will crack open your skulls like tiny bird eggs!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_36.text: I'll prove myself with these bare fists!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_4.text:
I go through that hell of training, only to come home to...
'Sorry, kiddo, gone on vacation'? Are you kidding me?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_5.text:
Battle data transfer complete.
Activating cloned battle modules.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_6.text:
Stop talking behind my back!
If you have a problem with me, say it to my face!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_8.text:
Nazrune's plan of uniting the two clans is the only road to peace.
I must become the chieftain of my tribe if I wish to fulfill it.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_5_9.text:
It is time to shed my dark life
of the shadows that haunt it.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_1.text:
I'll strike fear in the hearts of my enemies
and bring new hope for humankind!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_10.text: Necron... I will never forgive you!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_11.text:
The symbol of victory?
I would rather keep my lady's love.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_12.text:
None shall defeat me on the high seas,
no matter who they are.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_13.text:
As the representative of the Central Knights,
I shall bear myself with honor and pride.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_14.text:
The Fortress of Souls - and Soltar.
It is time to cut these times of ill fate once and for all.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_15.text:
Loviatar... Until your return,
I shall protect these woods as the second Witch of the Forest.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_17.text:
Oh! Gacha Rangers!
My adversaries! It's so nice to see you guys again!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_18.text:
As unreal as it seems,
being the descendant of the Ghost King feels no different from before.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_19.text:
If all humans were like you, Dorothy,
we devils wouldn't have suffered so much.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_2.text:
With a steely heart and a sharp mind,
I shall serve you, milord.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_20.text:
I'll accept my lot -
and cut everything down!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_21.text:
Under the Rosetta Stone's guidance,
I'll protect you two!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_22.text:
Money! Glory! Cool swordsmanship!
I don't want to become a boring old clan master anyway.
I'm going to be famous, you'll see!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_23.text:
I will teach those two Snorrisons
a lesson on true fear.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_24.text:
At last, this human body is mine to use...
I can properly serve my master now!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_25.text:
Oh, Sfera. Humans aren't as dangerous as you think.
They squeal like piglets before a couple of snakes.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_26.text:
Pretending to be blind is difficult...
Don't say anything to my daughter. She'll kill me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_27.text: You're joking. What do you mean, centuries have passed?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_28.text:
The glorious lineage of the sun god's
thousand-year-old kingdom continues to this day.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_29.text:
The holy sword doesn't mean anything by itself.
I know that I'm walking the true path of light, by my own will.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_3.text:
I will cut down
any who dares to corrupt our kingdom of Ryu.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_30.text:
No... No...!
It isn't over...! I will return, one day!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_31.text:
Lionel...
Can he be the one that I have been waiting for?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_32.text: If I can only atone for my crimes...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_34.text:
L-Lord Gordian called me back!
I'm not unemployed anymore! I-I need to get my armor back, too...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_35.text:
The future of Nosgard
needs no weaklings.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_36.text: I will find that scoundrel who turned me into this monstrous machine - and make them pay!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_4.text:
So... This is the story of my life, huh. Becoming the 'Absolute Devil'
without getting a single drop of blood on my sword.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_5.text:
Battle data 'file_1-1_final_final_06' transfer complete.
Activating code: Monte Cristo.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_6.text: Oh, are you here to sign up for the kendo club?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_8.text: Alisha... I shall avenge your death.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_6_9.text:
I have accepted the darkness within my heart
to slay the darkness without.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_COUPLE_.text: These skies are unfamiliar to me. Where must I go?
Can you feel it? The silent will of these lands.
The forgotten past, the forthcoming future... All shall return to dust by my hands.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_FOURWEE.text:
Huh? Why're you staring at me?
You wanna piece of me?
So, this is the potion that will turn me into a human...

Okay, I call it quits.
When is Habaek going to return?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG3_4_B.text:
I humbly ask, I humbly ask:
though 'tis sudden, where doth lie Hell?
Whilst the demons laugh, the people weep.
Since it doth lie outside the bounds of virtuous deeds,
I shall undertake the task of felling the Netherworld.
For I am a vulgar samurai of lowest rank.
I have no intent of dying the honorable death of a warrior.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG4_4_0.text: Oh… is this where I say my line?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_1.text:
I shall show you
why I am called 'faith'!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_2.text: Whatever. Hope you've said your prayers.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_3.text: Oh, you won't bore me at all.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_GG_4_4.text:
I'll warn you now...
I'M PERFECT!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_LASTSOU.text:
Oh...
My precious pumpkins...What have they done...?

Get out of my pumpkin patch!
Stop ruining everything!

Beware... I will show you the wrath
of my beloved pumpkins!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_SPR_4_T.text:
Ana Heinkel.
I won't let you have your evil ways.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMITED_SPR_6_T.text: The time for the final battle has arrived, Ana.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMTED_FOURTH_4.text:
Maria...
I've finally become a real knight.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMTED_FOURTH_5.text:
Strange occurences around Hero Town...
This may lead to trouble for the entire kingdom fo Grancia.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_LIMTED_FOURTH_6.text:
Ah, welcome. You must be the new Hero Captain.
I have heard much of your prowess on the battlefield.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_SUPPORT_5_1.text:
I can't die in a place like this.
I need to return home...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_UNIQUE_4_JARYON.text:
In order to serve my country,
I must grow stronger.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_UNIQUE_4_RAEL.text:
My ambitions lie far higher
than a young margrave of the kingdom.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_UNIQUE_5_JARYON.text:
Virtue on the battlefield can only be reached
through efficient, quick battles that minimize death and suffering.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_UNIQUE_5_RAEL.text:
Lionel... I won't let a bastard like you
steal my rightful honor.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_UNIQUE_6_JARYON.text: The darkness that plagues this kingdom...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WA_UNIQUE_6_RAEL.text: I will serve you, true king of Valencia.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_1_11.text:
After this year, I won't have time to sing.
I need to study for my college entrance exams!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_1_3.text: I want to learn more about mana.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_2_11.text: I wonder if the Magic Academy has a band?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_2_3.text:
I learned everything I can from these books
I borrowed from the library. I want to know more!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_3_11.text:
Me, pretty?
Haha, you're so funny!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_3_3.text:
Pumpkin City...
Will I be able to quench my thirst for knowledge there?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_1.text:
The voices are growing louder.
They keep telling me to... go to Valencia... to the Fortress of Souls?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_10.text:
Fools.
The truth lies in the darkness.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_11.text:
Me, a popstar...?
I'm just an ordinary girl!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_12.text:
Those cakes are too sweet! They aren't good for you!
My bread, on the other hand...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_13.text:
O Goddess who guides me,
your servant shall judge the pagans to their dooms!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_14.text:
What a greedy, proud race.
They will serve me well in my plans.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_15.text: If only I could be as agile and sneaky as a cat...!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_16.text:
Yawn...
Let me return to my nap...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_17.text:
Viola won't be lonely
if I make her a magically moving doll, right?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_18.text:
This... stupid... flame...! When is it going to disappear?
I'm going to study hard and get rid of it someday!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_19.text:
The path of learning
is open to everyone.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_2.text: Death angel? I'm sure that's only an urban legend.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_20.text:
What once is, will be not.
The symbol on my back shall fade away, one day.
Friends, will you not allow me into the village?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_21.text:
What led us to forget our ancient heritage?
Why do we continue to wander without a home?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_22.text:
Ooh, aah. How boring, how wrong.
A tribe of friendly neighbors and loving friends?
Where's the jealousy? The resentment and the accusations?
TIME TO START THE SHOW!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_23.text:
Ethereal magic?
Well, I guess I need SOMETHING to do.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_24.text:
We must not let anything divide us, the tribe of the Winter Wind,
for a sacred duty has been entrusted to us.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_25.text:
The work of guiding souls beyond death
belongs to us death angels, Saintess of Roman!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_26.text:
Who did it? Who was the one
who beat up Daddy and stole our entire fortune?!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_28.text:
Why are your eyes red? Why are you dripping in red water?
I want to know. Can I be like you when I grow up?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_29.text:
I have trained for only one goal:
assassinating the Emperor.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_3.text:
In order to learn Dark Magic,
I have to master the four elementals first.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_30.text:
Everyone should have one perfect set of clothes
that was made only for them.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_31.text:
My own genius frightens me at times.
I'm sure Professor Loviatar will love me, too!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_32.text:
... Reading this book...
empties my head of all other thoughts.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_33.text:
The plants of my forest must be perfect.
I'll keep every last one of you green all year round.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_34.text: 'Another' Hasla, huh. Huhu... I wonder what 'I' am doing in this dimension?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_35.text: Your pain is my own. I hope you remember that.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_4.text: What kind of tricks should I play today?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_5.text: Ohoho... What a sprightly young fellow.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_6.text:
Everyone is so mean to me...
But you're not, Vivian. That's why I love you the best!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_7.text:
I play today, I'll play tomorrow.
Super Fighting Cards is the only game for me.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_8.text:
Only harmony with nature
shall allow us to survive in these harsh lands.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_4_9.text:
I met someone - fresh and pretty, like a spring blossom.
I will restore honor to my family
so that I may court her without shame.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_1.text:
An army of cursed souls... I've seen that before.
I've been here before.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_10.text:
This beautiful massacre...
This bloodshed! The beginning of my life's work!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_11.text: In the name of love and justice! All evil, watch out!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_12.text:
Grr... I can't lose to that Chocolat.
I must think of healthier recipes!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_13.text:
Victoria, Victoria, Victoria!
You're my one and only Goddess!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_14.text:
Again, a complete failure.
Such an incomplete body would never be enough...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_15.text:
This is it, nya! This feline coordination was just what I needed!
... Although I hadn't been expecting this side effect
of ending most of my sentences with 'nya,' nya.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_16.text:
Dorothy... She's very persistent...
Perhaps she will leave me alone if I teach her...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_17.text:
The magic dolls are complete,
but the village...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_18.text:
Sigh... What are these ears? And these arms?
I can't even control them.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_19.text:
Beware, all evil!
None shall escape the never-sleeping eyes of the Night Witches!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_2.text:
Guide the dead?
Uh, this is a little abrupt.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_20.text:
Everything depends on your mindset...
As for me, I THINK my stomach doesn't hurt... I believe it not to hurt...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_21.text:
I thought the Temple of Anubisis would yield some answers,
but I see that I was wrong.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_22.text:
... B-OOOO-RING!!
I'll have to take you OUT OF THE GAME!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_23.text:
Sigh... Training is a little better than studying,
but it's still not a 'real' life. I need to go out and see the world!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_24.text:
Could it be true, the prophecy of the Great Oracle?
Is it truly the will of the gods?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_25.text:
When the time comes for me to call your name,
you shall have no choice but to follow me to the afterlife.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_26.text:
... I never knew money was a factor
for other people's opinion of you.
Everything is that thief's fault!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_28.text:
My life?
Come and take it from me - if you can.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_29.text:
The art of face-changing is no trivial trick.
One requires not only speed but also accuracy.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_3.text:
The Four Great Witches of Pumpkin City
will guide me in my studies!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_30.text:
Morgan... He's meaner than the rumors had him.
This order could be my chance to impart him a lesson.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_31.text:
Professor! My thesis is finally complete!
Could you - huh?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_32.text:
Relationships with other human beings are too complicated...
All I need is this book.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_33.text:
Even the best botanist in Hasla becomes blind with jealousy
before my talent!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_34.text: Grandpa actually liked you in this dimension, huh, Levine?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_35.text: She was no different from the rest of them. ... My own sister. I was foolish to trust her.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_36.text: ... And I didn't even get her name.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_4.text:
I never asked for this! How do you get them off?
Someone, please help!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_5.text:
Sigh... I need more mana than this.
Perhaps the young witches of my home can give their elder a hand.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_6.text:
I want to become a Succubus,
but I'm not so comfortable standing in front of other people...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_7.text:
To game or not to game,
that is the question.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_8.text:
To face the dangers of the future,
we must stand united.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_5_9.text:
Is this my limit?
No... I cannot give up
if I am to see her again!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_1.text:
I remember everything, now.
My sacred duty...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_10.text:
Idiots...
Become food for my ghoul.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_11.text: Music is love! So sing with me!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_12.text:
I have to develop a better variety of wheat
in order to bake tastier bread!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_13.text:
Filthy maggots who dare crawl to my goddess!
You shall all receive your judgement!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_14.text:
Destiny cannot be foreseen.
It is one of the few things that cannot be calculated.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_15.text:
Nyanya...
Do you hear a dog barking somewhere, nya?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_16.text:
Mm... I thought I'd be getting some time by myself...
But something feels wrong...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_17.text:
No matter what happens,
I'll keep Viola safe.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_18.text:
I give up. At least I'll be able to use these powers
to help other people...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_19.text:
I will do anything
in order to protect Pumpkin City.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_2.text:
Okay, everybody!
Let's reap some souls!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_20.text:
Are you finally ready
to receive my teachings?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_21.text: The Temple of Illusions... and the Seeker of Truth.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_22.text:
It's so MARVELOUS how they continue to fight!
SIMPLY DIVINE! In all ironic senses of the word!
I'll make all of you SING AND DANCE in agony!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_24.text:
Where am I...?
Where is the Sanctuary... Where is my tribe?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_25.text:
The dead who dare to escape the bondage of death
will all be judged by my scythe.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_26.text: I found you at last! Momota- Gasp!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_28.text:
'The Ghost King'... I wonder if he can save me
from this deep and desperate loneliness.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_29.text:
Hahaha!
Your death has finally found you, Emperor!
I, Wang Dao, shall take your life!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_3.text: I only want to see how far magic can reach!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_30.text:
Oh, are you not satisfied with your new suit?
You don't mean to say... that you can't see it?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_31.text:
I'll guide the younger witches
so that they don't lose their way, like I once did.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_32.text:
You were lonely, too?
I'm you. You're me. We'll help each other.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_33.text:
Have I been mistaken all along?
My forest is dying...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_34.text: So, you call yourself a Hero Captain? Let me give you a short demonstration of my newest ultrasonic weapon. 'D-CAT' will break your heart and soul.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_35.text: Patience... Soon, soon shall I shatter this endless cycle of agony!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_36.text:
The situation is worse than I expected.
... Where did she go, Hanee Baram?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_4.text:
This strength... I was frightened of it in the beginning,
but I'm glad I accepted it. I couldn't have saved the village otherwise.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_5.text:
Ah... Delicious.
The Goddess of the Night has returned!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_6.text:
Welcome to the Succubus Troupe!
We'll give you another night of amazing performance!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_7.text:
This will show my old teacher
that you CAN make a name for yourself through playing games!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_8.text:
As one, the Tribe of the Frost Wolves
will overcome all.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_6_9.text:
I have achieved everything to be achieved - save one.
I know that she'll be waiting for me.
My sweet Arona...

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_AUTO_4_.text:
It's finally complete: 'Candy Delivery Magic'!
Now I can deliver candy to children
with more speed AND accuracy!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_AUTO_5_.text:
This should have never happened...
How could have my candy magic hurt a child?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_AUTO_6_.text:
Okay, let's depart, everyone,
and give all those children a happy, merry Christmas!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_AUTUMN_.text: I want nothing more than some peace and quiet.

That ninja, Kaede... She's a little strange,
but I don't think she means ill.

Thank you, Kaede.
We will always be together.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EAST_5_.text:
I think... I forgot something precious...
But I can't remember.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_EAST_6_.text:
I couldn't become...
what you wished for me to become.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG3_4_D.text:
I want to know.
Am I your enemy?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_GG_4_1.text: Dolls can't choose their own futures.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SIXTH_4.text:
The Temple of Illusions
always filled me with a sense of dread.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SIXTH_5.text: Father... Can we meet again, someday?

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SIXTH_6.text: Humans... They always repeat the same mistakes.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SPR_4_A.text: Hiosbruke belongs to me, Twillie of Tasitte!

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMITED_SPR_5_A.text:
Did you get scared, Twillie?
I shall take the western front.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMTED_FIFTH_5_.text:
A fragment of Pandora's emotions...
... I want to be something more.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_LIMTED_FIFTH_6_.text:
What is the meaning of life...?
Maybe I can find out - with you.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_4_LOVIAT.text:
Wolfram... I will become stronger,
so that I may protect other children from a fate like mine.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_5_LOVIAT.text:
My unsleeping eyes
will never let injustice go unpunished.

TEXT_GACHA_SPEECH_CHA_WI_UNIQUE_6_LOVIAT.text:
I am sorry, Master...
I could not let them sacrifice that girl.

TEXT_GATE_BOSSRUSH_DESC.text: Abominable foes have come charging from another dimension! Challenge your limits against Bosses that grow increasingly difficult with every stage!

TEXT_GATE_CHALLENGE_DESC.text: Challenge more dangerous foes and earn rewards to boost your heroes' powers.

TEXT_GATE_KURENAI_DESC.text: At the Primal Volcano, the heroes of Ryu Kingdom and the Woopa Tribe must gather to stop the mysterious power of the Primal Flames.

TEXT_GATE_PRACTICE_DESC.text: Study your team's power and abilities by training against the most technologically advanced scarecrows in the continent.

TEXT_GATE_SCENARIO_DESC.text: Become a legend of the epic world of Crusaders Quest.

TEXT_GATE_SOUL_DESC.text: Lord Soltar, the tyrant of the bygone century, has awoken from his long slumber to conquer the world. Who shall stop his army of shadows?

TEXT_GATE_SUBSCENARIO_DESC.text: In other corners of the world, more stories await - as well as a mysterious power that lies waiting for its true master.

TEXT_GET_COVER_DESC.text: You have unlocked a pillow cover of your Hero!

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_BATSTATUE_01_DESC.text: A surprisingly spooky statue of a bat. Legend has it that, precisely at midnight, it comes to life.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_BATSTATUE_02_DESC.text: A surprisingly spooky statue of a bat. Legend has it that, precisely at midnight, it comes to life.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_FENCE_01_DESC.text: No one will dare to trespass over this foreboding fence.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_FOG_01_DESC.text: A fog that chills you to your bone. Suddenly faced with the thought that someone - or something - is drifting within, you hurriedly avert your eyes.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_FOG_02_DESC.text: A fog that chills you to your bone. Suddenly faced with the thought that someone - or something - is drifting within, you hurriedly avert your eyes.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_GHOSTTOWER_01_DESC.text: A haunted tower long abandoned. Yet rumors whisper that a lone light flickers in the windows every night...

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_GRAVE_01_DESC.text: A tomb containing not only forgotten remains but also an anguished soul.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_GRAVE_02_DESC.text: A tomb containing not only forgotten remains but also an anguished soul.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_OSSUARY_01_DESC.text: An eternal resting place for some unknown soul. Standing before it, you feel a probing gaze... from somewhere.

TEXT_GHOST_BOTTOM_TREE_02_DESC.text: An eerie tree... that seems to be screaming, but you must be mistaken.

TEXT_GHOST_CENTER_BAT_01_DESC.text: Two bats are better than one, even in such gloom.

TEXT_GHOST_CENTER_FULLMOON_01_DESC.text: All things strange can occur in the light of the full moon.

TEXT_GHOST_CENTER_OWL_01_DESC.text: The spirit of an owl forever doomed to roam the cemetery. Do not meet its piercing gaze!

Practice is key to success.
Do as you trained with the Steel Order, and victory is sure to be ours.

TEXT_GREEDWAR_LOBBY_GROUP_A_NPC_TALK_02.text:
Sigh... Truth to be told, I do have my qualms about His Majesty and this
tournament. As a knight, however, I must obey his wishes.

TEXT_GREEDWAR_LOBBY_GROUP_A_NPC_TALK_RAN.text:
For this round, {0} will lead us as the Vanguard.
I have faith that you will fight well in this round as well.

I am Victoria, Captain of the Central Order.
Everyone will soon see that our knights are the best in all of Grancia.

But... considering that this is a mock battle held only as one of

I-I'm the Captain of the Lion Knights!

I can't believe His Majesty will be judging this competition!
It's a chance for us Lion Knights to clear our name! At least, I hope so.

TEXT_GREEDWAR_LOBBY_GROUP_C_NPC_TALK_RAN.text:
{0} is our Vanguard for this round! Let's give a round of applause!
Hmm, what did that rulebook say about rewards...?
