TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_509_1.text: Huh! What a curious aura! As far as I know, only Ethereals training in the high peaks of the Kunlun Mountains can maintain such a pure aura. Maybe you're an apprentice training under Ethereals? Haha, a long time ago I too thought I could train to become an Ethereal myself and learn that enlightened magic. So I set out and met a Saint by the name of He Xiangu - huh, you don't say! You too trained under Saint He Xiangu? Well, that means I'm your elder brother in a way! Anyway, I spent some years training under Saint He Xiangu, but she told me that I had been born under too strong a star and was fated to become a fighter. 'It's no use attempting to become an Ethereal when you're meant for another road' is what she told me. Instead, she taught me a few training tips that would keep my mind pure as the purest of crystals, which proved handy when I had to spent years and years of harsh training. May all the mountain peaks of Chen and the Ethereals of the kingdom bless her soul, Saint He Xiangu. Only goes to show you that no man is made in a day or just by himself - he receives the help of many people in paving the path that is his life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_509_2.text: Ahh! Someone make this man stop talking! I'd rather go back to my lessons if I could only keep him away!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_510_1.text: Do you happen to know that strong-lookin' lass there? Your daughter? Ain't she a sight to behold! And I'd thought I'd been born strong with the strength from my mama's side o' the family. She's what you could call a fighter chosen by the heavens themselves. And even with her strength she's not one bit proud, and loves and takes care of her father like her own arm... She's a treasure, yessir. Say, why don't you let me train her? With the proper training, she may become the stuff of legends that these lands have never seen the likes of.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_510_2.text: No, no, no! I will not send my daughter to one of those fancy private academies! As if we had the luxury... Hrrmph!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_511_1.text: Um, Cano? A-about that last time, I... I'm...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_511_2.text: Meri! I heard you made your debut! I'm so happy for you, let's both try our best!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_512_2.text: You do know I'm your senior, right? Where are your manners?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_513_1.text: C-Cano stood up for me...! This is the happiest day of my life...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_513_2.text: Meri's a very good singer. Be nice, Yuna.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_513_3.text: Hrrmph! I guess anybody can become an idol these days.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_514_1.text: Do people even play that game anymore?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_514_2.text: Anybody up for a game of Super Fighting Cards?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_515_2.text: Dean Wolfram! Could you sign this permission slip? I got scheduled for another concert... Heheh....

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_515_3.text: Hmm... Yet another student become a celebrity. Perhaps I should think of editing the curriculum...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_516_1.text: What is that creepy man saying...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_516_2.text: A beautiful kuudere who's easily embarrassed... A++ waifu material!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_517_1.text: Chai, tell me again: who hosted the cooking competition that you won?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_517_2.text: A man named 'Mr. Paik'! He's traveling the world and eating street food these days! Hmm? I don't remember anyone telling me this...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_517_3.text: I too keep recalling things I don't remember hearing about. Maybe we should ask other Heroes on this matter? Master Shuwen may know something.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_518_1.text: I am haunted by memories that are not mine, these days. I seem to 'remember' a promise made under a peach tree...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_518_2.text: Hmm... And I thought I had been the only one. I 'remember' hundreds of ships on a river, ablaze with the flames of war.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_518_3.text: Oho, that's mighty curious! Before I came to be called 'the Fist King,' I was told to 'remember the order in which things disappeared' and 'look to the end of the world.' Baffling words, eh? Well, I 'spose I could tell you how I came to hear those words...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_519_2.text: I will not allow any mortal, insignificant as they may be, to tread unsanctioned the lands of my ancestors.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_520_2.text: Hmm? Oho! How strange, a penguin seems to be emitting the signals of my Steamer army.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_521_2.text: Captain, this is offensive! It's Animal Hero discrimination!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_521_3.text: Did you really think we would speak the same language JUST because we're of Animal race, Captain?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_522_2.text: What's that, meow? I may understand cats, but not penguins!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_524_1.text: MY HEAD IS BEING CONTROLLED BY AN ANTENNAE! I REPEAT! MY HEAD IS BEING CONTROLLED BY AN ANTENNAE! I AM OLGA DAUGHTER OF ORCA OF THE PENGUIN KINGDOM! MY HEAD IS BEING CONTROLLED BY...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_524_2.text: Wooah!! It's so black and white and fluffy and I WANT TO TAKE ONE HOME!! I shall call her Squawky and she'll be mine!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_524_3.text: I've made it possible for you two to understand each other for a short period of time. Go nuts.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_525_2.text: Gon confused! This person, smell like Gon's mama.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_526_2.text: I see you too were only recently released from the clutches of the ice. Huhu, perhaps we should create a support group with the other Guardians?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_527_1.text: Awooah awoo awoowoo wooah awoowooahah awoooo!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_527_2.text: Woomparoompapa pawooroompa. Apa roopawoompa woomroom. Woompa woomparoopa.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_528_2.text: Hmm, this creature... may resemble a dragon, but she is not one. There is no need for me to hunt her.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_529_2.text: Huh? This person isn't on the list of the dead!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_529_3.text: It seems she was born before written language was invented in the Realm of the Dead. Where should we send her, then...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_530_1.text: Oh, Y-Your Majesty! It's such an honor! I-I'll try my best!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_530_2.text: Oho, so you're the holy knight everyone's talking about these days! What do you say to my properly knighting you as the Captain of the Order of the White Lion, right here and right now?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_531_1.text: O-of course... I'll do anything, if it means I'll be able to repent for the sins of the Order!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_531_2.text: The Order of the White Lion! I know about you bullies! If you ever harass other people again, I won't forgive you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_532_1.text: The Holy Sword of Elanuma... I still can't believe I'm the one who pulled it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_532_2.text: The Holy Sword only lets those destined to fulfill the will of the Goddess draw it. I hear it's very picky when choosing a new partner... Congratulations!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_533_1.text: Of course! The Order may be important, but what's more important are my knightly duties and love for my people!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_533_2.text: At the heart of light... slumbers a darkness beyond belief. Do not let your faith blind you to the secrets of the Order.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_534_1.text: Wow! Is it really you, Master Leon? I'm a big fan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_534_2.text: Wait, is that the Holy Sword of Elanuma? I never did manage to draw it... I guess Goddess Elanuma doesn't like me as much...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_535_1.text: Excuse me... Have you ever met the Maesters of the White Lion?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_535_2.text: Most of them should have returned to Grancia. ... The ones who remained are no more.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_535_3.text: The Order of the White Lion, of Grancia... They had been stationed at our kingdom at the request of the former Cardinal.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_536_1.text: (So this is the man who leads bloodthirsty fools to a hollow doom. Yes... I will wait by his side and bring down judgment when the time is right.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_536_2.text: O Night Raven, come with me. Together we shall punish the unworthy ones and restore glory to the lands of our fathers!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_537_1.text: (Oho. So the blind king means well! What an honor - is that what I should say? He does not understand the lives of those who must linger in the shadows. ... I grow sick of this kingdom...)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_537_2.text: You can choose a better life than this. Will you not reconsider your decision?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_538_1.text: (The likes of her make me sick to the stomach. Does she not know she fights for a mere illusion?)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_538_2.text: The life of a warrior must be dedicated to the glory of the battlefield and war cries drenched in blood! My life for Nosgard!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_539_1.text: (The best assassin waits for the right moment to strike from the shadows. To reveal oneself before the enemy is the greatest mistake that can be made!)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_539_2.text: Huh, how old school... That attire just screams ‘assassin.’

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_540_1.text: (He left so soon... And I never got to thank him.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_541_1.text: (A home to protect... How I envy you. May you keep your faith to a noble end.)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_541_2.text: Hrrmph. Fools may sing for war-bound glory, but I myself have always deemed my home village most precious. Worth even more than a captain's position granted by His Majesty himself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_542_1.text: (Why is that Frost Elf staring at me so?)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_542_2.text: Oh, crap. It's that Night Raven Captain everyone's talking about... Should I run? Will I make it if I run?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_543_1.text: What is this? A mere stroke of fortune? A keen eye that sees through my motives? ... Whatever she is, the heavens are hindering my revenge through her!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_543_2.text: I don't know what you were up to, but I'm definitely not letting you ruin a joyful ceremony!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_544_1.text: I'll kill the Emperor. I will give up everything if I have to!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_544_2.text: I too share your hatred for the Emperor. But do you not see that your chosen path leads you across thin ice?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_545_1.text: That old man... I'd heard that he went blind, but it almost feels as if he sees right through me. I'll have to be careful.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_545_2.text: Hmm... A face may hide itself behind a mask, but the blade of vengeance in one’s heart can gleam bright as a full moon without clouds.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_546_1.text: Look at that twit babbling about something he doesn't know! This is a beautiful art I've devoted my life to!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_546_2.text: Hrrmph. I'll never understand why people get so excited over such trivial tricks.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_547_1.text: I almost fell asleep... Thank the heavens my mask was on.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_548_2.text: My father always told me, never trust people who don't reveal their eyes!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_549_1.text: Ohoho! Really? Maybe I should publish my special recipe - though I doubt anyone could ever properly follow it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_549_2.text: Ooh, this is some neat stuff! I never thought to remodel a dessert into bullets!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_550_1.text: So it's true that Chen people eat anything and everything! You really find my tteok delicious?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_550_2.text: Ooh~ This is delicious! The texture is very unique...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_551_1.text: That tiger... I don't like admitting it, but to this day he's the only one who really liked my tteok.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_551_2.text: Haha, tteok are considered an irresistible delicacy by tigers. Or so a little bird told me up in the mountains.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_552_1.text: Hrrmph, the nerve of that tiger. If he ever returns, I'll make sure to fill up his no-good belly with all the tteok I can pelt at him!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_552_2.text: A talking tiger? And he disappeared after giving you a big present of mountain insam roots... Maybe he just wanted to be friends?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_553_1.text: Go home, you buffoon! How many times have I told you, you can't eat any more on credit?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_553_2.text: Kyah~ Now this is the stuff! One more bowl of gukbap here, Malsook!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_554_2.text: A taste of utter darkness, straight from the abyss... Huhu. This is to my liking.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_555_1.text: Look at you, dressed up in such finery! Seems you passed your exams with flying colors!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_555_2.text: Thank you for your wonderful cooking. Haha... It was one of the things I missed the most while studying for the gwageo examinations.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_556_1.text: That supposed to be a compliment, or what?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_556_2.text: Ooh! So these are the tteok that kills two with one bite! Thank you for helping me reap souls so easily, Tteok Mama!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_557_1.text: It's been a while, Master Wolfram... You are beautiful as ever...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_557_2.text: Loviatar... You too look your old self. Welcome back.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_558_1.text: You can be very cruel when you wish to be... But I know you are saying such things on purpose, Shasha...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_558_2.text: Huh? I thought you died of old age. You aren't her daughter, right?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_559_1.text: Oh, dear... Vesper, don't cry... Everything's alright now...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_559_2.text: Sob~ Loviatar! I missed you! You won't believe how much the others kept teasing me in your absence!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_560_1.text: I never thought you would call me 'Master'... Huhu, you must have read my journal... I always wanted to apologize... for the things I couldn't do...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_560_2.text: ... Master Loviatar. I... I wanted to say thank you... for saving my life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_561_1.text: A true heart... Perhaps the Neth Empire has been waiting for you to cleanse it of its sins... I have great expectations for you...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_561_2.text: Yes. I shall do everything in my power to save the Empire... If only to continue his will.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_562_1.text: Oh, how romantic... If I had had a lover... I suppose I wouldn't have had to spend all these years in the Lab...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_562_3.text: If Lyudmilla ever gets into trouble, I would do anything to save her, too!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_563_1.text: Sigh... I cannot return to my homeland... For I have betrayed my father to succeed his throne: an unforgivable sin!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_563_2.text: You're worried about getting scolded if you return, right? I understand...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_564_1.text: A-a gigantic spider! Never have I seen such a disgusting monster!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_564_2.text: Hmm... First spiders, now moths. I guess moths are a lot more talkative than spiders.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_565_1.text: Ooh, finally a human worthy of my time! Are you the Empress of Roman?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_565_2.text: Oh, I am Athena - not an empress, but a mere low-ranking senator. Welcome to the Roman Republic, Lady Fairy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_566_1.text: Aahh!! Is it really you, Lady Kriemhild?! I read about you in my book of human tales! I'm such a big fan, can I have your autograph??

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_567_1.text: Hrrmph, that puny human doesn't deserve the beautiful Lady Kriemhild!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_567_2.text: Why is that fairy glaring at me...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_568_1.text: Almael! That human says she'll take us to the Beast King!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_568_2.text: W-what? Erm, Your Highness... This book... Well, it says something quite different... about the Beast King...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_568_3.text: Wow, a Fairy Queen and a Fairy Knight...! This is so adorable...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_569_1.text: Come on, Almael! Let's go defeat the Beast King and free our people!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_569_2.text: Yes! Your wish is my command, Your Highness! I'll fight with my life!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_570_1.text: Grr... You're doing this on purpose, right? Pretending not to notice my predicament?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_570_2.text: Hmm? What do you mean? I have no idea what you're talking about!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_571_1.text: Eek, that's Athena, the terrible Saintess of the Battlefield...! If she sees me, she'll rip me apart wing by wing!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_571_2.text: Hmm... I see the almost brash courage shown by the other fairy is not shared by other members of her tribe.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_572_1.text: Sob... Oh, Spider Queen... Please have mercy...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_572_2.text: That moth seems to be trying to tell me something... Maybe I'm hallucinating...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_573_1.text: Of course we exist! And we're harmless and cute, too! So please don't hunt us down!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_573_2.text: Fairies... I thought they only existed in the stories my grandmother used to tell me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_574_1.text: I can't believe this isn't a female human.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_574_2.text: What beautiful wings! Almost as beautiful... as myself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_575_1.text: Eek! Why is there a wild harpy in the capital of Roman? I-I don't want to get eaten!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_575_2.text: Why would I eat you when I have so many other delicious things to eat?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_576_1.text: ... Really? Let's start by discussing the working hours...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_576_2.text: Are you having problems with your boss? Why don't you join me instead? I'll see to it that you find your conditions... satisfactory.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_577_1.text: We need to stop Nyanma and the Jyarei Monsters!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_578_1.text: No one can block Hol's charge!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_578_2.text: Charge...? I don't really remember, moo

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_579_1.text: I promised Gao to never back down again!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_579_2.text: I know well that a leader should know how to do everything.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_580_1.text: Anything is possible if you believe in your friends, right?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_580_2.text: Bakumaru, you need to trust your friends at all times

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_581_1.text: Drago, you can't transform into a dragon here!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_581_2.text: Clouds, wind, and thunder! Haha, it was a joke.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_582_1.text: Nyorori says a lot of complicated stuff but you can trust him!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_582_2.text: There are so many interesting inventions here, Nyorori!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_583_1.text: The Eto Rangers will protect the Novel Worlds!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_584_1.text: That mere child is thought to be better than me? Alexander must have gone soft in the head.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_584_2.text: Oh, it's my pleasure to do a rematch... if you wish.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_585_1.text: Your face reminds me of a certain nuisance I disposed of long ago...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_585_2.text: My father was the former Vice Captain of the Blue Blood Knights... You dishonored my father. Prepare to die!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_586_1.text: Everyone respected me! They all swore fealty to me! Only you never acknowledged me, the great Morgan!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_586_2.text: I once deemed you my successor...Yet talent alone does not make a king.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_587_1.text: Damn it all! This is ridiculous - how can a mere maid foil a trained assassinator?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_587_2.text: Victoria is mine to kill. You won't lay a finger on her!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_588_1.text: Do you like being Vice Captain, boy? A position you could have never obtained under normal circumstances!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_588_2.text: ...So, you're Morgan, the former Vice Captain. I have nothing to do with a knight who threw away his honor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_589_1.text: If only I hadn't sprained my lower back... Mumble mumble...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_589_2.text: You are right, O Great Master! Forgive me! How could I ever have dared to raise this piece of barbarity against you?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_590_1.text: Ah, it's bald Heth's old student! How's the old geezer doing?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_590_2.text: Who dares to insult my master... Oh!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_591_1.text: How have you been, sweetheart? Ares isn't bullying you these days?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_591_2.text: Oh, Grandfather! What brings you to the Arena?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_592_1.text: That Oberon - I told him again and again that he should especially look after the children! It's dangerous for young fairies to leave the Peaks of Glory! Tsk, tsk.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_592_2.text: A lion mask... Just like the Beast King. Maybe he's a big fan.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_593_1.text: Hmm? You look just like Oberon - you must be his daughter, Delrien! Does my little princess want a piece of candy, hmm?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_593_2.text: I'd recognize that smell anywhere! You're the Beast King, aren't you? The oppressor of the fairy folk!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_594_1.text: So you're the evil overlord threatening this village! In the name of justice, I'll kick your ass with my Six-Star Cannon!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_594_2.text: Muhahahaha! So another foolish mortal dares to cross - wait, what is that monstrous gun you're holding?! Stop scaring me! Put it away!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_595_1.text: How could you sell your comrades to a kidnapper?! I should have never trusted you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_595_2.text: Huh? You mean Popo? She was just asking for directions.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_596_1.text: I never asked for all this. I just want my old body back.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_596_2.text: Welcome, cyborg comrade! Ooh, that's a nice cannon transformation device you have there...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_597_1.text: I just got chills down my spine...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_597_2.text: A new hero? As if! I should prepare a new trap soon...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_598_1.text: It's not so bad. Could've been worse.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_598_2.text: Yet another victim of the inhumane experiments of the Empire... A tragedy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_599_1.text: Captain Magnus, have you been visiting the Silver Archers again? When will you find the time to take care of your - real - business?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_599_2.text: H-how did you know that? Have you been spying on me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_600_1.text: The Captain of the Silver Archers... I heard she enjoys snacking on wood chips. I wonder if she's ever tried the ones I used to sell.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_600_2.text: Oh, that's the girl who used to sell wood chips! She's all grown up now.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_601_1.text: Princess Wolfram! Your Highness! A-and the greatest witch in the continent... It's an honor to meet you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_601_2.text: I have cut all ties with the royal family. You don't have to be so formal.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_602_1.text: Grr... Captain Magnus... This can't continue happening...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_602_2.text: S-S-Sigruna. I found this lying around. I-it is yours, if you wish...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_602_3.text: How strange! Wood chips dipped in honey are really hard to get! These are a delicacy!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_603_1.text: If it were up to me, I would continue serving my Captain for a decade, a century if need be.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_603_2.text: A Vice Captain, huh? I too miss the days serving under Lady Victoria.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_604_1.text: Pakaracchi~ talking about youth all the way here too?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_604_2.text: Leader! Not enjoying your youth is wasteful!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_605_1.text: Souffle, you're one of the Eto Rangers too, so have some more confidence!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_605_2.text: I can't fight as well as Bakumaru... but I want to protect the Novel Worlds too!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_606_2.text: Kek, that Pochiro. He'll never catch me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_607_1.text: To think that the tomboy Tart could become such a lady, I guess anything can happen!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_607_2.text: Huh? Bakumaru, you want a taste of my kick?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_608_1.text: I know how you feel, but be the bigger person, Pochiro!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_608_2.text: Leader, did you not see Monk just now? He's definitely up to no good.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_609_1.text: Oh, Urii! We're all together so it'll be okay!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_609_2.text: Uwah~! Why are there so many scary things in this Novel World~!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_610_1.text: Nyanma... you... are you really... the Cat Spirit I was looking for?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_611_1.text: This refreshing aura... Hair the color of the ocean... A face no different from the former Oracle of Water... I found the Oracle at last! I missed you, sob...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_611_2.text: W-who are you? Why are you - ... Oh, I remember now, Maré! But where are your fins?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_612_1.text: You reek, Gramps. When was the last time you took a bath?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_612_2.text: Mm. Fresh water is always scarce during long sea voyages... I suppose that's no excuse.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_613_1.text: You're one of the Naga tribe! What are you doing on land?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_613_2.text: Oh, E-Elder Sister.... Erm, I didn't do anything wrong, I promise...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_614_1.text: The Ocean King? Hrrmph, as if humans could ever rule or even understand the will of the ocean...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_614_2.text: I ask you to judge me for my actions - not a mere title.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_615_1.text: Why don't you try protecting the ocean from idiots for decades yourself? I'm lucky I can speak at all, with all that shouting.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_615_2.text: You're a mermaid...? Aren't mermaids supposed to have beautiful voices, like the Naga tribe?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_616_1.text: Sigh... I REALLY don't need another problem to ruin my life at this moment. So get out of my way!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_616_2.text: From the darkness of the abyss, your worst nightma -... Ow, ow! Ack, I - I'm sorry!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_617_2.text: O blessed Abyss, are you the one who sent me the prophecy?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_618_1.text: The Naga tribe... Those simpletons are so easily tricked.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_618_2.text: Sniff... I can smell the waters of the deep.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_619_1.text: I sense a fragment of the abyss...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_619_2.text: Asmo? Why are you shaking like that?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_620_1.text: A human who has willingly embraced the abyss... Huhu, how interesting.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_620_2.text: I sense true darkness from you... You aren't a normal mermaid, are you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_621_1.text: The pieces of darkness are gathering... My rebirth will be soon.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_621_2.text: If we could only find the other half of that magical tome yet unfound in the world...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_622_1.text: Thank you for your purchase every year!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_622_2.text: These golden roses... No other flower will serve for the annual ceremonies of the Golden Archers. This year's blossoms are especially beautiful - perfect!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_623_1.text: I... I'm not so sure. I'm a simple botanist, not a psychologist...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_623_2.text: Why can't I stop eating bark chips?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_624_1.text: It's an honor to be acknowledged by the Witch of the Forest herself!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_624_2.text: What magnificent vines. I can see whoever cared for them did so with much love.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_625_1.text: 'The Flower Fields of Heavens,' huh! I'm sure there would be many rare and beautiful plants there not found anywhere else!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_625_2.text: The flower fields in my dreams... I am sure you'll succeed in reaching it someday, Professor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_626_1.text: Is it true that a gigantic plant has suddenly appeared on Hell Island? Your Devilship, do you know anything about this?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_626_2.text: I, erm, I don't. I've never heard anything about a gigantic... plant... And even if I have, I wouldn't have anything to do with it...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_627_1.text: Oh, are you having problems with your eyesight? Don't you see all the fine details? It's my masterpiece, if I do say so myself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_627_2.text: ... I... see... What... magnificent... clothes... Grr...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_628_1.text: Ahem. Your Majesty, your waist size... seems to have increased again...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_628_2.text: Hoho, the passing years will do that to any man... And any man will be inclined to feel this embarrassment.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_629_1.text: I hope to design an exclusive just for you someday, Lady Victoria!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_629_2.text: Oh, but the best dress for a knight is her well-polished armor.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_630_1.text: ... Are you sure about this design? Chocolate... Gentleman...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_630_2.text: Do you not think it beautiful? I thought of it myself.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_631_1.text: I remember seeing you at the Royal Ball a few years ago. Your blue dress was very charming!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_631_2.text: Thank you. Bridget would be flattered as well, for a master seamstress of the court to speak so highly of her work.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_632_1.text: It is your destiny, sire... to rid Valencia of the darkness that has long plagued her.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_632_2.text: I still have a long, dark path ahead of me. Tell me, Margrave. Why do you trust me as your king?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_633_1.text: Valencia thanks you for your services - had it not been for you, the young heir to the House of Ferdinand may not have found his way here, today.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_633_2.text: Oh, I was just trying my best to keep him from getting into MORE trouble. One must keep a close eye on runaway boys.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_634_1.text: Valencia shall stand proud and unsullied as long as I live. We will not bow down to you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_634_2.text: So you throw in your lot with decline and despair! Very well, you'll live to regret it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_635_1.text: Arkana... So you are truly the hero of legend, the one who first subdued Soltar in his lair one hundred years ago.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_635_2.text: None of us expected a new darkness to rise from the Fortress. The time has come to end things - once and for all.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_636_1.text: How many times must I tell you? I am no king. Stop with your foolish jibber-jabbering and let's go get a drink, old friend.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_636_2.text: Hoho, who's this? It's the Great King Laertes, the most gracious monarch Valencia has ever known! Thanks to you, the only worry I had on the seven seas for all these years was the occasional rough wind.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_637_1.text: Look who it is - my pretty D'Art! I'm back! Did you miss me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_637_2.text: Aramis, where have you been all this time?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_638_1.text: Captain, isn't D'Art too young for you? You do know that not everyone's going to approve of the age difference, don't you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_638_2.text: Ah, so speaks the one who has never known love.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_639_1.text: Our baby of the group! I brought back a lot of delicious snacks from my travels - think you're up for the job?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_639_2.text: Why do you always treat me like a kid? ... So... What kinds of snacks?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_640_1.text: Wait, you're... The rumors were true after all! How could you sacrifice your brother like that, Prince Cain? You were brothers!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_640_2.text: Oh, one of the Cardinal's little pets. Why don't you join me, instead of wasting your life on that snake's dirty work?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_641_1.text: How can it be, that the compassionate king of Trista has turned into such a monster...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_642_1.text: Ba da ba ba ba~ We're loving it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_642_2.text: From Neth Cheesecake to Chocolat's Chunky Chocolate, Hasla Beans offers the best ice cream throughout Hasla in a variety of fun flavors!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_643_1.text: What do you mean, 'tiger'? Look, this here is a lion mask! As I am Lion Mask!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_643_2.text: Oh, another tiger? Sorry, boy. I'm all out of tteok right now.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_644_2.text: Ah, Master Hansheng, isn't that a 'bamboo wife' you have there? Now those body pillows are woven from bamboo cane, aren't they? Just the word 'bamboo' brings to my mind fond memories of my panda friend Panpan whom I met back in Chen - ah, how the tears come rushin' to my eyes at the mere mention of that name! You see, the pandas of Chen have this big problem of babies bein' born only rarely in their clan. Now Panpan was late into his years when he had his son, but this precious son of his became ill with a disease that didn't let him grow up into a big, normal panda. Every villager in Panpan's clan was sick with worry over this child and nursed him day and night taking turns, and the sight touched my ol' heart so that it almost burst with pity and sympathy. I couldn't just pass them by now, could I? So I searched everywhere near and far for a good doctor when...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_645_1.text: A-a rabbit! Somebody, get me that rabbit's liver at once!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_645_2.text: W-wait! This is just a costume!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_646_1.text: Haha, perhaps you could make me something visible this time?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_646_2.text: Y-You seem like a completely different person than before!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_647_1.text: I will grant you three wishes, anything that your heart may desire.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_647_2.text: I have only one wish. Dethrone Alexander and make me king!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_648_2.text: Oh, Genie of the Lamp. Find me my princess.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_649_1.text: Ah, I just received a compliment from the royal seamstress! I'm blushing now, aren't I?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_649_2.text: What a lovely dress - perfect for the ball, Seiren!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_650_1.text: My treasure? If you want it, you can have it... Try and find it. I left everything I have there!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_650_2.text: ... I've heard that line somewhere before. Well, guess it doesn't matter as long as I find that treasure.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_651_1.text: That won't happen! This armor has been specially designed for my grand finale battle! I - I'm sure it won't break so easily!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_651_2.text: Ooh~ Going for your daily defeat by the Gatcha Rangers? Hey, if you ever need to scrap that armor, I'll give you a good sum for it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_652_1.text: Ooh. Now that's a cool uniform... Full of inspiration for a new song!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_652_2.text: I'm practicing new moves for the imperial ceremony. Will you have a look?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_653_1.text: The highlight of camping is the tent! Or better yet, a romantic teepee under the stars!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_653_2.text: But this camper van is so convenient, it'll let you go places you wouldn't dare on foot!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_655_1.text: Oh, what a magnificent whale! Won't you let me train her?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_655_2.text: 'Train'? You do know whales are way smarter than humans, right?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_656_1.text: This brief life on earth will be immortalized through the art of masks...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_656_2.text: A day will arrive when that mask of yours comes off.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_657_1.text: Kee kee kee... Cower in fear, witches of Pumpkin City! ... Is this how you do it, Mom?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_657_2.text: Kyahaha! Now YOU will feel the pain of my poor pumpkins!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_658_1.text: You're the leader of Pumpkin City? Hmm... Well, the stakes will tell...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_658_2.text: Oh, the real victors never truly engage in mere child's play.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_659_1.text: Y-you're the witch who only went for the dead center of the field! Do you know how many times I had to deal with your flames?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_659_2.text: Is that ugly pumpkin talking to me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_660_1.text: ... You can't tell what she's thinking... Maybe that's the reason I find her a little scary...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_660_2.text: Ooh... Ants... Maybe there's a cookie nearby...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_661_1.text: You're equally to blame for letting them get away with this mess!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_661_2.text: Sigh... If you think you can stop those three, you're sorely mistaken.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_663_1.text: Wolfram, didn't you learn as a kid not to play with your food?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_663_2.text: I have nothing to say... except that I'm sincerely sorry.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_664_1.text: You idiots! Get out of my pumpkin patch!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_664_2.text: You don't get it! Vesper's being annoying!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_665_1.text: Ha! Think your pretty words can win me over after everything that has happened?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_665_2.text: Your pumpkin pie... I can still remember how good it tasted on a crisp autumn afternoon...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_666_1.text: I knew you'd get it! Only farmers understand what other farmers are going through!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_666_2.text: Crops must be cared for. I understand where you're coming from!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_667_1.text: I realize only now what you truly intended, Grandfather. I apologize for everything I've done...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_667_2.text: No, no. I know you were angry with me. I should be the one apologizing to you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_668_1.text: That is all I can ask for. Thank you, Your Majesty.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_668_2.text: Your strength will prove to be a great help to Valencia and her future. Won't you help us rebuild our kingdom?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_669_2.text: The others may have forgiven you, but I'll never forget the fact that you stabbed Lionel in the stomach!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_670_1.text: Wait, you moved to the Central Knights? Are you trying to avoid our duel?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_670_2.text: Young Margrave... Your opponent will be the Vice Captain of the Cobalt Knights.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_671_1.text: I am the fortress that protects Valencia! You will never succeed in invading our kingdom!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_671_2.text: Ah, the fortitude of a true knight, as the rumors said. She reminds me of Lady Victoria...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_672_1.text: Nyom nyom... I always say that your tteok are the best. Especially with that tangy aftertaste...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_672_2.text: Grr... You fat cat... Let's see who wins!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_673_1.text: Hmm... Yeowoodong, your powers have dulled in the time I didn't see you. Perhaps you have lived too long among the humans?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_673_2.text: Oh, but why have you grown so small, Master Halla?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_674_1.text: Sob... Haerang, the humans burnt down my forest! You must tell Habaek of this disaster, perhaps he'll punish them...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_674_2.text: Disruptions in the energy of the land... Forest fires... Perhaps they were caused by the same person.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_675_1.text: A child who cannot find her place between the realms of the living and the dead... Poor, poor child...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_675_2.text: Huh? Will you mind your manners, 'child'?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_676_1.text: A saint of Chen, huh... Tsk, tsk, having a few tricks up your sleeve doesn't justify attempts to control nature like that. Don't like them at all.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_676_2.text: Ack! A tiger! ... Now that I think about it, why are there so many animal patron saints in this country?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_677_1.text: You only follow a mere human who calls herself a Saintess. You do not know the true Goddess. Repent for your sins!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_677_2.text: Saintess Maria's will is my true faith.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_678_1.text: Crazed One, do you really believe that you were chosen by the Goddess?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_678_2.text: Oh, of course. And one day... She will be mine. For sure!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_679_1.text: Saintess Maria. I know what you are doing in Trista...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_679_2.text: Hmm~? I have no idea what you're talking about!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_680_1.text: Punishment for heresy is death! May the Light punish all who do not believe in the true Goddess!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_680_2.text: The Order of the Lion will be reborn. Just you wait and see!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_681_1.text: Oh, Sister. The sole path to Light is the one that follows the will of the Kalard, the true Goddesses of this world.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_681_2.text: Huh? By Goddess, don't you mean Goddess Elanuma?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_682_1.text: Ah, sister... I see you have faced many woes in your time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_682_2.text: Camilla... I wished to speak to you for a long time.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_683_1.text: So you wish to reconstruct the kingdom of your ancestors? How innocent you are... Do you not hear the anguished voices of the souls buried below?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_683_2.text: We saw for ourselves the sins of our ancestors. The revived kingdom will not make the same mistake - I vow it on my life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_684_1.text: I smell the dirty blood of Anubisis. You're the one who succeeded the necromancers of old, I see.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_684_2.text: If you wish for vengeance... Fine, I won't resist. But let me at least see Osiris become king and revive our ancestors' lineage.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_685_1.text: Be at peace. I no longer seek to fight you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_685_2.text: C-C-Camilla...! H-h-how did you... Cough, cough!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_686_1.text: And you... You were supposed to die a long time ago.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_686_2.text: So it's you... The guardian of the false idol, created by the clowns who once called themselves the Three Kings.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_687_1.text: Professor... Do you know how long it took to get my diploma after you disappeared...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_687_2.text: Er... Uhm... I have nothing to say. I'm sorry.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_688_1.text: Hrrmph, you may be the second Witch of the Forest... But I'm Professor Loviatar's best student!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_688_2.text: I never properly learned anything from Master Loviatar... Do as you wish.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_689_1.text: This is the reason why all witches need a proper education!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_689_2.text: I never once read a single thesis in my life... Is it really necessary?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_690_1.text: Huhu, then please consider me a fair candidate for the next principal of the Academy!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_690_2.text: Estelle, how kind you always are~ And so clever~

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_691_1.text: (For some reason, I don't think she's being sincere...)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_691_2.text: One's talents as a scholar and those as a teacher are quite different things. I expect much of you, Estelle.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_692_1.text: CANO!! I owe you my life!! I'll never forget you!!!!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_692_2.text: M-Miyu... Erm, there's really no reason to be melodramatic, as touching as this moment is...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_693_1.text: So proud of beating people up, aren't you? You're nothing but a phony!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_693_2.text: Sigh... What is it with Cano and her lackeys? Not a day goes by without one coming to ruin my day.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_694_1.text: True music isn't about becoming more popular! The road of steel and flame will be my sole path!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_694_2.text: Wait, you're Miyu, the legendary bassist of Cano☆Revolution... Why did you quit the band? You shine brightest by Cano's side.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_695_1.text: Did I die and go to Rock 'n Roll Heaven?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_695_2.text: Your performance... recalls to me the world I come from. The world full of blood and ashes... A true road to heavy metal!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_696_1.text: This guy is the real deal... I can feel it! He's 'out there' in all senses of the term.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_696_2.text: Woompapa... Jeomrye, was it? Your music reveals a heart full of soul.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_697_1.text: Atalante! I swear to win the next hunt! And... if I do... erm, would you be interested in going out for... a lunch with me...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_697_2.text: Oh, lunch sounds nice. Good luck!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_698_2.text: How dare you burn down my private forest! If you weren't Ares's son, I would have already fed you to my lions!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_699_1.text: I will pay any price if it means I can best Atalante in a hunt!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_699_2.text: Be cautious when dealing with spirits - you will never know what they will demand in return for harnessing their powers.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_700_2.text: Ooh... Arrows that accelerate or change trajectory after they're released? Are they a type of gyrojets? This is fascinating!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_701_1.text: O Mighty Champion. Do you know of a witch who deals with elemental spirits?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_701_2.text: Those oddballs? I once heard that they all fled to the Peaks of Glory after the Olympus Council banished them from the capital...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_702_1.text: Why aren't people more cautious? What will happen if humans invade the island? Things certainly weren't like this when Demona was here.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_702_2.text: Not all humans are bad, you know.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_703_1.text: Elf Mask? Don't listen to that suspicious Elf. We Devils must stick together, sweetie.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_703_2.text: Okay, you've clearly never met him. He's one of the nicest people I know! And who are you anyway, kiddo?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_704_1.text: Oh, what a polite little girl. Do you want a butterscotch, sweetie?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_704_2.text: Are you trying to help us? Thank you, but my sister and I plan to travel alone for the time being.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_705_1.text: Sigh... Devils these days are so reckless... There's no end to the trouble they brew up.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_705_2.text: I agree. Were we this bad back in the days? Tsk, tsk.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_706_2.text: I am still an inquisitor of the Order, no matter which Goddess I believe! Step back! I will slay this foul Devil!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_707_1.text: Oh, a strange-looking bear. Come here, Mister Bear!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_707_2.text: I'm supposed to be a lion! Can't you tell?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_708_1.text: You're but a leech who feeds off the blood of the people. You shall receive your rightful punishment.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_708_2.text: Your sly and devious words will only win you death.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_709_1.text: Hello there, fellow raccoon! Are you enjoying the human world?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_709_2.text: Huh? Oh, are you in costume too?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_710_1.text: To gamble with forbidden magic, fueled by trivial emotions... This is no science.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_710_2.text: Death, forbidden spells… Does anything matter before her death? My love will give birth to the future of science!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_712_1.text: Oh, that moving plant...! Is it a new species of mandrake? Can I take a closer look, please?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_712_2.text: What? A mandra-what? Never heard of such a thing. This is Sansami! San-sa-mi!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_713_1.text: These wheat fields are in wonderful condition! I'd love to take some samples, if you don't mind.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_713_2.text: Samples? Well... I suppose my wheat IS the best in the Empire.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_714_1.text: Round lollipops are the best kind of candy!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_714_2.text: Oh, I see you have no taste. Rainbow swirl lollipops are undoubtably the most classic.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_714_3.text: All candy tastes sweet, regardless of their shape♪

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_715_1.text: Ooh, that's some quality junk! I won't have to scavenge for weeks!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_716_1.text: Are those... mushrooms growing on the top of your hat? They do belong to the fungi kingdom, but as a botanist, I can't help but marvel at such a wonderfully formed ecosystem!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_716_2.text: Oh, ecosystem...? This, dear, is magic.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_717_1.text: Hrrmph, you're the new 'Lord of the Sea'? I refuse to serve an old man who's only interested in his own decaying health!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_717_2.text: Sob... B-but... If I fail to get my hands on the rabbit of a liver, I'll...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_718_1.text: That wolf... He might try to eat up my poor Jarvis! I should get rid of him here and now, when I have the chance...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_718_2.text: ... Something feels off - as if someone is watching me...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_719_1.text: Oh, a newcomer! Come with us, we'll introduce you to the best fairy spots!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_719_2.text: Thank you for your offer, but I prefer being on my... Oh my, what a tasty-looking dandelion you have there...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_719_3.text: Huh, I've never seen a fairy with such a big appetite.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_720_1.text: I can sense them! Please wait, poor spirits, I'll help you depart this world!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_720_2.text: P-Please don't chase away my friends!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_721_1.text: Are you searching for a way to put out your flame as well?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_721_2.text: Oh, erm, I don't know if it's mine, per se... but yes, it's a dangerous power, and I don't want it.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_722_1.text: The stars... They whisper in harmony with your soul. Or rather, they chat endlessly with your soul.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_722_2.text: Hmm, I'm not sure what that means, but I AM the sole master of celestial magic in Hasla!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_723_1.text: These waters are under my jurisdiction!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_724_1.text: Another pirate? I won't rest before these seas are cleansed of villainy!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_724_2.text: I only came out here to get some peace and quiet...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_725_1.text: Kee kee... I sense many fresh ghosts nearby, ready for harvest...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_725_2.text: They're my friends. They're not like the evil spirits you've enslaved against their will!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_726_1.text: That candy cane... I can feel its true power radiating from it...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_727_1.text: Oh, you're the employee from before. Is that a new uniform you have on? Always keeping up with the announcements, I see.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_727_2.text: What? An employee? I think you've been mistaking me for someone else.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_728_1.text: Santa Girl...! Excuse my manners! I didn't recognize such a high-ranking official!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_728_2.text: Erm, I'm not sure who you think I am, but this outfit was just a present from someone.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_729_1.text: Wow, that's a pretty snow globe! Did you make it yourself?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_729_2.text: I-I only made it because Cano forced me to...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_730_1.text: A gun... A gun may be just the thing that will let me deliver candy to children with increased speed and accuracy.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_730_2.text: ... In other words, you'd be shooting the children. Literally.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_731_1.text: All nice children deserve a wonderful gift!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_731_2.text: T-thank you. I've never received so many presents in my life...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_732_1.text: That tree... is the symbol of the evil corporation Christmas! You tricked me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_732_2.text: W-what are you doing! This is just a normal Christmas tree!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_733_1.text: That sleigh belongs to Code Name: Rudolph! So that evil assassin thinks he can get away with everything in plain sight!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_733_2.text: Ack! What are you throwing at me? Lumps of coal?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_734_1.text: It's no use disguising yourself as a ridiculously large present! My nose can detect the smell of crime lingering in the air!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_734_2.text: I only stole in order to survive, when I didn't know any better! I'm clean now, I swear!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_735_1.text: Ahem... I admit, those Christmas assassins do know a thing about fashion.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_736_1.text: What? A thief? Naughty children get lumps of coal instead of presents!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_736_2.text: Wait a minute, this is all pretend! Stop!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_737_1.text: So you aren't... an evil secret agent of Christmas? E-erm, sorry. Would you like a present?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_737_2.text: So you aren't... a fellow employee? Excuse me. Would you like a piece of candy...?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_737_3.text: Get out of my sight, both of you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_738_1.text: You villain! I won't let you ruin Christmas! Candy Couriers, prepare to fire!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_738_2.text: You dirty agent of Santa Claus! That candy is hard enough to drill holes in the wall, and you want to shoot it at kids?!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_739_2.text: I've seen that book before. You're lucky to have kept it close and not have been devoured.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_740_1.text: I don't know who 'they' are, but my book desires to see more of the world.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_740_2.text: We have been searching for you for a long time. 'They' are waiting.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_741_1.text: ... A monster of Han. This is none of your business.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_741_2.text: You travel with a dangerous companion, young master.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_742_2.text: The time has finally come... Everything is in place: the two swords... and the two tomes...!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_743_1.text: I don't understand what you mean.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_743_2.text: A victim of the turbulent times... That book reeks with malice and evil. But I see it is too late to stop you now.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_744_1.text: Just a teensy drop of my potion and that other bakery won't have a chance against your bread! Come on, you know you want it!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_744_2.text: My wheat research keeps me busy enough as it is. And don't you think of wasting food!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_745_1.text: Eek, that dog-human means trouble! Better keep away!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_745_2.text: Huh, sniff, sniff... This smell is familiar.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_746_1.text: Hmm? This font seems familiar... Have we ever met?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_746_2.text: ... To the best of my knowledge, no.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_747_1.text: One sip of this potion and your head will grow lush as the Elves' forest! Introducing the EZ-Hair Potion: a limited stock of only 10 bottles!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_747_2.text: W-what? I'll take everything you have!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_748_1.text: Of course~! Will that be cash or credit?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_748_2.text: Hee hee... Athena will never ignore me again now that I got my hands on this potion!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_748_3.text: Consuming unidentified concoctions seems rather brash, but it's your choice.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_749_1.text: So you're Jet?! Hey, I think you'll find good use for my potions. I'll even give you a special discou- Eek!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_749_2.text: I've seen that face before... on a wanted poster!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_750_1.text: Well, as long as you remain on the living realm, you will not be able to meet them. A scarier being than I guards the path.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_750_2.text: At the end of the long road of necromancy... lie beings like you? What must I sacrifice to form a contract with them?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_751_1.text: Oh, my child. Of course. I have always seen you. I will always see you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_751_2.text: It was you who were always with me... Always... My abyss...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_752_1.text: You will recover over time. You had too much knowledge not meant for you stored in your head.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_752_2.text: Ugh... Euh.... Urrrgh.... W-what? W-where am I? ... Who am I?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_753_1.text: Plaga. Do you wish to roam free, as Balrog does? Do as you wish. It is your life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_753_2.text: Hmm... Hey, Cassia. What should we do from now on?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_754_1.text: I am sorry, child of Habaek. I will no longer do what I did, so ease your anger.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_754_2.text: ... Say that to Habaek himself, when he awakens.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_755_1.text: Huh, so this pretty young lady was the reason you weren't answering to mummy's calls, was she?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_755_2.text: Who's this brat? Who are you talking to?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_756_1.text: Hmm... You've been through much trouble. I can feel it from you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_756_2.text: So it is you. 'The one' whom the book spoke of...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_757_1.text: Tsk... You disappoint me. You disgrace the name of our household and mine, a chosen Senator of the Olympian Council.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_758_1.text: Hmm, Achillles. My son seems to have troubled you with his foolishness.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_758_2.text: It's no trouble at all, Senator, especially compared to the generosity that you have shown me all these years! Please pay it no mind!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_759_1.text: Ugh... You become more and more like the former Athena. Only by purging ourselves of our past mistakes can we move onto the future.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_759_2.text: Ares... The past, once bygone, cannot be erased, but efforts to right one's past wrongs do not go lost.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_760_1.text: ... I will not make excuses for myself. But you must allow me to help you now, at least.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_760_2.text: So you think you can atone for your sins now? Look at me! I am the living proof of your cruel and savage past!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_761_1.text: You are too old to be continuing such silliness. What will people think of you revoking your retirement?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_761_2.text: I-I had a lot of time on my hands in the mountains! And what about you? Shouldn't you be concerned for your back with your age? Don't you need to retire?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_762_1.text: ... Where have you been? I thought you were dead...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_762_2.text: T-two wars broke out in Neth? I'm sorry I didn't know, Miel... I was busy as a gladiator in Roman for the past few years.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_763_1.text: C-Commander! Private Miel reports as ordered.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_763_2.text: At ease, soldier. You must be cold - here's a hot cup of coffee to keep you warm.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_764_1.text: I don't really care for gas masks - they make me claustrophobic...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_764_2.text: Pssh... You are talented. What do you think of a position in the N.D.D?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_765_1.text: Thank you. You helped me find an effective way to fight against the mechanized troops.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_765_2.text: Haha, I only gave you a little push in the right direction; you were the one who did all the work! I'm glad everything worked out!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_766_1.text: (He's cool, even if he insists on adding 'woompa' to the end of his sentences...)

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_766_2.text: That is excellent bowmanship. I taught you well-woompa.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_767_1.text: Oho... It has been a long time since I've seen such sharpened senses in combat. Is she your daughter? Entrust her to me and I'll make an unparalleled fighter out of her!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_767_2.text: ... Why is everyone asking after my daughter? Whether it's to you or the talkative old man from before, my answer is still no! And don't you tease your elders!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_768_1.text: Malsook? Jeomrye? People here really do prefer old-fashioned names.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_768_2.text: Nari? Now that's a dog's name.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_769_1.text: ... How did you know my family name was 'Gae'?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_769_2.text: Look at all those forsythia blossoms - in Han, we call them 'gaenari.'

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_770_1.text: You shouldn't let the world get to you, dear. Your life is worth more than you think - keep your chin up and hope for the best!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_770_2.text: Hmm... For a young girl, she strangely sounds like a reproving grandmother. Perhaps my own grandmother would have spoken like her...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_771_1.text: It sounds like Chinese, but... It's a different dialect from that spoken in Wulin. I can't understand a word of what he's saying.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_771_2.text: Oh! That clean ‘ki’ energy flowing through your body… Your straight and firm posture… You were born to learn the art of qigong; you’re a natural! If you’re looking for a master, I – Hmm? W-wait… This, this is…! I hadn’t noticed it before, but your ki, it’s… It’s not stored in your ‘dantian’ energy center! Are you continuously circulating it through your body by pure willpower? By the heavens… Such grace! Such resolve! I never dreamed I would see such mastery with my very own eyes! I must call you ‘Master’ from now on. Are you the ‘absolute master’ of legend whose mastery of the arts is so great that she maintains eternal youth? Ah, those eyes… You glare at me because I ask so foolish a question, for something that comes so naturally to you! I apologize, Master! I am lacking, but I must have thought I could be proud of the little training I had done! Your prowess opens new horizons before my eyes, no, new dimensions of training! It pays to live this long… Oh, excuse me… I boasted of my age before you, Master, when you must be much older than you seem. And you look so young! How many years you have lived, I can’t even begin to guess. You have my highest respect. If it is not too much bother, your junior wishes to serve you a meal – perhaps you could impart a little bit of your knowledge, Master!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_772_1.text: You are the boy whom I saw with the Goddess, aren't you? I thought you died back then.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_772_2.text: S-so... You're really the grandma from before?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_773_1.text: Haha... I'm sorry - for you and your sword, that is!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_773_2.text: Continue to be rude to Lady Himiko, and you shall have to answer to my sword.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_774_1.text: Now that we've come to know each other better... Can I call you Himi-chan?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_775_1.text: Kendo club? Sigh... It's my mistake. An expert like me should have expected such school life clichés in isekai sooner.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_775_2.text: Huh? What's with that look? I've seen the likes of you before. Come near my sister and I'll kill you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_776_1.text: Yes... The wind has carried something dangerous into this country.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_777_1.text: Tsk... The dark dragon of my left eye rages. A full moon rises tonight...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_777_2.text: Oh, you're right! You're just like my grandmother - her joints hurt before it rains!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_778_2.text: Huh, that's strange. Only this part of the wheat field seems to have suddenly grown overnight...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_779_1.text: E-erm, are you really the Witch of the Forest? Do you think you could help me revive a dying -... Sigh, never mind.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_779_2.text: Hmm? Speak up. I cannot hear you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_780_1.text: As if you did any better. ... Oh! Nothing, nothing at all!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_780_2.text: Tsk, how pathetic. You call yourself an Elf, and all you have achieved while secluding yourself away in a forest was devastating it! You should be ashamed of yourself!  ... What did you just say?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_781_1.text: I found you at last, Linné!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_781_2.text: Oh, Éfendére! It's been so long! What brings you out of your forest?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_782_1.text: Sigh... Wilted or not, I wish I could go back to my forest and have some alone time. Maybe it's not too late to return...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_782_2.text: Sigh... I miss the days when I could be alone.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_783_1.text: Y-you're the girl who discovered the way to the Flower Fields of the Heavens! Please tell me how to get there!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_783_2.text: I'm not sure, but I think it was sincere love and care for flowers that led me to the Fields.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_784_1.text: Another bothersome dog, sniffing at its own tail.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_784_2.text: Huh. All my senses tell me there's a hotshot around here, just waiting to be caught.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_785_1.text: Why the long face, young man? Youth is a time for making mistakes and getting kicked out of one's home.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_785_2.text: Sigh... When will I ever get back home?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_786_1.text: A more finicky customer than most, I see.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_786_2.text: Black tea? Let's see, what ingredients is it made of? What potions should I combine it with?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_787_1.text: I only bring in the best leaves... through a certified route. As for outlaws, I can guarantee there are none in my store.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_787_2.text: I hadn't expected such fine tea outside the country of Ryu. ... Anyway, I hear that there are many wanted outlaws roaming nearby. Do you know anything about this, bartender?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_788_1.text: Ah, so the hero of the Wild West is back in town.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_788_2.text: I've received reports of suspicious activity concerning this tea house. Please step out of the way. The premises must be searched.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_789_1.text: Haha, and you have fine taste! Young man, here are some treats that should pair nicely with the tea, on the house!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_789_2.text: Sip... Ah, this is fine tea you have! Everything is perfect: the fresh aroma - the right temperature - the delicate flavor!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_790_1.text: Young lady, I won't tolerate trouble in my house.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_790_2.text: Smuggled goods! I can't let this pass! You're under arrest!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_791_1.text: And what do you mean by that? Doubt alone proves nothing.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_791_2.text: A leopard can't change its spots. Remember that I have my eye on you.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_792_1.text: Even death won't part us now, Faust.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_792_2.text: Sien, I've never been so happy in my life.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_792_3.text: Love stronger than death... So romantic!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_793_1.text: Huh? This is a fish-shaped bag, not a real fish, meow!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_793_2.text: So it was you who took my fish! I just stole that; give it back to me!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_794_1.text: Please don’t cook marshmallows over someone else’s head!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_794_2.text: Mm mm mm~~ Tasty squish yummy marshmallows roasting over an open fire~

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_795_1.text: Ah... The god you worship reeks of foulness. You must severe your ties before it's too late...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_795_2.text: They are my only family. Never speak of them in that way again.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_796_1.text: ... Ignorance can sometimes serve as wisdom that will save you from worse trouble.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_796_2.text: That dangerous and probably forbidden but irresistible aura... What exactly is it that you carry on your back? I simply must know!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_797_2.text: Keep us from all evil, and lead this world to eternal salvation...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_797_3.text: O pure Light, show us the rightful path...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_798_1.text: Ha-ha, Odin's wearing an eyepatch only to look cool for the girls!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_799_1.text: ... Try me, Estelle. If you dare.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_799_2.text: How dare you repay Professor's kindness in such a manner! I'll punish your ingratitude with my very own hands!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_800_1.text: What an interesting magic - enchantment that employs the power of the moon. Would you care to explain the specific principles and formulas by which you carry out your ritual?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_800_2.text: P-principles? Formulas? I only have to pray to the moon with all my heart, and she lends me her strength.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_801_1.text: You'll get wet if you get too close to me. I'm sorry...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_801_2.text: It's okay - flowers like the rain! Let's go together and see!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_802_1.text: Thank you for your concern, Senator Athena. However, please refer to me by my proper title of 'Hades' from now on.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_802_2.text: Macaria... I give you my sincerest condolences for your recent loss.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_803_1.text: Ah... Yes, Uncle Ar- I mean, Senator Ares.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_803_2.text: Come, Senator Hades. I will teach you what you need to know.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_804_2.text: Hades, you fool... Were you so desperate as to yoke your young daughter's soul to the eternal curse of your family?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_805_1.text: When the task of the Rings finally comes to an end... I will gladly pay the price for my family's sins.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_805_2.text: Ah, the heir of the bloodline that dares to refuse my calling. You have your father's eyes, little girl: defiant and brash as to stare at Death in the face.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_806_1.text: Thank you, but that is my own business, First Saintess.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_806_2.text: Your soul is burdened with that of another. Is there any way I can help you?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_807_1.text: Haha... You're the same as ever, Zeus.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_807_2.text: Oh, Macaria! You poor thing, come and pour your heart out in my arms!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_808_1.text: Huh, so this is one of the many powers of my new ring...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_809_1.text: I'm not a little kid anymore, Athena. Why don't you lay off me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_809_2.text: Zeus, what is this I hear of your soldiers failing to show any proper discipline? Remember your place and your duty.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_810_1.text: Achilles! I heard of your overwhelming victory at the Colosseum! Congratulations on defending your title of Champion - again!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_810_2.text: Haha, thanks, brother! Come with me now, I'm buying a round of drinks for everyone!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_811_1.text: Good morning, Senator! Won't you join my soldiers and me on our morning run?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_811_2.text: Ah, Senator Zeus. Sigh... My son would do well to follow in your steps.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_812_1.text: Haha, I heard that you burnt down an entire forest! I knew you had it in you!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_812_2.text: Erm... I didn't do it on purpose...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_813_1.text: How come a little girl who should be protected at home is wielding that kind of power?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_813_2.text: Hm. I have many things to protect with this power. I have great responsibilities.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_814_1.text: I didn't follow you because I trusted you… I trusted my sister.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_814_2.text: Thank you for trusting me, Fredrick.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_815_1.text: …Who is it? Is it someone you know, Francesca?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_815_2.text: No… But it looks like he has gone through the same things as us.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_815_3.text: Are you… like me? I can feel we are different, but I feel something familiar…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_816_1.text:
Well. Who knows if I betrayed the Order, or if the Order betrayed me... 
Can you be certain which one it is? Sister.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_816_2.text: Brother, how come you betrayed the Goddess and joined the pagans?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_817_1.text: Francesca. You sacrificed yourself all this time for me? I… didn't even remember your existence.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_817_2.text: It's okay, Fredrick. This is the path I chose… As for the forgotten memories, we can make new ones.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_818_1.text: …Thank you for helping me. I wouldn't have been able to bring Fredrick back on my own.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_818_2.text: If you are grateful, I want 10 chocolates!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_818_3.text: If there's someone suffering because of the evil doings of the Order of the Goddess, then of course we must reach out to help. We… Demona!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_819_1.text: You… How long have these experiments been going on for?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_819_2.text: So there was another one besides that stuttering child… There's no end to human sin.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_820_1.text: Sacred? Don't make me laugh. Try if you can!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_820_2.text: You joined hands with the Black Order and dared to step into a sacred cathedral. You will pay for that sin in the name of the Goddess!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_821_1.text: …What? I-I'm sorry… But please don't come near me.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_821_2.text: Darkness… I feel darkness… I must go…

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_822_1.text: …I'm not sure. What do you want to know?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_822_2.text: …A normal human survived this kind of experiment. How?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_831_1.text: But... But black beans are good for you! You should eat more vegetables, Princess Vivian...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_831_2.text: Stop secretly putting black beans in the rice! You're not my mom!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_832_1.text: Oh, erm... I... I didn't mean to offend you... I just wasn't used to it; I'll be more careful in the future...! I'm so sorry!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_832_2.text: Jack, why do you always call me 'lady'? Do you not want to admit that I'm a Princess of Hell Island?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_833_1.text: I-I think so too... Some people can be very rude...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_833_2.text: Kids these days. They have no respect for their elders. Everything was better when Queen Demona ruled with an iron fist...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_834_1.text: I-I'm a completely normal age for a Dryad! You're the one who should be embarrassed, introducing yourself as twelve-years-old!

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_834_2.text: Hey there, grandma. Do people know how old you really are?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_835_1.text: Hmm? Your smell is so addictive...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_836_1.text: I am not so sure. I only had a couple of drinks with them to ease the tension between us, but...

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_836_2.text: The other Tiger Generals seem to be avoiding you. Can you think of a reason why?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_837_1.text: Mengqi. Have I done something wrong? I noticed that you only talk with General Hansheng.

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_838_1.text: Oh, General Shuwen? Can you hear me?

TEXT_INTERACTION_EASTER_EGG_838_2.text:
... ....
(Zilong... He is a nice enough lad and I am always grateful that he's patient enough to listen to everything I have to say, but he doesn't have to ruminate over his answers to my questions and return with them days after, when I can't remember half of the things I asked him. Diligence is good but too much of a good thing, and you have a lad like Zilong. Perhaps that's the reason why I find him a little difficult to talk to these days... Well, you can't have everything... I wonder if I pushed him too far in our training sessions when he was younger. Maybe a wrong blow to the wrong vein changed his personality and made him like this... Is he still talking? ...
