TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_02.text:
If you have been tricked by the evil pagans, 
it's not too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_03.text: Instead of using such a terrible power…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_16_04.text:
It would be better if you play with some cute dolls 
in a warm house.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_17_01.text:
What...
I thought you were stuck up...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_17_02.text:
You are actually pretty okay.
Don't you agree, Melissa?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_17_03.text: Demona… This really isn't the time for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_18_01.text: Hmph, thanks for thinking of me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_18_02.text:
We didn't come here because 
we wanted to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_18_03.text: Someone begged to help you, so that's why I came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_19_02.text:
That's... Not something we can tell you.
They should be joining us soon…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_01.text: Why are you doing this, Brother?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_03.text:
Fredrick, my brother.
I have always been fond of you…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_04.text: But it is now time to end this tragedy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_05.text:
You have done your duty, 
as a servant of the goddesses, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_1_06.text: I've been hiding something from you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_01.text:
There you are, Francesca. 
And the escape route?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_02.text:
… No issues. 
I took care of anything that might get in the way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_03.text:
Glad to hear that.
Let's hurry, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_04.text:
Yea, you might have taken care of the ones on the way, 
but there might be more of them coming.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_20_05.text:
…They just keep on coming.
Now what. A corrupted apostle from your side?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_21_02.text:
Don't come close.
The energy of darkness is pulsing everywhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_22_03.text:
…We came here to save you.
You are not alone now, so we can do it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_01.text:
…I don't understand what you are talking about.
How can I just trust you and follow you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_02.text:
And...
Regardless of that demon and pagan over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_03.text: You really are absolute darkness itself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_23_04.text: And who are you saying you want to save?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_01.text:
…Why do you want to stay here?
You saw how they treated you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_02.text:
I must choose between those who have been by my side 
all my life, and some corrupted strangers...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_03.text: Is that so hard to choose from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_05.text:
You know about the things they have done… They are
too evil and unethical to be for the goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_06.text:
…If that's what the goddess wants, then
what is the Road of Light that they believe in?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_08.text: ... How much, do you not remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_09.text:
Don't you remember how many children
died in those experiments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_24_10.text:
…What? How do you know,
…Ugh! My head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_25_01.text:
…A-are you okay?
I'm sorry. I reminded you of a painful memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_25_02.text:
Ugh... What... 
…What was that just now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_01.text:
... But, it's the truth. 
They used you, and now that they don't need you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_02.text:
They are trying to get rid of you, 
like the other subjects of their experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_03.text: I… cannot let that happen. I can't just stand and watch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_04.text: I will not let that happen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_06.text:
I'm sure it must be hard to go against the faith
that was imposed on you, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_26_08.text:
…I know it sounds ridiculous. 
But let me help you. Fredrick.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_27_01.text:
Over there!!
There! The traitor and the pagans!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_28_01.text:
Hey, it's nice and all, seeing siblings meeting again. 
But I don't think this is the time for that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_28_02.text:
Demona is right. 
We really don't have time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_29_03.text:
Even if you don't remember, and your body can't
be reached… As family, I'll protect you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_2_01.text:
Because of your existence, 
part of this world is being tainted by evil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_2_02.text:
Fredrick, do you know why you are able
to wholly exist as the container of light…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_30_03.text:
It's hard for you if I'm near you. 
…You feel the energy of darkness pulsing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_31_01.text: It's okay. I'll keep my distance behind you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_31_02.text:
Okay.
…You told me to trust you, so you better come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_32_02.text: We'll make you pay for making us suffer all this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_3_02.text:
Wrong. In order for you
to be born as the container of absolute light...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_3_03.text:
There was a little girl who 
received the darkness you had.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_03.text:
The stigmata on your forehead, 
was used to transfer your darkness to her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_04.text:
As you reborn as the container for absolute light, your 
sister became the container for absolute darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_05.text:
One that corrupts everything... 
A servant of the wicked darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_06.text: A twin? I know nothing about this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_4_07.text:
If I had family, 
How could I not remember all this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_01.text:
What is strange about that? Your memory
is not complete. Of course you don't remember.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_02.text:
What… are you saying...
My memory is not complete?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_03.text:
How could someone who hasn't purified his own memory 
be called the container of light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_05.text:
As long as you exist, evil will engulf this world...
And will corrupt innocent people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_06.text:
…Now, Fredrick. It is now time
for you to step up to the altar of offerings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_07.text:
For this world... 
For the goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_08.text:
Just as we sacrificed everything
so far for you,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_5_09.text: now is your turn to step up to the altar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_6_02.text:
Your life will remain
a part of the path for the great goddesses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_6_03.text: Then, may you rest in eternal peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_01.text:
The Black Order…?!
How did you enter…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_02.text: What do you mean by "how"? Through the door, of course!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_03.text: We are not late. What a relief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_04.text:
W-who are you guys...
And that appearance... Demons?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_7_05.text:
You must be confused, but we don't have time. 
We have to get you out of here now…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_8_01.text: How dare you evil pagans step inside a cathedral!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_48_8_02.text:
They never change, do they?
Words don't get through them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_02.text:
The festival is well underway, and the place is crowded
with people who share an interest and love of plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_03.text:
I thought it would be fun to participate. As you can
see, I'm running a plant consultation booth here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_04.text:
A lot of the locals have been visiting to consult their
plant-related problems. I've been quite popular...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_05.text:
... to the point that I'm finding it difficult to keep up with
them. I'm not sure why you came to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_10_06.text:
But if you help me today, I'll see what I can do to
alleviate your troubles, whatever they may be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_01.text:
W-what do you mean?
I never said anything about needing your help...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_02.text: Oh, I see I was mistaken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_03.text:
... Okay, okay. I'll do as you say...
But you have to keep your promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_11_04.text:
Okay, great!
Then let's do this! Next!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_12_01.text:
Hello, Professor! I found this flower at the
Girl Scout camping grounds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_12_02.text:
Isn't it pretty? I'm going to plant it in a pot. What
should I prepare if I want to grow this kind of flower?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_01.text: Hmm... Do you have a cat or a dog in your family?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_02.text: Oh, how did you know? I have a two-year-old kitten!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_03.text: Yes, I thought I saw cat hair on your uniform!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_04.text: I recommend that you don't grow this flower if you have a cat…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_05.text:
This narcissus is a bulb plant.
It can be poisonous to cats!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_06.text:
Oh, I didn't know that!
Whew, I'm glad I asked you first!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_07.text:
If you want a new plant companion, I recommend
the 'braid tree' or the 'starflower grass.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_08.text:
Even if your cat decides to nibble on them,
it'll be perfectly safe!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_13_10.text: Good luck with your new plant! Next~

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_15_01.text:
Hello, Ms. Botanist. I recently succeeded in developing
a new variety of flower.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_15_02.text:
I've prepared to sell this new species at the festival:
I've given it water, the best fertilizer on the market...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_15_03.text:
But it only continues to wilt, regardless of how much
care I give it. Could you see what the problem is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_16_01.text:
You've given your plants too much fertilizer! The excess
of nutrients is what's slowly killing your plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_16_03.text: Now, as for this new variety of yours...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_16_04.text:
You should have only watered it slightly… The roots
may have rotted due to the excessive hydration.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_17_01.text:
Oh, no... W-what should I do?
This year's profits depend on this one flower!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_17_02.text:
Don't worry!
We have an expert who'll help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_18_01.text:
N-no! I don't want to. He killed off his flower with his
greed. Why should I help him?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_18_02.text:
Oh, don't be so harsh.
You promised to help, didn't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_18_03.text:
I know you can save them...
Both the flower, and this gardener's yearly profits.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_19_02.text:
If I fail to save my flower before the festival ends...
My yearly income will suffer greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_19_03.text:
He desperately needs your help.
Why don't we give him a hand, just this one time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_1_02.text:
She said she was going to study a gigantic plant rumored
to have been recently discovered somewhere...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_1_03.text:
I haven't seen her since. Has it been, what, a week?
Maybe two weeks since I last saw her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_20_01.text:
... Ugh.
Fine, fine. Give me that pot.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_21_01.text:
Oh... Ooh...! My flower! It's revived!
And it's more beautiful than ever!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_21_02.text:
Thank you, Professors!
I won't ever forget your kindness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_21_03.text:
I... I don't care. Just don't kill off your plants again.
They don't deserve that kind of treatment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_22_01.text: ... Isn't that why you're here, Éfendére?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_23_02.text:
I'm talking about your forest, of course. Aren't you
here because you're in doubt of your own powers?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_24_02.text:
If an Elf like you - proud, conservative, and all-too-willing
to stay home - came all the way to meet me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_01.text:
And seeing that you came to find me in time of need,
your opinion of me must be higher than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_02.text: I'm a little happy for that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_04.text:
You were right all along.
My forest is dying, and it's all my fault.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_05.text: I only wanted to keep my forest beautiful...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_06.text:
Now I'm being punished for being greedy.
It's all my fault.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_25_07.text:
... I'm no different from that stupid gardener...
No, I'm actually worse...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_26_01.text:
Stop blaming yourself, Éfendére. Self-pity does
nothing to help revitalize your forest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_01.text:
Does that mean... that you're going to help me?
But my forest... Nothing grows there anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_03.text:
Don't worry!
An academic's strongest suit is their tenacity!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_04.text:
This is my first research attempting to save an entire
forest. It will be a great opportunity for me as well!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_27_05.text: Hehe. This is so exciting! I can't wait to see how things turn out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_28_01.text:
... Thank you.
I'm sorry for how I treated you back then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_28_03.text:
Shall we go now?
To save your forest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_29_01.text:
Gardening may seem simple,
but it requires delicate skills.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_29_02.text:
As for me,
even a cactus provides a challenge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_2_01.text:
A gigantic plant?
I heard that some Hero took care of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_2_02.text:
There was another Elf who came this way last week.
She seemed very interested in plants, just like you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_2_05.text:
Well... I do recall
that she mentioned heading towards Hero Town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_01.text:
Pant... Pant...
I missed her... Again?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_02.text:
Linné...
How can you travel so quickly? And why?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_03.text:
... I'm too tired to search any longer.
I'll rest in this village for tonight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_04.text:
Come visit our Spring Festival~! Fresh fruit, home-grown
vegetables, snacks and attractions galore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_3_05.text:
Greet the flowering new season at the annual Spring Festival,
where everyone is welcome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_4_01.text:
Spring Festival...? Maybe I can spare some time take
a look around...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_4_02.text:
But then again, what do humans know about
handling the true power of the earth?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_4_03.text:
All they're interested in
is making money off plants...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_01.text:
... And I watered it according to the manual,
but it continues to wilt. I don't know what to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_02.text: Should I give them more fertilizer?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_03.text:
Oh, this plant should bloom very soon!
It needs much more water than usual.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_6_04.text:
Soak them in water once or twice every day,
and it will freshen up in no time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_7_01.text:
I-I found you at last!
Linné!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_7_02.text:
Please stand in line!
I'll get to everybody in time if you -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_01.text:
It's been a long time! What brings you out of your forest?
You usually insist on staying at home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_02.text:
And at a festival like this! Who would've thought
we'd meet here, out of all places?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_03.text:
That's what I should be saying!
It took me forever to find you here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_8_04.text: The world is wide and full of plants to meet and study!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_9_01.text:
Hmm... Tell me later, if you want.
Anyway...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_49_9_02.text:
You're well versed in botany, Éfendére.
Won't you give me a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_10_01.text:
Did you really expect me to not recognize you, even
if it has been years since our last meeting?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_10_02.text:
You're still embarrassed of your name, aren't you, Barnie?
Is that why you pretended you were a stranger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_01.text: ... Ugh... Couldn't you just have pretended not to know me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_02.text:
But how could I ignore my childhood friend?
You're cruel, Barnie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_03.text:
It's the first time I'm seeing you since you left to 'see the
world.' Our cute little baby of the group, Barnie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_04.text:
S-stop calling me that!
I'm not Barnie anymore.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_05.text:
I go by Basquiat now. I finally have a name that
sounds like an artist's!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_11_06.text:
Basquiat?
Huh, I've heard that name before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_02.text:
The head of the artists
rebelling against Road Industry, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_05.text:
So stop calling me Barnie.
I told you, it's lame.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_07.text:
But I didn't know you still painted.
I remember you were good at art, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_12_08.text: Hadn't you given it up to earn a living?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_01.text:
... I had, but I discovered that you can't stop your
heart from getting what it wants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_02.text:
That's how I've been living: painting the streets
with members of my crew...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_03.text:
... when mercenaries, hired by those big companies,
started kidnapping my friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_04.text:
I've yet to find out what they're up to, but I know for sure
that it can't be good. But nobody seems to care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_06.text:
The conglomerates of this nation are using human beings
as tools in the name of 'the advancement of science.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_07.text: It's a tragedy that must be stopped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_08.text: Yeah. We can't remain blind to their crimes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_09.text:
I had to speak up,
if only for the sake of my friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_13_10.text: This led to that, and now... I'm here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_01.text:
Anyway. Weren't those soldiers back there
mercenaries hired by Rapture Science?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_02.text: I thought they were here for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_03.text:
Why are you on the run?
And what's that strange bow you have there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_05.text: Give me the short version, then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_14_06.text:
I'm a wanted criminal.
If they catch me, I'm dead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_15_01.text: ... Okay, a little longer than that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_01.text:
Alright... I'm currently working for
the Neth Empire Interim Government.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_02.text: The Scrappy Gang disbanded after the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_03.text:
I joined the Revolutionary Army to fight against
corrupted soldiers, developing my own arrows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_04.text:
After a few clashes with mechanized troops
belonging to Rapture Science...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_16_05.text: I found that I had a bounty on my head. And so here I am.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_01.text:
Whoa... You've been living the hard life, too.
... I guess we're both aiming for the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_03.text:
I mean, who in their right mind would ever tolerate
such evil? And right under our noses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_04.text:
Those companies will sacrifice their own humanity
if it means they can develop some new technology.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_17_05.text:
... It's highly likely that your friends were kidnapped
to be used as test subjects for their experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_18_01.text:
Isn't it obvious why they're kidnapping so many people? They
need cheap batteries filled with mana to experiment...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_18_02.text:
... which they can take by the dozen from the back
alleys or slums, no trouble.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_18_03.text:
I thought they were only interested in foreign wizards,
but if even the people of Neth were kidnapped...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_01.text:
A-are they insane?
And what do they do that for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_02.text:
I thought mad scientists only existed in TV shows.
Are they really experimenting on humans?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_03.text:
Yes. For what they call technological advancements…
For power. They're using human beings as mere tools.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_04.text: That's... I don't know what to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_19_05.text:
I just thought that they were forcing kidnapped people
to work in an underground mine or something.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_1_02.text:
All that's left is the back alley of 5th Avenue… and the
walls of 2nd Street... And today's work is done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_1_03.text:
You there, vandalizing the streets!
Halt!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_20_01.text:
People have been keeping quiet about what's going on,
even when they knew the truth. It's time to change.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_20_02.text:
Yeah. I refuse to live in a country
that oppresses its own helpless citizens.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_20_03.text: We gotta fight, if no one else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_21_02.text:
We may have a chance to cooperate in the future. Until
then, let's do our best in our respective places.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_21_03.text:
Did you hear that?
It must be the intruders!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_22_01.text: Looks like we wasted too much time here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_22_02.text:
We've gotta run.
Come on, Barnie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_23_01.text: I told you to call me Basquiat!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_24_01.text:
Barnie... That's adorable - and easy to remember.
Why he was so embarrassed of his old name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_24_02.text:
Actually, changing my name could bring a fresh breath
of air. How about... Pandy? Dora? Dorie?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_24_03.text:
...
Fine, you don't have to look at me like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_2_01.text:
Oh, crap!
They must be hired mercenaries!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_3_02.text:
Shh.
Be quiet for a sec.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_4_01.text:
Which way did he go? He can't have gone too far.
This is the last time he'll get away...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_4_02.text:
I'll search this direction.
You go the other way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_5_01.text:
... Looks like they left.
Sorry about that just now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_5_02.text:
You can't just run in here like that!
The spray hasn't dried yet - ... huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_6_01.text:
Wait... Do you know me?
You seem strangely familiar...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_6_02.text:
N-no! We don't know each other!
I mistook you for someone else. Haha...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_7_01.text:
... We're both on the run. We don't have time for chit-chat.
Go that way; there's an escape hatch there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_7_02.text:
Hmm? The only people who know about that hatch
are members of the Scrappy Gang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_7_03.text:
Yes... Your face... your voice… Everything about
you points to one person I know very well...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_01.text:
I-it's not Barnie! Do I look like a Barnie to you?
Do I look like a cute four-year-old kid?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_02.text:
I am the great artist and rebel Basquiat, sworn to fight
against the crimes of the conglomerates of Neth!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_03.text:
That strange dislike of the name 'Barnie'… How he
reacted... It certainly seems like the Barnie I know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_05.text:
I don't know who you think I am,
but I'm not it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_06.text:
Then let's make sure.
Take off your mask.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_50_8_07.text:
I told you, I don't -
Ack! My mask! Give it back!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_01.text:
Quaxo what?
... I knew it. You're insane.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_02.text:
'Quaxolotl.'
The great god who leads our tribe -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_03.text:
Sigh... Fine, fine.
Then why have you come all the way out here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_04.text:
Your tribe refused to venture out of the jungle
for years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_05.text:
As I said before,
we were blessed by the great god Quaxolotl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_06.text:
That is why we don't have to
hide in the jungle anymore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_10_07.text:
It's about time we come out back into the open
and with a power matching that of the Woopa tribe -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_12_03.text:
Night falls, and quickly.
You will be late for dinner, at this rate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_12_04.text:
I was just about to return, but that weirdo insisted on
summoning his disgusting bugs and pestering me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_13_01.text: Huh? Do you two know each other?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_13_02.text:
It is 'Woopa,' not 'Woompa.'
... I met him once, when he was still a boy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_13_03.text:
Yes, it has indeed been awhile, Luca. Quite a few years,
in fact, since I've last spoken with one of the Coatl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_13_05.text: Hrrmph. I've no obligation to explain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_13_06.text:
We, the great Coatl tribe, will soon return
to win back our glory in the sun.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_14_01.text:
That mood swing was abrupt.
Freak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_14_02.text: Are all Coatl tribespeople like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_14_03.text:
Of course not. Luca was always more hot-tempered than
most, even as a child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_14_04.text:
It seems he still harbors ill will
towards our tribe - especially me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_15_02.text:
No. Something that cannot be seen. I cannot explain it,
this anxiety that uncoils within me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_15_03.text:
It is welcome news that the Coatl tribe
is thinking of returning to the open...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_15_04.text:
... but there is something unnerving about the news
that I cannot quite pinpoint.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_16_01.text:
Oh, Chief. You always worry over nothing. Come on!
Let's forget about that weirdo and return home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_16_02.text: We're really going to be late for the tribal dinner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_16_03.text:
Yes.
I only hope that is the case...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_17_01.text:
Bugs, snakes… Interesting varieties of magic can be
found deep within the jungle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_17_02.text:
... I better keep out of their way
when they start fighting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_1_01.text:
The soil of this region is especially fertile.
The jungle is lush... And there's even a waterway.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_1_02.text:
Good, I'll be remembering it as a candidate
for my tribe's new home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_1_03.text:
Now, before I return,
I'll check out the lake by the third hilltop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_2_01.text: Hello, sweetie! Where did you come from?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_2_03.text:
You're the prettiest snake I've seen for miles around!
Hmm? What's that? You know your scales are beautiful?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_3_01.text:
There shouldn't be another tribe around here.
Do you belong to the Woopa tribe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_3_02.text:
Shh! Stop bothering me!
Go away! Can't you see that I'm busy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_3_04.text:
Hey! You're scaring her! Don't wave your gun around
like that. W-wait, eek?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_4_01.text:
Sigh... I was just in time.
That snake won't be returning any time soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_4_02.text:
Ack! Where did all these bugs come from?!
Get away from me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_4_03.text:
Calm down.
They won't harm you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_4_04.text: On the other hand, that snake was an extremely deadly viper.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_4_05.text:
It's aggressive, too,
so you were likely to be bit -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_4_06.text:
These bugs are causing me a thousand times more harm
than that poor serpent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_01.text:
Pestering me
when I was on the verge of making a new friend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_02.text:
Appearing out of nowhere and attacking with these
disgusting bugs! Who do you think you are, huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_03.text:
... Pestering you? What do you mean?
Weren't you getting attacked by that snake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_04.text:
Of course not! I fight alongside serpents.
My bow borrows from their strength.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_05.text:
I was excited because I'd never seen her kind
around these parts, before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_06.text:
And then you come and ruin everything. She probably won't
come back, knowing there's a raving lunatic here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_5_07.text: What are you going to do about this?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_6_01.text:
... You can summon and control such dangerous vipers?
Huh, I thought there was something special about you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_6_02.text:
You're no ordinary girl.
I'm a little sorry that you belong to the Woopa tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_6_03.text:
What are you mumbling about? Speak up!
Ugh, it still feels like I have bugs in my mouth...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_6_04.text: I've lost my appetite for the next month.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_6_05.text:
Bugs are edible. Don't worry,
none of the ones I summoned were poisonous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_6_06.text: ... Yeah, thanks for that helpful piece of advice. Not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_7_02.text:
I've never heard of any tribe around here
who can control insects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_7_03.text: I am Chief Luca of the great Coatl tribe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_7_04.text:
I was navigating the area
to find more prosperous land for my people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_8_01.text:
Chief? Someone so young like you?
And you say you're from the Coatl tribe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_8_02.text: I've heard of you, but not that you could summon insects.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_9_01.text:
Ha. As you just witnessed just now, we Coatl tribe received
a special power from the great god Quaxolotl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_51_9_02.text: Summoning armies of bugs is a part of that power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_10_01.text:
My apologies.
The other Four Witches can be... excessive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_10_02.text:
I've told them that they can't resort to brute force every time
they find something not to their liking... Sigh.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_10_03.text:
N-no! I'm thankful that you agreed to hear me out.
Thank you, Master Arita.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_11_01.text:
However. Is it true
that Rainbow Delivery has gone bankrupt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_11_02.text: That's... troublesome, to say the least.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_11_03.text:
Not many delivery services
agree to deliver letters in confidentiality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_12_01.text: If that's the case, don't worry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_12_02.text:
For you, Master Arita,
I'll deliver it myself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_12_03.text:
Is that so?
You have my thanks then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_12_04.text:
Of course! I'll continue delivering your letters for you,
if...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_12_05.text: If... I can ask for your help?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_13_01.text:
Hmm. You mentioned you were
searching for a delivery witch named Arche.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_13_02.text: Is she not the merchant who sells stakes at every Pumpkin Festival?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_13_03.text:
She won't be able to refuse the promise of high profit.
You could find her easily then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_14_01.text: U-until the Pumpkin Festival?! That far away?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_14_02.text:
... You are right. You will not last until then,
not with so many people looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_14_03.text:
And with Wolfram on your tracks,
there is not much you can do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_14_04.text: Ugh... Nothing? S-so my fate is sealed?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_14_05.text:
D-don't you know any expert of... tracking magic, maybe?
Or an acquaintance who may know Arche's whereabouts?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_15_02.text:
She will stop at nothing
to gain profit for herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_15_03.text:
It is highly probable
that she has been planning her flight for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_15_05.text:
D-does that mean
that you can't do anything, Master Arita?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_15_06.text:
I'm sorry. It seems your best course of action
is to hide and wait until things cool down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_15_07.text:
I have nowhere to to go...
What should I do...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_16_01.text:
Hmm.
Iris, what do you have in that bag there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_17_01.text:
It's my treasure.
It's the only thing I managed to bring with me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_17_02.text:
This is all the data I recorded
while researching delivery magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_17_03.text:
I may be on the run, but that doesn't mean I can stop my
research! I couldn't leave my documents behind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_18_01.text:
Oho. Such valuable information regarding a new type of
magic… That could turn the tide for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_19_01.text:
What? Really?!
How can this pile of paper help me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_19_02.text:
They could win over one witch
who may be able to help you find Arche.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_19_03.text:
I... do not exactly recommend seeking her out,
as she hardly is one known for her altruism.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_1_01.text:
What? Rainbow Delivery... Bankrupt?
Can such a successful business die overnight?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_1_02.text: ... Wait, what happened to my investments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_20_01.text:
P-please introduce her to me!
I'm desperate. I need all the help I can get.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_20_02.text: P-please? Where can I find her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_20_03.text:
... Follow a babbling brook that leads to the eastern forest,
and you will find yourself at a site of ruins.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_20_04.text:
Nearby, you will see a dilapidated house.
A witch dwells there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_20_06.text:
Once... A long time ago, 
I once received her help as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_01.text:
She must be very powerful
to have helped you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_02.text:
But it's the first time I'm hearing of any great witch
living in the eastern woods...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_03.text: I guess it's true that I've been living under a rock.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_04.text:
She usually keeps to herself in her forest,
so it is only natural that you do not know her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_05.text:
And she never uses her magic for others,
no matter what you offer her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_07.text:
However... She happens to be a curious sort,
especially about different usages of magic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_08.text:
Your research data
will certainly pique her interest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_21_09.text:
They will be worthy of trade to her,
so you will want to take them with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_22_01.text:
I see!
I'll go right now, then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_22_02.text:
The deep parts of the eastern forest,
near some ruins, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_22_03.text:
Here is a map.
I have marked the road for you in red.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_22_04.text:
Be careful. Do not consider her offer lightly.
Think before you accept anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_22_05.text:
Of course! Hee hee...
I'm glad I sought you out, Master Arita!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_22_06.text:
When I find Arche, I'll come and thank you personally
the first chance I get!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_23_01.text:
... Oh, and I'll make sure to deliver your letter
within the week!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_23_02.text: So don't worry. Then I'll see myself off!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_24_01.text:
Betrayed by her friend and having to bear the burden by
herself… I feel bad for her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_24_02.text: What path will unfold before her, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_2_01.text:
Professor Wolfram!
H-have you seen Arche anywhere?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_2_02.text:
I-I know she was home last night, but she disappeared!
And she took everything with her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_2_03.text:
Ah, I've been looking for you, Iris.
You have some explaining to do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_3_01.text:
Monopolizing an entire industry, then going bankrupt
overnight. That's too extreme, in such a short time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_3_02.text:
I gave you my trust, and my trust is something to be valued.
Now, then, who shall I inquire for a return on my investments?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_3_03.text:
I-I... That's why I've been
searching for Arche -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_3_04.text:
I cannot overlook this transgression. I refuse to
overlook this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_3_05.text:
Professor Estelle is also enraged over the news.
Now, if you will excuse me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_5_02.text:
I know you're busy, but...
Can I have a word with you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_6_01.text:
If you know I'm busy, why won't you leave me alone? Why
are so many people bothering me these days?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_6_02.text:
I'm counting to 3. If you're still here by the time I say
'3,' you can be sure you'll be burnt to a crisp. 1… 2...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_7_01.text: Eek. D-did you invest as well, Master Shasha?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_7_02.text:
I thought you had no interest
or knowledge whatsoever in the economy...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_7_03.text:
... Are you trying to insult me?
Never mind. Where is the book I ordered?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_7_04.text:
You told me you didn't know last time.
Have you still not found it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_8_01.text:
O-oh! That!
Erm, that's not exactly my area of business...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_8_02.text:
Arche deals with the actual deliveries.
She's been missing for a few days, so that's why I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_8_03.text:
Don't you KNOW how many days it has been?!
I need that book NOW! I'm busier than you think!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_8_04.text:
I ask and ask and you tell me every time 
you don't know and you don't care! I've had enough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_52_9_01.text:
... And that's why...
I found myself all the way out here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_10_001.text: Sigh... You can tell why Achilles is so unpopular, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_1_001.text:
The scope of Athena's power only continues to grow,
while mine wanes... What to do...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_1_002.text:
I must put these two under my command.
It is the only way I can win that sly witch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_1_003.text:
... Now that I think of it, when are they arriving?
I called for them urgently! Ugh, commoners! Always late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_2_001.text:
Haha, welcome, welcome!
I have been waiting for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_2_002.text: Do you have a reason for summoning us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_2_003.text:
A man of haste. I see.
Straight to business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_2_004.text:
Please hurry.
We have a meeting with an important figure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_3_001.text:
And impudent as well! Well, your current popularity 
allows it, so I will allow it as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_3_002.text:
In fact, I want to make you two celebrities an offer. Aren't 
you curious of what my generosity can grant you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_3_004.text: I thought this was supposed to be something 'important'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_3_005.text:
Listen, and you may change your mind. Come under my 
command. Together we shall rule Roman, strong and -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_3_007.text: That goes for me as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_4_001.text:
What? At least take some time to think it over! Do you not 
know that opportunities like this are not so common?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_4_002.text:
This is... a sensitive situation, so I shall proceed with cau-
tion. We have received a similar offer from the Lady Athena.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_4_003.text:
Athena? Athena?!
It is always Athena -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_4_004.text:
And we were on our way with our answer. It was only the
urgency of your messenger that brought us here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_4_006.text: We thank you for the 'generosity' you have shown us, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_4_007.text: We have decided to follow Lady Athena.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_5_002.text:
Thank you for your kind offer once again, Lord Achilles.
We wish you luck on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_5_003.text:
Surely we shall meet again.
Goodbye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_6_001.text:
Why does everyone prefer Athena to me?
What does she have that I do not have?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_6_002.text: ... Or rather, what do I lack...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_6_003.text:
Oh, no sir!
YOU are not the problem, Lord Achilles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_6_004.text:
That's right! It's their fault not being able to recognize the 
majesty of the great Lord Achilles, true ruler of Roman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_7_002.text:
Don't we always tell you? Only we can truly perceive the
greatness of the Lord Achilles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_7_003.text:
Through thick and thin, we will stay by your side until the
end, Lord Achilles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_7_004.text: How I wish everyone could be like the two of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_8_001.text:
I have a good plan. You should hold a combat tournament
in your name, then enter to win the competition yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_8_002.text:
Now that's what I call a great plan! With your might and 
valor, you shall win over the hearts of everyone in Roman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_8_003.text:
Hmm... And this plan would be possible ONLY by my
superb self?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_8_004.text:
Of course, milord! It is a plan concocted thought only of
you, for you, BY you, Lord Achilles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_6_9_001.text:
Haha, superb! This shall be my chance to show all in 
Roman my valor and strength! Commence the plan at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_10_02.text: I'll show you the true power of fire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_11_01.text: Well... I suppose you can fight fire with fire, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_11_02.text: ... Burning other people doesn't seem the greatest of solutions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_11_03.text: I wonder if that young man succeeded in getting away?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_1_02.text: The cottage by the big tree stump over the hill...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_1_03.text: This here should be the place, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_2_01.text: Sigh... So it's another dead end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_2_02.text: And I thought I had the right information this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_3_01.text: Who's that making all that noise outside my door?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_4_01.text: Hrrmph, a human... You have some guts, kid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_4_02.text:
Are you ready to pay the price of bothering me on my free afternoon?
Heads up - it's expensive.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_4_03.text: Wait. A-are you the Witch of Fire...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_4_04.text: Finally! I've found you at last!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_4_05.text: Master Witch! I need your help; I beg of you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_5_01.text:
Do you know what you're saying?
Why would I, the Witch of Fire, help a human I don't even know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_5_02.text: And anyway, didn't you just hear me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_5_03.text: If you don't want to be roasted alive, you better -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_6_02.text: Who are you? Rather, what are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_6_03.text: You're just a human. You shouldn't have that sort of power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_6_04.text: Yes! That's exactly the reason why I've been looking for you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_7_01.text:
Huh... So THIS was your true purpose.
To challenge me for my title as the master of Fire!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_8_01.text: Ha! As if you could lay a scratch on me! Come at me, kiddo!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_8_02.text: Let's see whose fire proves the hottest!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_8_04.text:
I mean, I wanted to ask you about my problem,
but this isn't what I meant -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_7_9_02.text: No! You don't understand - I'm not here to fight! I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_10_03.text: I did not mean to pry, Master Ares, but yes, I did.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_11_02.text:
As the one who inherited the title of 'Ares,'
I should know better than to be uselessly caught up in the past.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_12_01.text: It is a painful task, to fully accept one's past for the sake of the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_12_02.text:
Many choose instead to blindly fool themselves,
not wishing to face the anguish and regret...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_12_03.text:
Yet you have chosen to embrace everything,
in order to right your past wrongs.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_13_01.text: ... I have wasted no short time in madness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_13_02.text: I must act now, if I wish to change anything for the better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_13_03.text:
... Many times do I find myself much indebted to you.
Thank you, Athena.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_14_01.text: No, I thank you, Master Ares.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_14_02.text:
In this time of turmoil, your return
after you successfully overcame the influence of the ring...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_14_03.text: ... feels to me like a ray of light in the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_14_04.text: You must remember Persephone still poses a threat to the Republic.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_14_05.text: More than ever, the Council of Olympus must come together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_15_01.text: Yes, we have no time to waste over trivial reflections.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_15_02.text:
As to you and Hades...
I must properly express my gratitude, when the time comes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_15_03.text:
My foolish son recently got himself into trouble
that proved too big for him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_15_04.text: I will hold a feast in your honor after everything has been dealt with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_16_02.text: Ah, did you not say that you would be meeting Achilles this afternoon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_16_04.text:
That boy... He should know better than to continue
fuming over old and trivial hostilities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_16_05.text:
Please pay our disagreements no mind.
I fear he finds me lacking, and I agree with him, in some ways.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_16_06.text:
Ha, I see the rightful amity between childhood friends that he lacks
does not go missing on your side. ... Then, I will see you later.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_17_01.text:
Forgive me for attempting to understand your pain,
for I know that I will fail to grasp the full brunt of your suffering.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_17_02.text:
Yet I also know that lingering in one's dark past
will only prolong the agony to eternity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_17_03.text:
It is but one step. Take but one step into the future,
and you will find that you indeed can put your past behind you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_17_04.text:
There are many who would willingly help you.
... The choice is yours, Harpya. Please remember that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_19_01.text:
Regardless of who you are...
Making yourself into a better person can be difficult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_19_02.text: Will they succeed in overcoming themselves to face a brighter future?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_1_01.text: There's nothing like a stroll in the fresh air to clear one's thoughts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_1_03.text: It seems like it's time to head back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_3_01.text: Harpya, I would not dare ask you for your forgiveness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_3_02.text:
I too had been possessed by the power of my ring for many years,
driven to heights of brutality that I had not known before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_3_04.text: ... how such time spent under evil influence can ruin a person's soul.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_3_05.text: Your pain is my fault to mend. Let me help you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_4_01.text: When you came to the Peaks of Glory... My entire life was destroyed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_4_02.text:
Do you truly believe that if you simply treat your crimes
as the bygone past, claiming to have changed for the better...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_4_03.text: It will immediately solve everything in a nice and tidy manner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_5_01.text: Harpya, you must understand that I -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_6_02.text: By the very person who pushed me into this eternal abyss?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_6_03.text: How will you do that? Let me ask you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_6_04.text:
Will your 'helping' me bring back my comrades,
killed by your soldiers for sport? Will it return my life to as it were before?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_6_05.text: Stop feigning a change of heart!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_6_06.text: Don't make me laugh with your professed goodness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_7_01.text:
You will not escape your past.
Your crimes will define who you are - forever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_7_02.text:
Neither you nor I can escape the confines of the past we have tread.
My life as it is... is proof of that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_8_9_02.text:
If I only had managed to gain control over this ring more quickly...
Things would have been different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_10_01.text:
Aren't they pretty?
Oh, this one bloomed last week!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_10_02.text:
The flowers are still in full bloom.
I think they like living in my room!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_10_03.text:
... Tell me if I've understood properly.
You're telling me that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_10_04.text:
You've been receiving an unidentified plant sent
anonymously every week for the past few months?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_10_06.text:
And you've been happily growing them ever since,
without any suspicions whatsoever?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_11_01.text:
... Of course! Everything is wrong. You shouldn't be so
trusting of people! This is very suspicious business!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_11_02.text:
Huh? What's there to be suspicious of?
Aren't they just pretty plants?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_11_03.text: Sigh... I can't deal with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_12_01.text:
Hera. Don't you understand?
You are a Senator of the Olympian Council.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_12_02.text:
When an unidentified, unsearched package is delivered
to your rooms without anyone knowing about it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_12_03.text: It means bad business. Assassination kind of bad business.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_13_02.text:
What's the matter?
Oh no... Does the plant have bugs?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_13_03.text:
Hera, you must get rid of all these plants right this
instant. No, I'll burn them myself -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_02.text:
My fingers smart after touching them. What if those plants
are poisonous? Haven't you thought of that possibility?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_03.text:
They couldn't be, I'm sure of it! Or else the mystery
friend wouldn't have sent all those nice letters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_04.text:
Although they vanished
after I read them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_05.text:
They said the plants
would help me feel better!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_06.text:
They vanished? Are you sure you didn't lose them?
... Don't you realize how strange everything sounds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_07.text:
And whether they are poisonous or not, these plants are
still my friends. I couldn't just throw them out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_14_08.text:
I've been giving them all my love ever since I received them.
I won't back them this time, not even to you, Zeus!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_01.text:
... Fine. Then... Could I borrow one of those plants
for a little bit? That's okay with you, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_02.text:
Borrow? Hmm... Zeus, for all your talk of burning
it down, you really like this plant, don't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_03.text:
Nonsense. I... Uh... Well, a friend…
I mean a soldier of mine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_04.text:
He loves growing plants...
But, uh, his favorite one withered away recently.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_05.text:
He's very upset, and I hear that his favorite plant
looked just like yours?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_06.text:
If you could lend him one of your plants until he gets a
new one, I'm sure it'll help him get, erm, over his grief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_07.text:
I don't know... Is it okay to lend someone
a present that you received from someone else?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_15_08.text:
It's only for a few days.
I'll even say please, huh? With a cherry on top?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_01.text:
... Okie! He must feel terrible
to have lost his favorite plant like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_02.text: Promise to return them once your friend gets better!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_03.text:
Fine, fine. Oh, and here's the report for today's
conference. Look it over once you feel well enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_16_04.text: Then I'll be seeing myself off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_18_01.text: I knew it. My lightning has grown noticeably weaker.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_18_02.text:
But that plant. What kind of plant is barely affected
by a bolt of lightning, regardless of its strength?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_18_03.text:
So that strange aura I felt in the room...
was caused by the plants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_19_01.text:
A plant that restrains the power of the rings...
I've never heard of such a thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_19_02.text:
And to continuously send such plants only to Hera...
Is that why she's been falling ill more frequently?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_19_03.text:
... Darn it. That kid is too stubborn for her own good.
I'll have to send this sample to be investigated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_1_01.text:
Mm... Oh!
When did I fall asleep?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_1_02.text:
I know I was listening to Zeus telling me about
tomorrow's schedule… And then I suddenly fell ill...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_20_01.text:
A plant that weakens the power of the rings of Roman?
I hadn't known such a thing existed in this dimension.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_20_02.text:
Anyway, those spikes on that plant...
Don't you think they look familiar, somehow?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_2_01.text:
... and I guess an entire day has passed since then?
Oh, no. Zeus's efforts have been for nothing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_2_02.text: Why do I always cause him so much trouble? Sigh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_2_03.text:
As my temperature has fallen,
I should go and apologize! Better late than never!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_3_01.text:
Huh? A parcel, addressed to me...
... Can it be?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_4_01.text:
Hee hee, I thought so.
Another delivery of a flowerpot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_4_02.text:
Ooh, it's a pretty purple flower this time.
And a letter, too.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_02.text:
I hear that you are taking good care of the flowers I sent
you. I am happy that you find them to your liking.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_03.text:
I can imagine how well they're doing
under your benevolent care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_04.text:
Today, I send you an iris. It's a new variety, and I hope it
brings you some well-deserved peace of mind and body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_05.text:
Please look at the enclosed manual for further instructions.
I am sure the flower will help you greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_5_06.text:
I'll send you another present soon.
Sincerely, your caring friend.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_6_02.text:
Whoever they are, this mystery friend always writes so nicely... 
I wish I could keep the letters so I can look at them again and again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_6_03.text:
Hmm, at least the instruction manual
doesn't disappear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_7_01.text:
I'm here to deliver the agenda
discussed at today's conference.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_7_02.text:
Oh, Zeus! Come in! Oh, I've been meaning to go and
find you, not the other way around -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_01.text:
Well, you seem to be doing better today.
How are you feeling?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_03.text:
Haha... Yes, thanks to everyone's help.
B-but I did miss today's meeting, as you said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_04.text: I really need to go and apologize to the other Senators...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_8_05.text:
The other Senators are fully aware of your situation.
So stop worrying.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_01.text:
Hera.
When did you buy a new plant?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_02.text:
I'm sure the last time I visited, you weren't in possession
of that slightly twitching plant over there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_03.text:
Oh, a mystery friend has been sending me presents
since last month!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_04.text:
Apparently, they've been cultivating new flowers just for
me! They asked me to take care of them with love!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_05.text:
Strange. I don't remember receiving any reports
of multiple plants being delivered to the Council.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_06.text:
Hmm? But I always find them lying
right there on my desk when I wake up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_009_9_9_08.text:
Hee hee, isn't it curious?
It could be real magic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_10_0001.text:
HEE HEE... Fools make the greatest actors.
Now time for the Second Act: the Breaking of the Seal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_11_0001.text:
What could Loki be planning?
Aren't you curious about his ulterior motive?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_1_0001.text:
Day after day and nothing ever changes for the better...
This isn't what I wanted! I never wanted this boring life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_2_0001.text:
HAW HAW! You there, young master,
I have a story just for YOU!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_3_0001.text:
A story? What...
Wait! Who are you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_3_0002.text:
HAW HAW! A simple clown I am, traveling the lands
and bringing joy with my stories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_4_0001.text:
But who am I? Who are you? Who is anyone?
It only matters that my story is meant for you and you are meant to listen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_4_0002.text:
What in the...
And why should I listen to a clown that I've just met?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_4_0003.text:
Oh, young master is full of fear and doubt.
No wonder his life is dull! Boring! HOPELESS!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_5_0001.text:
W-what! Did you just call me, the brave Heim, hopeless?
You're lucky I'm in a good mood. Let's hear this story of yours!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_5_0002.text:
HAW HAW! Good, good! 
Well then, have you ever heard of the 'Treasure of the Sanctuary?'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_5_0003.text:
I was born and raised in Nosgard, but it's the first time
I've heard anything of any treasure around the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0001.text:
Oh, only a few know of it: royalty, important figures, blah blah blah.
A NATIONAL SECRET! And now you know! HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0002.text:
R-really? Then how do you know of this 'treasure'?
It seems strange that a mere clown would know something as important...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0003.text:
HAW HAW! Our master is full of doubt! This poor fool only tells stories
to bring joy to others and receive some mere fun as payment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0004.text:
Stories I have by hundreds and thousands! 
Stories that could be true, if you want them to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0005.text:
F-fine! I'll... I'll listen to what you have to say.
So what is this 'treasure'? Could it mean a treasure chest?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_6_0006.text: HAW HAW! That depends on YOUUU, Master Heim!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0002.text:
I say what I mean and I mean what I say! HAW HAW!
Treasure could mean riches and riches. It could mean something... more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0003.text: You mean... It could be used for another purpose?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0004.text:
HAW HAW! WHAT A CLEVER BOY MASTER HEIM IS!
The nature of this 'treasure' depends on the abilities of its owner.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_7_0005.text:
Who knows? Why stop at gold and silver? Why not the entire continent?
It can be whatever you want! HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_8_0002.text:
HAW HAW! It's up to Master Heim, clever and courageous Master Heim!
No boring life for you! Oh, boredom's a bad thing, yes it is, HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0001.text: Haha! Okay! It's time to say goodbye to my boring old life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0002.text:
HAW HAW! Yes, yes, good Master Heim!
No boring life for you. No, indeed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0003.text:
But... this is the Sanctuary we're talking about.
It's forbidden for most people to enter. There could be sentries...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0005.text: Oh, is Master Heim a coward? A COWARD!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0006.text:
Rumors and tales bear ghosts where there are none.
 Mountains out of molehills, dragons out of grass snakes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0006_1.text:
#For a snake to be the tales of dragons, 
it must cut the dragon and take whatever it is the most precious to him.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0007.text:
Y-yes... You're right.
I was just being careful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_1_9_0008.text:
Okay! Every hero needs a trusty crew. I'll start for the Sanctuary
right away with my friends! Good bye, old life!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_1_001.text:
I shall never forgive...
I will make them pay...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_1_002.text:
I will break this seal
that took everything away from me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_001.text:
HAW HAW! He is right, he is right!
What did he do to suffer so? Tragic, tragic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_002.text:
He only sought to earn money
to buy his ailing daughter some medicine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_003.text:
And yet he was punished, encased in the ice for years.
And all for love! All for NOTHING! HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_2_004.text: What would she have thought, waiting for her father who'd never come back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_001.text:
How - how dare you speak of my daughter thus!
I'll rip out your eyes! Your face!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_002.text:
HAW HAW! How will you do so?
I am not the one trapped in the ice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_003.text:
Are you not angry? Do you not boil within?
Do you not loathe the Goddess, who burdened you with this fate?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_004.text:
What if I gave you a chance of...
retribution? To pay back what she has given you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_3_005.text:
What...? Who are you?
How do you mean to break this seal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_001.text:
What importance does it have to know who I am?
I am I, I am myself, I am here and there.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_002.text:
What is important is YOUR hatred towards the Goddess!
And that you are not alone in your loathing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_003.text:
Now, Bjorn, Guardian of the Sacred Ground.
Will you not give me the 'Key to the Seal'?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_005.text:
Yes, yes. It cursed you, it did!
The very bane of your fate, HAW HAW!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_006.text:
You, a Guardian, shall be able to resist the will of the Goddess
and give the key to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_4_007.text:
HAW HAW! Think of your daughter. Remember her face!
Remember the RAGE! THE TEARS! THE DEATH!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_5_002.text:
Finally... Finally!
Hundreds of years and this accursed thing did not even budge...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_5_003.text:
Now I will only have to wait
before this seal breaks open and I am FREE!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_6_001.text:
It has been a long time, Cora.
I have finally returned, and you must wait!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_6_002.text:
For I shall go hunting with my sharpened fangs -  
the jaws of Utgard shall pierce your throat before long!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_2_7_001.text:
So that clown was actually in disguise the whole time.
... Now that I think about it, I've heard that name before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_1_001.text:
Brr! It seems even colder inside!
If only there wasn't a blizzard raging outside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_1_002.text:
Hmm, this block of ice seems peculiar.
Something seems to be inside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_1_003.text: Haha, it almost seems like there's a human being inside...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_2_002.text:
I-is she alive?
Hey, erm, are you alright?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_001.text:
... The Sacred Ground...?
I... I remember the ice falling, and...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_002.text:
Thou saved me from the accursed ice.
... I offer thee my deepest thanks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_003.text:
I am Lakias,
Chieftain of the Tribe of the Winter Wind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_004.text: May I ask my savior his name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_005.text:
Er, m-my name is Sasquatch.
Did you say, the Tribe of the Winter Wind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_006.text: I've never heard of such a tribe before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_007.text:
Thou jest, sir. Surely thou have seen my kinsmen
guarding these traitorous grounds?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_008.text:
And yet - thy attire is strange upon my eyes;
... Sir, what year is it by Snorri's Reckoning?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_3_009.text:
Snorri's Reckoning? What's that?
It's the 34th year of King Thor's reign.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_001.text:
Loath shall be the First Great King to hear such words!
The regnal year has changed without my knowing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_002.text:
...By the gods! How long have I tarried here,
locked within the ice? How many years?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_003.text:
... The Seal of the Sanctuary.
Can it be...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_004.text:
Master Sasquatch,
to thine good heart I do supplicate.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_005.text:
Thou must aid me out of this cursed place
and take me to where I guide thee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_006.text:
Only the swiftness of our feet shall save
the fate of these lands, our kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_007.text:
Huh? Fate? What?
Argh, I really have a bad feeling about this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_4_008.text:
We must make haste!
Thine arms - quickly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_3_5_001.text:
Snorri was the first sovereign of Nosgard.
How long has Lakias been sleeping in the ice, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_001.text:
Odin! I have been looking for you.
You know well why I have come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_002.text:
We of the Einherjar stand on your side of the rebellion
only in light of our pact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_003.text: We have kept our side of the promise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_004.text:
Our warriors are eager to taste the blood of our foes.
Every preparation is complete.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_2_005.text:
Why do you hesitate?
Surely your heart has not grown weak with caution?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_001.text:
Haha... I see that the warriors of Einherjar 
are sharper than the northern wind and hastier than the short spring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_002.text:
Some battles must be fought with patience.
As not all wars can be won with pure valiance.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_003.text: Haste shall only ruin what fate has promised us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_004.text:
My soldiers are searching for Freyja, your captain,
even as we speak. I too thus remain true to the pact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_005.text:
You are dismissed, Randgrid.
... And one more thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_3_006.text:
Show more respect to the man
who shall be the next king of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_4_001.text:
...Ha! Then we shall be waiting.
Yet remember this, Odin.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_4_002.text:
The Einherjar only swear fealty
to the glory of the battlefield, and nothing else!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_4_004.text:
Any longer, and we shall take matters into our own hands
and seek our lost honor by ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_5_002.text:
Slay the coward who disgraced the Einherjar
 And insulted the honor of our Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_002.text:
You were always so kind, my brother... And thus weak.
Yet the greater good always requires some sacrifice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_003.text:
Look at these lands! Our ancestors had to battle ice and snow
to claim these beautiful lands for their descendants.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_004.text:
Our lands are proof of our people's might and glory!
The heritage that remains shining, brilliant and true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_6_005.text:
And yet you! You, my weak-hearted brother, only grovel under the words 
of that Southerner Alexander. What honor is there to be found here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_7_001.text:
Remember the glory of the gods that blessed our people of Nosgard!
The undying flame that lights the skies to the north, the hearts of our kin!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_7_002.text:
I, Odin, heir of the divine bloodline that conquered the North Wind,
shall reclaim this honor! This glory! The rightful heritage for our people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_8_001.text:
So Odin is planning a revolt.
Against his brother, no less...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_4_8_002.text: It seems blood will soon be shed in the northern lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_10_002.text:
But... What can be the experiment
that Lyudmilla mentioned, I wonder?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_001.text:
It has been several years
since I escaped from Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_002.text:
Yet once a traitor, always a traitor,
as the saying goes...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_003.text:
I hadn't thought they would chase me all the way deep into the mountains
of Nosgard, even after changing bases so many times...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_004.text:
... but I suppose it is my fault
for underestimating my former colleagues.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_005.text:
They must deem me a danger
as I remain the only fugitive who has knowledge of the experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_006.text: If only I can continue to remain here... Just like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_1_007.text:
Ahhh! Get away from me! 
I didn't do anything wrong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_2_001.text:
Scanning complete. Results show signs of recent interaction
with traitor. Entering Interrogation Mode.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_3_003.text:
Argh... Thanks for saving me.
Normally I wouldn't have too much trouble with those invaders, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_3_004.text:
I'm embarrassed to admit it, 
but I was caught unawares while taking a nap.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_4_001.text:
But thanks to you, I'm okay now!
It's a relief you were where you were.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_001.text:
You mean to say that it's my fault.
It's my fault that you almost died today... and the countless times before.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_002.text:
I will repeat once more:
you can leave me anytime, Sasquatch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_003.text:
I... You helped me realize the crime I was committing in working for them.
I'm now trying to make up for my past, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_5_004.text:
I can't force you to stay with me any longer.
It will become only more dangerous from now on.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_001.text: Lyudmilla, you really are an idiot, you know that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_002.text:
I told you over and over that
it was you who saved my life back then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_003.text:
And with you by my side,
I'm not lonely anymore. Not like before I met you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_6_004.text:
So stop blaming yourself, Lyudmilla.
It's time to go home. Together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_7_001.text: - Wait, or will we have to move again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_7_002.text: Aww, what a pity! I really did like our cottage this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_8_001.text:
But camping is always fun, don't you think?
We should try going deeper into the mountains this time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_5_9_003.text:
Then we need to hurry, Lyudmilla!
We have to find a place to sleep before the sun goes down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_001.text: Daddy always used to say to me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_002.text:
If I want to travel to Mommy's home when she was a little girl
and see the northern lights like she did, I need to get better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_003.text:
And if I want to get better, I need to go to bed
and sleep whenever I grow tired.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_1_004.text:
But tonight,
I don't feel like going to bed at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_2_001.text:
The winter wind is rattling all the windows...
It's been three days since the storm came.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_2_002.text:
I'm scared of the blizzard.
I'm scared of the night when I can't see anything...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_2_003.text:
But I'm most scared that Daddy hasn't come home yet
after he left to get my medicine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_3_001.text:
He's never been away
for this long...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_3_002.text:
Could something have happened?
When will he come back?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_3_003.text:
I... I don't know what to do.
What should I do? I'm so scared, Daddy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_001.text:
Ines. My jewel, my sweetheart...
Whenever you grow scared or sick, remember this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_002.text:
Even if you grow scared of the dark or the harsh winds,
remember that, in the end, the winds will die down and the sun will rise.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_003.text:
Someday, you will get better.
I promise you that, Ines.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_004.text:
Until then, you must be brave.
Do you remember the stories I used to tell you at bedtime?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_4_005.text:
If you keep brave, just like in those stories,
winter will end and spring will come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_002.text: I'm the one who needs to be brave this time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_003.text:
Just like the heroes in the stories
Daddy used to read to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_004.text:
I'm twelve years old today.
I'm not a little girl anymore!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_5_005.text: This time... I'll be the one who helps Daddy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_7_001.text:
The 'Cold Dream'... Today it amounts to no more than a bad cold,
but it was a highly feared disease back in the day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_7_002.text:
Winter nights in Nosgard
can be cruel beyond imagination.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_6_7_003.text:
I hope spring comes
to the brave girl and her father.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_001.text: I have kept you waiting for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_002.text: Many things have happened since then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_003.text:
Had it not been for the druid of your tribe,
the war would have continued for many more days.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_004.text:
I know... You wouldn't have liked what I had done, back then.
Yet I couldn't stop myself in that moment, seeing you like that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_005.text:
... But the war is now over. 
Peace has come to our people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_006.text:
There are many tasks yet ahead of us,
but our people will soon be joined as one,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_007.text:
under a single alliance...
As we have been hoping for such a long time, Alisha.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_008.text: Roaming together the icy peaks and snowy fields of these lands...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_2_009.text: I only wish... You were here with me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_001.text:
Oh... my sincerest apologies, Chief.
I... shouldn't have interrupted you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_002.text:
It's just...
Master Nazrune is looking for you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_003.text:
He said it was an urgent matter...
I thought it best to bring it to your attention right away, Chief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_004.text:
And after all, it's a feast celebrating the peace treaty
between the two tribes! All thanks to you, Chief!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_005.text:
And we're all missing you out there.
But... I 'll come back later, Chief.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_006.text: ... No. I was about to head back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_007.text:
I only came out for a breath of fresh air.
... It seems I was gone for too long.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_008.text:
I'll follow soon.
Go on ahead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_3_009.text: Yes, Chief! I'll get going now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_001.text:
I think you should have this.
...Do you remember?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_002.text:
The first present I gave you after becoming one of the Wolf Guard.
A cheap little trinket... And yet you never took it off,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_003.text:
It was returned to me
after... after you left.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_4_004.text:
Keep it safe, Alisha...
Until we meet again, someday.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_5_001.text:
That's a familiar-looking mask. The Wolf Tribe...
This story must have taken place a long time ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_7_5_002.text:
There are many tragic memories
buried in the snow-covered fields of Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_10_02.text:
He sounds angry.
Perhaps King Thor is paying a visit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_10_03.text:
Perhaps, but it sounds more serious than that.
Let us go and see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_01.text: Do not make me repeat myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_02.text:
This is holy ground, not meant to be tread by filth like you.
If you do not retreat at once...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_03.text:
You shall be charged on the grounds of invasion and offences
against the royalty of Nosgard. I shall see to your punishment myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_04.text:
Our prince here can be a tad sensitive, but he's not wrong.
I too have no patience for rude intruders barging into our kingdom.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_11_05.text: It will serve you well to explain the meaning of your actions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_010_8_12_01.text:
