TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_01.text:
Stop spouting the cliched delusions of a tacky villain
and tell us the truth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_02.text:
Where is His Majesty?
The true Emperor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_03.text:
Oh, General Mengqi...
Did you not guess, after everything I told you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_04.text:
I disposed of the old imbecile
a long time ago. He proved to be of no use to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_08_06.text:
I had him buried in the courtyard.
If you wish, I will reserve a place for you there as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_01.text:
You confess to evil without cause or justification.
Your wickedness astounds me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_02.text:
Did you truly believe you could make the world suffer
if it meant fulfilling your pride?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_03.text: It is the most important thing in the world to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_04.text:
That hardly justifies your actions.
Nor can you be forgiven.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_05.text:
As long as we know the truth,
we must stop you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_09_06.text:
Do as you will - it will change nothing. I have many other
soldiers who will gladly give up their lives at my command.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_01.text: All bark and no bite, I see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_02.text:
Did your 'Lady' only bestow you the gift
of jealousy and deceit?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_03.text:
No - no! That absolute power - that godly strength - I know
it was real, I - !

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_10_04.text: It's coming out... It's leaving me...! No...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_01.text:
... Sigh... I wondered why my strength was suddenly being
drained. {PLAYER_NAME}... We meet again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_02.text:
Our last encounter in Nosgard forced me to slumber and heal
my wounds. And you dare to appear before me again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_03.text:
You are very persistent.
I can now understand Arart's disgust now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_04.text:
W-who are you?
Why - how did you come out of... me?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_05.text:
Oh? Your ego remains. But then again, Da Ji, you were
always an 'egocentric' child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_06.text:
You should still understand, however,
that I didn't 'come out of you'...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_09.text:
It's perfectly natural that you don't remember.
However... I devoured the real 'you' years ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_10.text:
You are nothing but a husk I have been controlling
to acquire power over Chen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_11.text: N-no...! Everything I did, I did by my own will -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_12.text:
If it pleases you to believe that lie,
then I have nothing more to say to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_13.text:
However... I have no further use for you,
and maintaining your form only tires me. Return to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_11_14.text:
N-no! I-I never asked for this!
Please don't -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_01.text:
What... was that just now?
Has Da Ji been hiding her true identity all along?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_02.text:
That Kalard has the ability to steal others' appearance at will, 
to the extent that it is impossible to discern

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_03.text:
Da Ji was not the Kalard's minion...
She was the Kalard herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_04.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} has faced her in battle before,
in Nosgard.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_06.text:
Yes. I know you.
You are the Elard Aubrey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_07.text:
I had been hoping
that we wouldn't cross paths.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_08.text:
... {PLAYER_NAME} told me that you claim
to be fulfilling the 'true will of Cora.'

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_09.text:
Yet all that you have done is
create hatred and wage a meaningless war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_12_10.text: Is this truly the path of light?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_13_01.text:
I remember—that stupidly strong Daughter of Cora
said the same thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_13_02.text:
Treachery under the name of Cora?
Meaningless hatred and war?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_01.text:
It was all your own doing: the humans of Hasla are so easily tempted
by the darkness within their souls. One little push, and down you all go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_02.text:
Do you truly believe yourselves worthy
of this holy land where Cora will finally descend?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_03.text:
You humans are already impure. Destroy yourselves
in your mindless wars - only then can the path of light be reached.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_14_04.text:
Accept your fate as a single cornerstone of the world as our vision.
Let paradise on earth come into being!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_15_01.text:
I should have realized sooner
that you would prove the greatest hindrance to our plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_15_02.text:
I will no longer let you rouse those beasts
who refuse the true guidance of light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_16_01.text:
I will sacrifice everything if need be.
Your road ends here... in the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_17_01.text:
Despite having sacrificed everything...
I still failed to defeat you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_02.text:
L-Lethe!
You must not come out!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_03.text:
Did you not promise the rest of us that you would never
reveal yourself in front of {PLAYER_NAME}...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_04.text:
Arart worries too much for her own good.
I am in no danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_18_05.text:
I only wished...
to see {PLAYER_NAME} with my own eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_02.text:
‘In no danger,’ huh?
Are you so confident of yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_03.text:
You must be stronger than your comrade over there,
passed out on the ground.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_04.text:
No, I am no stronger
than the average human being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_06.text:
Can it be... the 'Great Lady' Da Ji mentioned
before her ego dissolved away?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_19_07.text:
Da Ji could fabricate memories,
but Gullveig displayed no such ability.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_01.text:
Ooh, you're right! 
You are indeed clever, Oracle of Water.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_02.text:
Yes, I am Lethe, the #Kalard of Oblivion#. All who come under
my power remember and forget as I will it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_03.text:
As well as the one you seek...
The cause behind everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_04.text:
The Kalard of... Oblivion?
Behind everything? You?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_05.text:
Yes. I've been trying to design the second War of the Eastern
Kingdoms and oppress Roman and Trista in the process...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_07.text: However... I'll admit that you amused me greatly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_08.text:
I have never met anyone else
who has so keenly detected my presence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_10.text: Have you never thought it strange?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_11.text:
Why the humans of Hasla can never remember the history
before the Apostles War, one hundred years ago:

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_12.text:
the lost Desert Kingdom of the Three Kings
and the forgotten Temple of Illusions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_13.text:
Elder Edda, the old capital of Nosgard, abandoned by King Snorri's
decision for his kingdom, and the Seal of the Sanctuary.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_14.text:
The Oracle of Water who guards the mystical seas,
and her master, Habaek the White Dragon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_15.text:
I have erased such history from the face of this world:
the lost history of these lands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_16.text:
N-no. That can't be.
Such things couldn't have happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_17.text:
And even if you speak the truth,
why are you telling us everything?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_18.text:
Oh, you see...
I can do this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_20_19.text:
#You will forget everything that I said#
#since we met.#

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_01.text:
I expected more from the one who had given you much trouble.
Are you hurt, Gullveig?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_02.text: ... Your abilities never fail to amaze me, Lethe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_03.text:
To manipulate the mind of 
a formidable being like {PLAYER_NAME} is a great feat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_04.text:
I am not strong like you and the others.
I only hold mastery over the realm of memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_05.text:
I have already confirmed that I can erase even the memories of 
#Chronos#, one of the three Daughters of Cora, through direct contact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_06.text:
Indeed... 
Now, what will you do with that one?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_07.text:
Sigh... That is the problem.
I had other plans for them...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_08.text:
But I cannot risk any more setbacks to the great plan.
Their story ends here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_22_09.text: Won't you give me a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_23_01.text:
How can it be...?
Why haven't you succumbed to my power?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_24_01.text:
You were the Champion of Hasla.
No... It can't be...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_24_02.text:
A mere human of a remote dimension, hero or otherwise,
should not be able to match Goddess Cora in power!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_24_03.text:
Lethe! What are you doing?
You can't -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_25_03.text: Lethe... You are needed for the plans ahead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_25_04.text:
We cannot let you die here.
Go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_25_05.text: Wait! There must be a way-

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_26_02.text:
Even if you discover the truth of this world...
Only death and darkness await you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_26_03.text:
Outside... Beyond your understanding… You will see that…
it would have been better to accept your fate...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_27_02.text:
What just happened?
When did we defeat Gullveig?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_01.text:
Ah, my head...
I seem to be remembering many things at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_03.text:
Gullveig's defeat must have broken
the Kalard's hold over our memory.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_04.text:
This is...
All of our proper memories are returning to us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_28_06.text:
How could have I forgotten... such tragedies
happening in places I hadn't known...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_01.text:
The shadow of the Kalard have lifted from the Eastern Kingdoms.
It is painful to remember the wounds of the past and present.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_02.text:
However... Hope of the future 
also shines amidst the memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_03.text:
I can see it now. Gullveig's iron stakes, infused with her
energy, have lost all their power. The land is healing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_29_04.text: I only hope that soon - oh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_31_01.text:
Haerang... That new aura about you.
Have your powers as the Oracle of Water returned?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_31_02.text:
Habaek has returned -
our old promise has been renewed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_31_03.text:
Let's go outside, everyone.
We must greet him properly - he is coming our way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_32_02.text:
The mystical seas are at the eastern end of the world.
He must move quickly indeed for him to arrive so soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_32_03.text:
Habaek travels across the ley lines that spread throughout Hasla.
He is swifter than lightning, at least in the Eastern Kingdoms.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_33_01.text: It seems he hasn't arrived yet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_33_02.text:
... Thunder rolls from afar.
The earth quakes....

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_33_03.text:
Something comes...
I can feel it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_34_01.text:
I call you, my master, who amidst the endless waiting of long years
still hold close to his heart the threads of fate between human and earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_34_02.text:
Your oracle, ever standing between the human world and that of the
ancient guardian deities, request your presence from the mystical seas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_34_03.text:
I invoke our eternal promise, 
here in these lands where old memories lie unforgotten.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_03.text:
It is not often that I wish for the light of my eyes to return,
but this stately presence...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_04.text:
Such beauty and grace...
I haven't seen him for a long time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_06.text: ... It has been some time, Haerang.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_08.text:
I failed you... I failed to follow the guidance of the water,
and could not find you for more than a hundred years...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_09.text:
The sands of time fall slowly for those who have seen the first dawn.
Do not reproach yourself so, child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_10.text:
I must thank you instead for overcoming the Kalard's schemes
and keeping me from fading into the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_11.text:
I didn't do it on my own. Without {PLAYER_NAME}, it would
have been an impossible journey.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_12.text:
Yes... {PLAYER_NAME}. I know you - the one chosen by
our Goddess for the sake of this earth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_13.text:
The tales of your feats are whispered even by the mermaids 
and creatures who frequent the depths of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_14.text:
Thank you for freeing my siblings,
#Galatea# and #Loki#, from the clutches of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_15.text:
We #Ancient Sacred Beings#
were born to protect Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_16.text:
We were born with much power, far greater, perhaps, than what we
must have had... Thus I feared to interfere in the lives of smaller beings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_17.text:
For long years I pondered, until I decided to appoint one wise human 
the  #Oracle of Water#, who would guide the usage of my powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_18.text:
I would thus grant human beings wisdom and strength, unlike
my siblings who viewed them with either #mischief# or #pity#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_35_19.text:
That means... You were trapped in the Sanctuary of the
Deep Seas for all these years, by your own doing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_02.text:
He believes in the integrity of human beings… or at the very least,
the Oracle of Water, and entrusts her with his powers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_03.text: No, I was just a little surprised.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_04.text: Habaek's decision, however, will lead to the turn of the tide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_05.text:
As Habaek had been sealed within the Sanctuary of the Deep Sea,
the corruption of the Kalard would not have reached him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_06.text:
Yes, you are right.
Now that I have returned...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_07.text:
I, Habaek, lord of the mystical seas of Hasla,
shall heal the wounds of these lands and console the grief of my people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_09.text:
... The Kalard are strong. To remain an observer in these circumstances
would aid their cause. It is time to rouse from slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_10.text:
As for the humans of the Eastern Kingdoms, you will elect
representatives of each country to form a new #Eastern Alliance#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_11.text:
In the meantime, I will prepare to rouse
#the last Ancient Sacred Being# from their slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_12.text:
The last Sacred Being...?
So there was one more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_13.text: What are they in charge of?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_15.text:
If you ever require my aid,
call for Haerang, and I will come. This I vow.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CH3_ST6_36_16.text: Until the day we meet again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_01.text:
I apologize for the poor hospitality.
I must ask for your patience, considering the circumstances.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_02.text:
You must remain hidden
if we are to avoid Dionne's keen eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_03.text:
Do you realize what you have done? You are mad.
I should have known that you were planning such things...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_04.text: I am perfectly aware of the consequences of my actions, Chancellor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_05.text:
Before I was asleep; now I am awake.
No longer do petty ideals cloud my judgement.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_01_06.text: I've come back from my mission, milord!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_01.text: You are quick to return, Leon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_02.text:
... We came across {PLAYER_NAME} and their company
in Edenberg, milord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_03.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}?
Hmm. Were they not last spotted in Nosgard?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_04.text:
Then again, they were always quick on their feet.
And what happened then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_05.text:
We failed to recruit new soldiers
due to an unexpected interruption, milord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_06.text:
Interruption? Neth should not have the strength
to oppose you, the one who has inherited the Flame of Cora.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_07.text:
#Galatea# was there:
the being that Arart the Traitor had been researching.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_08.text:
It's unclear how, but she had acquired a new physical
body and regained her powers as well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_09.text:
I only failed to capture her because the Elard Bella
and the Neth soldiers continued attacking from both sides.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_02_10.text: I will defeat her properly next time, milord.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_01.text: ... So they rise, one by one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_02.text:
While I had expected there would be other variables
outside {PLAYER_NAME}...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_03.text:
I admit, it is not pleasant to see more and more
potential enemies of Grancia coming into power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_04.text:
Do you not see the folly of your own ways?
You yourself are creating more enemies against your empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_05.text:
If you continue like this, the antipathy of all countries in Hasla
towards Grancia will only increase.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_06.text:
The alliance you formed three years ago to oppose the Apostles
will turn their blade against you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_07.text:
That is exactly what I intend for them to do. The disturbances in Nosgard
and Neth... The bounty on {PLAYER_NAME}'s head...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_03_08.text:
Everything is coming into place. The great war will start soon - and erase
all other coutries off the face of Hasla, leaving Grancia the sole victor...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_04_01.text:
... Alexander.
What did the Kalard promise you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_04_02.text:
Is it worth the bloodshed that will ravage the continent of Hasla?
Is it worth the newfound peace of the people?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_05_01.text:
I am merely following the true path of light.
The only path to eternal peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_05_02.text:
Attention! Your Majesty,
I come bearing an urgent report!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_06_01.text:
What is it? Did I not forbid anyone from entering this room
except for the most urgent of affairs?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_06_02.text:
I beg your forgiveness, Your Majesty! But a #white dragon# has been
spotted in the skies over the capital of Chen!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_07_02.text:
No, Your Majesty!
The dragon was seen to communicate with other humans!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_07_03.text:
It called itself #Habaek#,
lord of the mystical seas.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_07_04.text: ... The lord of the mystical seas... That can't be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_01.text:
Leon, prepare to set out at once. Our time has come,
much more quickly than I had expected.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_04.text:
#Utgard Loki# of Elder Edda.
#Galatea# of Heaven...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_05.text:
And now, #Habaek# of the mystical seas to the east. They
are rousing the 'Ancient Sacred Beings# from slumber.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_06.text:
Their next destination is clear: the #Primal Volcano#.
Take the other Chrona Heroes with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_08_07.text: Yes, Your Majesty! I won't let you down!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_01.text:
... Tell me...
Tell me one last thing, Alexander.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_02.text:
Where is...
Where is Sera? Where are you keeping her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_03.text: There is no knowing what the #Execeutioner# thinks or intends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_04.text:
Why don't you pray for her sake?
Isn't that what you Elard do best?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ED_09_05.text:
Who knows -
your Goddess Cora may answer your prayers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_01.text: Thank you for gathering here today, everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_02.text:
Although we haven't succeeded in contacting
the king of Han and the shogun of Ryu...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_03.text:
We have gathered today to discuss
the direction that the new #Eastern Alliance# must take.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_04.text:
... Is there need for discussion?
Only you can communicate with the ancient guardian of the sea.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_05.text:
I dared not voice my stance as a subject of Chen before 'Lord Habaek.'
Yet I must refuse to partake in this gathering if Han seeks to seize all power.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_06.text:
You are mistaken.
I am not here as a representative of the Kingdom of Han.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_07.text:
My reincarnations are not bound to a particular country… In my
past lives I have been born several times in both Chen and Ryu.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_08.text:
Several times... Reincarnation is curious business. I remember
there were several reincarnated people in Hero Town...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_01_10.text:
I am not completely sure...
Even if I were, it would not be my place to tell you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_01.text:
If you say so, Oracle.
Then I shall stay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_02.text:
You're more careful than usual, General.
To the point of overanalyzing everything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_03.text:
Mengqi. We have failed to protect the late Emperor,
and His Majesty left no heir.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_04.text:
Chen is currently in a precarious position.
If any more trouble were to befall the kingdom

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_02_05.text:
while we Tiger Generals administer the affairs of the state...
I would never forgive myself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_01.text:
That won't happen.
I promise you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_02.text: Then let's hear what you have to say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_03.text:
I still think it is too early to decide on an alliance
that hasn't even been formed yet. Why the hurry?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_03_04.text:
The Kalard we fought are directly associated with
the political turmoil among the nations of the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_01.text:
As you may know, {PLAYER_NAME} and I come from Hero Town,
a small village in Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_02.text:
Three years ago... When darkness first befell Hasla,
Emperor Alexander proved himself to be a valuable ally

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_03.text:
But he has recently defected to the side of the Kalard,
and the Order of the Goddess has followed his lead.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_04.text:
I don't know what brought about his sudden change of heart,
but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_04_05.text:
If we Eastern Kingdoms form an alliance around #Habaek#,
it is very probable that Grancia will seek to antagonize us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_02.text:
It is a losing battle. 
You underestimate the strength of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_03.text:
No, we know better than anyone what Grancia is capable of. That's
why we're will form an alliance with all of Hasla - save for Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_04.text:
... Luckily, {PLAYER_NAME} has something of a reputation, 
as well as some good friends around the continent.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_05.text:
Your optimism borders on the absurd. A few friends will not
move the entire continent to our side.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_06.text:
Well... The Eastern Kingdoms will still fight for you.
We're all in the same boat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_07.text:
Yes, I suppose so.
You would do well to show some compassion, Mengqi.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_05_08.text: Oh? So I'm the bad guy here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_06_02.text:
Oh? So you were all gathered here!
I've been searching for you all around the Palace!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_01.text:
S-Shuwen! I am glad to see you are alive and well and not
dead at all! I thought you were busy fighting that monster.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_02.text:
Hmm? Hahaha! Oh, Master Hansheng!
Your mischievous jokes always get me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_03.text:
It almost sounds as if you WANT me not alive, not well,
and very much dead! Which of course I believe isn't the case!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_04.text:
Of course that isn't the case! I was jesting.
Yes, merely jesting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_05.text: Sigh... What brings you all the way here, Shuwen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_06.text:
Oh, now that's a good tale!
You see, I came to ask for your help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_07.text:
It has to do with that monster you mentioned. It seems no small 
business, and I wanted your opinion, Master Hansheng.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_08.text:
Because whom else can I trust more than you, Master Hansheng?
You're the only man in the world I would give my back on the battlefield.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_09.text:
That night... After you all ran to the Palace, not heeding my warning
thank you very much, the monster and I fought to the death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_10.text:
Well, almost to the death, as both of us are still pretty much alive.
But I can promise you that that was the fiercest fight I ever fought

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_11.text:
in my life, and my life is full of some grand wars and battles, I tell you.
Anyway, during the fight, a most curious thing happened: I heard

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_12.text:
a voice speaking - in my head! Right in the middle of the fight,
when a single blow would have knocked either one of us out! You see,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_13.text:
it was the MONSTER! The MONSTER was tryin' to speak to me with
their eyes: help! - they seemed to be saying, I don't mean to fight you but

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_14.text:
I can't control myself! That's what I heard through those eyes! And
who would have thought - the monster was actually a holy mountain saint!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_15.text: I need to lie down for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_16.text:
Oh? It's rare for a human to succeed communicating with Taebaek
when he's in 'that' state. You must be closer to our realm than I thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_17.text:
Yes, Masters Luhe once said something similar when I paid them a visit
some years back. That I can cross into the divine realm if I want to?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_18.text:
They also mentioned that my ki energy was too strong, however,
and I couldn't train to become an Ethereal even if I wanted to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_19.text:
Which is a pity, because who wouldn't want to ride on clouds
and eat fresh drops of dew at dawn? I guess it isn't my lot, and I'm alright

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_20.text:
leaving it at that. Now to return to the story at hand, the monster or 
mountain saint and I continued our conversation while exchanging

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_21.text:
a few more parries, like we do in training sessions. He talked of the
mountain he rules over, the memories of his first love, his favorite food,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_07_22.text:
the songs he likes to sing in the morning and in the evening... And then
I finally realized why he had asked for my help. I couldn't believe it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_01.text:
... And so when space-time contorted and the boundary
between life and death faded away, there suddenly appeared... ... Hmm?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_02.text:
Why is everyone dozing off on the floor?
I am not done with my story!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_03.text:
Y-you are mistaken, Shuwen.
Please continue with your tale; we are completely, absolutely awake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_04.text:
Are you sure, Master Hansheng? Because your eyes are red almost as if
you had been taking a nap... But no matter. Anyway, to summarize my

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_05.text:
tale just for the sake of a good ending, the mountain saint warned that
the boundaries between the realms of the living and the dead had waned

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_06.text:
and that a mysterious monster had appeared from the resulting rift.
He requested me to ask {PLAYER_NAME} to subdue the monster.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_07.text:
... Did you just... effectively summarize the entirety of your arduous tale, 
Shuwen? Why didn't you do so sooner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_08.text:
Boundaries waning... Strange beings crossing over rifts...
I have seen this before, some decades ago.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_09.text:
The White King was born on such a night: the only human 
who has dominance over ghosts who answer to no other master.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_10.text:
What should we do? The riots that are taking place
throughout Han and Chen also require urgent attention.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_11.text:
Let us disperse for now and each attend to urgent business.
We cannot waste any more time talking - or rather, listening.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_EP5_CL_ST1_08_12.text:
Mm... Snort!
I-I wasn't sleeping! ... Has he finished?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_GROUP_REPEAT_1_001.text:
Today we seem to have
received numerous requests from one person...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_GROUP_REPEAT_1_002.text: Let's carry them out one by one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_GROUP_REPEAT_3_001.text:
This is the last request.
Please be careful to the end.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_REPEAT_1_001.text:
Here is your request of the day.
It is a simple one, but please be careful nonetheless.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_REPEAT_DAY_1_001.text: Here is your request of the day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_REPEAT_WEEK_1_001.text:
This request is quite difficult…
Perhaps more so than the others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_REPEAT_WEEK_1_002.text: You may want to make some preparations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0001_001.text:
After the Apostle El Thalnos was sealed
within the Dimensional Rift,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0001_002.text:
the remaining Goddesses and humans strove
to reclaim peace from the ashes of the battlefields.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0001_003.text:
Three years passed by, 
slowly healing the wounds left by the war.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0001_004.text:
The Goddesses too departed, their duty to humans fulfilled.
The sorrow of parting awaited the others who remained behind…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0002_001.text: It is time to leave for the capital of Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0002_003.text:
I will contact you as soon as she returns.
This is for the best, Goddess. Do not worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0002_004.text:
…Three years have gone by so quickly.
I suppose we can't delay the Emperor's request any longer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0002_006.text: (You hope to see Lednas soon in Impelis.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0002_007.text:
Yes, we will follow behind you
as soon as the others finish making their preparations.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0002_008.text: I wish you both a safe trip.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_001.text:
Welcome, {PLAYER_NAME}.
It feels as it has been years since I have seen you last.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_002.text:
How are you finding life at Impelis?
I must admit, I find it a little lonely all by myself,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_003.text:
with Anut and Bella having returned to their own Sanctuaries.
I hope they come visit soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_004.text:
Dionne has left for her training, strong as she is.
I am sure that she will overcome Nemesis's grasp.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_005.text:
I… am rather worried about Aubrey, however.
I wonder if she found Sylunis after her disappearance…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_007.text: (You ask Prestina whether she is thinking of Sera.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_008.text:
You know me too well, {PLAYER_NAME}.
It has already been three years since Sera's departure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_009.text:
I understand that she has much training to do. But do you not
find it strange she hasn't sent one letter to this date?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_010.text: (You try to comfort Prestina, saying that Sera is in good hands.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_011.text:
Yes, I pray for her safety every day and night, but…
I cannot help but be worried for her sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_012.text:
(You ask Prestina if she wants to take a walk
in her old forest for a change of scenery.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0003_013.text:
… Yes. Yes, that seems a very good idea.
I always found the Forest to bring peace to a stormy mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0004_001.text:
It has been a while, but the forest is as serene as ever.
…I remember, this is the place that I first met Sera…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0004_003.text:
Did you hear that, {PLAYER_NAME}?
I thought I just heard the voice of a girl...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0004_005.text:
It may be Sera!
Let's go and see, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_002.text:
Hello, there.
Can I ask why you are alone all by yourself in this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_003.text:
I-I'm not alone at all!
Don't you see my big, red frien- huh?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_004.text:
He left after you came…
Wait! Wait for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_005.text: (You ask Prestina the reason for her concern.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_006.text:
This forest was full of dangers even when I made it
my Sanctuary, so most people avoided this place.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_007.text:
You saw it too on our way here, {PLAYER_NAME}.
After my departure, it has fallen completely to monsters.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_008.text:
That child… I do not know who her "friend" is,
but I fear that she may be in danger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0005_009.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Should we follow her, just in case?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0006_001.text:
Um, where is this place? Are you usually so quiet?
You don't find me annoying, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0006_002.text:
Um, hello…
Do you happen to know where I am…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0006_003.text:
Why are you so silent?
Are you angry at me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0006_005.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}!
Let's save the girl before it's too late!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_001.text:
Let us hope that the girl has not been too badly hurt.
I only pray that her wounds are within my powers to heal…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_002.text:
Hurt...?
I'm not hurt at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_003.text:
That can't be! You were taken by a monster -
and a violent one at that…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_004.text:
…! But you really did receive no injuries.
How strange… But it is a relief that you are alright.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_006.text:
Why are you here alone in these dangerous grounds?
Most people do not wander too far out here into the wilds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_009.text:
I-I can't… I can't remember.
All I know is that… I had to come here…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_010.text:
Shh. It's okay.
You are startled, and you need to rest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_011.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
Why don't we go search for her family back in the city?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_012.text: I-if it wouldn't be too much of a bother…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_014.text:
T-thank you, erm -
Um, what should I call you…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_017.text:
I do not know whether you felt it, {PLAYER_NAME},
but that girl… she reminds me of Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_018.text:
It is a vague connection…Yet could it be a coincidence
that this was also the place that I met Sera, years ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0007_019.text:
Haha, I am feeling rather sentimental today.
Should we go back home?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_001.text:
Wow…! It's - it's so huge!
And there's so many people!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_002.text:
How?
How can there be so many people in one place?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_003.text:
Well - it would be expected of the capital
of one of the largest empires in Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_005.text:
Mm. That is… A capital is the largest city
in the country, where the most people live.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_006.text: This particular capital is called Impelis.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_007.text:
I see! Impelis!
I'll be remembering that. And capitals, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_008.text: Haha, that's very clever of you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_009.text:
And... I never knew before that everyone had their own names.
You, and the capital…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0008_010.text: I wonder why I don't have a name…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_001.text:
Prestina. {PLAYER_NAME}.
It has been some time. Three whole years, yes?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_002.text:
Ah. I do not mean to scold you for your... tardiness.
You are not involved in the politics of this empire, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_003.text:
Haha. You jest with a serious face as ever, Goddess Chronos.
How do you find your duties as a Chancellor?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_004.text:
I find them agreeable, and Alexander is reasonable enough.
What remains of the War… should be settled soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_005.text:
I too shall take my departure, when the time comes.
…Although Trista draws my attention, as of late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_008.text:
Ah, we found this child in the forest…
Wait, how do you know about Trista?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_009.text:
Do you come from Trista?
Is it your home?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_011.text: What is the meaning of this?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_012.text:
My deepest apologies, Goddess Chronos.
May I explain after we safely retrieve her?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_013.text:
She… has no memories,
if that may suffice for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_014.text:
I see...
Then I shall wait for your return.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0009_015.text:
A child with no perceivable past or future…
What is she destined for, that unnamed child?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0010_002.text:
H-help! Please help me!
If I'm taken back, I'll… I'll…!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0010_003.text:
Shh, shh. It is alright, child. We won't send you back.
Won't you tell us what happened, so that we can help you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_001.text:
In short, you have found this child in the forest, alone and
without memories, and took her in as you would a stray cat.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_002.text: I-I hope I'm not too much of -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_003.text: What do you know of Trista?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_004.text:
Goddess Chronos, she is unsteady at this time.
I do not think it would be wise to force her to remember so soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_005.text:
N-no! I can remember - I need your help!
There are many children in Trista just like me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_007.text:
When I woke up, I was in a dark and scary place…
I wanted to get out of there, so I ran for the door.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_008.text:
There were many strange machines beeping
and lights shining…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_009.text:
And in the middle, there was a large tube
with water bubbling in it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_011.text:
There were other children in that tube!
And other girls outside, too…!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_012.text:
I-I was so scared - I tried to wake them up,
but they didn't. Only I escaped from that place…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_014.text:
Hmm, so you escaped from a laboratory
which still holds many other children like yourself…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_015.text:
And this likely illegal laboratory is holding
human experiments somewhere in Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_016.text:
If her story is true…
How could they be doing such a thing…? And with children...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_017.text:
Goddess Chronos.
I wish to go to Trista together with this child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_018.text:
We do not know anything about this child, nor of her tales.
Acting alone in foreign territory is a dangerous deed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_019.text:
I have no definite plan, at the moment.
But…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_020.text:
Your faith in this girl will not be enough to stop 
war between the two countries, if you are discovered.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_021.text:
Trista will not take espionage within their borders 
lightly. This is not the time to be stubborn, Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_022.text:
Then must I sit silent - and pray, perhaps -
when there are children in pain and despair?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_024.text:
Please don't… fight because of me…
I… I'm sure I can do this alone, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_026.text:
(You tell Chronos
that you also wish to accompany Prestina to Trista.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_027.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}… Yes. I remember.
You have connections to the Musketeers of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_028.text:
If you were to go and act together with the Musketeers,
we would have enough political justification.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_029.text:
After all… I too have business with them.
I will permit your quest only on these conditions.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_030.text:
T-thank you!
I'll be good and helpful as I can!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_031.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, escort the child out for a 
moment. I need to have a word with Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_032.text: …And we still do not even know that child's name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_033.text: I am thinking of giving her a new one.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_036.text: Yes, Ellie. That would be a good name for the child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_037.text:
Ellie… Yes, I think she would like it.
It fits her, for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_038.text:
Yes… 
And she is Ellie, Prestina. Not Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_039.text:
I understand your concern. No news has come from Sera
for three long years, and you are frightened for her sake.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_040.text:
But you must understand that Ellie is not Sera,
and neither are the children of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_041.text:
I do not disapprove of your pity for their sake,
but your must not let your love for Sera blind you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_043.text:
You may take your leave.
I too have unfinished business at the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_045.text:
Ellie… It has been some time
since I 've last said that name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0011_046.text:
That child… She too possesses a destiny that I cannot 
read. Perhaps it is fate that she bears your name.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_001.text: Ellie, it's dangerous to go about alone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_003.text:
Oh! Me, right?
I'm still not used to having a name… Heehee.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_004.text: Haha. Do you like your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_006.text:
Then, Ellie.
Do you remember the general location of the laboratory?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_008.text:
Then perhaps we should walk around 
a little more while it comes to you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_010.text: Do you come from outside Trista?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_011.text:
Yes, we have just arrived.
Is something wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_012.text:
We are the Order of the Shadow Rose,
with direct orders from the throne to guard the city premises.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_014.text:
They're lying!
These people are lying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_017.text:
We shall take that as direct insult
to His Majesty the King of Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0012_019.text:
What…!
What have we done wrong? This is madness!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_001.text: We seem to be a little late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_002.text:
Yes, because you insisted
on being distracted, Captain.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_003.text: What business do the Musketeers have here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_004.text:
That is what I wish to ask you.
You show poor hospitality to the Musketeers' guests-of-honor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_005.text:
Immediate execution…
You have much to explain, Shadow Rose.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_006.text: They are criminals who slandered the King, His Majesty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_007.text:
A dilemma. You see, we have a prior appointment 
with them. Will you not be a dear and... piss off?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_008.text:
If they truly committed a "crime," as you say,
we shall judge and punish them ourselves.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_009.text:
His Majesty ordered there would be no exceptions,
even for the Musketeers. We shall punish as authorized.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0013_010.text:
If you are so keen to fight, remember that we are 
more than capable of defending ourselves and our honor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_001.text:
Think you really that it is wise to continue?
His Majesty will not appreciate... a ruckus, I believe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_002.text:
… We will not accept this arrogation of authority.
His Majesty will hear of this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_003.text:
You will be incriminated with treason against the throne
as well as obstruction of justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_005.text:
Touché, touché.
Lovely finish as always, darling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_006.text:
Hmm? A cute lady that I haven't met yet!
Pardon, little miss, but may I ask for your name?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_008.text:
Please ignore our dear Captain.
He's always like that - you must excuse him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_009.text:
Ahem. How have you fared? I heard from the Chancellor
that you would be coming. Yet I do not see Miss Sera.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_011.text: (You reply that Sera has business elsewhere.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_012.text: Hmm. Well, new meetings offer as much pleasure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_013.text:
The Chancellor has relayed to us all that we should know.
Ellie, was it? You are looking for the laboratory you escaped from.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_014.text:
Yes! I may not remember much,
but I remember that place! I-it was very scary, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_015.text:
A laboratory, a laboratory…
It will be difficult to find. Trista is a kingdom of many masks.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_016.text:
At day it may seem beautiful and elegant,
yet night reveals many dangers better off unknown.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_018.text: (You ask about the Order of the Shadow Rose.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_019.text:
They were not ordinary police, accusing us as they did.
What is happening to Trista these days?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_020.text:
These are dark days. They call themselves executors of justice,
yet they tyrannize the streets, threatening the common people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_021.text:
Even we cannot do anything to protect the city from them,
as they have His Majesty's direct orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_022.text: But why would the King give such an order?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_023.text:
I fear I do not know His Majesty's intentions.
The Cardinal is opposed to the Shadow Roses, however.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_024.text:
It is a relief to hear that there is some official opposition.
I have heard that the Cardinal has much power in Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_025.text: I fear it is not so simple.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_026.text:
We have suspicions that he has, in fact,
a… secret agreement with the Shadow Roses.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_027.text:
Did you not just say that the Cardinal is
opposed to the Shadow Roses?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_030.text:
The Shadow Roses are coming.
We must leave at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_031.text: Ah. I suppose we must continue at some other time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0014_032.text:
You see, they do not appreciate us here.
We must excuse ourselves. Farewell!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0015_001.text:
Yes… Good.
It is time to lift the veil.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_002.text:
Everyone seems to be fine, fortunately.
Now, can we hear the rest of the story?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_003.text: The Cardinal… Who is he truly?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_004.text:
We do not yet know for certain. Did you not meet
Saintess Maria during the War of the Holy City?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_005.text:
She must have told you of her suspicions that the Order was
implicated in the Tower of Manacar and the War of the Holy City.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_007.text:
Maria has been holding her own searches 
throughout the Order ever since.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_008.text:
She contacted us some time ago,
with irrefutable evidence leading the path to Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_009.text:
We too had been doubting the Cardinal ever since he was found
to have questionable connections with the Neth Empire.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_010.text:
Of course, such connections had been kept confidential,
and remain unknown to the public.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_011.text:
Rather, it is the King who is publicly known to have cooperated
with Neth, and so receives the hatred of the people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_012.text:
The War was seen only as justification of that hatred.
And with the Captain not in Trista, I had to take care of all the -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_013.text:
Well! All's well that ends well,
and you did look so heroic coming to rescue me, darling.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_015.text: Someone for whom you have great affection and love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_017.text: Whatever it is you're thinking, it's NOT it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_018.text:
If you have evidence that the Cardinal cooperated with Neth,
and if there is proof that an official of high status

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_019.text:
was implicated in the onset of the War of the Holy City...
Then the Cardinal is certainly suspicious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_020.text: You have a keen mind, Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_021.text:
The business of Trista is the Musketeers' lot - yet I would
have you keep safe. The kingdom is not what it used to be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_022.text:
I fear you must find the laboratory on your own,
as we ourselves are tied up in this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_023.text:
It-it's okay!
I'll try to remember as hard as I can!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_024.text:
Then shall we go separate ways for the time being?
Little miss, I am sure that you will remember everything soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_025.text:
We will come find you, should you find yourself needing aid.
There are a few of my men throughout the city. They will know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_027.text:
If we learn anything about the Cardinal,
we will let you know at once.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_028.text:
Please be careful of the Shadow Roses.
To this date, no one has returned from their dungeons.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0016_029.text: If need be, do not hesitate to use force to escape.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_001.text:
We have found them.
Permission to kill fully authorized.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_002.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}.
I'm afraid we must "use force," as D'Artagnan said.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_003.text:
I-I'll use force!
You can escape first, and I'll follow you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_005.text: (You ask Ellie what she is going to do.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_006.text:
Um, I'll do it! Use force!
But.. Could you tell me what "force" is and how you use it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_008.text:
Haha… Ellie, {PLAYER_NAME} will show you
what it means to "use force."

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0017_009.text: Should we step back for the time being?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_001.text:
Oh…! So… "using force" means…
hitting someone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_002.text:
I… I really want to learn and be helpful...
But hitting people is scary, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_003.text:
You are right. Hitting people is a scary business.
Sometimes, however, it is necessary to defend what you love.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_004.text:
You must always remember this difference
so that you may use your powers for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_005.text: I… I'm still not very sure…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_006.text:
…but I know {PLAYER_NAME} is good!
Always saving me from trouble...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_007.text: I want to become like you, {PLAYER_NAME}!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_009.text:
Do you think I could become like you? Even someone like me?
I don't know anything, and I'm no help to anyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_010.text:
(You offer to become Ellie's "teacher"
and help train her.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0018_011.text:
Really?!
Thank you! I'll do my best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0019_001.text:
What business do you have? No one is allowed to pass
while the Order of the Shadow Rose executes justice.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0019_002.text: B-but this is the way we have to go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0019_003.text:
Ah, it is the felons. Good, we will execute them here.
It will be easier than taking them to the execution grounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_002.text:
Demons...
Demons wearing the mask of humanity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_004.text:
Who is this heretical wrench?
What have the guards been doing to let her through?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_005.text:
Cease your clamoring!
The Cardinal shall judge the sinner!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_006.text: His Eminence the Cardinal is coming!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_008.text:
Demons, stealing His Majesty's authority in his illness
to tyrannize the innocent people of our kingdom…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0020_009.text:
The vilest of sins. Worry no more, my beloved people.
I shall protect you from the clutches of the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_001.text:
I fear there are still other demons hiding in the shadows…
Yet our work is finished here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_002.text: This child is under our care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_003.text:
She has done no wrong.
We will take her with us, if you are done here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_004.text:
You cannot.
Who is to say that this child is not a sinner?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_005.text:
If she was but an innocent child,
she would not have swooned as my light purged the darkness.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_006.text:
You do not understand. She has an illness -
how would you know that it was light that affected her so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_007.text:
Hmm… Then I must ask you this.
How much do you know about this child?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_009.text:
For I sense this child's true nature.
A great evil, lurking amidst her apparent innocence...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_010.text:
The demons under the guise of the Order of the Shadow Rose
would be mere flies, in comparison.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_011.text:
Would you not call this child, who masked herself and 
rebelled before even the Goddess' light, the true demon?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_012.text:
Did she not see through the Shadow Roses' true nature
when no one else did?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_013.text:
One could even say… she is the demons' true master,
able to control them to her will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_014.text:
You lie. I don't believe you.
{PLAYER_NAME}, let's go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_015.text:
Your Highness!
Should we pursue them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_017.text:
To flee with a child that I myself judged as a demon…
They too share the sin of revolting against the Goddess' light.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_018.text:
Heaven's Cavalry, I shall entrust the matter
of the demon-controlling child and her worshippers in your hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_019.text:
They are devils in human disguise, and a great threat to
our people of Trista. I authorize all means of execution.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_020.text:
We vow to fulfill our duty
under the Goddess' name!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0021_021.text:
Two birds with one stone…
This too…is divine will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_001.text:
First demons,
now the Heaven's Cavalry…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_002.text:
How have things come to this?
And when will Ellie wake up?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_003.text: (You think it will be wiser to go find D'Artagnan and Rochefort.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0022_004.text:
Yes. We need their help.
They should also know of the Cardinal's plans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_003.text:
Prestina. {PLAYER_NAME}?
H-huh? Have I fainted again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_004.text:
Yes.
I was worried that you would not wake up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_005.text:
(You ask Ellie whether she knows something
about the Order of the Shadow Rose.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_006.text: The Order of the Shadow Rose…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_007.text:
How did you know they were demons, Ellie?
We're under suspicion of being in league with them now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_008.text:
Demons? Did I say something…?
I-I don't remember anything…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_009.text:
(The conversation is growing too long.
You warn the others that they cannot stay too long in one place.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_010.text: You are right. They could be looking for us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0023_011.text: (W-what did I do now…? Who am I…?)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_003.text:
Fortunately not. We're the Leopard Girls.
We came under Sir Rochefort's orders.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_004.text:
He tells you that the city district of Trista is dangerous.
He will come and find you while you hide.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_006.text:
There is a secret hiding place underground,
in the sewers of the city.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_007.text:
It can be accessed through the drains at the edges of the city.
Sir Rochefort advises you to hide there for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_008.text:
We will.
But what about you…? Are you safe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_010.text:
Don't worry about us.
We'll show them the strength of the Desert wildlands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0024_011.text:
I give you my blessing.
Ellie, {PLAYER_NAME}. Let's go at once!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_002.text:
Huhu. Three years go by so quickly.
How have you been, Prestina?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_003.text:
You're the same as ever, Maria.
And Roland - you seem to have gotten quite buff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_004.text: Haha. It has been a while, Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_005.text:
Your hair is much prettier down like this, Prestina.
While Goddess Chronos is, and always will be, herself…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_006.text:
She's so pretty, sparkling like stars...
And she smells really nice…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_007.text:
Oh, she's adorable.
What is your name, little girl?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_008.text:
Her name is Ellie.
We are taking care of her for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_009.text: But how did you find us here…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_010.text: I have business with the Musketeers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_011.text:
Saintess, be careful.
I sense a presence close by.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_013.text:
They are Ratmen. They had disappeared after the Apostle War,
but it seems they had been living in Trista's sewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_014.text: But why are they armed so…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_017.text:
Erm… Uh, hi!
Um, yes, I'm a human… And my name's Ellie!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_019.text: The Captain's not gonna like this…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_020.text:
…Then we should get rid of them
before he catches a whiff of their scent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_021.text:
…It seems they are hostile towards us,
for some reason.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_022.text: I shall take care of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_023.text:
Wait. Roland and Maria, you shall not participate in battle.
You have your roles in the Order to think of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_024.text:
Crossing the border undercover and waging war in foreign territory
is not the wisest course of action, I must say.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_025.text:
Yes... Goddess Chronos is the Chancellor of Grancia,
and Maria and Roland are renowned figures within the Order.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_026.text:
That only leaves Prestina and {PLAYER_NAME}!
It seems that we will be in their debt, Roland!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_027.text: Ahem… It seems I must forfeit this particular battle.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0025_028.text:
It is your chance to boast of your prowess, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I hope it has not tarnished with time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_001.text:
T-these humans are strong…!
Scary-squeak, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_002.text:
You there! Don't squeak like a damn amateur!
Hrrmph. We fall back for now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_003.text: I see that you have all met.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_004.text:
I fear this is not the banquet hall we would like to be dining in.
Although it does seem to resemble {PLAYER_NAME}'s chambers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_005.text:
Everyone…
Demons have revealed their presence in Trista.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_006.text:
This may be our chance to find out more about demon mutation,
perhaps our greatest ever since the Neth War.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_008.text:
Have you been researching demons ever since the War?
I didn't know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_009.text:
(You mention that the Cardinal has accused Ellie
of being the demons' master.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_010.text: This poor innocent girl? Surely not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_011.text: I see what he is planning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_012.text:
And yet our dear citizens and the Heaven's Cavalry
trust his words to every last syllable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_013.text:
He has trained our people well,
that Cardinal. There is nothing to be done at this point.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_014.text:
We couldn't prove Ellie's innocence.
After all, we ourselves do not know who she is, exactly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_015.text:
That is of little concern. 
For we are close to unveiling the truth of demonic mutation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_016.text: How is that so, if I may ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_017.text: I saw the Order of the Shadow Roses on my way here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_018.text:
They seem to be using the same tarnished energy
we have been researching these last three years.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_019.text:
Yes… Yes. I remember more clearly now.
I had been distracted with escaping, but… I felt the similarities.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_021.text:
Yet it will not be easy to reveal the Cardinal's crimes
as long as the people of Trista trust him for what he is not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_022.text:
I fear that the power of blind faith…
can prove to be stronger than anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_023.text:
We need irrefutable evidence
that would turn the tide against the Cardinal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_024.text:
I will go back to Hellad's laboratory.
There may be evidence that the Cardinal had relations with Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_025.text: Yes, that seems a good plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_026.text: And we will go and shake down the Order of the Goddess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_027.text:
Oh, don't be so barbaric, Roland!
It's not "shaking down," per se... It's investigating.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_028.text:
Saintess, please see to it that he is not overeager
and rush into mistakes, as he did in the Tower of Manacar.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_029.text: T-that was three years ago, Rochefort!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_030.text:
Then let us move quickly. We must gather evidence
before the demons hide back into the shadows.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_031.text:
Yes, yes. This it the most exciting it has been
for quite some time!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_032.text:
Good, 
then we will go search the Palace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_033.text:
O-okay!
Then what should I do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_036.text:
Goddess of the Forest, {PLAYER_NAME}.
You must remember the reason you have come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_037.text:
We will take care of the demons.
Hide here for the time being. It is not safe.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_040.text:
Haha, of course.
But beware of the Ratmen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_041.text:
They are rather… too unrefined to appreciate visitors.
Once they were not as hostile as they are now, but...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0026_042.text: … Well. I suppose it is time to take our leave.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_001.text:
Ratmen again.
They are curiously hostile.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_002.text:
We need to stay here in the sewers for some time.
Should we attempt to negotiate with them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_005.text:
They… used to be good, kind people.
But their hearts are… now full of hatred and pain… Fury…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0027_006.text:
A hatred that… refuses all reason…
that knows no bounds…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_001.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}. I…
I am afraid for Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_002.text:
She seems a normal child, but at times…
I do not understand her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_003.text:
Who is she? What is she?
What does she know to talk of such matters as if…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_004.text:
(You answer that you too don't know for sure,
but you're certain that she isn't a bad person.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_005.text:
Yes. I think that too.
However… Neither is she a normal child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_006.text:
She… sees through people to their true forms.
So it was with the Shadow Roses, the Ratmen…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_007.text:
And I know that it is dangerous…
to use a power of which even its holder is unaware.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_008.text:
I wish to help Ellie,
until she comes to know the truth about herself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0028_010.text: It is a relief that you are here, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_003.text:
What do you mean…?
Ellie is sleeping beside…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_005.text:
(You reply that 
Ellie was already gone by the time you had woken up.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_006.text:
The Ratmen are hostile, and the sewers dark and winding.
We must find her as quickly as we can.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0029_008.text:
Yes. Rochefort advised us to stay in one place…
but it cannot be helped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_001.text:
… {PLAYER_NAME}.
Do you not feel another presence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_002.text: It seems someone is following us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_003.text:
(You observe that it doesn't seem to be
a demon or a trained soldier.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_005.text:
However… If it's neither a Shadow Rose
or a Heaven's Cavalry, who could be following us?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_006.text:
…Oh my.
Do you think we could do that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_007.text:
I suppose it is all for the best.
We are in enemy grounds, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0030_008.text:
I'm afraid I'm not experienced in such matters. 
I will entrust this particular plan to your hands, {PLAYER_NAME}.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_001.text:
Oh, your plan has succeeded after all, {PLAYER_NAME}.
I was a little worried when you wanted me to become the bait…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_002.text:
Hmm? Now that I take a closer look, this Ratman seems…
rather - and I do not mean any offence - cute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_004.text: (You ask why he is following you.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_006.text:
Us? Bad humans?
Why do you think so?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_008.text: (You ask the Ratman how he knows Ellie.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_009.text:
I'm never gonna tell-squeak!
Ellie is my friend to protect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_010.text:
(That Ratman may be the one
who has taken Ellie, you tell Prestina.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_011.text: Yes, I think so too. Let's go after him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_012.text:
(You ask Prestina how they can find the Ratman,
when they have already lost him.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_015.text:
Hee hee… I planted a small seed in the Ratman's fur
while he was distracted.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0031_016.text:
It contains a spark of my power, and I can detect it well enough.
Now, it's time for us to catch the mouse.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_003.text:
They're traitors who ran 'cuz they thought they were better
than the rest of us! The lot of them! We'll make them pay!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_004.text: Kiiirrr…. They'll be…. Kiiiiirrr… Just like me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_005.text:
Wait. It seems like someone is inside…
Let me see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_007.text:
You bad rats!
Go back! Stop bothering us-squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_008.text:
Hey, fella. Shut up if you don't want a knock on your head.
We have orders to bring you in the best condition possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_009.text:
Squeak! You think I'm gonna be scared?
I'm not going to shut up! I'm not!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_010.text:
What a bother.
Let's just kill him and get it over with.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0032_011.text:
All my pleasure.
I'll do it quick.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_001.text:
Are you alright?
Oh, my name is Prestina.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_004.text: I'm pleased to make your acquaintance, Rata.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_006.text:
I'm grateful that you saved me,
but I'm not going to tell you anything about Ellie, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_007.text:
I know you're going to do bad experiments on her!
Well, not anymore! You won't hurt her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_008.text:
What? Not at all! We too are here to protect Ellie.
Can you tell her where she is? How is she now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_009.text: … She was worse when I first met her, squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_010.text:
She was in pain… talking nonsense like a madman, ya know.
Talking about the… experiments.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_011.text:
Me, I don't like humans, humans don't like me.
I didn't want to be a part of this, but…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_012.text:
Ellie's different, ya know? 
Squeak… She's not scared of me…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_013.text:
Always saying she's sorry for some stupid thing…
Even when she's the one in pain…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_014.text:
What've you done to her, you psychos!
She's the only good human I've met!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_015.text:
Rata… We are here to put a stop to those experiments
once and for all, and so alleviate Ellie's wounds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_017.text:
Oh, good morning. I had such a good dream.
And the voices of the children… I don't hear them as much now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_019.text:
Ellie!
You shouldn't have run off like that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_020.text:
I-I...
Someone was calling me, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_021.text:
Ellie, hurry!
You have to go now-squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_023.text:
…Angry Warrats are coming.
Many of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_024.text:
We can't fight them.
We have to run if we want to live, squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_025.text:
I-I don't know what to do.
Do we need to leave this place?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_027.text:
…All I know is that once we're dead,
we won't be able to run even if we want to.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_028.text:
Rata, about the other Ratmen…
They were not as hostile as they are now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_029.text:
Some were changed into horrifying forms…
I need to know the reason behind their sudden enmity.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_030.text: And what're you gonna do when you find out?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_031.text:
We will give you our protection.
I only ask for your cooperation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_032.text:
Yes, Rata!
Prestina and {PLAYER_NAME} know… They know…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_034.text:
….Okay. If Ellie says so...I'm still not sure about this,
but I guess I need your help in protecting my village.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0033_035.text: Yes. And we will protect Ellie as well. Together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_001.text: Well, the place seems cleared up.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_002.text:
You took care of that many fighters?
I guess you really are strong!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_004.text:
Fine. I keep promises too, squeak.
What do you wanna know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_005.text:
The Ratmen… Since when and why did they
become hostile to humans? And to the others, like yourself?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_007.text:
I'm a traveling merchant by trade, so I lived outside-squeak.
Things were like this when I returned, so I ran away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_008.text:
Mm… Someone else could explain better.
Wait here, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_009.text:
Grandfather Triva!
These are the humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_010.text:
Yes… Squeak… So you are curious
about the reason the Ratmen changed…?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_011.text:
It is because of you humans… Squeak…
One hundred years ago, and now… It is the same…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_012.text:
Humans… Always so keen on despising us,
unwilling to acknowledge our existence…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_013.text:
They built a giant pipe at the end of the sewers…
And filled our dwellings with the filth of the outside world…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_014.text:
And not just ordinary filth…
But the remains of a strange, unclean mana…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_015.text:
The Ratmen who came in contact… with that mana…
were changed, and… earned strange powers in return…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_016.text:
Yet the problem… squeak… is that
the Ratmen… wanted to use these powers…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_017.text:
The other Ratmen who escaped with us…
were those who refused to be changed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_018.text:
Now I finally understand
their loathing of humans...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_019.text:
I-I may not know much,
but I know that that's not right!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_020.text:
They do not understand… that their brutality...
is no different from the cruelty of humans…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_022.text:
It would be best to… squeak… destroy all the mana filth…
but as its source comes from human territory…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_023.text:
There is… a captain of the corrupted Ratmen…
Rudrat…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_024.text:
If you stop him…squeak…
No Ratman will be changed against their will…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_025.text:
Rudrat… squeak…
seeks to change all the Ratmen…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_026.text:
I see… Triva, Rata.
I fear that we can't help you and the village for too long

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_027.text:
but if we find this Rudrat you speak of,
we will make sure to stop him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_028.text:
Thank you… You remind me… squeak… of old times…
when humans and Ratmen… lived in peace…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_029.text:
But they are bygone times…
Where will you go, now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_030.text:
We have no clear destination.
We are trying to recover this child's - Ellie's memories.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_031.text:
P-Prestina.
I just remembered where we should go!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_032.text:
The children of the laboratory… They're calling me.
They're begging for help… I can hear them crying…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_034.text:
I'm not very sure… But…
I can feel that we need to go in this direction!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_035.text:
(You also think that they should go 
in the direction Ellie pointed.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0034_036.text:
Yes, let's hurry!
Then, thank you, Rata, Grandfather Triva -

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_001.text:
W-wait!
Take me with you, squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_003.text:
You humans don't even know your way around the sewers.
And Ellie could get herself lost, or hurt, and…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_004.text:
Well, it's a Ratman's honor!
I can't just sit around waiting for humans, right? Squeak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_005.text: Okay! I'd be happy if you came with us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0035_006.text: (You say that it's okay to follow them.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_001.text:
Now that I think about it, how did you come here?
Most humans don't even know the existence of these sewers.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_002.text:
Ah, well… There was a small problem overhead.
We are… um, hiding for the time being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_004.text:
Haha.
Do you really think Ellie is capable of a crime?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_005.text:
Well. I guess if you're with Ellie…
Huh. I guess not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_006.text:
What are you talking about?
Can I learn how to do it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0036_007.text: I don't think you need to, Ellie.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_002.text:
Ellie, are you alright?
You do not seem well.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_003.text:
The children… They are calling for me even more loudly.
My… my head hurts, Prestina…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_004.text:
Shh, shh…
We will save the children soon. All of them.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_005.text: Ellie. Are you sure we need to go this way, squeak?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_008.text:
… It's the hairs of the Mutarats. 
And I smell the stench of mana filth as well… Squeak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_009.text:
There should be many of them ahead of us.
Think you're strong enough for them?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0037_010.text: (You don't know, but you say there's no other way.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_001.text:
It feels… different here, in this part of the sewers.
Almost as if the walls themselves are listening for intruders...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_002.text:
We're doomed. Squeak!
This - this is a rat trap!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_004.text:
Not a literal one, Ellie.
What is it, Rata?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_005.text:
Our path leads right to the 
headquarters of the corrupted Ratmen.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_006.text:
We’re dead-center in enemy grounds.
We're like mice trapped in a cage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_007.text:
You guys may be strong,
but I know you won't be that strong…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_008.text: This may be for the best.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_010.text: We promised to help you, after all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_011.text:
Don't be stupid! These aren't your ordinary Ratmen.
They're clever and use weird powers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_012.text:
Even if you're strong,
you're in their home territory. This isn't gonna work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_013.text:
The strength of the enemy
cannot defy our mission, nor deter our path.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_014.text:
Cora herself taught that it is your own will that is important, 
as well as knowing your true path and the reason for its being.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_016.text:
Fine, fine. Let's go, squeak! I guess Majerius the hero
didn't earn his Golden Grain sitting on his tush!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0038_017.text:
After all, my senses as the best merchant in the Ratman Village
are giving me the green light to go with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_001.text:
Okay. Now that it's all settled, I'll go ahead
and scout the road. Wait here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_S2_SQ0039_005.text:
Betraying our tribe by refusing the power to protect our people,
