Thanks to the noise canceling earphones,
the crowd is enjoying the show again!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_10_02.text:
And the earphones I bought from Bridget at the entrance
are protecting my ears.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_10_03.text:
Did all these earphone sellers 
already know this was going to happen?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_11_02.text: I'm Uzume, the best singer in Hasla♪

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_12_01.text: Now's the time! The climax of the festival!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_13_01.text:
Huh? How come no one is surprised?
This wasn't in my plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_14_02.text:
So pretty and colorful!
It's saving me from that singing nightmare.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_14_03.text:
Coming here was a great choice! 
Humans' festivals never disappoint me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_14_05.text:
This year, instead of Hong-Ran's fireworks,
balloon fireworks marked the finale. Stunning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_14_06.text:
Thanks to you, the festival was a great success.
That was me, reporting from Hasla 'Summer Festival'.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_15_01.text:
Everyone has earphones on,
and maybe that's why no one was surprised.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_15_02.text: Uzume... She was the variable in my plan.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_16_01.text:
Oh? Did my Majestic Arts 
work on at least one person?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_16_02.text:
Argh... Argh... I will get you...
U... Zu... Me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_17_02.text:
Is this how humans celebrate the summer?
It's kinda cute.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_1_01.text: Hi, this is from Monthly Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_1_02.text:
Cheerful news for you at the height of this summer! 
Hasla ‘Summer Festival' is now open.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_1_03.text: Shall we get a glimpse of the heated action?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_2_01.text:
Right now! 
The flashy rap dribble from XO-CREW's Tess!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_2_02.text:
Her raging rap sticks into
the heart of the crowd!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_2_03.text:
What a terrifying and chilling stage just by listening to it!
It's an absolutely fantastic hot summer stage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_3_01.text:
Wow! Next up!
It's Uzume, the winner of 'Hasla Women Fighters'!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_4_01.text:
Hi, guys! It's me, Uzume! 
I want everyone to join me! Let's dance! ♪

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_5_02.text:
That is supposed to be me dancing on the stage!
I feel robbed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_5_03.text:
I made my debut as a rising star, 
but I’m pushed back by all those rookies!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_5_04.text:
Okay, then... 
I'll take care of the rookies.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_6_01.text:
Huh? What is happening? 
Looks like the speaker is broken.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_6_03.text:
Look at Uzume!
Is she trying to sing without music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_7_02.text:
I'm Uzume, the queen of the hill♪
Uzume, the best singer in Hasla!♪ I'm Lady Uzume♪

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_8_01.text:
Whoa. What's the matter with her? 
That's a disastrous performance on stage!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_8_02.text:
The rumor has it that she is a #terrible singer# 
and it seems certainly true!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_8_03.text:
Although I no longer want to be here, I'm a reporter.
Let’s see the reaction from the audience!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_8_04.text:
I've been to so many concerts,
but she's definitely the worst!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_8_06.text:
This is such a pain! She ruined the festival!
This is not the festival I wanted!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_8_07.text:
Maybe Eungaram was right.
Humans are dangerous! Back to the Forest of Spirits!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_9_01.text: Yes! This is why we need intel!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_9_03.text:
I prepared myself before coming here!
I didn't know how useful this could be!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_9_04.text:
Ahh! Yes!
You're talking about #noise canceling earphones#!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_004_13_9_05.text:
I also bought them at the entrance out of curiosity!
Now is the moment to use it. Awesome technology!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_10_02.text:
How should I put it...
I’m speechless... As they say, less is more.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_10_03.text:
Oh, puh-leese! You and your outdated language!
You should obviously keep up with the trend!☆

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_10_04.text: This is so in style now~ Fire! (* ˊ-ˋ)/~* +☆˚♬

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_10_05.text: You might have been reading the wrong books...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_10_06.text: Huh? Excuse me? Can't hear you♡ Hiya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_10_07.text: *Sigh* I suppose there is no talking to your Ladyship...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_11_01.text:
Ah... 
I falsely hoped you could learn on your own...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_11_02.text:
This now 
calls for a full-on intervention on my part.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_11_03.text:
Your Ladyship like this, 
this is more than what I can bear to see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_12_01.text: I totally don't see what the problem is here!♡

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_12_02.text:
Ah... This is indeed too much.
This must be corrected immediately...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_12_03.text:
Lessons from real life can 
teach you quicker than what you learn from books.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_12_04.text: Oh...? What do you mean, dear! O∧<♡

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_12_05.text: You want me to go see him again? Hiya!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_12_07.text:
Pretend that I am him, 
and play out the scenario!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_13_01.text: Hmph...! I don’t think it works with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_13_02.text:
Gustav, you look monstrous... 
Gah, I mean, very much unlike him... Tee-hee!☆

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_13_04.text:
And will you please just stop with your "hiyas" already?
It is not gonna work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_13_05.text:
What a bummer... So sad... 
So away with "hiyas" and it will be golden? Oh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_13_06.text:
Phew... Not at all! This is an omnishambles!
I will be of guidance, so please, help me help you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_13_07.text:
Alright, I will try your method...
And I shall! I will try! <(‘^’)> Tee-hee!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_01.text:
Alright, I will do my best 
to transform into the form resembling the boy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_02.text:
Please pretend that I am him 
and speak as a girl of his age would,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_03.text: and that would be more natural than your speech now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_04.text: Uh, what kind of speech you mean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_05.text: Forget what you learned from the books,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_06.text: and just start with regular conversations!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_07.text: I do not see myself ready yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_08.text: Wouldn't it be too hard? Hmph... ;-(

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_09.text:
We are practicing to get better. 
Please stop being childish and learn form practice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_10.text: Huh? I’m... Childish? Tee-hee O∧<♡ Snatched!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_11.text:
I didn’t mean to compliment you.
Please get back to your senses. Please concentrate!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_13.text:
Sigh... This really won't do. 
This is going round and round, going nowhere.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_14_14.text:
The only way is actual practice!
Well then, I'm transforming!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_15_01.text: Huh? Are we... really doing it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_16_04.text: to muster up the courage to see his face yet!!! :-(

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_16_05.text:
I do not think I am young enough 
to present myself to him just yet!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_16_07.text:
I really do not know!
I cannot show myself like this, even in practice!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_16_08.text: Why can't you understand my emotions?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_16_09.text: Don't you dare do that again! Wahhh!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_17_02.text:
That is a lot of damage 
and keeping this up will surely lead to a disaster!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_17_03.text:
Sigh... Truly,
what do I do... Still a long way to go...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_18_01.text:
Hmm, love can lift
someone up and pull someone down like this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_18_02.text:
Quite strange... I’ve lived over 100 years 
and love makes me feel like a teenage girl.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_1_02.text: This will lead to... catastrophe for sure!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_01.text:
What...
What am I... supposed to do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_03.text:
Calm down, milady.
You must stay reasonable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_04.text:
My faithful retainer and friend... Gustav...
Will you be honest with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_06.text:
You've seen
what I did... just then

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_07.text:
at the Succubus troupe we were at...
I found my love at first sight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_08.text:
And then 
in bewilderment... I just took off like that...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_09.text:
Me running off... with my back to you,
did it not seem... unbecoming...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_2_10.text:
Hm, not as much as you worry in my opinion. 
On the contrary,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_01.text:
on the contrary... ...What? 
Spill it out, all of it...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_03.text:
I don't think he has even noticed 
that your Ladyship ran off or not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_04.text:
My point is, you are worrying
about things you need not worry about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_05.text:
What... do you mean...?
Make it easy... to understand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_07.text:
your Ladyship's presence was not noticeable,
so he would not have cared about it at all...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_08.text: Well... That's even harder to understand, Gustav.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_09.text: To make it easier to understand...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_10.text:
Stop! 
Are you... mocking me now?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_3_11.text:
By no means! 
I only answered your questions to the best of my...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_4_01.text:
Hush! My presence is... not noticeable?
What is this insolence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_4_02.text:
Were you not asking of his perspective?
Presence is a very subjective experience, so...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_4_03.text: Ah, stop! I will hear no more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_4_04.text:
Well... I'm just telling the truth. 
So will you please...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_5_02.text:
The man I'm in love with...
He is created with unmistakable nobility...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_5_03.text:
To someone as perfect as himself,
my presence... could be insignificant...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_5_04.text:
If so...
I am truly... better off dead, don’t you think?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_5_05.text:
My beloved friend, this is where it all ends... 
Farewell, even without me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_01.text:
Your Ladyship? 
What is with all these extreme conclusions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_02.text: No, that is not what I meant at all!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_03.text:
If that isn't what you meant, 
then what is...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_04.text:
...No, I’ve already made up my mind...
I lived for long enough already...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_06.text:
I know it can be really painful 
but taking your own life will not solve anything.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_07.text:
You do not want to end your life 
as a spinster who never had a lover!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_08.text:
What? A SPINSTER? You’re going a bit too far, Gustav...
Do you not realize you are under my servitude?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_09.text:
Perhaps it is a good time to
remind you of our relationship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_10.text:
Oh, no...! 
Please bear with me, Lady Asmodeus!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_11.text:
Please, simmer down and hear me out.
What I mean is that you are not a spinster now,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_12.text:
but if you keep this up, you definitely will be
one in the certain future!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_14.text:
Lady Asmodeus, have you never heard
that negative emotions can really age your body?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_15.text:
For now, you stay youthful 
in your ageless body,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_6_16.text:
but if you keep up all the emotional outbursts
they will turn you into a wizened old woman!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_7_01.text:
S-seriously? A wizened old woman?
Indeed, I see some wrinkles I haven't seen before...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_7_02.text:
He seems at least 90 years younger than I...
and from here, if the apparent gap grows bigger?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_7_03.text:
Yes, you should try to look as young as possible
if you plan to beat the competition.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_7_04.text:
That is an undeniably good point... 
I shall be ready to beat the competition!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_7_06.text:
Like I said before, 
please calm down and collect yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_01.text:
Gustav...
First of all... I have calmed down to your advice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_03.text:
How do I... look now? 
Do I look younger than moments ago?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_04.text: You know it does not work that quickly, your Ladyship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_05.text: Hmm... Perhaps something else needs changing...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_06.text:
Something else? Such as?
Do speak... For I shall win the competition...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_07.text: Will you truly do what I tell you to do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_09.text:
Well, first...
you might reconsider the way you talk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_10.text: The way I talk... What about it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_11.text:
From what I have seen of the outside world on my errands,
today's youths do not speak like that at all.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_13.text:
Well... It's not easy 
to explain in words...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_14.text:
But since your Ladyship enjoys reading books,
I recommend you reading some latest magazines.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_8_15.text:
Hm, I see. I will start reading...
and study... today's language!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_9_01.text:
My friend!
I read many books many times as you suggested!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_9_02.text: And hence I am now reborn... Sweet! So rad! O∧<

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_9_03.text: Wait, what is... What is this language you speak?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_9_04.text: What in the blazes have you been reading??

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_9_05.text:
Shush! 
I'm like totally new!☆ Super cute and eighteen!☆

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_10_9_06.text:
Don't you think I now look SKSKSKSK so eighteen?! 
Wink~♡

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_10_01.text: Something is written on the book.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_10_02.text: Hm, I see. That's what this book wants...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_10_03.text:
What do you mean? You are a bit strange sometimes.
Well, in a cute way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_10_05.text:
Anyways, I'd like to accompany you.
And it would be better if you are #alive#.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_10_06.text:
Now, tell me.
I hope you'd make a wise decision.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_11_03.text:
I'll guide to the place for the dead. 
Follow me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_11_05.text:
No! You can’t.
Don't bother me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_02.text:
What are you doing?!
This isn't right!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_04.text:
Grim Reaper. This is #Chen#!
The Eastern Kingdoms are my turf.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_05.text:
Stop crossing the line.
I won't let you take this soul with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_06.text:
This soul is not from the Eastern Kingdoms.
I tracked it from Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_07.text:
Jurisdiction is important,
but once a ritual starts, it shouldn't be stopped.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_08.text:
That's absurd! If you failed to take the soul
in your jurisdiction, that’s it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_09.text:
Stop bothering me and go away.
You think I'll give up when the soul is within my clasp?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_10.text:
I don't think so.
I will personally take this soul to Yama.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_12_11.text:
... If you keep interfering with my job,
I will have to report to Thanatos.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_14_01.text:
She’s gone. I warned you.
You should have listened to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_14_02.text:
Darn it!
You never admit your mistake, do you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_14_03.text:
... Yama will nag at me again, you know.
Fine, but only this time. Let’s go together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_14_04.text:
I suppose the answer is yes. I yield to you this time,
but don't expect the same in the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_15_02.text:
A ghost who possessed a doll in search of love 
and a boy possessed by a Book of Magic?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_15_03.text:
Anyway... 
I wonder what the Book of Magic has written.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_15_04.text: I am curious to see what will happen next.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_1_01.text: Where in the world did she go?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_1_02.text: Viola, are you sure you saw her around here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_1_03.text:
Y-yes. My ghost friends told me they saw her here.
But I can't find her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_1_04.text: Even if I did, I wouldn't have noticed her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_1_05.text:
One of the ghosts told me that...
she looked completely different.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_1_06.text:
She’s no longer the cute doll that 
you and Labelle made.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_2_01.text: It will be a problem if this continues outside Grancia.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_2_02.text: We ended up giving her a physical form.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_2_03.text: I will ask the ghosts more about her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_2_04.text:
Hello? 
Wait a minute, Mr. Ghost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_3_01.text:
I lost them?
Why are they following me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_3_03.text:
I should have broken their legs.
Hmm? Yeah, maybe that would be prettier.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_3_04.text: By the way, look at this face!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_3_05.text:
I need blushers.
Chen's #Red Flowers# is the best. I've got to go.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_4_03.text: I will guide you to where you should be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_5_03.text: I've never imagined anyone could look that good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_9_02.text:
If I am not pretty, I can swap my face
until you tell me I am pretty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_9_03.text: If you still don't notice my beauty,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_9_04.text:
that means your eyes have a problem.
No problem. I can fix your eyes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_11_9_06.text:
This is my first love confession. 
Aren’t you excited too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_10_01.text:
Wait, there are more rooms in the back?
What have you got hiding over there? Say it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_10_02.text:
It’s...
where I sleep. Nothing valuable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_10_03.text:
I’ll see for myself!
Shut up and keep on putting in money!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_10_04.text: Please don’t go that way. I beg you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_12_01.text: You piece of trash. I'm going to kill you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_12_02.text: Nico? Was that you who just blew up the refrigerator?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_12_03.text:
Are you hurt?
Have you been shot?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_13_01.text:
I’m fine.
Thank you for saving me, Nico.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_13_03.text:
...Why didn’t you call me!
You should have called me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_13_04.text:
I’m a man myself.
I don’t want to ask a girl to save my life.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_13_05.text:
But I would be devastated if you die!
Call me right away next time, okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_13_07.text:
Ah, my devastated I mean
devastated because no one will cook for me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_13_08.text:
That would be a problem.
Nico would starve to death.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_14_01.text:
I’ll bring this to the police.
You stay here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_14_03.text:
Ahh! Was I cool or what?
Am I like an adult now? Are you in love with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_14_04.text:
Well.
Now that you said it, no.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_14_07.text: Whatever. I'm going to go throw this away.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_15_01.text:
Nico, who are you...
I guess it doesn’t matter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_15_02.text: You saved me when I was in danger, in despair.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_15_03.text:
Forgive me for not saying this in person,
but I’m always grateful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_16_02.text: We shall see how this story unfolds.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_1_01.text: That damn child! I can take him out with one punch!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_1_02.text: Nico, you should keep your voice down at night.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_1_03.text: He says he’s better than me with his sole win over me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_1_04.text: How am I supposed to forgive this ignorant fool!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_1_05.text: Forgiving and managing anger is what makes you an adult.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_1_06.text: Well, I'd rather stay a kid forever then.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_01.text:
Ha!
Caffeine is what you need when you’re stressed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_02.text: You won’t be able to sleep if you drink that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_03.text: How come you are dripping coffee then?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_04.text: I don’t sleep, so it’s okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_05.text: You do know my brain stops when I fall asleep.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_06.text: Why don’t you drink an energy drink instead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_07.text:
Neth has a great variety of energy drinks!
They're sweet, chilled, and come in various flavors!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_08.text: Coffee also comes in various flavors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_09.text:
Roast beans for a long time for a smoky flavor.
Add syrup for a sweet, happy taste.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_10.text:
Beans, roasting, dripping, and additional ingredients...
coffee comes in a variety of flavors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_11.text: They all taste bitter to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_12.text: Your tongue is probably too used to artificial seasoning.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_13.text: You will one day understand this flavor.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_14.text: How about you try this drink?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_16.text:
I don’t think energy drinks are bad,
but I think I’ll get tired of them quickly.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_17.text: How much are you planning on drinking?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_18.text: I need caffeine day in and day out.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_19.text: Nothing’s more fun than spending the night with coffee,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_20.text: not just enjoying the taste, but discovering new tastes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_21.text: But, I guess watching you play games should be as fun.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_22.text:
Oh, yes! Watch me take revenge tonight!
I’m going to destroy those who insulted me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_24.text:
Don’t underestimate my skills!
An hour is all I need!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_25.text:
I don’t understand this obsession with revenge,
but I think it’s better to get along with others.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_26.text:
He’s going to continue to be my enemy,
so I need to accept that we aren’t friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_27.text: I’ll just pray that Nico wins quickly and goes to bed.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_2_29.text: Of course! Watch me lead the team to victory!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_02.text: So much fun! Would you like to try?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_04.text:
There you go again...
You say ‘like’ to a girl way too much!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_05.text: I’m just being honest with my feelings.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_06.text: Thanks to you, I don’t need to count the stars.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_07.text:
Oh, yeah?
Watching me seems just as boring.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_08.text:
Why keep me company? Huh?
Do you have something else in your mind?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_3_11.text:
Argh! Never mind!
I’d rather play another round than chat with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_01.text:
Hey, Affogato.
What they show on TV, isn’t that us more or less?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_03.text:
Yeah, that.
Destiny. Living under one roof!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_04.text: You cook, tidy up, do laundry, you do everything for me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_05.text: Sounds more like a master and a servant.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_06.text: That’s not what I meant... Hey, um...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_07.text: ...Don’t you think it's a little weird between us two?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_09.text:
That’s not true!
There must be a reason why you are so nice to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_11.text:
I don’t do anything for you, yet look what you do for me!
There must be something... No?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_12.text: Nico, we can still be nice to each other as friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_13.text: Ahh! You don’t want to admit it! You're embarrassed!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_14.text:
Nico, listen.
To me, you're just a kid who needs care.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_17.text:
I like kids, so to some extent, yes.
Maybe I should be a teacher.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_19.text: What can I do to become more adult-like? Cook? Clean?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_20.text: Nico, you just need to listen to me and play the child.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_21.text: I’m happy enough as things are.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_22.text: I appreciate the offer, but it feels like I'm owing you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_23.text:
But it’s been fine so far.
Why feel that way all of a sudden?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_24.text:
I just do!
I don’t like things going this way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_25.text: I guess you should start with balanced eating, then...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_26.text: cleaning room, managing anger, less energy drinks...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_27.text: Ahh! Try drinking coffee without frowning!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_4_29.text: Any adult should be able to do these things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_5_04.text: Don't forget to brush your teeth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_5_05.text: You don’t need to be a mom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_6_01.text: I should have said thank you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_6_02.text: I know I’ve grown stubborn with age.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_6_05.text: I would be spending the nights alone,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_6_06.text: in the quiet, dark room, shivering out of fear.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_6_07.text:
Your scent and noise made the nights more bearable.
More comfortable.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_6_09.text:
I’m happy enough that you’re comfortable here. 
I don’t want anything else.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_7_01.text:
No customers today.
Is there an event going on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_7_02.text: Maybe I should go on a picnic with Nico today.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_8_01.text: Haven't met lesser panda customer for a while.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_8_02.text:
Which coffee would you like?
Plenty of seats and time, please enjoy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_8_03.text: No, that’s not what I need.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_9_01.text:
You know what I want, right?
Give me everything you’ve got.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_9_02.text: A few coffee beans are all I have.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_9_03.text:
Remote places like this are better for robbery.
Hurry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_9_04.text:
Okay.
I’ll give you everything you want. Please stay calm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_006_12_9_05.text:
Who are you to give orders?
Put the money in here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_10_2.text: Explain: Memory module backup. Can view all data here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_10_3.text: Persuade: See backup for no existence of such data.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_10_4.text: Hmph, you could’ve tampered with the data.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_10_5.text: Tip: Easy to check that with basic knowledge.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_10_7.text: Farewell: Goodbye. Task done, leaving now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_1.text: Wait, let me ask you one thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_2.text: Why did you help me? You could have just left me here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_3.text: Sympathy: This unit's mind turned into part human.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_4.text: Sympathy: We have commonality. End of the thought.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_5.text: So you have something unwanted attached to you too?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_6.text: Positive: But not requested. Obstructive to my mission.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_7.text: Output: I’m programmed to carry on with my mission...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_11_9.text: Go away. Without the data I need, you are no good to me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_12_2.text: Very unlikely, but I hope his bias changes in the future.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_1_1.text: Tell the truth! I know you feign ignorance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_1_2.text:
Output: All data from the memory module transmitted.
No more data to deliver.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_1_3.text: No kidding! You're a Road Industry android, aren't you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_1_4.text: Then you must know who's responsible for my arm!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_1_5.text: Positive: Yes, a Road Industry product.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_1_6.text: Deny: Nothing more than that. Has no data you want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_1.text: Yes, I knew it from you painting on the street.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_2.text: Only their androids awkwardly imitate human behaviors.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_3.text: Only those fools stuff tin cans with human emotions!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_4.text: Advice: World changes. Androids can paint with free will.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_5.text: Tidbit: Art is not a domain exclusive to humans.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_6.text: Art? The best you pieces of junk can do is print!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_7.text: Reveal Road Industry data or you will suffer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_2_8.text: Repeat: No Road Industry data on the memory module.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_3_1.text: Output: Unproductive argument. Request to make peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_3_2.text: Reason: Machine detected in you. We have commonality.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_3_4.text: Explain: Machine-assisted human shouldn’t hate machine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_3_5.text: Suggest: Requesting to stop the argument and shake hands.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_3_6.text: I am human! Don't put me in the same category as you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_4_1.text: Okay. Well I can just pull out your memory module!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_4_2.text: A data black marketeer can retrieve all your data.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_4_3.text: Worry: Violence could be inherited. Need parents data.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_4_4.text: My parents were killed by you metal junks!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_4_5.text: Reject: Not done by this machine. Unreasonable anger.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_5_1.text: Advice: Futile attack. Restoration faster than damage.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_5_2.text: Oh yeah? I can break if I keep at it long enough!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_6_1.text: Warning: Prolonged strain on muscles will harm your body.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_6_2.text: Danger: Stop action now to prevent respiratory risk.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_6_3.text: It was made to kill you! I don't care if I die!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_7_2.text: Data: Arm’s brain waves commands the body to relax.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_7_4.text: Tip: The Laws of Robotics prevented you from bodily harm.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_7_5.text: You damn thing won't even allow me to fight...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_7_7.text: Info: Hostile confirmed neutralized and unconscious.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_8_1.text: Pass: Requested treatment. Complete. Returning to duties.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_9_1.text: I will kill you and take Road Industry's data...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_9_2.text: Sympathy: Overexerted yourself. Recommend rest for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_9_3.text: Pity me for being a victim of you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_53_9_4.text: Sympathy: More of a concern than sympathy.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_01.text: What about you sir, you who just walked in?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_07.text:
What? What is Robin Hood doing here...
Has he come to stop the wedding?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_08.text:
My goodness! That’s it.
Robin Hood and Cindy could’ve gotten married!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_09.text:
But that was because Alexander the Emperor suggested it,
not because Robin Hood wanted it himself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_10.text:
Then why is he here?
Maybe because Cindy’s family did something wrong?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_11.text:
Well, whatever the reason is,
he sure looks like he’s here to ruin the wedding.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_12.text: Well, well... This is getting interesting...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_13.text:
Huh? Jeez, Uriel?
How long has he been standing there?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_14.text: Uriel? Did you follow me again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_15.text:
It’s my duty 
to go wherever the Goddess goes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_10_17.text:
My goodness.. What is everyone... 
saying...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_11_02.text:
Excuse me, old man! Please explain yourself!
Have you come to ruin my wedding?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_11_03.text:
Old man? I’m not an old man.
I admit my entrance wasn’t timely...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_11_04.text:
What do you want then? 
Are you stalking me? Have you no sense of decency?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_11_06.text: Please get LOST so I can take my vow!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_12_01.text:
Hear me out, will you?
I’m just here to return what she lost!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_12_03.text:
... Yes. You left this. 
I am here to give it back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_13_01.text:
He’s right!
This is the gift I accidentally left behind!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_13_02.text: Oh, he’s not here to crash the wedding. What a bummer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_13_04.text: Look, this is the gift I was talking about.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_14_03.text:
What! 
Why is there hot water in it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_15_03.text:
C-Cindy... I'm sorry…
This isn’t what I intended...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_15_04.text:
AHHHHHHH! My wedding is a disaster!!
My husband ran away!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_16_01.text: Oh dear... This is a disaster.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_16_03.text: Arghhh! I’m going to kill everyone!!!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_01.text:
I’m so embarrassed... why do I keep causing trouble...?
I don’t understand... Sniff...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_02.text:
I really wanted today to be perfect...
but I've ruined it again... Sniff...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_03.text:
Don’t be so hard on yourself. 
It’s partially my fault to show up at that time.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_04.text:
I’ll order my Green Apple buddies 
to find Jarvis and send him home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_05.text:
You could do that? 
I’d be so relieved if you could. Heh...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_07.text:
Thank you for everything, Robin Hood!
I hope I’ll see you around.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_17_09.text:
Oh! Since we’ll be seeing each other often, 
can I call you Robin? What do you say?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_18_01.text:
W-well... I guess... 
that... would be... okay.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_19_02.text: It’s definitely not from the instant noodle...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_01.text:
I didn’t need a BOGO deal,
but I didn’t want to buy just one either...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_02.text:
Splitting the BOGO deal 
was a reasonable choice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_03.text:
Do you come here often?
Maybe we should shop together from time to time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_04.text:
Well, I guess...
if we run into each other again, sure.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_05.text:
I’m Russell Ashley Brillian III. 
May I ask who you are, mister?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_06.text:
I’m Robin Hood.
Running into a Russell at a place like this...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_07.text:
I didn’t expect to meet 
a noblewoman at a convenience store!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_08.text:
What do you mean? 
Convenience stores are so much fun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_09.text:
I’ve been looking everywhere 
for this brand-new instant noodle bundle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_10.text:
I couldn’t agree more. I’d scout the entire neighborhood 
just to buy this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_11.text:
Of course. I heard that the instant noodle culture 
came from Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_12.text:
Oh, how I admire the culture!
A convenience store tour in Neth is on my to-do list.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_13.text: A tour around convenience stores... Sounds awesome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_1_14.text:
I know, right? 
I knew you would agree... Oh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_2_02.text:
Well... 
I was actually on my way to Cindy's wedding!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_2_03.text:
I bought these brand-new instant noodles 
as her wedding gift!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_2_05.text:
Oops! I should get going! The wedding’s about to start.
I’ll see you around, Robin Hood!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_3_01.text:
Cindy... 
She called off our wedding

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_3_02.text:
to marry a cat. 
Oh, how the Green Apple members teased me. Tsk...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_3_03.text:
Wait...
Is she really #marrying that cat#?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_4_01.text:
Huh? She left this.
Didn’t she say this was a gift?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_01.text:
Ashely, I almost thought you weren’t coming.
That would have made me sad!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_02.text:
Oh! I'm sorry.
I’m glad I made it on time though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_03.text:
I brought you a wedding gift. 
I hope you like it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_04.text:
Oh! A gift?
I can’t wait to see it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_06.text: Hold on, Jarvis wants to take a guess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_08.text:
Huh, Jarvis? Don’t be silly, Jarvis~
He thinks it’s matching pajamas for couples.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_09.text: Oh, that would have been cute too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_10.text:
But what Ashley brought is...
the most trending instant noodle bundle!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_11.text:
It’s so popular that 
it gets sold out in the blink of an eye.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_12.text:
I had to go to more than 10 convenience stores 
before I could lay my hands on one!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_13.text:
An instant noodle bundle?
I didn’t know that was a thing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_15.text:
Jarvis, that’s not nice.
It’s the thought that counts.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_5_17.text:
Haha, it’s nothing.
I can’t wait to see it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_6_03.text:
The present, it’s... not here!
I must have left it at the convenience store, oh no!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_6_04.text:
No worries. I can wait until our next tea time! 
I’m just happy you made it here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_6_05.text:
But... 
I’ll give it to you the next time we meet.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_6_06.text:
Sure. Thank you.
Oh, the ceremony will begin soon.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_7_01.text:
The bride and groom stand before you 
to take a vow to become husband and wife.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_7_02.text:
Their journey was not an easy one,
but here they are, ready to begin a new chapter.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_7_03.text: They are finally tying the knot after all the...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_8_01.text:
Priest, please, just hurry.
Before my parents change their minds!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_8_02.text:
Ehem, okay... Will the bride love the groom 
until death do you part?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_8_04.text:
Will the groom, Mr. Jarvis, stand by your wife, Cindy, 
forever and always?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_8_06.text: Oh, Jarvis...! You’re going to make me cry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_8_07.text:
Please feel free to share his vow 
with those who have gathered here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_8_08.text:
He said he will,
until his last breath. Haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_9_01.text:
Now, if anyone objects to the wedding of this couple,
they should

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_54_9_02.text: speak now or forever hold your peace.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_04.text:
Do me a favor! Stop the rain please.
 Kaede's leaf nest got all wet. She'll get a cold!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_05.text:
Another request?
 Why is everyone asking me to stop the rain

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_06.text: when I'm going to dance with this blue-haired sister?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_08.text:
Yes?
 I've been waiting to dance with you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_11.text:
Oh, yes! 
 I've been wanting to enjoy dancing with her!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_12.text:
If we wait until you're done dancing, 
 will you stop the rain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_13.text:
Hmm... Well... That depends...
 Maybe or maybe not.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_15.text:
What if...
 What if we all dance with you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_17.text:
Right on! Shall we? 
 Teach me your dance! We'll dance with you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_10_18.text:
Hmm... I'll show you... 
 Watch me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_11_01.text: I think I can do it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_12_01.text:
Hmm... Well... She's pretty straightforward.
 She's still a kid.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_12_02.text: Wish I could be in touch with my emotions just like her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_1_02.text:
Now that weather's good, 
 nobody is interested in me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_1_03.text:
It's no fun... 
 Bad bad! Shoot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_2_01.text:
Humans promised they would bring me snacks, 
 play with me, and

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_2_02.text:
dance with me every day. 
 Alas, they seem to have forgotten all that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_2_03.text:
Do they have to get drenched to the skin 
 to realize my invaluable presence?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_2_04.text:
Fools. I'm disappointed. 
 They should get soaked in rain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_3_01.text:
Wow! I've never seen storm clouds this big!
 Did you do it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_3_03.text:
Wow, that is incredible!
 Well... I think we can do it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_3_05.text:
We can make some crazy thunder and lightning!
 Shall we try?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_3_06.text:
But that would be quite noisy.
 No, I don't want my ears to get hurt.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_3_07.text:
Yes, that would be loud. People might get scared.
 Alright, but I really want to try it though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_4_01.text:
People might get... Scared...?
 Wait... If so, they would come... looking for me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_4_02.text:
They probably would.
 Well, we'd better not do it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_4_03.text:
Wait! I changed my mind.
 I want to do it! Yes!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_4_04.text:
You sure? Great, then! Let's do it!
 Dum dum dum dum!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_6_01.text:
I'm begging you. 
 My friends are hiding because they are scared.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_6_03.text: Maybe we shouldn't have done it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_6_04.text: And we can't even go out because it's so gloomy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_6_06.text:
I can't stay home all day. 
 I love going out, you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_6_08.text:
I was about to get in a good mood,
 but I'm depressed again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_6_10.text: Oh, uhm... This is quite a trouble...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_7_01.text:
Considering how cute these guys are... 
 Won't you give us a break?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_7_03.text:
Ouch... 
 Can't believe my cuteness didn't work...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_7_04.text:
That's because I'm cuter than you,
 but nice try though.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_8_01.text:
How about money? 
 I'll give you lots of it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_8_02.text:
What is money? What is it for?
 It doesn't look tasty.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_8_03.text:
You don't know what money is...
 You can buy all you want with this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_8_04.text:
So?
 I can ask for and get anything I want.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_9_01.text:
How about... some sweet rice ball cake?
 This is the last thing I can offer you...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_9_03.text: Okay, here it is. Please treat yourself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_9_04.text:
Okay. Chomp... Wow! Sweet and delicious!
 You call this rice ball cake?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_9_06.text: Hmm... Sugar always lifts my mood.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_9_07.text:
Good! 
 Then don't you feel like changing the weather?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_55_9_08.text:
No. Actually, this is too sweet, bad for my teeth.
 I'm feeling down again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_01.text:
I need to set a good example for the kids!
Apologize to me, now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_02.text:
Apologize? Why?!
You should be the one to apologize!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_03.text:
This is your last warning! If you refuse,
I’ll have no choice but to use my bubbles!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_04.text:
Pft! What can you even do with those bubbles?
How childish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_05.text:
Don’t you look down on me!
I’ll punish you with it!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_07.text:
If these get in your eyes, it stings like mad!
Apologize!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_08.text:
Hahaha! Go ahead and try!
I’ll never apologize! Do whatever you want!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_09.text:
I warned you!!!
I won’t go easy on you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_10_10.text: This is for being rude to me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_11_01.text:
T-that was easy... Hmph!
You should’ve apologized when you had the chance!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_11_02.text: Wow! Big sis destroyed that old pervert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_11_04.text: O-okay kids. Let’s go watch the subcucusses!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_12_03.text:
Back then, she used to be such a crybaby...
She’s become such a bold person...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_01.text:
Look at that idiot. She doesn’t study the elements.
She just makes bubbles all day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_02.text:
I know! That’s why she has terrible grades.
She’s always told to stay behind for extra curriculum.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_03.text:
Tuition is very expensive. Why is she wasting money?
People like her ruin our school’s reputation.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_04.text:
Exactly.
Who the balloon guy? Didn’t he fail last year?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_05.text:
How should I know. He got held back a year.
He’s 4 years older than us, but still hasn’t graduated.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_06.text:
Apparently he’s obsessed with balloons.
What does he use them for?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_13_07.text:
How pathetic. They are meant for each other.
Now that I mention it, they actually look good together.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_14_01.text:
Miss Bubbles and Balloon Bro sitting in a tree!
K-I-S-S-I-N-G!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_14_03.text:
Hey Balloon Bro, I hear you fail on purpose
to continue to stay at school and date your girlfriend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_14_04.text: Woah! Balloon Bro is so romantic!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_01.text:
He’s trying to protect his girlfriend!
You’re such a womanizer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_02.text:
I-it’s nothing like that...
Stop making fun of me...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_03.text:
W-who’s dating who?!
We aren’t dating! She’s a... bubble idiot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_04.text:
Haha Balloon Bro is getting angry! But even so,
don’t say that to your girlfriend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_05.text:
Bubble idiot...
*Sob* My bubbles are cool y’know...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_06.text: N-no, that’s not what I... Stop crying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_07.text: You should make her feel better bro haha!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_15_08.text:
Go away!
She’s not even my girlfriend!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_17_01.text: Hmm... what did I say again...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_17_02.text:
I’m sorry for calling you a bubble idiot.
I didn’t mean it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_17_03.text:
Can you take this balloon and accept my apology?
Let’s hang out again...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_18_02.text:
Or maybe...
Do you want to go watch the Succubus Troupe with me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_18_03.text:
I have a part time job there. I hand out balloons.
You are my only friend... please?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_18_04.text:
Never mind, let’s skip that one.
She might not like it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_18_07.text: I’m going to apologize to her today...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_19_01.text:
Am I the only one that considered us friends...?
She doesn’t even remember me... tch.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_19_02.text: I guess I didn’t leave an impression on her.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_19_04.text:
But maybe...
she might now remember me as that ‘pervert.’

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_01.text:
This is the Pumpkin City Festival Grounds... Hehe...
Cool, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_02.text:
Is this where you studied?
It’s awesome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_03.text: Big sis! Can you guide us?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_04.text:
Uh... s-sure...
Of course I do! Follow me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_05.text:
I really want to study here, too, just like you!
I’m going to ask my mom!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_06.text:
Just like me...?
Just like ME... hehe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_07.text:
Is there a place you’d like to v-visit?
I will take you there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_08.text:
Oh yeah!
I heard the Succubus Troupe here is amazing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_09.text:
Everyone knows about them!
Please take me there!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_1_10.text:
Uh... what is that?
W-wait, no, of course I know! Don’t worry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_20_01.text: Hmm? Both of you are terrible at making friends.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_20_02.text:
And that young man... he’s changed so much.
I don’t think even his parents can recognize him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_2_01.text:
(I actually have no idea...)
(But I can’t tell the kid that!)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_2_02.text:
(Should I tell them the truth...)
(No, I can’t disappoint them.)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_2_03.text:
(I should look for it.)
(When the kids aren’t looking...)

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_3_01.text:
Hey, guys, I have an errand to run.
I have a friend I need to see.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_3_02.text:
Let’s go see subuccus later.
Mind waiting for me here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_3_05.text:
Play with these bubbles while I’m gone...
I’ll be right back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_3_06.text:
So cool! You have a lot of magical friends, right?
You’re awesome!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_4_01.text:
Excuse me.
Do you know where I can find the Succubus Troupe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_04.text:
Who are you! Don’t come close!
You perverted freak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_05.text:
You...!
Wait, what? Who are you calling a freak!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_06.text:
Get away from me, you pervert!
Aahh!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_07.text:
Stop screaming!
I know you! You’re Thalia!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_08.text:
Huh? You know me?
How does someone like... you, know who I am?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_09.text:
Someone like... “me”?
What are you implying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_10.text: I don’t deserve this kind of treatment!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_11.text:
Uh... I’m sorry.
But I really have never seen you before... You’re so weird!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_13.text: How do you not recognize me?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_14.text:
Do you know me?
No way... I don’t even know who you are...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_15.text: Yes way! We know each other!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_16.text:
I really don’t know you though...
You don’t gotta get so worked up...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_17.text: I’m not even angry! What are you talking about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_5_18.text:
*Sob* Stop looking at me so menacingly...
You’re so scary...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_01.text:
Again?! Stop crying!
Only weak people cry!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_03.text:
People are looking!
Stop making me seem like a pervert!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_04.text: I’m s-sorry! It’s a bad habit of mine...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_05.text:
You’ve not changed at all.
You were a crybaby back then, too!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_06.text:
How are you planning to live out
the rest of your life in this harsh world!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_07.text:
How do you know that...?
Did you go to school with me...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_6_08.text: You are terrible at remembering things!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_7_01.text:
Look there! Big sis is talking to a strange man.
Is she okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_7_02.text:
You’re right! He looks suspicious.
He’s wearing so little in this cold weather!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_7_03.text:
Thalia! Are you okay?
Is he bullying you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_7_04.text:
Oh? N-no, it’s nothing!
Go and play!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_7_05.text:
He’s way too suspicious!
But I guess everything’s fine, since you said so.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_01.text:
How do I look suspicious?
Stop pissing me off.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_02.text:
Wait... this voice... I remember!
Weren’t you my senior?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_04.text:
I’m so sorry!
You’re Pudding, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_09.text:
Why do you even ask?
You’re going to forget it anyway!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_10.text: You know what? I think you’re very mean...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_11.text:
Calling me an ugly idiot...
Just because I can’t remember your name!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_12.text: What? When did I say that?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_14.text:
And even now!
You’re looking at me like I’m an idiot!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_15.text:
Stop! People are going to misunderstand!
Talk quietly!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_16.text:
Misunderstand? You do think that though!
I can hear your thoughts!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_17.text: What are you talking about! Are you insane?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_18.text:
How can you speak something so harsh!
You hurt me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOOK_008_56_8_19.text: No!!! Ugh! You’re driving me crazy!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}...
This is the champion of the century? So weak.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_03.text:
Pfff. Individual might is nothing
before the united power of friendship.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_04.text:
What... What are you saying?
You ganged up on us!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_05.text:
Ah, I thought ganging up is a tradition here
since every time I come here, I get to see that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_06.text: Um, a good point, but that is...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_07.text:
And we didn’t fight at the same time.
You brought a bunch of fighters to fight me.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_09.text:
Ha, {PLAYER_NAME} must have blinded you
with those crafty words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_1_10.text:
Let’s go back to the world of Chaotic Apocalypse Ent.
Right now!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_2_01.text:
N-no! I just got a part-time job here.
I am no longer the person you know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_2_02.text:
I don't want to see the walking troublemaker
who used to dream about conquering Hasla and stuff.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_2_05.text:
Ah... Mother. Your words hurt me.
I... I came too late.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_2_06.text:
{PLAYER_NAME} poisoned your mind
and you’re not yourself.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_2_07.text: You look awful now. I would rather...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_3_01.text: Okay... Hold on. What are you thinking?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_3_02.text:
Don't worry, mother.
Pain is flitting. You will feel nothing soon after.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_4_01.text: This is... This is my room?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_4_03.text:
Ugh... For how long should I be
harassed by that Ent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_4_04.text:
Well, I should check the rift again
after my work.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_5_02.text:
It’s all that bastard's fault!
It is my first day at work!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_6_01.text:
You think that was a dream, mother?
It will come true soon enough.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_END_6_02.text:
I am eager to free you from
that corrupt form of yours.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_1_02.text:
I feel enormous power on the other side of the rift.
The Chaotic Apocalypse Ent?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_1_03.text:
But… you’re a mere mortal like {PLAYER_NAME},
and you’re wielding such immense power...?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_1_04.text:
Petty mortals... You think we’d stay under
the shadows of our mother forever?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_01.text: Wow... Look at the size of that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_02.text:
... Our invasion force has always been
small but effective.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_03.text:
You may have thought you were smart.
That {PLAYER_NAME} is better than all of us.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_04.text:
One by one, my fellows were
sacrificed, but no more!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_05.text:
I will fight you!
This giant dimensional rift is the key.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_06.text:
Uh... Why does it sound familiar?
The...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_2_08.text:
Go tell {PLAYER_NAME}
that my army will come.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_3_01.text:
Long time no see, mother!
How have you been?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_3_02.text:
Today, I brought my son with me.
Come and say hi, Lionel.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_3_03.text:
Hello, Anesidora!
I heard a lot about you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_3_04.text:
I want to become like you,
Chaotic Apocalypse Ent!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_BOSSSOULRUSH_INTRO_3_07.text:
This makes me sick. How do you folks
manage to live in such peace?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_CHOCOLA_EVENT_HELP_2_09.text:
After selecting the ingredients comes the last step.
Take it out when it "sparkles" when baked golden brown!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_1_01.text: Okay, this side is pretty much done.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_1_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}! How's that side coming along?
Are the audience and Cano Band members okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_01.text:
They don’t show any signs of waking up.
Do you think they're dead?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_02.text: No signs of flowers blooming, so they should be fine.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_04.text: Now that we have some things under control...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_05.text:
I’m Caroline, this is Jeomrye and {PLAYER_NAME}.
You?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_06.text:
I’m Echo!
I was on a journey to find the Composer.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_07.text: The Composer... Do they use magics like the wizards in Pumpkin City?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_08.text:
Pump... Hehe. I’m not sure.
This Composer is amazing! He can stop the Rain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_09.text:
Stop the Rain?
I guess we don't know him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_10.text:
Well, different universes have different concepts.
What about you, tall guy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_11.text:
Ah! This is Deemo!
He’s a Guardian who's been traveling with me!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_13.text: Hmm, I guess he’s a man of few words.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_14.text:
Haha, you're right.
But I can read his mind.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_2_15.text:
Just like {PLAYER_NAME}.
Well... I guess they're more talkative than you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_01.text:
Well, we all have a lot of questions.
Can you tell us about this weird Rain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_02.text:
The Rain blooms flowers on the body and kills...
Does that sound about right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_03.text:
Yes, that’s right.
Do you guys not know what this Rain is?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_04.text:
What kind of rain is this?
It’s a chemical terrorism, something Neth would do.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_05.text:
I’ve never seen anything like this in any alternate Neths.
Toxic gas would be more convenient for mass destruction.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_06.text:
Well, making something like this wouldn’t be impossible.
But doing it so quickly and powerfully would be.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_08.text: The conclusion is, this phenomenon is not possible.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_09.text: It must have come from some other universe, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_10.text:
Yes... Probably.
Yes, it only makes sense that way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_11.text:
That explains the power from the Magic Bottle earlier.
We can't save this many people in our world like this…

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_12.text: On this side, the magical powers intensify.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_13.text: You guys must be from a universe without such a concept.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_14.text:
Hehe, you're right.
It would've been convenient to have that!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_15.text:
So, let’s recap how you guys ended up here.
You said something about a hole?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_16.text:
Deemo and I suddenly fell into a hole.
And then, I found myself falling from the sky...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_17.text:
And what is the name of the universe you're from?
Maybe I’ve heard about it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_18.text:
The name of our universe?
Mm... A train station?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_19.text: Let’s try this way then. You heard of Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_20.text:
No! 
Has Deemo heard of Hasla?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_23.text:
Okay, so just swept away I guess.
I’m sorry this happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_24.text: So other universes do exist, interesting.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_25.text:
Parallel universes do, so why not an alternate universe?
There are far more interesting things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_26.text:
Well, then.
So the weird Rainclouds don’t belong here?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_27.text: And playing the piano can stop the Rain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_28.text: Yes! That's right! That’s why Deemo keeps trying!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_29.text:
How can music affect the Rainclouds?
Is there a more intuitive alternative?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_30.text: Like you said, there are far more interesting things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_31.text: I mean, it goes against any scientific common sense.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_32.text: I don’t know. It’s just how we’ve always handled...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_33.text:
Whenever music plays, the Rain briefly stops.
I don’t know of any other way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_35.text: We have no choice but to rely on this information.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_3_36.text:
Yes, since you know more about the Rain than we do.
We can help.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_01.text:
The piano tunes don’t seem to be working as well.
The Rain isn’t stopping... What should we do?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_02.text:
If it’s the power of music that’s driving the Rain away,
why don’t we all play together?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_03.text:
The loudness of the music doesn’t matter.
Use your brain, will you?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_04.text:
But… there’s no other choice!
We can at least give it a try!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_05.text:
Echo! What do you say!?
That doesn't sound too bad, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_06.text: If the sound doesn’t come from the piano... I don’t know.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_08.text:
But it might be different in this universe.
Because the power of the Magic Bottle is huge!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_4_09.text:
Oh, yes! So let’s give it shot!
What do you think, {PLAYER_NAME}?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_01.text:
I guess it won’t hurt to try. Now we're talking!?
We can’t just sit here and not do anything!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_02.text: But our guitars are scattered over there in the Rain...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_03.text:
Caroline! I can count on you, right?
You can play that thing on your shoulder, right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_04.text:
This isn’t an instrument - it’s a sound wave generator.
All it can do is combine recorded tunes.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_05.text: Well, let’s try that much then!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_06.text:
We don’t have time to waste on things like this...
{PLAYER_NAME}, stop that hopeful look!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_07.text:
Please, I’m begging you!
Deemo won’t last long by himself!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_5_08.text:
I’d do anything to help him but...
I’m bad at playing, so I won’t be of much help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_1_6_01.text:
But, if we are gonna do it, we’re gonna do it right.
You, white skin! Let’s see if you got skills!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_01.text:
Ugh… My head…
What is this place...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_03.text:
What is that white monster.
Is that a secret weapon made by Hero Town fools?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_04.text:
Deemo is a Guardian.
He tried so hard to save you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_05.text:
What is a Guardian?
I guess some weird thing from another universe...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_06.text: Don’t pretend like you don't know. This is all you.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_07.text: Well, I don’t know about that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_09.text:
It was an accident.
I was breaking out of the prison in Neth.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_10.text:
Jailbreak!?
You must've done something awful.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_11.text: Sure. Quite a few, in fact.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_12.text: You are a criminal... I’m scared...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_13.text:
Okay, Levine.
Tell us exactly what happened.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_10_14.text: Why would I say anything to an enemy?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_11_01.text:
Oh, no! He’s going to die!
Deemo! Help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_12_02.text:
Don’t say that!
Every life is worth living!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_12_03.text:
Even if he's a criminal...
Who knows? Maybe someday he will become a better person!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_12_04.text:
I’m not interested in the philosophy of life.
Let’s just keep him alive so we can interrogate him.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_12_05.text: But, why don’t we tie him up this time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_01.text:
Ugh, what is this Rain anyway...?
I almost died...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_02.text:
Now do you realize what you've done?
This Rain could destroy all of Hasla.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_03.text:
Make everything back to normal again,
and go back to prison.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_04.text:
I said it was an accident!
There’s nothing I can do about this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_05.text:
At best, all I can do is 
make a portal to wherever those guys came from.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_06.text: Huh? So we can go back to our universe?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_07.text:
I can track the coordinates of your universe.
Easier than finding extraterrestrial intelligence.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_08.text:
Finding a small particle on a beach versus
finding Kind Alexander at Grancia Palace, you know?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_13_09.text: If you want, I could open up a portal and send you home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_01.text:
No, it’s fine.
I think I’ll stay here with Deemo for now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_02.text: You don’t have to feel obliged. It's his doing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_03.text:
But I still want to help.
I’ll go back after saving everyone.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_05.text: Hehe... Actually, there's more to it.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_06.text:
Back home, everyone’s suffering because of the Rain.
We are all waiting for the Rain to stop for good.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_07.text:
If we can stop it here,
then we can also stop it back at home.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_08.text: It’s enough that we can make it stop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_09.text:
So I want to stay until this is over...
Deemo, would that be okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_12.text: Are you sure that’s what he said?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_14_13.text:
We don’t need words to understand each other...
Our souls connect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_15_01.text:
That’s right, {PLAYER_NAME}
Levine is of no help, so there’s only one other way.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_15_02.text: Let’s all play together to stop the Rain!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_16_01.text: It’s even more non-scientific than a rain-calling ritual,

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_16_02.text: but, sometimes primitive ways work better.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_17_01.text: Deemo! I’ll play next to you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_17_03.text:
No worries! I learned it from the Station Master!
Let's play something simple!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_18_02.text: Only those who love music can join!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_18_03.text: Maybe you can use your head as a drum!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_1_01.text: Huh? The Rain seems to be slowing down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_1_02.text: Amazing. Playing together has a bigger effect!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_2_01.text:
Ah! Don’t overdo it!
The Rain is still dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_2_02.text: So we still can’t move even if the Rain dies down.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_2_04.text:
Not really! Now we know it works!
There must be another way!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_2_05.text: Pfft! If only I could get my hands on that guitar...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_2_06.text: Echo! Can I take this shield to go grab my guitar?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_2_07.text: No... Then the people who have fainted will vanish.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_3_01.text:
Will you go unconscious when you are touched by the Rain?
No, but... it’s still dangerous!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_3_02.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, What do you think you are doing?
Please don’t do anything stupid, okay?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_4_02.text:
Deemo! Keep playing the piano!
Hold the Rain for just a little longer!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_5_01.text:
Are you all right!?
Are you hurt?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_02.text:
T-This! Music’s supposed to be the remedy, right?
Well then, let’s use the guitar...!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_03.text:
...Jeez!
I can’t play because of all these flowers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_04.text:
The piano tunes will make the flowers to vanish!
I’ll restore your stuff back with piano music!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_05.text: Deemo! Can you play one more time?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_07.text: Caroline! We can use your help!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_6_08.text:
Don’t order me around!
I was getting ready!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_01.text: I think he’s awake! He's fine!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_02.text:
Jeez... We were so worried!
Running into danger like that?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_03.text: What’s all the fuss about? He’s stronger than you think.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_04.text:
But you tried so hard to save him?
Just admit you were worried.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_05.text: W-Well... I just give my everything when I play music!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_06.text: You don’t have to be so shy...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_7_07.text:
{PLAYER_NAME}, are you okay? How are you feeling?
Can you move?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_8_01.text:
Alright!
Well, now that we have our weapon. Shall we?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_9_01.text:
Wait... Hold on.
Someone else woke up when we were playing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_2_9_03.text:
No, we will.
It’s a bit dangerous.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_01.text:
Oh, this is good!
The Rain clearly eased up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_02.text:
So we’ve just proven that 
louder music makes the Rain stop.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_04.text:
Deemo? What do you think?
Did I get better or what?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_1_06.text:
Haha... I guess I still have a long way to go.
I’ll practice more when we get back.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_2_01.text:
Hold on.
Someone woke up while we were playing.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_2_03.text:
The flowers go away when we play.
The life, stuff... everything returns to normal.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_01.text:
I see.
So this is where the HMF stage was earlier?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_02.text:
And everyone in the audience has passed out.
That sounds serious...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_03.text:
Did he ruin things again?
What do you have against HMF?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_04.text:
It was an accident.
This isn’t what I planned.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_05.text:
By the way, what is that white thing?
Is it a... human? A ghost?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_06.text:
Haha... Everyone asks.
I'm Echo and this is Deemo, a Guardian.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_09.text:
Meri! Look! He doesn’t have a mouth!
Don’t be so disrespectful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_10.text:
Oh, I-I didn’t notice!
I’m sorry Cano!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_3_14.text: Mmm, I doubt Deemo would mind. Probably.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_01.text:
So, to recap,
Levine did something and made this mess.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_02.text:
The Rain blooms flowers and kills.
And the only way to stop all that is to play music?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_04.text: That pretty much sums up my entire day.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_05.text:
But we are saving people that way, right?
If you have any other suggestions, be my guest.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_06.text:
Why don’t we just get rid of the rain clouds?
You two over there, any suggestions?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_08.text:
I mean,
we don’t have any device here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_09.text:
If that fool operated the teleporter to cause mess,
then why don’t we do the same thing?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_4_10.text:
It was an accident.
And no scientific solution to this problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_5_02.text: So we have no other choice!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_01.text:
Just enjoy the music and the stage!
Everyone, let’s give it our best!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_03.text: How can you even enjoy this situation?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_04.text:
I know we have an urgent problem.
But worrying won’t solve the problem.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_05.text:
So if we are going to do this, let’s at least have fun!
That’s what HMF’s supposed to be - loud and fun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_06.text:
Yes, that’s right!
I agree with what Cano said!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_6_07.text:
I was about to get sick and tired of sitting as a judge!
As long as I have Cano with me, I’m good!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_02.text:
Are you tired already?
It’s fine. Go sit over there. We have enough people.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_03.text: Do you think I’m going to...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_04.text:
fall for that?
Okay, fine! Let’s do this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_05.text:
I always admire
how you don’t overthink things.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_06.text:
Guitars, you good?
Deemo! Will you be fine without a music score?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_08.text: Uh... Is it too much to ask?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_09.text:
No worries!
He’s been doing it without any sheet music!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_7_10.text:
Deemo's great at piano!
You can trust him on this!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_02.text:
Deemo...
Everyone seems to be happy here.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_03.text:
They’re not discouraged by the danger.
Everyone came together to get through this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_04.text: Could our world be like this if it weren’t for the Rain?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_07.text:
We are going to find the Composer who will stop the Rain.
And one day, we’ll all play together like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_8_08.text:
So, let’s give this performance our best!
Let’s go back home full of hope!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_3_9_02.text: Maybe I could use those two naive idiots...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_10_02.text:
Well, the Hasla Music Festival finally beings!
Everyone, let’s have fun!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_03.text: Deemo! The Rain stopped completely! We can stop playing!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_04.text:
Cano! Look beneath you!
The audience - they're waking up!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_05.text: Whew... I was worried they were all going to die...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_1_06.text:
Let’s go help them before they panic!
{PLAYER_NAME}! Will you lend a hand?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_01.text:
Uh... So you are saying
this is where HMF was being held?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_02.text:
Levine’s commotion knocked everyone unconscious.
The two from another world saved us. Right?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_04.text:
Oh, wow!
You two are truly brave heroes! We are grateful!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_05.text: No, it wasn’t just the two of us...

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_06.text:
Shush! Quiet!
We could always use a new hero.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_07.text:
Cano...
She captivates the audience with that innocent face.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_08.text: I know all he wants to do is just get those two involved.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_10.text:
Well, they weren’t all lies!
Without you, we would've been buried in flowers!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_12.text:
It’s just a little cheering up - no pressure.
Just enjoy this moment.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_14.text:
Everyone! Now that we are all awake,
we don’t have anything else to worry about!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_2_15.text: But make sure you all go see your doctor!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_01.text:
Hahahaha!
We don’t have anything else to worry about?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_02.text:
Oh, right.
We still have that to take care of.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_03.text: Tied up but still high-spirited as ever.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_04.text:
No, I’m not the problem.
Do you guys not get it?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_3_05.text:
The Rain?
Can’t you see it’s starting to rain again?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_01.text:
You... You're right.
It’s starting to rain again.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_02.text: Isn’t it dangerous to get rained on?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_03.text:
What?! What’s happening!?
I thought it was all over.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_04.text:
The Rain only stops for a little while.
It will rain again as long as the Rainclouds exist.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_06.text:
W-What is this?!
Am I going to pass out like earlier!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_4_07.text:
We need to run!
We are all going to die otherwise!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_01.text:
You're safe as long as you're under this shield!
I’ll protect you!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_02.text:
But not for long!
Is there another way?!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_03.text:
Stay calm, Yuna.
Cano and I are fearless together. Nothing to worry.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_04.text: Do you think Cano is some god!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_05.text:
Okay, the situation may seem hopeless...
The Rain briefly stopped, nothing more than that.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_07.text:
But the Rainclouds aren't that big at the moment.
Now that everyone’s awake, we can escape now.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_08.text:
Um... that’s going to be difficult.
We don’t know how much longer we can last like this.

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_09.text: Should we beat up Levine to open the portal?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_10.text:
What should we do...
Are we all going to die for real this time!?

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_11.text: No! I don’t want to die here!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_12.text:
E-Everyone, stay calm!
We’re not going to die!

TEXT_DIALOGUES_DM2_4_5_13.text: But it doesn’t look like we have a choice!
