I never considered carrots to be delicious before.
Why am I craving one so badly now?

TEXT_TALK_015_1_D018.text:
Not only raw carrots. I want to drink
carrot juice and even cake! I want them all!

TEXT_TALK_015_1_D019.text:
Have you ever experienced something similar?
Where you get this huge craving for certain food?

TEXT_TALK_015_1_D021.text:
But even those who don’t like spicy food,
sometimes crave it. Maybe it’s something like that.

TEXT_TALK_015_1_D023.text: Give it some time. The cravings might disappear.

TEXT_TALK_015_1_D024.text: And don’t take it too seriously.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D004.text: ...Is it perhaps about your cravings for carrots?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D005.text:
Well, that is still a problem,
but I got a bigger one to deal with now.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D007.text: Have you ever feared water before?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D009.text: It’s a serious question, so give me a serious answer!

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D011.text:
Being scared of water is a serious problem.
You need to drink water to survive after all.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D013.text: Well, the problem is, I’m scared of water right now.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D015.text: When it’s raining, I don’t want to go outside!

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D016.text: Me too. I don’t like leaving the house when it’s raining.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D018.text: It felt really weird when it rained recently.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D019.text: I started shaking at the sight of rain!

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D020.text: I even hid under my blanket!

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D021.text: It rained pretty hard recently, right?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D022.text: It was a loud thunderstorm. It’s normal to be scared.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D025.text: Being scared of thunder or the dark is normal.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D026.text:
Everyone has something they’re scared of.
As we age and become adults, we overcome those fears.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D029.text: You sounded like a lecturing old man there.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D031.text: Being scared of something is all in your head.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D032.text: Steel your heart and mind, and it’ll be fine.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D033.text: Do you really think it’ll be okay?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D034.text: Why are you so concerned about it?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D035.text:
Did you know?
Rabbits instinctively avoid water.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D036.text:
And recently, I was madly craving carrots...
I’m sure there’s a connection.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D038.text: But I guess I don’t know what you’re exactly feeling.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D039.text: Do you not have anyone close you can talk to?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D040.text: Hmm... I’ll try asking professor Estelle.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D041.text: She’s a professor at your college, right?

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D042.text:
Yeah. When we talk, she gives me even more assignments,
so I tend to avoid her.

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D043.text: But I guess I have no choice but to rely on her guidance!

TEXT_TALK_015_2_D044.text:
That seems like a good idea.
Talk about it with her.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D002.text:
I’m doing well.
Have you talked to Estelle?

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D003.text:
Yeah.
We had a long conversation.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D004.text:
We couldn’t solve the problem...
but we found the cause.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D007.text: That’s right. The ‘thing’ inside this flame is the problem.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D008.text: You know that there is a flame on my head right?

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D009.text:
It harbors the spirit of the Rabbit King.
I was born with it.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D010.text: I was made fun of as a kid because of it!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D011.text: The reason I entered college was to get rid of it...

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D012.text:
I always thought it looked good on you.
I didn’t think you saw it as a problem.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D013.text: I started to consider it a part of me...

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D014.text: It wasn’t a complete nuisance to me.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D015.text:
Because of it, I ended up studying a lot
and got accepted into a university in Pumpkin City.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D016.text: And just as I accepted it as a part of me...!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D017.text:
I began fearing water and craving carrots!
It’s all because of the Rabbit King!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D018.text: Why do you think it’s so suddenly acting up?

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D019.text:
I don’t think it was something sudden!
I think... it was waiting for the perfect moment.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D020.text: I think I read it on a research paper before.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D021.text: Devrans. A being that produces demons.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D022.text: Devrans infest the minds of Haslans and turn them to demons!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D023.text: This fat rabbit inside me must also be a Devran!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D024.text:
I used to think it was cute!
It was just tricking me to take control of my body!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D026.text: If only I could somehow communicate with it...!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D027.text:
I studied and researched,
but I never found a way.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D028.text:
Now that I think about it... I started eating a lot more.
I’m always looking for a snack.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D029.text: I also run out of breath more often when I run!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D031.text: No I don’t! It’s all because of the rabbit!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D032.text: You fat rabbit! Get out of my body!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D033.text: I think you’re putting way too much blame on the rabbit.

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D034.text:
I’m not blaming it!
At this rate, it’s going to consume me!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D035.text:
You watch!
I won’t let it have its way!

TEXT_TALK_015_3_D036.text: What are you going to do?

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D002.text: You haven’t texted me for a while. Is everything okay?

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D007.text: I’m so tired that I can barely send a text.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D013.text: I’m having a mental war against it.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D016.text: If it’s persuading me to eat carrots...

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D017.text: I can retaliate by not eating them!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D021.text: What are you talking about?! This fight is brutal!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D022.text: I’m not moving to save calories, so I don’t get hungry!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D023.text: Okay, I think you’re going insane.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D024.text: I’m fine! I will win this war!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D026.text:
This is a fight to the death!
I have to do my best!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D027.text:
I don’t have the luxury to sit around!
This is the only way to defeat the rabbit!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D028.text: Although I’m tired and only thinking about carrots!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D029.text: I don’t want to be dominated by the rabbit...!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D030.text: I know where you’re coming from,

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D031.text:
But I can tell that you’re exhausted.
Don’t push yourself too hard.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D032.text: I don’t really have a choice...

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D034.text: I ended up accepting it as a part of me.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D035.text: I always looked for ways to remove the flame on my head.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D036.text: I wanted to be a normal girl, just like everyone else.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D037.text:
I always thought
that you and the rabbit were inseparable.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D038.text: You were born with it. You must’ve had a hard life.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D039.text: I, too, began to believe I couldn’t get rid of it.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D040.text:
I actually used the rabbit’s powers to help others.
I tried seeing it positively.

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D041.text: But if its mana tries to consume me...

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D042.text: If it tries to infest my mind like the Devrans...!

TEXT_TALK_015_4_D043.text:
My life depends on it!
It’ll be my very first and last chance!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D002.text: Carrot Carrot Carrot Carrot Carrot Carrot Carrot.

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D004.text: Carrot Hill. Carrot Sun. Carrot-shaped carrot.

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D005.text: Yichui... in the end, you lost, eh?

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D006.text:
No! I didn’t lose!
I haven’t lost the war!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D007.text: The rabbit spirit is the one that’s losing!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D008.text: A shining victory is close at hand!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D009.text:
Get to your senses.
You keep speaking nonsense.

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D010.text:
I okay!
I feel so normal I think I can fly!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D011.text: Uhm... I don’t think that’s a normal feeling.

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D012.text:
Where are you? I’ll head over to you.
You seem like you need help... badly.

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D013.text:
I don’t need your help!
I’m going to defeat this rabbit soon!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D014.text: No... that’s not what I meant...

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D016.text: Oh?! You want to see my victory in person?!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D017.text:
I see!
Let’s enjoy my victory together!

TEXT_TALK_015_5_D018.text: I’m at the Pumpkin City University! Hurry and come!

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D001.text: Captain. I have something I need to talk about.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D003.text: Has something gone wrong at the orphanage?

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D006.text: This is a major issue, right?

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D007.text: Stop saying that and hear me out.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D008.text: This is a bit embarrassing, but I’ve never dated anyone.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D009.text: My faith was all I cared about. I neglected my feelings.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D012.text: Everyone around me has a lover...!

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D013.text: Calm down. You will eventually meet a partner.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D015.text: How long do I have to wait?!

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D016.text: I have strong faith in the goddesses.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D017.text: But I don't have faith that I’ll ever find someone!

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D018.text: Why are you suddenly acting like this?

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D019.text: You used to never care about stuff like this.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D021.text: I’ll struggle to find a date due to the nature of my job.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D022.text: Once I’m in my thirties, she said I’ll be hopeless.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D024.text: Age has no influence on love.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D025.text: You do have a point, but it’ll still affect my chances.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D026.text: Especially since I have zero experience in dating.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D027.text: You’re afraid of not knowing what to do when the time comes.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D028.text: I always made excuses and avoided relationships.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D029.text: Now, I think I have to look for one before it's too late.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D030.text: If there’s an advice I can give you...

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D032.text: Uriel. It has to be Uriel.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D033.text: Uriel takes really good care of me as my superior.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D035.text: Uriel and I were destined partners.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D036.text: No Thehyss, you don’t know how he feels about you.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D037.text: For a while, I considered Uriel to be my eternal partner.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D038.text:
But he is my superior.
So I couldn't approach him as a woman.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D040.text: You’re right. There’s someone that he has a crush on.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D044.text: But I don't want to give up.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D045.text: You told me I shouldn’t give up, even if he isn’t single.

TEXT_TALK_016_1_D047.text:
Thank you captain.
Thanks to you, I realized my feelings.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D002.text: Is there anything you can tell me about Uriel?

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D004.text: I understand. He never really talks about himself.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D005.text: That’s something I did not want to hear.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D006.text: ...Do you think he’s too obsessed with Victoria?

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D009.text: Why don’t you just confess your love to him?

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D010.text: What if he refuses me? My life will be over!

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D011.text: Uriel is my leader and caretaker.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D012.text: I don't want to act rashly.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D013.text: You are more careful than I imagined.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D015.text: You are close with a lot of people.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D016.text: You converse with people of different beliefs and race.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D017.text:
For someone like you...
You must have a lot of dating experience.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D021.text:
You must be too shy to admit it... hehe.
You are still young, so I understand.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D024.text: Then what you’re saying is true?

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D025.text: That means you’re just as inexperienced as I am.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D027.text: I guess I have no choice but to think this through alone.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D029.text: No need to apologize. I’m sorry for taking your time.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D030.text: So you don't need my help anymore?

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D031.text:
You personally know Uriel.
You will still be of great help.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D032.text:
And I feel a sense of kinship from you now.
I look forward to your help!

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D033.text: Kinship...? I guess that's better than nothing.

TEXT_TALK_016_2_D034.text: Okay then! Talk to you later!

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D003.text:
I haven't confessed yet...
But I have a bigger problem!

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D004.text:
I’m still thinking about it...
But I have a bigger problem!

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D005.text:
Have you seen kids carrying swords and guns
at Hero Town?

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D008.text: I’m worried. I woke up and found them missing.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D011.text:
Yes. The kids were raised to defend themselves.
They’re trained to be powerful fighters.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D012.text:
The world is grim and dangerous.
The kids have to know how to defend themselves.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D013.text: How are the other kids at the orphanage?

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D014.text: Wouldn’t they be worried? Their friends are missing.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D016.text:
They say they don’t know anything.
Kids don’t know how serious this is.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D017.text: Were the kids not getting along?

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D019.text: Even just yesterday, everyone seemed fine.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D020.text: Today, even when some of them went missing, no one cared.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D021.text: I don’t understand what they’re thinking.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D026.text: Is anyone hurt? Are they alright?

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D027.text: Everyone is OK. But I still have to scold them.

TEXT_TALK_016_3_D029.text: You are more concerned about other people than the kids?

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D002.text: Something came up, so I had to go.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D005.text: Whenever you visit, I’ll treat you to delicious food.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D008.text:
My birthday was coming up.
The kids were preparing a surprise party.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D009.text:
They kept it hidden from me.
That’s why they left the orphanage in secret.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D010.text: Oh, your birthday was coming up?

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D011.text: If I had known, I would’ve bought you a gift.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D012.text: It’s okay. Even I forgot about it.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D013.text:
As an inquisitor in the Order of the Goddess, I stopped
caring about those things.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D014.text: But how did the kids find out about your birthday?

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D015.text: They broke into the headquarters and stole the info.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D016.text: Okay, you REALLY need to scold them for that.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D017.text:
I did.
But they’re still kids.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D018.text:
When they said they did it for me, I couldn’t scold them.
They didn’t have any ill intentions.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D020.text: No one ever went that far for me.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D022.text: Not yet. I think they’re still preparing in secret.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D023.text: Yes, I feel a lot better.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D024.text:
Seeing these kids care for me...
Maybe I was overreacting, just as you said.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D025.text: I don’t have to get married to live a happy life.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D026.text: There we go. Don’t think too much about it.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D027.text: I’ve been thinking of marriage for a long time.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D028.text: The only man I considered a partner was Sir Uriel.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D029.text: But I know that he idolizes Victoria.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D031.text: I didn’t feel any emotion. It felt “normal.”

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D032.text: So then I came to the realization...

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D033.text: I don’t think it was ‘love’ that I felt about him.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D034.text:
Perhaps it was pure respect.
I just wanted to rely on someone I respected.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D035.text: Are your emotions in order now?

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D036.text:
Of course. I was never alone to begin with.
The kids are always by my side.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D037.text: My feelings toward Uriel was just respect.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D038.text: But... if Uriel gives up on Victoria... I’d be happy!

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D041.text: Giving up on Uriel, I feel more at ease now.

TEXT_TALK_016_4_D042.text: Oh, it’s time for the kids to take their nap.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D003.text: Remember when I told you the kids were preparing a party?

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D004.text: They said they wanted to keep it a secret...

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D005.text:
Something didn’t feel right, so I investigated.
They’re preparing an ambush against Victoria!

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D007.text: I think their “birthday gift” to me was Uriel...

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D008.text: So they wanted to get rid of the interference.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D009.text:
I guess this is what happens when immature kids
are granted power.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D011.text: Of course Victoria would never lose to these kids.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D012.text: But if they did attack Victoria...

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D013.text: The orphanage - myself included - would’ve been banished.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D014.text: The Order or Grancia would never severely punish minors.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D015.text: But the kids and I would’ve gotten separated.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D016.text: You called off their ambush, right?

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D017.text:
I did. But they’re still adamant
in going through with their plan.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D018.text: The kids were preparing the gift for me.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D019.text: So seeing me telling them to stop must’ve confused them.

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D020.text: Is there something I can help you with?

TEXT_TALK_016_5_D021.text:
I have a plan.
Can you come to the orphanage?

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D002.text: Do I not seem like an ordinary person?

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D003.text: You seem like a normal person to me.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D005.text: People always assume that I’m a werewolf.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D006.text: Whenever I’m traveling, I can sense people staring at me.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D007.text: Well, your ears and tails ought to garner attention.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D008.text: It’s not every day you get to see a werewolf.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D010.text: I wonder if those people feel scared from seeing me.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D011.text: I want to say that you’re overthinking it...

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D012.text: But, maybe, children could be scared of wolves.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D013.text: And their parents might avoid you for that.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D014.text: But I never attack or bite people.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D015.text: My beastly instincts are sealed away with these chains.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D017.text: Do you think there’s a solution for this problem?

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D018.text: Maybe a way to make myself less scary looking?

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D020.text: I can’t just do as I want.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D021.text: How can I not pay attention to what people think?

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D022.text: If I could do that, I wouldn’t have brought it up!

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D023.text: You’re right. This is quite difficult.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D024.text: How about wearing a sign around your neck? “I don’t bite”

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D027.text: Thanks! That sounds like a great plan.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D028.text: I knew I could rely on you.

TEXT_TALK_017_1_D030.text: I was just kidding! Don’t take me seriously.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D003.text: Thanks to your advice, I got closer with the villagers.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D004.text: I wore the “I don’t bite” sign around my neck.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D006.text: What do you mean did I really do it?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D009.text: The kids that were avoiding me started approaching me!

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D010.text: They asked me if I really don’t bite.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D011.text: ...They are treating you like a scary dog.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D012.text: Before I knew it, all the kids were playing with me.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D013.text: They surrounded me and touched my ears and tail!

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D014.text: We raced around the village and played.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D016.text: You didn’t leave them in the dust, right?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D017.text: Yeah, I lost to them on purpose.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D018.text:
Good.
Don’t be too serious around kids.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D019.text: But as I played with them, the adults came to me.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D020.text: They thanked me for playing with the kids.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D021.text: They were intrigued that I was a werewolf.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D022.text: They told me to come by the village again.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D023.text:
I’m so happy right now.
It’s all thanks to you.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D024.text: I shouldn’t take credit. You were a good sport.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D025.text: So... what should I do next?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D026.text: Should I hunt and bring them food?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D027.text: Should I get rid of the dangerous animals nearby?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D028.text: I want to do something for them... but what?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D029.text: Do what you think is best, and don’t rush it.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D030.text:
Okay.
Then I’m going to visit the village again and play.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D031.text: Are you going to race again?

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D032.text:
Yeah.
I also really enjoyed playing fetch with a bone.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D033.text: It seems like the kids are seeing you more like a dog...

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D034.text: When it’s my turn to throw, I tossed the bone lightly.

TEXT_TALK_017_2_D035.text:
Oh, so you throw too?
Okay then, there’s no problem.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D007.text:
She used to be a member of the Elite Four.
You can’t just accidentally “hurt” her.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D008.text: There’s a reason. Let me explain.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D009.text: I was walking through the forest.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D010.text: Then, I felt someone’s presence behind me on a tree.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D011.text: I attacked and destroyed that tree.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D012.text: And... Charlotte was resting atop that tree.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D013.text:
Fortunately, she only sprained her ankles.
Is that her only injury?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D015.text: Keep an eye on her, just in case.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D016.text:
Make sure her arms and legs are completely unhurt.
You never know with this kind of stuff.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D017.text: She said falling from a tree can’t hurt her.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D018.text:
She said she only sprained her ankles because she was
feeling cold, which led to her sloppy landing.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D020.text: But anyways, why was she stalking you in the first place?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D021.text: Couldn’t she have just approached you normally?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D022.text: She said she has the flu.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D023.text: I think she didn’t want to pass it on to me.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D024.text:
Is that why she was stalking you?
Err... was that an act of kindness?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D025.text: If I say it is, it is.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D026.text: I’m very happy that she came to see me.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D027.text:
I suppose so.
If she had the flu, she should’ve stayed home.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D028.text: Idols don’t have a lot of free time.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D029.text: So she really wanted to come, even if she was sick.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D031.text: I think she is getting dizzy because of her flu.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D032.text: And now she even has a sprained ankle.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D033.text: She’s resting up at the village that I befriended.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D034.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D035.text: Right now, there’s only me and Charlotte here.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D036.text: So I have to nurse her, but I don’t know what to do.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D039.text: But I ended up burning it all.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D041.text: Okay, that sounds dangerous. Stay away from the kitchen.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D044.text: I want to do something... what should I do?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D046.text: I tried, but Charlotte just laughed, so I gave up.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D047.text: So hot... she’s like a furnace!

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D049.text: Put a wet towel on her forehead to cool her down.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D051.text: She angrily said, “are you trying to drown me?”

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D052.text: You have to squeeze the towel first.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D053.text: Oh, so you don’t just throw the soaking towel on her?

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D054.text: I’ve never nursed someone before, so I didn’t know.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D055.text: She asked me if there’s medicine.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D057.text: I’m not sure. I will have to look around.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D058.text: If there isn’t one nearby, I can try the next village.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D059.text: I will search the entire continent if I have to.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D060.text: My powers as a werewolf will come in handy for this.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D061.text: If you can’t find any medicine, come to me.

TEXT_TALK_017_3_D062.text: There ought to be a hero here who is good with medicine.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D001.text: I think her flu is getting better.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D003.text: Glad to hear that. I guess you found some medicine.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D004.text: Yeah, there was a pharmacist in the village.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D005.text: Charlotte took some medicine and took a long nap.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D007.text: She recovered from the flu, but her leg’s still not healed.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D008.text: She can’t perform on stage like this.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D009.text: If she has the flu, she should really rest at home...

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D010.text: I’m the one that hurt her.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D011.text: I feel guilty seeing her hurt, unable to move.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D012.text: And I can’t magically fix her leg with medicine.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D014.text: You can’t force her up on stage with a sprained ankle.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D015.text: I’m sure her fans wouldn’t like that either.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D016.text: But she doesn’t want to disappoint her fans.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D017.text: She said they were waiting for her for a long time.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D018.text: Seems problematic... a sprain takes time to heal...

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D019.text: What if you take her place and perform on stage for her?

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D023.text: I think that’s a great idea. Let me talk to her.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D024.text: Charlotte loved the idea. She even called me a genius!

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D026.text: Before I perform, I have to wear an idol outfit.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D027.text: I’ll send you some photos, can you see if I look good?

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D030.text: The miniskirt seems way too short.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D031.text: I’m getting nervous to wear this in front of a crowd.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D032.text: You do look good in it. Can you do it?

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D036.text: Now that I think about it, I think this is a bad idea.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D038.text:
You should ask Charlotte.
Ask her if she can postpone the concert.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D039.text: I did. She said she can’t.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D041.text: She said she can postpone the concert any time.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D042.text: She just lied to me to get me to wear this outfit.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D044.text: As soon as she gets better, I’m gonna beat her.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D045.text: From what you told me, she did act strangely...

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D046.text:
I guess the concert isn’t a problem for you anymore.
Don’t worry about it.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D048.text: But I still did hurt Charlotte.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D049.text: I want to find a way to help her heal.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D050.text: She’s the one that snuck up behind you.

TEXT_TALK_017_4_D051.text: Don’t beat yourself for it. Let me know if you need help.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D001.text: Another day, and Charlotte’s legs haven’t healed.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D002.text:
Her legs have gotten bright red.
It looks painful.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D003.text:
Unless there’s a way to magically fix her leg,
only time can heal her.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D005.text: To a wolf, a minor injury like this is nothing.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D007.text: If she transforms into her beast form, will her leg heal?

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D008.text: Yeah, but it’ll be difficult right now.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D009.text: You can only transform during a full moon

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D012.text: If only there was a way to force the transformation...

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D013.text: Now that you mention it, Fenrir.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D014.text: Faust gave you those chains to suppress your rage, right?

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D015.text: Yeah, thanks to Faust, I’m able to live alongside humans.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D016.text: Maybe... he has something similar with opposite effects?

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D019.text: But he might actually have something for Charlotte.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D020.text: Captain, can you talk to Faust for me?

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D021.text:
He’s here, actually.
He’s getting ready to leave somewhere.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D022.text: Let me stop him and ask him for his help.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D023.text: I’ll come find you after I talk to Faust.

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D025.text:
I want to see Faust in person...
But I have to nurse my friend!

TEXT_TALK_017_5_D026.text: I’ll ask him if he can come along.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D001.text:
Knock Knock.
Did you get my message?

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D002.text:
Yeah.
I didn’t expect to get an Oztalk from you, Sfera.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D003.text:
Mmhm.
It feels weird talking to you like this.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D004.text: Why not think of it as a... form of letter?

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D005.text: This is really different from sending a letter.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D006.text: You can take your time to write a long letter.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D007.text: But as for Oztalk, you talk in real-time.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D008.text:
You can’t see the other person’s facial expression.
So it’s easy to offend someone through this.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D009.text: I understand where you’re coming from.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D010.text: But it also has its advantages.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D012.text: Oh wow, how convenient. I can send photos of my travels.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D013.text: You’re right! This is an awesome feature for traveling.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D014.text: Sharing my traveling experience with others sounds great.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D015.text: But... you’re the only one I can do that with.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D016.text: You must really enjoy traveling now.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D017.text: You started traveling because of your sister, right?

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D018.text:
Mhm.
Echidna left home because of some strange masked man.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D019.text: My job was bringing her back whenever she left home.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D020.text: But because of that, I’m now experiencing the world.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D022.text: No, I’ll never thank that man. He’s a bad influence.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D023.text: I don’t think so, Echidna just lived her life as she saw fit.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D024.text:
But he did teach us that the world is a big place.
So I won’t resent him for it.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D025.text:
Oh, sorry.
My sister is asking me to come.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D026.text:
It’s fine. You can always talk to me through Oztalk.
Go to your sister.

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D027.text:
Okay.
So... how do you end conversations with this?

TEXT_TALK_018_1_D029.text: It’s common etiquette to type ‘YAH!’ when ending a convo.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D001.text: Captain! The desserts at Ness Cafe are so pretty!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D002.text: You’re at Ness? You really ARE traveling, huh?

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D003.text: My sister is taking me all over the place.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D004.text: But these desserts are so pretty...

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D005.text: They’re huge and decorated with strawberries!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D006.text: I want to eat it so badly! Do you know how I feel?

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D007.text: You’re not very good with words. But I see you’re happy.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D008.text: The whip cream is shaped like a large turd!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D009.text: You shouldn’t describe food with... turd, Sfera.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D010.text: Sorry! I just spoke what’s on my mind.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D011.text:
You can directly send photos with Oztalk.
Why not try it?

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D014.text: Okay, did you get the photo?

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D015.text:
Yeah.
And...you’re right. It does look like a turd.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D016.text: It’s really sweet! Really, really sweet!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D017.text:
It’s like a ball of sweet temptation!
This really fits the description of being a demon!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D019.text: Sshh! Don’t say things like that!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D020.text: Why don’t we have cafes like this near our castle?

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D021.text: I’m going to try all the desserts today.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D022.text: So you didn’t message me for a specific reason?

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D023.text: Yeah! I just wanted to share my happiness with you!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D026.text: Sharing is caring! Happiness is doubled when shared!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D027.text: Captain, I’ll buy and keep a dessert for you!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D028.text:
Anyways, I’m going to browse more desserts!
Have a good day!

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D031.text:
By the way...
The whole ‘YAH!’ thing was a lie...

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D032.text: I said that to Echidna and she made fun of me.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D033.text:
Sorry.
I said it as a joke. I didn’t think you’d believe me.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D034.text: But still, I don’t know how to end a convo without it.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D035.text: So in a way, it was actually a good idea.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D036.text: Then let’s keep it a code for just between us.

TEXT_TALK_018_2_D037.text: Okay! Let’s continue to use ‘YAH!’ then.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D001.text:
Did something happen between you and your sister?
Your status message mentioned your sister...

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D003.text:
I can tolerate most things my sister does.
But I can’t let it slide this time.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D005.text:
When the waiter brought our food at a restaurant...
Echidna poured sauce all over it without asking!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D007.text: You think that’s bad, too, right?!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D008.text: Do you really not see the problem here?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D009.text:
It’s not proper etiquette to do that without asking!
The food might get soggy!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D010.text: You can at least pour just a little bit...

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D011.text:
I suppose she wasn’t being considerate.
Did you guys fight?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D012.text: Yeah, Echidna got upset and left.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D013.text:
Echidna is a nice girl.
But she isn’t very thoughtful.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D014.text:
She’s usually an obedient girl,
but at times, she can be so stubborn!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D015.text: The reason you’re out traveling is because of her, too.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D017.text:
So this time, I’m going to show her that I’m really mad!
I’m not going to let this slide!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D018.text: What are you going to do?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D019.text: When we get home, I’m going to feed her ONLY vegetables!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D020.text: So you’re still going to cook for her?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D022.text: I’m not sure if that’ll be effective...

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D023.text:
Oh, and by the way,
are you heading back home?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D024.text:
Yeah, our house has been unoccupied for too long.
I bet our mailbox is overflowing right now.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D025.text:
Traveling is fun, but we have to return once in a while.
I talked about this with Echidna, too.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D026.text: So when are you heading home?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D027.text: After we reach the Eastern Kingdoms.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D028.text:
But... if Echidna doesn’t get back quick,
our return home might be delayed.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D029.text: Where did she head off to?

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D030.text:
My sister has a severe case of itchy feet...
Who knows, she might’ve already crossed the border!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D034.text:
But the world is very dangerous.
I bet there are robbers waiting to rob us!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D035.text:
I don’t think there’s a robber
that can defeat Echidna...

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D036.text: Who knows! The robber might be extremely skilled!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D037.text: Someone that strong will never amount to being a robber.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D038.text: Ugh... maybe I shouldn’t have been so hard on her...

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D039.text: If Echidna gets hurt, I’ll be super sad...

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D041.text:
If you’re that worried, you should go look for her.
Make up with her.

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D043.text: Thank you so much! I’ll get going now. YAH!

TEXT_TALK_018_3_D044.text: You wanted to make up with her from the start...

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D001.text: I’m sorry for leaving so abruptly last time.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D002.text: I was in such a hurry at the time...!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D003.text: It’s okay. You did say YAH!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D004.text: More importantly, did you find and apologize to Echidna?

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D006.text:
I don’t think Echidna even cared. But it doesn’t
matter now, I’m not angry at her anymore.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D007.text: Both of you are still like I remember.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D008.text: After we made up, we’re traveling the Eastern Kingdoms!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D009.text: Our last stop today is Han!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D010.text: The Eastern Kingdom have interesting culture. How is it?

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D011.text:
You’re right!
The three nations seem so similar yet different!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D012.text:
They have great food and attractions!
There’s so much to see!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D013.text: They’re all the same human, yet they’re so different!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D014.text:
Of course.
No two humans are the same after all.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D016.text:
Humans are humans. Demons are demons.
I used to be so shallow!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D017.text: I considered all humans rude... they discriminated demons.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D018.text: When we were kids, humans despised us.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D019.text: Those that discriminate are bad, indeed.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D020.text:
There are good demons as there are bad demons.
The same thing applies to humans, too.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D021.text: I didn’t know that until I saw it with my very own eyes.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D022.text:
I just locked myself up at the castle.
I closed my eyes to the world.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D023.text: I’m gonna have to thank Echidna.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D024.text:
I can’t say that though.
If I do, Echidna might get a little too excited.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D026.text:
Besides... I can’t just thank her randomly, right?
I will when I get the chance.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D027.text: I’ll serve her sausages tonight. Her favorite.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D028.text:
Yeah, do that.
It’s great seeing you two get along.

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D030.text:
Oh, I’m heading out now!
Echidna is calling me again!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D031.text:
Back to my travels!
I’ll talk to you later! YAH!

TEXT_TALK_018_4_D032.text: Yeah, and tell me about your travels later.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D002.text: Did something happen during your travels?

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D003.text:
No, we’re at home right now.
We’re not traveling.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D004.text: When we returned... a cat was meowing at the door...

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D006.text:
That wasn’t a good explanation!
The cat is alone! And it’s small!

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D007.text:
I still don’t get what’s happening.
Calm down and tell me slowly.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D008.text:
Sorry...
The kitty was crying so sadly...

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D009.text:
It’s a kitty cat, huh? First, don’t touch it.
It’s mother might abandon it if it smells you.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D011.text:
Where’s Echidna?
One of you should go look for the mother cat.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D012.text:
She went off somewhere...
I’m alone right now.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D013.text: She’s always disappearing off to somewhere...

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D016.text:
The kitten is sitting in a corner, crying.
But it’s not moving at all.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D017.text:
Are they always like this?
I can’t tell if it’s hurt.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D018.text:
What should I do?
What CAN I do?

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D019.text: I feel very flustered right now.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D020.text:
Stay right there.
I’ll go over there.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D021.text: I guess I’ll bring a vet, too, just in case it’s hurt.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D022.text:
No, you shouldn’t.
That’s too much for me to ask of you.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D023.text: If you tell me what to do, I’ll do it myself.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D024.text: No, I’m coming. Stay right there.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D028.text:
That is so cool!
Then can I rely on you?

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D029.text:
I’ll buy some milk and snacks for the cat on my way.
Hmm... I wonder where I can buy them.

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D030.text:
No, you don’t need to buy them!
Because I already did...!

TEXT_TALK_018_5_D031.text:
My, aren’t you well-prepared...
Okay then, see you soon! YAH!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D004.text:
Nothing!
Do I need a reason to contact you?!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D005.text: No, but I’ve never seen you use Oztalk before.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D006.text:
Kids noWadays, alWays talking bak and stuf!
Why can’t they just be obedien?!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D008.text: Agh! Why is it so hard to text?!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D009.text:
Take your time.
Typos tend to happen if you rush your text.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D010.text:
I know that!
Kids nowadays always try to correct their elders...

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D011.text:
When an adult is talking, you wait until they’re finished!
You don’t even know that?!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D013.text:
No need to apologize.
Just be more careful.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D015.text: So you just messaged me on a whim?

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D016.text:
Yes. Everyone is using this ‘Oztalk’ nowadays.
I wanted to try it.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D017.text: You’re right in that regard. Oztalk is trending.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D018.text: But you should keep your messages short and concise.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D019.text: Why don’t you give it a try?

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D020.text:
What are you talking about? Are you telling me I talk
too much? Young folks nowadays are so rude!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D022.text:
I couldn’t even look at my elders in the eye! I kept my
mouth shut and showed them my utmost respect!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D024.text: trying to cut me off, but that’s extremely rude!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D025.text: “Excuse me sir, may I open my stupid mouth and talk?”

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D026.text: That’s what you should ask when you want to talk! Okay?!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D028.text: This isn’t nagging! This is a life lesson!

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D029.text: But I understand the point you’re trying to make.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D031.text: It was built for comfortable, convenient conversations.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D032.text:
Hmph. Fine.
I’ll try it your way then.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D036.text: Are you... doing this to spite me?

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D044.text: Okay, so you aren’t doing this on purpose.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D045.text: ...I think you are better off talking like you used to.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D046.text: Yeah, I like this better, too.

TEXT_TALK_019_1_D047.text:
So I guess my Oztalk is functioning well.
Then I’ll talk to you later.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D002.text: It’s always better to talk to someone making eye contact.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D003.text: But you can’t always meet someone in person to talk.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D004.text: I always thought young folks used this to avoid me!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D005.text: This is WAY too convenient. I understand them now.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D006.text: It’s more useful than you thought, right?

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D007.text:
You can also express your mood and tone through text.
So you don’t have to meet someone.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D008.text: This Oztalk was invented by Ku-Klip, right?

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D009.text:
That old can is so skillful! I don’t know what it
doesn’t work alongside Vivian!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D010.text: I thought you didn’t like Vivian?

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D012.text: She always skips work to hangout with her sister!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D013.text: But even then, she’s the daughter of Gordian.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D014.text: I have to protect Vivian because I owe Gordian.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D015.text: But the Elite Four spoil her instead of fixing her!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D016.text:
The Elite Four are supposed to be the pillars of
Gordian’s demon army! They need to be role models!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D017.text:
Ku-Klip shows no interest in the duties of the
Heavenly Kings. She’s defiling our name!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D018.text: When Gordian was in control, none of this happened.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D019.text:
Even Charlotte, who seemed the most competent,
left to become a celebrity! How sad and shameful!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D020.text: Everyone is incompetent! What can I even do?!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D022.text: Right? I knew you’d agree with me.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D023.text: This isn’t freedom. This is incompetence!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D024.text: Kids nowadays lack persistence and proper work ethics!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D025.text: They were selected to be Elite Four!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D026.text: They should be grateful and follow orders!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D027.text:
This is a job you know?! They need to contribute!
They don’t work, and they do whatever they want to!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D028.text:
Think about it! What would you do if your subordinates
stop working and just quit all of a sudden?!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D030.text:
They’re very capable, as selected by Gordian himself.
They are the Elite Four!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D031.text:
Even though they were disobedient, they were still very
capable people. Now the army is in disarray.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D032.text: I miss the days when there were just Elite FOUR.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D033.text: Yeah, those were the good days.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D034.text: Looking back, I guess I should’ve treated them better.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D035.text: They might have a change of heart if you tell them that.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D036.text: Nah. They left on their own.

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D037.text: You still want them to come back, don’t you?

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D038.text: What makes you think they won’t leave again?

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D039.text: Let them leave! I don’t need them anyway!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D040.text: Even if they come back begging, I won’t accept them!

TEXT_TALK_019_2_D041.text: ...I’ll let them know that you want them back.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D001.text: Gen NG nowadays are so incompetent!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D003.text: What is that? I’ve never heard of it before.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D004.text:
Of course you haven’t!
I just made it up!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D005.text:
They don’t respect their elders!
They’re ‘NO GOOD,’ that’s why they’re Gen NG!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D007.text:
I don’t say mean things because I want to!
I say it because it’s the truth!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D008.text: You should always consider, “why am I getting insulted?”

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D009.text: You need to work hard and prove yourself!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D010.text: Kids nowadays are so sensitive! Always making excuses!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D012.text:
Not you. You work hard.
And you’re a very responsible person.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D013.text: But you scold me all the time.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D014.text: Not scolding! It’s a LIFE LESSON!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D015.text:
I only scold you so that you grow up to be a fine person.
There’s always room for improvement!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D018.text: Don’t be satisfied! Continue to strive to improve!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D019.text:
There’s no ‘perfect’ person!
A person should know their shortcomings!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D020.text:
But what’s important is...
Both you and I can become NG.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D021.text: Always check if you’re on the right track, okay?

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D022.text: Listen to your elders and stay respectful!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D023.text: Don’t work for a reward! Work for respect!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D024.text: Adults are more experienced and wise, remember that!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D025.text: Don’t forget that! Engrave these words in your heart!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D027.text: What’s that insincere response? You’re acting like an NG!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D028.text:
It’s because it’s a text.
I’m actually bowing to you as I type.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D030.text:
This is why it’s better to talk in person!
I can’t tell if you’re being sincere or not.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D031.text: You’ll see as you get used to Oztalk.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D032.text: You implying that I should get used to modern culture?

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D034.text:
Then you should help me practice.
I’ll message you more frequently.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D035.text: I didn’t expect you to say that.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D036.text: Falling behind is not something I want to do.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D037.text: I need to master this and stay ahead.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D038.text:
Okay.
Let me know if you’re having troubles.

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D039.text: I like your attitude towards helping others!

TEXT_TALK_019_3_D040.text: Okay! I’ll talk to you soon!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D001.text: Captain, let me borrow your ears.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D004.text:
When I was one of the Elite Four, I went hiking with
my subordinates every weekend.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D005.text: After I resigned, they stopped talking to me altogether!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D006.text:
So I sent letters to all of them.
To meet and hike like we used to.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D007.text: But they aren’t responding to me!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D008.text: The few that did respond refused strongly!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D009.text: Did they forget that I used to be their boss?!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D010.text: Do you know what one of them said?!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D011.text:
“Do you still think you’re one of the Elite Four?”
“Wake up and stop bothering us.”

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D013.text:
I’ll find him. I’ll chase him.
I will teach him a lesson.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D014.text: You did force them to go on a hike every week...

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D015.text: But you’re right. He did sound very mean.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D016.text: So I went on a hike by myself to cool my head.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D021.text: Hmm... you should’ve smiled for the photo.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D022.text: How can I smile after reading that letter?!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D023.text: Kids nowadays are always locked up in their room!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D024.text:
They should come out and exercise!
They’re destroying their bodies like that!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D025.text:
They should hike to stay in shape!
Once you realize this, it’s usually too late!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D026.text: Kids nowadays always make excuses to not exercise!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D027.text:
When I was their age, I attended every activity
that my superiors asked of me!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D028.text:
I would bow to them as I yelled “good morning sir!”
“Thank you for everything!”

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D029.text:
But the kids now? They don’t even show up!
Our future generation is doomed I tell you!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D030.text: ...So you’re telling me you’re sad that no one showed up?

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D031.text:
Yes, I am!
I always wish them the best, but they hate me!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D032.text: Why don’t you try and listen to them?

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D033.text:
Call them and personally ask them.
Try to find out why they’re avoiding you.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D034.text:
But when you do, just let them talk.
Don’t interrupt them or scold them.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D035.text:
I’m an adult! They should listen to me unconditionally!
Why should I listen to their ‘opinion?’

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D036.text: It’s not like they’re going to change, even if I do!

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D037.text: If you don’t, they will continue to avoid you.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D038.text:
Just... do as I say this one time.
You aren’t even their boss anymore, remember?

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D039.text: In order to fix a problem, we need to know the source.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D040.text:
Hmph. I’m a passionate, hard-working man.
I can’t be the source of the problem.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D041.text:
But... alright. You are a trustworthy person.
I’ll do as you say.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D042.text:
I don’t usually hand out praises like this.
You should be proud of yourself.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D043.text: You can just say that you want to get along with people.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D044.text: That’s your issue. You always say one too much.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D045.text: Anyways, so you want me to stay quiet and only listen?

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D046.text: Yes. Just listen to them without interrupting them.

TEXT_TALK_019_4_D047.text: Okay. I’ll talk to you later.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D001.text: I had great conversations with my subordinates.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D003.text:
It was frustrating to hear them talk,
but as you advised, I listened.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D004.text: Talking, I realized there were lots of misunderstandings.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D005.text: I told them to talk freely, and some even started crying!

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D006.text: They must’ve had a lot of built up emotions.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D007.text: You’re right. And they were able to release them.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D008.text:
I would’ve scolded them if it weren’t for you.
“Why are you complaining so much?” I would’ve said.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D009.text:
But I can’t be too harsh on someone crying.
I stayed quiet and listened.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D010.text: I shouldn’t have ignored them in the past.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D011.text:
If I wasn’t so harsh on them,
maybe they would’ve shown me more respect.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D012.text:
Back then, I thought unfaltering loyalty
and great work ethics were all you needed.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D013.text: For the first time, I feel like I was wrong.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D015.text:
Anyways, I had a lot to think about.
If it wasn’t for you, I wouldn’t have.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D017.text:
I always asked the young folks to work hard.
I guess it’s now my turn.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D018.text: Why are you saying that now?

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D019.text:
I can’t just change overnight.
But I’ll strive to become a better man.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D020.text:
And it’s been a while since we met.
Will you meet and eat lunch with me?

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D021.text: It’s on me. I owe you for helping me.

TEXT_TALK_019_5_D023.text: After I decide where to eat, I’ll message you.

from day-to-day items to missiles,
deliveries guaranteed within 3 minutes!”

The delivery service for
Oztalk users has begun.

the delivery time exceeds 3 minutes.

will be delivered today.

please make sure to have your ID with you

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D004.text:
Delivery started.
Your product will be delivered in 3 minutes.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D008.text: This item must be personally collected by the recipient.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D009.text:
Can you count it as received?
Please just leave the package there.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D011.text: I cannot take responsibility if any issues arise.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D012.text: I won’t ask for your responsibility.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D014.text: Please provide me with your location.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D015.text:
I have an urgent matter
to attend to in the Tundra region.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D018.text: I’m in the Tundra now! Where’re you at?

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D019.text: Dear customer, where are you now?

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D020.text: Oh, sorry! Another urgent matter came up,

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D021.text: so I took a portal to come to the Volcano region.

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D022.text: The Volcano region? I’m coming wherever it is!

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D024.text: Arrived at the Volcano! Where are you?

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D027.text: Just let me know where you are!

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D028.text:
Even if it's a battlefield in the midst of lava,
I don't mind!

TEXT_TALK_020_2_D029.text: Even if it's a boiling inferno, I don't mind!

TEXT_TALK_020_3_D002.text: I forgot that I was the intended recipient,

TEXT_TALK_020_3_D003.text: which caused you to repeatedly go back and forth.

You are at least

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D022.text: That’s when I heard a strange noise...

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D026.text: He was talking with my grandma... they were whispering.

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D027.text: They were having a secret conversation of some sort!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D029.text:
The thing is, I’ve never seen them talk like that before.
They barely know each other!

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D031.text:
They were startled
and disappeared without a trace!

When I returned to my room,
my friend was in the bed sleeping

TEXT_TALK_023_3_D045.text: You are thinking what I’m thinking, right?

I’m training in exorcism

But I will take your advice

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D008.text: I have someone I want to learn about.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D011.text:
What???
You are friends with YUNA?!
OMG!
Well anyways, before we talk about that...

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D013.text: I want to learn about Seimei!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D021.text: If it’s similar to what you know, tell me.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D027.text: I don’t know about it in detail, but I heard Seimei swallows people whole!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D028.text: It might be because you’re so strong!

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D030.text: I heard Seimei has devilish fangs and teeth

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D035.text: ...Devilish isn’t a word I’d use to describe Seimei...

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D036.text: Seimei is actually quite... soft and delicate...

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D037.text: Seimei is nothing like what you’ve described

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D039.text: The adults at Ryu all believe Seimei is an evil being.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D040.text: They told me Seimei will eat me and take my body if I run into it.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D041.text: They told me I need to continue my training if I want to defeat Seimei.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D044.text: So anyway, you’re telling me Seimei is nothing like what the adults at Ryu described, right?

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D045.text: There might be something you don’t know?

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D046.text: There should be a good reason as to why the people at Ryu told you those stories.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D047.text:
But the Seimei I know
isn’t a bad person.

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D049.text: The adults might be wrong then

TEXT_TALK_023_4_D055.text: I will buy you two jellies!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D010.text: But I’ve already completed all preparations

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D011.text: I’ve already completed all preparations, so I had no choice

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D015.text:
No...?
I didn’t think you wouldn’t help me...

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D017.text:
I have a place I need to be
after I run away from home!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D018.text: If I travel alone without an adult accompanying me.

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D019.text: People will most likely try and escort me back home.

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D026.text: and see what kind of person Seimei is myself!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D030.text: So please tell me where I can find Seimei!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D035.text: If you help me this one time

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D037.text: I will help you with anything you ask, one time!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D038.text: A child is begging you this much for your help...!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D039.text: As an adult you should help that child, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_023_5_D044.text: Please take good care of me!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D005.text: Hmm... do I have the wrong number?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D015.text: Is it not enough for you?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D019.text: Don’t take it too seriously... I was just playing with you!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D020.text: Next time, don’t ignore my messages, okay?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D022.text: So, why did you text me?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D024.text: Do I need a reason to text you?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D025.text: Ever since I joined your mercenary group, you rarely come to see me...

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D031.text: After seeing my picture, did it get... bigger?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D035.text: Your love for me. Did it grow bigger?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D039.text: As told by my master, the queen of love.

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D040.text: I’m the prettiest thing in the world!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D041.text: She said anyone who sees my photo will fall for me, regardless of gender!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D043.text: Yes! The Goddess of Night, Lilith!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D044.text: No! The Goddess of Night, Lilith!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D046.text: The tooltip from the loading screen said she’s never dated anyone in her life.

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D048.text: I don’t know what that is, but it’s wrong.

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D050.text: Oh! New visitors! I have to go welcome them!

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D051.text: Next time, reply to my texts faster, okay?

TEXT_TALK_024_1_D052.text: I just saw your status message. Please stop.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D010.text: But... maybe I should still trouble you with a photo of mine...

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D012.text: You’re a fun one to tease

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D013.text: Too late. Come see me in person if you want to see me.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D016.text: Don’t lure people into the Maze Forest like last time

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D018.text: You suddenly show up out of nowhere

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D019.text: and started swinging that massive thick stick around...

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D023.text: I only used a wooden stick to keep the people away from touching you!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D024.text: Even still! You shouldn’t wave a weapon like that around a lady!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D025.text: I used it to keep them away...

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D026.text: I didn’t expect the stick to melt away like that as soon as it touched you.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D027.text: I knew your body was acidic, but I didn’t think it would be that potent.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D028.text: Tch, if you didn’t interfere, I could’ve absorbed more mana from them.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D029.text: Why are you interfering with my work?

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D031.text: I just wanted an arm and a leg!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D032.text: You want to keep me all for yourself, don’t you?!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D036.text: Master told me to treat those who try to lay their hands on me like beasts!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D039.text: Once a person loses control of him or herself, they’re nothing but beasts!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D041.text: You are the one that seduced them to consume them...

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D042.text: But all I do is smile and they offer their life force to me...

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D043.text: Well, anyway, all my visitors left because of you.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D044.text: And those who left the forest started spreading bad rumors about me...

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D045.text: No one’s visiting me anymore. I’m lonely.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D049.text: Good thing master shared some of her mana with me.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D050.text: It’s enough for me to continue with my research!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D051.text: Once this research is complete, I will never feel lonely, ever again!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D052.text: I won’t have to hear your nagging, ever again, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D054.text: Hmph, I’m not telling you about it.

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D055.text: Aren’t you going to interfere again if I do?

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D058.text: I don’t like clingy people, y’know

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D059.text: It’s my duty as a captain

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D061.text: You can’t do this, you can’t do that

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D062.text: You must really, really hate me

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D063.text: In the end, the only “ally” I have was my master

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D064.text: I’m only doing things for your well-being!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D065.text: Master told me to avoid people who nag all the time

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D066.text: Captain is a grumpy old nagger!

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D067.text: All you ever do is scold me

TEXT_TALK_024_2_D068.text: I’m spending my days sad and lonely all because of you, y’know

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D003.text: You left last time like you’re never talking to me again...

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D004.text: I thought you didn’t need me anymore.

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D005.text: Nonsense! You have no idea how much I like you, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D006.text: It was a technique called ‘carrot and stick’ that master taught me

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D009.text: You were still upset about that? What a dummy!

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D011.text: You thought I left for good, but now I’m back! Do you like me even more now?

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D013.text: ...I didn’t take you for someone to hold grudges. I’m sorry for saying mean things to you.

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D017.text: I saw a Veslime today at the Maze Forest

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D019.text: Veslimes look so dopey that they’re actually kinda cute

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D023.text: The fact that they can only speak the word ‘Ves!’

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D024.text: Even the name ‘Veslime’ is super stupid.

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D030.text: Why do you hate Veslimes so much?

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D031.text: Do you have a specific reason?

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D033.text: Both Veslimes and I were born inside Vesper’s pot, but we’re vastly different

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D034.text: Veslimes don’t fear death... like fools

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D035.text: I’m always on my toes... in fear that I’ll one day perish...

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D036.text: The Veslimes just follow Vesper’s orders then POOF! Vanish after they’ve done their job

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D038.text: They appear out of nowhere then vanish and repeat!

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D039.text: They always leave me! It’s unfair!

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D043.text: Ugh, I got way too excited

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D044.text: This is because you said Veslimes are cute. It’s your fault

TEXT_TALK_024_3_D047.text: I’m super pretty, cute, and sexy. And yet you think Veslimes are cuter than me?!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D008.text: Don’t compare my babies with wild animals!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D009.text: Do you remember the research I mentioned before?

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D010.text: The research was about separating the ether that my body is comprised of

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D011.text: to create clones of myself! They share my memory and personality!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D012.text: They don’t look exactly like me

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D013.text: because the process of creating them was extremely complicated...

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D014.text: But even so, aren’t they super cute?

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D017.text: You don’t have to state the obvious.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D019.text: my babies are super cute in my eyes!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D020.text: They also don’t disintegrate when I touch them.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D021.text: They’re the only thing in this world that can hug me.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D023.text: You did mention that you will never feel lonely again...

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D026.text: Master was also very happy for me

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D027.text: So what are you going to do now?

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D028.text: I’m going to teach them how to talk

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D029.text: then teach them how to become beautiful, just like me!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D031.text: I’m going to give them a really pretty name!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D032.text: My name’s Lime because I’m a failed Ves’lime.’

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D034.text: Unlike me, I want to give my babies a proper name.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D035.text: Oh? That’s not bad! I’ll use that from now on

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D037.text: Hmm... giving them a cute name is pretty hard.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D038.text: When master arrives, I’ll ask her for advice.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D040.text: Can you give them a name?

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D042.text: You’re so talented, Captain! I’m already excited!

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D043.text: Err... Hmm... I don’t know what to say.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D044.text: But even still, you’re probably better than me at this.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D046.text: The one in the front looks soft, so how about ‘Softie’?

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D049.text: The one in the back is blue, so how about ‘Bluey’?

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D053.text: I did my best you know...

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D054.text: But... I will still give you my compliment for trying your best.

TEXT_TALK_024_4_D055.text: Thanks for everything, Captain! I’m sure my babies appreciate you!

TEXT_TALK_024_5_D011.text: I didn’t think my babies would meet the same fate as them as they’re my clones...

TEXT_TALK_024_5_D012.text: As soon as I gave them their name, they perished...

TEXT_TALK_024_5_D018.text: But they all left my side...

TEXT_TALK_024_5_D024.text: Wait right there. I’m heading to the Maze Forest

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D005.text:
I thought you’d lock yourself up in your room.
Not bad.

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D008.text: Just in case you run late

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D009.text: and leave me hanging here in the dark.

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D012.text:
Worried?
Oh, I’m not the one that should be worrying.

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D013.text:
Oh? Okay.
I guess you’re more
responsible than I thought.

While I’m out,
I decided to visit the Hideout

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D022.text: It’s a place filled with old, retired people, talking about boring topics...

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D023.text: It’s a waste of energy and time

TEXT_TALK_025_1_D025.text: Forget that, have espresso with me
