TEXT_TALK_025_1_D033.text: We have a lot of things

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D002.text: for that bounty hunt we did.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D003.text: The one that we did together in the Wastelands?

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D004.text: Yeah, the one where I carried you.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D008.text:
Celebrate what?
This isn’t something to celebrate.
Don’t waste time.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D009.text: Even you, the ‘captain of justice,’ is hungry for money I see.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D014.text:
Are you angry?
How cute, do you bite?

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D017.text: Honestly, it should be 10 to 0, considering what went down.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D018.text: But since I hope to work with you again, I’m giving you 20%.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D019.text: Do better next time, and I will give you more.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D021.text:
That’s how much you deserve.
If you want to earn more, work harder.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D022.text:
Yeah.
You’ll live a long... and thin life.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D025.text:
You only just tagged along.
I honestly think I’m giving you more!

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D026.text: How about we switch roles next time then.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D032.text: If you can do all of this, you can take 80% instead.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D034.text:
I knew you’d say that.
So I was right.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D035.text:
Oh? You’ll try?
There’s no way you’d pull it off.
I don’t trust you yet.

TEXT_TALK_025_2_D039.text: You will get your chance tonight.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D003.text: I have the mask that Ibelin discarded when she left the Wastelands.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D005.text: If you were to put a bounty on Ibelin’s head,

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D009.text:
Lots?
You never really thought about it, huh?

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D012.text: Is there a reason to place a bounty on Ibelin?

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D013.text: I’m curious how much she’d cost.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D017.text: Her value with the mask on

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D018.text: is different to the unmasked Ibelin.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D021.text:
You’re exactly correct.
That’s the truth.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D022.text:
It is different.
For example, if you weren’t the Captain,
you’d be nothing but a stray dog.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D024.text: is nowhere close to the unmasked Ibelin.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D028.text: But it won’t be easy to exceed that.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D031.text: Although you’re probably very, very wrong...

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D032.text:
You?
I wonder how helpful
a simple mercenary captain can be.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D034.text: But seeing you trying to comfort me

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D035.text: made me feel a lot better.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D036.text: You act like a clown at times.

TEXT_TALK_025_3_D037.text: How useful. Continue being who you are.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D004.text: This is one of my most prized possessions.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D010.text: Do you find her cute, too?

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D012.text:
Why did I even bother to ask.
Seeing how you are, you know nothing of beauty.
Do you even shower?

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D013.text: Of course, I’m the one raising her after all.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D014.text: Today I will give you an important assignment.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D015.text: I’m planning to visit Trista for a few days.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D016.text: Please take care of Milady the 2nd while I’m gone.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D017.text: I will send you the instructions on how to remove pests

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D018.text: and her daily vitamin dosage later.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D019.text: I made it very simple and to the point

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D020.text: so that even someone like you can easily understand it.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D022.text: Hmm... I didn’t expect you to talk back to me like that.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D024.text: You are... one of the most useful

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D025.text: subordinates I have at my disposal.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D027.text: You would be in your room wasting your time anyway, right?

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D031.text: I will reward you well, so work diligently.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D032.text: If I come back and find a single thorn out of place...

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D033.text: I’ll do most unfathomable things to you, okay?

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D035.text: But why are you raising... this cactus?

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D036.text: It’s kind of weird to see you attached to something to this extent.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D037.text:
Plants are honest.
They don’t lie. They don’t stab you in the back.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D038.text: If you treat them well, they pay you back by blossoming beautiful flowers.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D039.text: And besides, Milady the 2nd gives me useful gifts from time to time.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D040.text: She’s much better than most humans.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D042.text:
Are you curious?
I can let you feel it next time.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D043.text: Ah... I just searched it up.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D044.text: Milady the 2nd is a cactus called the resin spurge...

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D046.text:
Nice. You can look things up by yourself now.
You’ve improved.

TEXT_TALK_025_4_D047.text: Ok, since you seem to have satisfied your curiosity

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D003.text: Though, you’re probably at your house just lying around.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D004.text: I want to make sure where you are.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D006.text:
Answering a question with another question
is a terrible habit that you should work to get rid of.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D007.text:
Ha. Expected nothing more from you.
Where exactly are you?

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D012.text: Even if your best friend asks you to hang out, say no.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D013.text: Though I’m sure you have no friends to speak of.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D014.text: But just in case, you know?

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D015.text: Hey, I do have friends...! Like one or two...

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D016.text: So is there anyone else you’ve been talking to?

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D019.text: Oh and spam messages don’t count.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D022.text: Even if they show up at your door knocking

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D024.text: Oh, and don’t get to administer Milady the 2nd’s vitamins at the scheduled time.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D028.text: Oh, do you have a door lock on your front door?

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D029.text: Have you never heard of it before?

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D031.text: ...A level of security fit for a person of your caliber.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D032.text:
Why is your password my birthday...?
This is genuinely scary...
Stop being a pervert and change your password.

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D035.text: Add more layers of security and keep yourself

TEXT_TALK_025_5_D036.text: and your small life savings safe.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D003.text: Ha♡ But I only spoke the truth?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D004.text: Ha! You mad? Look at you copying me.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D005.text: Why are you being so mean...?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D008.text: How can the leader of the most prestigious mercenary group in Hasla be this weak?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D009.text: We aren’t beasts, so as a leader, you don’t have to be too strong I suppose...

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D010.text: But even still, you’re way too fragile.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D012.text: Pft. Is that why you broke your arm when you were arm wresting with that grandpa 4 days ago?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D013.text: FYI, that grandpa’s name is Shuwen... he used to be a general of the Chen Army.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D014.text: Then explain this: two days ago, I saw you getting pushed around by little kids at the town circle.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D015.text: It’s because I didn’t have breakfast that morning...

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D016.text: I saw you getting mugged yesterday.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D017.text: Well, as a captain, I couldn’t dare hurt another person, even if he was a mugger.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D018.text: Wait... you were watching? Why didn’t you help me?!

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D019.text: On the surface, you look like a hard worker. But the more I look into it, you’re just a clumsy goof♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D020.text: It’s really unfortunate, because you actually have a great body for martial arts.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D023.text: Why would I lie to you?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D024.text: Do you perhaps want to learn martial arts? I’ll consider it if you get on your knees and beg.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D025.text: There’s no way a loser♡ like you have any pride anyway, right?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D027.text: Ew, no! I bet you’d love that.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D028.text: Pft♡ Stop acting like you actually care.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D029.text: You’re just mocking me. I bet you’re a terrible teacher anyway.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D030.text: Uhm, no? I’m not a loser♡ like you. I always mean what I say♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D031.text: But to learn from me, you need to at least know and master the basics.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D032.text: I’m going to send you a training manual. Once you become accustomed to this, I will teach you♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D034.text: It’s really simple. It’s basic physical training♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D035.text:
Daily Routine
1000 Push-ups
1000 Sit-ups
20km Runs
1000 Squats with 100kg weights
1000 Jumping jacks
And... being able to do a full split.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D038.text: Stop acting like you’re strong please? It’s kind of pathetic♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D039.text: How in the world can anyone follow that insane training manual?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D040.text: I bet even you can’t do it.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D041.text: I’m not a loser like you, Captain♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D045.text: Of course you’d doubt me. You’re always so, so narrow-minded.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D046.text: Fine. I will show you proof♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D048.text: Look at my split. It’s perfect, right?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D050.text: But there’s a lot more exercises in the manual!

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D052.text: Do you want to see me suffer that badly?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D053.text: ...Do you get excited from that? Seeing girls suffer?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D054.text: You sicko♡, you are absolutely disgusting♡ pervert♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D056.text: You can’t even make up an excuse for this one.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D057.text: Ugh, I hate your response. It sucks♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D058.text: So, is there anything else you want to know about me?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D059.text: No... stop making fun of me now...

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D060.text: Make fun of you? I’m saying all of these things for YOUR benefit.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D061.text: If you continue to be a loser♡, Hero Town’s reputation will fall♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D063.text: I have a weekly mercenary meeting I have to attend. Bye.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D064.text: Oh? Are you running? Running from your problems? Pft♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D065.text: Stop acting like a child♡ Pathetic♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D067.text: I know you’re seeing this message, acting like you left♡ You’re so predictable♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D069.text: If you can’t follow my training...

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D070.text: I will... step in and help you in person♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D071.text: How about it? You like the deal?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D075.text: I will be kind when I teach you... I won’t call you a loser...

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D078.text: Oh sorry about that, I was really at a meeting.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D079.text: You’re going to teach me in person? When?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D083.text: I thought you lied about the meeting to run from the situation... It was real?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D084.text: You’re more serious about your job than I thought♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D085.text: So, are you going to teach me?

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D086.text: I guess I have no choice♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D087.text: But before I come visit you, at least do SOME training. Try and perfect the split♡

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D088.text: That sounds way too hard to do... but okay. I will try.

TEXT_TALK_026_1_D089.text: Yeah, go ahead and try♡ You’ll probably fail though♡

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D002.text: I apologize for the rude remarks I made previously. Will it be alright for me to meet you and apologize in person?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D004.text: I’m sure you’re shocked, but... please believe me. I am, indeed, Tian Mo.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D005.text: You sound... very different. Did you hit your head or something?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D006.text: I had a small accident during training... my mind goes on and off. I’m ashamed, but the Tian Mo you are used to is the result of that accident.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D007.text: Your mind goes on and off?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D009.text: When my mind goes “off,” I start saying things I don’t mean to.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D015.text: I actually had intentions to teach you, as I do believe you have bad habits.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D016.text: Once I got my hands on this Oztalk device, I got a bit too excited.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D017.text: Although I start speaking rudely, my thoughts remain the same.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D018.text: So you’re saying, you were serious about the 1000 push-ups and sit-ups?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D019.text: As the leader of one of Hasla’s largest organization, a small amount of physical training shouldn’t strain you.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D021.text: Did you think I was joking?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D022.text: So, did you succeed in doing a full split?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D023.text: You really sound like an entirely different person though...

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D024.text: When I’m myself, my mind is at its original, mature state.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D026.text: I unconsciously act... cute. My immature body takes over my brain.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D027.text: I almost laughed out loud when you said cute. But Tian Mo, you ARE a girl.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D028.text: You shouldn’t be ashamed of acting your age.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D029.text: No. It is shameful. That’s because I’m actually a “man” named Hwang Bo.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D032.text: I heard that often from my parents. What is it?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D034.text: I have memories of a past. Memories of a place far, far away. I was the leader of the Sect of Tian Mo.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D035.text: Sect of Tian Mo? Are you...?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D036.text: That’s right. I kept the memories of my past life. I have been reincarnated.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D037.text: I was a master martial artist. I perfected my craft over hundreds of years of training.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D039.text: ??? Are you not surprised by what I’m saying?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D040.text: I’m not joking. Why aren’t you taking me more seriously?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D041.text: Well, you’re claiming you’re from a different universe. And that you’re some reincarnation of an old man...

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D042.text: The thing is, Hasla is actually filled with people like that...

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D043.text: I’m sure even my merc. group has someone in a similar situation as you.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D045.text: Yeah. And I’m so sorry about what you’ve gone through. You must’ve had a hard time adjusting to the life of a girl in Hasla.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D046.text: You’re the best! All the other losers♡ didn’t believe me...

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D047.text: You are better than all those other losers♡ Captain! No wonder you’re such a reputable figure in Hasla! You’re the best!

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D054.text: Ugh... I was so overwhelmed with happiness and excitement, I briefly lost myself.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D055.text: I should go and meditate before I lose control of myself again... wait.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D058.text: I should go and have lunch first.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D060.text: You really do take good care of yourself, don’t you?

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D061.text: I should get going now. I have to channel my ki to stay sane.

TEXT_TALK_026_2_D062.text: I will text you at a later date.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D002.text: Hi? You look as pathetic as usual♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D003.text: We’re on Oztalk. You can’t even see my face.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D004.text: Judging by the way you’re texting, I guess you have “lost” yourself again today.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D006.text: But I’m proud of you♡ As pathetic as you look, you’re actually hardworking♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D007.text: Although you can’t keep up with everything I wrote in the training manual, you’re still trying to do them at the best of your ability♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D009.text: Are you on your way to take a shower?

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D011.text: What?! Are you watching me??? Where are you! Come out!

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D012.text: Kyahahaha! Loser♡ You don’t even know how to detect ki. You will never find me!

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D013.text: Ugh... you’re always making fun of me.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D014.text: It’s because I like you, captain.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D015.text: And the compliment I gave you. I mean it.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D016.text: Unlike the other young folks around here, you are actually persistent♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D017.text: If only my henchmen were as half as decent as you are...

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D018.text: They’re all lazy and impatient. Totally weak qualities♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D020.text: I’m actually lying to you. Sike!

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D021.text: Should I stop trying to act cute? Is it disgusting?

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D022.text: Maybe I’m just a bad teacher...

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D023.text: This will affect the progress of creating the Sect of Tian Mo here in Hasla.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D024.text: I’ll never fulfill my goal at this rate...

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D026.text: The truth is, I ran into the killer of my previous life.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D027.text: Dragon Fist Nari... do you know her?

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D028.text: Isn’t that the high school girl that Haruki is always avoiding?

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D029.text: High school? That granny? Don’t be silly♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D030.text: Compared to me, who is super young, Nari looks like a grandma♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D032.text: Captain, I bet that you were a grasshopper in your previous life.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D033.text: I’ll be plump in a few years.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D034.text: Well, anyways, I met Nari again here in Hasla. But she’s grown even stronger.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D035.text: I thought I exceeded her... but she was already far ahead of me.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D036.text: So I started gathering men to help me in my revenge.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D037.text: But I feel like I have been wasting my time.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D038.text: You don’t sound like yourself. Have confidence.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D039.text: Cheer up. I really do think your training manual is helpful.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D040.text: Although you always mock people by calling them a loser, your training instructions are simple and effective. Your henchmen will become stronger in no time.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D041.text: Really? Do you really think that?

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D043.text: Hahaha! I knew it! I was a genius! The strongest of them all! Not only that, I’m extremely cute!

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D045.text: You have a good eye, Captain♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D046.text: Aw, stop being shy you pathetic loser♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D047.text: I feel a lot better now♡ Haha♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D048.text: I didn’t think my compliment would have this big of an effect... but yeah!

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D049.text: Since you made me feel better, I’ll reward you♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D051.text: Tada♡ A cute and powerful photo of me!

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D052.text: How is it? Since you’re a huge pervert, I had to force myself to press send... but you deserve it.

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D055.text: You’re acting all tough, but I know you’re smiling on the inside♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D056.text: Okay now, I have to get going. I’m going to check up on my henchmen’s training♡

TEXT_TALK_026_3_D057.text: You should continue to train, too, Captain♡

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D002.text: If you are not too busy, may I have a word with you?

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D003.text: Again, you sound completely different... it’ll take some time for me to get used to this...

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D004.text: It’s not like I’m enjoying this. If I keep training, then one day, I’ll be fully back to myself.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D006.text: Don’t say such a scary thing.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D007.text: I’m not enjoying any of this.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D008.text: It’ll take a lot of time and training...

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D009.text: But I have to stay hopeful, or else, I won’t be able to bear with myself.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D010.text: Training my men and running this large organization... it’s not easy.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D012.text: Hmm... I’ve been thinking and thinking. But I just can’t seem to figure out a way to defeat the Dragon Fist.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D013.text: Even in my previous life, she was strong enough to destroy the entire Sect of Tian Mo by herself. But now she’s even stronger.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D014.text: Even now, she’s probably training, growing stronger by the minute. How do I catch up to her???

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D015.text: I even thought of just abandoning it all! But I am the Shura Lord, Hwang Bo. I can’t possibly do that...

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D018.text: Pretty strong? No. She’s insanely strong.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D019.text: You always sound so depressed when you’re in your old man mode.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D020.text: I’m actually starting to prefer your child-like way of talking...

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D021.text: Captain, you’re making me even more depressed.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D022.text: A way to catch up to Nari... Now that I think about it, have you ever met Haruki before?

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D023.text: He is also very familiar with ‘reincarnation.’ He mentioned he received some ‘abilities’ from a Goddess.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D024.text: Maybe Nari is strong because she, too, have those abilities. Why don’t you ask Haruki?

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D026.text: He told me Nari beat the living crap out of that Goddess. The Goddess lost almost all of her powers as a result.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D028.text: I guess the only option I have is to continue my training. I have to find a way to enter a state of near invincibility to beat Nari.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D029.text: I do know of a very effective training method, but I don’t know if this body can handle it.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D031.text: I’m sure it can also cure my “swaying” personality.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D032.text: In order to achieve such a breakthrough, however, I will need to go through rigorous training.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D033.text: I partially achieved that state in my previous life and also here in Hasla as Tian Mo.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D034.text: I will have to meditate and channel my inner spirit.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D035.text: But before I do that, I need to absorb and store more ki within my body.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D038.text: I won’t be able to endure the feeling of shame.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D039.text: Then what do you want to do?

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D040.text: I don’t have enough ki to try it yet.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D041.text: As soon as I’m ready, I’ll message you.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D042.text: Until then, don’t skip out on your training.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D043.text: I’m also going to give you a role.

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D045.text: But I just came out clean to you! I didn’t think of you as such a rude person!

TEXT_TALK_026_4_D046.text: You sound trustworthy. Though it sounds like you’re bluffing.

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D004.text: You already forgot? Captain♡ You have the intelligence of a goldfish♡

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D006.text: I have enough ki now for the training!

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D008.text: Is it really okay to do it now though?

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D010.text: But you’re in your child-like mental state right now.

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D011.text: We should wait until you’re back to your senses.

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D012.text: Captain♡ I’m not a loser♡ like you are! It’s okay! We should do it right now, this instance!

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D015.text: Good! That’s what I wanna hear!

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D016.text: I will send you the address. Come!

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D019.text: Is it really okay? I have a bad feeling about this.

TEXT_TALK_026_5_D021.text: If you arrive late like the loser♡ you are, I’m gonna destroy everything, okay?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D002.text: How have you been? Are you busy?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D005.text: Now that’s what I wanted to hear!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D006.text: I know it’s sudden, but I have a question.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D007.text: I’m actually planning to make a comeback with a new mini-album.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D008.text: I’m about to go in and have a meeting with my producer.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D009.text: But before that... I wanted to hear your opinion, too.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D014.text: I knew I could rely on you, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D015.text: Captain, you’re good friends with Cano, Yuna,

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D016.text: and even Meri, the greatest celebrity in Hasla!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D017.text: At this point, you ARE an idol expert.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D018.text: I’m sure I can use your insight to good use.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D023.text: You are also a very trustworthy person.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D024.text: Anyways, let’s get back on topic!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D025.text: I want to use this mini-album as a way to communicate to my fans.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D026.text: I want to show them my newly improved singing skills.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D029.text: For example, what if I sing a ballad song with emotional lyrics to move my fans?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D030.text: Or sing a bright, high-pitched song that can energize my fans?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D031.text: I’m not known for my singing, but we can change that with this album!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D032.text: I will make a comeback as the “singing beauty, Uzume!”

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D033.text: That’s what I’m going to tell the producer.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D039.text: I think the producer is planning to make me do only dance performances, AGAIN.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D042.text: I was always known for being a good dancer...

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D043.text: Imagine doing the same thing over and over again.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D044.text: As an idol, I need to show the fans something different.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D046.text: Don’t you think so? I can’t do the same thing forever!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D047.text: Technically, yes, BUT! It’s still better to change things up a bit once in a while!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D048.text: It’s time I show my fans something different!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D049.text: And I think some people have a misunderstanding of my singing skills.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D050.text: I don’t think they’re misunderstanding anything...

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D051.text: I’m sure they are well-aware of your singing, Uzume.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D052.text: Remember what happened at the Summer Festival...?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D054.text: The audience gave me an epic reaction!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D057.text: My fans were yelling so loudly to cheer me on! That performance really motivated me!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D059.text: Let me know if you have more ideas.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D060.text: Don’t be shy! Come on and tell me!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D061.text: Don’t you think the fans would still prefer to see your cute and energetic dancing?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D062.text: Remember. People became your fans because of your dancing.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D063.text: If you suddenly change your identity as a dancer to a singer... I’m sure some fans wouldn’t like that.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D064.text: Who knows? Some may cry out, asking for the old Uzume back.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D065.text: So “Uzume” should remain as “Uzume.” You should continue to hone your dancing skills.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D066.text: Hmm... so what you’re trying to say is that

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D067.text: I should continue to practice dancing as I sing?

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D069.text: No! I completely get what you’re saying!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D070.text: It’s okay, I got the gist of what you’re saying.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D071.text: The Uzume the fans expect and want...

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D072.text: Thank you Captain, you’ve opened my eyes to the dilemma.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D073.text: It’s perfect! I’ll go ahead and tell the producer.

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D075.text: I will heed you advice for sure! Thanks for everything!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D076.text: I need to go in and attend the meeting now! See ya!

TEXT_TALK_027_1_D077.text: I will talk to you later!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D002.text: I’m messaging you to update you on the progress of the mini-album!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D003.text: After speaking with my producer and other staff during the meeting...

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D004.text: We came to the conclusion of including just a teeny bit of singing in the new album! To maintain my image as a dancer - while at the same time - enticing the fans with something new!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D005.text: So in the end... you’re going to sing...

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D006.text: Did the producer REALLY agree with this?

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D007.text: Of course the producer allowed it!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D008.text: The biggest reason as to how I was able to persuade him was

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D011.text: You don’t have to say it like that.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D012.text: During the meeting, I told him that you, the esteemed Captain, provided me with the idea!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D013.text: He said, “if the Captain, the Hero of Hasla, says so, I guess we have no choice.”

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D014.text: It’s all thanks to you that I can sing in my new mini-album.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D016.text: Your input played a crucial role, Captain.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D017.text: We will make sure to include your name, big and bolded, in the ending credits!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D019.text: I’m going to go record the new title song soon!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D020.text: Captain, can you come to the studio and participate in the process?

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D023.text: Like I said, you played a large role in the upcoming album.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D024.text: Can you watch over the recording and give me your input?

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D025.text: Try and see it from the perspective of a fan.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D026.text: Let me know what you think about the vocal directing or if the song itself is good or not.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D028.text: It’d be an honor, but I’m too busy at the moment.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D029.text: I have to stop evil things threatening Hasla

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D030.text: and provide my heroes with bread and berries.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D031.text: I also have to do weekly quests and visit the Colosseum.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D032.text: I want to help you so badly...

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D033.text: But I’m too busy to actually help you...

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D034.text: Yeah, I don’t think I can squeeze that into my schedule.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D036.text: I will work around your schedule!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D038.text: It’s a practice recording session anyway! I can redo the schedule for it.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D041.text: but it won’t have a large impact.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D042.text: So yeah, I’ll adjust my schedule to work around yours!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D043.text: No, no, no. Think about the fans who are waiting for your comeback.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D044.text: Many are waiting patiently for your next hit, Uzume. You shouldn’t make them wait, not even for a day.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D045.text: Don’t worry about my schedule and start recording ASAP.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D046.text: You do have a point, Captain.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D047.text: Okay then! You don’t have to come for this one!

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D048.text: As always, thank you for your input.

TEXT_TALK_027_2_D051.text: Err... Whew as in, “it’s so unfortunate I can’t see you at the studio.”

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D002.text: I was so sad that you couldn’t come...

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D003.text: I must’ve sounded like an angel. If only you could’ve heard it!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D005.text: You think so, too, right? It’s so unfortunate!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D006.text: You can only joke like that because you didn’t see it in person.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D007.text: You really, really should’ve been there.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D008.text: The staff were twitching uncontrollably to the beat! Almost as if they’re having seizures!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D009.text: Seeing them moved by my music

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D011.text: It reminded me of the first time I saw Meri’s concert.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D012.text: I always wanted to be like Meri.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D013.text: With this, I feel like I’m one step closer!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D015.text: One of the staff was crying, another lost in thought, and another who fainted!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D016.text: Of course! I was really moved when I saw Meri’s performance!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D018.text: But I do feel bad for the staff for their troubles.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D019.text: For Uzume to say something like that... what happened?

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D020.text: We took multiple takes on the recording because I didn’t like most of them.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D021.text: So the recording took a really long time.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D022.text: Okay, I can tell they DID have a hard time.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D024.text: BUT! As an artist, I have to strive for perfection.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D025.text: Even if I have to sing the same line 100 times, I only want to show my fans the best I can be.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D027.text: Thank you for being considerate! But I want my album to be perfect!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D028.text: I’m always thankful for the staff.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D029.text: But I think the extra time we spent at the studio was well worth it.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D031.text: I really want you to hear it, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D033.text: Is there a way to transfer audio files through Oztalk?

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D040.text: You can only send images on Oztalk currently.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D041.text: The person that created Oztalk is Ku-Klip, right?

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D042.text: I was actually planning to visit the Demon Realm soon to prepare for my next tour.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D043.text: Maybe I should ask Ku-Klip to add the feature while I’m there!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D045.text: But don’t you think many people will enjoy such a feature?

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D046.text: I’m sure there are many people who wants to send audio files!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D047.text: Some people will enjoy it for sure...

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D048.text: It would be massively convenient... BUT!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D050.text: Ku-Klip has been very, very busy lately.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D051.text: He was always busy, but the recent launch of Oztalk got him even busier.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D052.text: I inquired him about an Oztalk issue I had, and he said it’d take him at least 20 weeks for him to get started on it.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D053.text: You really shouldn’t bother him with anything else right now.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D054.text: Besides, it’ll be rude to suddenly show up at Ku-Klip’s door and advise him on what to do with his own invention!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D055.text: Right Uzume? I’ll just assume that you understood.

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D056.text: I think you’re right! I almost made a mistake!

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D057.text: But since I still want you to hear my recording,

TEXT_TALK_027_3_D058.text: I will look for another way!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D001.text: Captain, did you receive a package?

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D004.text: Did you send it to me?

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D011.text: Don’t tell me what I think it is.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D014.text: Can you tell me what exactly it is? So I can mentally prepare...

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D018.text: I suppose you receive a lot of weird packages, Captain.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D019.text: I wanted it to be a surprise...

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D020.text: But I guess I have no choice! I’ll tell you.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D021.text: It’s a demo CD of the mini-album!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D022.text: Sir Ku-Klip told me that the implementation of sending audio files through Oztalk will take some time.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D023.text: So I figured I’ll just send you the physical copy instead!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D025.text: The head of production of the Demon Realm Dome was, coincidentally, Ku-Klip!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D026.text: When I visited the Demon Realm to prepare for my tour, he was there!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D028.text: He said it’s completely possible to add the feature!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D029.text: But when I told him I’m planning to send my singing to you, he kindly told me that it’d take months to fully implement it.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D030.text: I’ll need to thank Ku-Klip later...

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D031.text: I didn’t expect you to send this to me in a package.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D033.text: Anyhow, I’m glad you received it!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D034.text: You can finally listen to my new album!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D040.text: Don’t worry about a thing! I received permission.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D041.text: The producer said you HAVE to listen to it!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D042.text: ...I guess he wants to share the burden...

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D043.text: It’s too good to not share, y’know?!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D044.text: Ehem, although it’s kind of embarrassing to say this myself,

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D045.text: I think this mini-album is going to be a HUGE masterpiece!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D051.text: Can I listen to it after its official release?

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D054.text: What a hardworking individual you are, Captain...

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D055.text: Just keep it running on your music player while you’re matchmaking for Arena

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D057.text: But if I listen to it now, I will lose the excitement of waiting for your grand comeback.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D058.text: Although I’m thankful that you think that way,

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D059.text: don’t you think it’d be fun to listen to this now so that you can compare it to the final copy on release?

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D063.text: but I don’t have a CD player on me right now.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D067.text: You told me that you bought a high-end CD player at Neth!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D069.text: No! I’m sure you told me that!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D070.text: Did it grow legs and run off?

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D072.text: My cat bumped into it yesterday, and it dropped onto the floor. It’s completely destroyed beyond repair.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D073.text: Cat? You have a cat, Captain?

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D074.text: Uhhhhh, maybe it was me that bumped into it.

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D078.text: Oh, darn! My cat just sprained its ankle! I gotta go!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D079.text: I’ll listen to your album in the far future, bye!

TEXT_TALK_027_4_D081.text: Did you seriously just leave me hanging?

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D003.text: This is a fan-made ad that my fans made me for my comeback album!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D006.text: I’m thankful for you too, Captain.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D008.text: My comeback has officially been announced!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D011.text: That the final copy of my mini-album is complete!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D013.text: So you’ll finally listen to it, right?

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D017.text: You told me that you’ll listen to it once it’s out!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D025.text: Listen to it and give me your input! I’ll be waiting for your text!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D028.text: Let’s just meet up and go to a karaoke!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D029.text: You helped me lots, so I wanted to thank you in person anyway!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D030.text: And I’m also craving some karaoke!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D033.text: My album will be released to the public this week! And my comeback showcase is featured next week!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D034.text: I can spare a day to meet you, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D035.text: Hold up, hold up. Give me a second to collect my thoughts, Uzume.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D036.text: Uhm... I think I’ll be busy this week.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D040.text: Who are you planning to meet? I’ll go talk to them.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D041.text: Can you adjust your schedule just a little bit? Where did you make your reservation?

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D042.text: I’ll ask through Oztalk right now!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D044.text: Now that I think about it, I have an even more crucial business to attend to.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D048.text: I have plans to break my legs and become hospitalized

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D051.text: Do you just... not want to hear my album, Captain?

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D052.text: Is that it...? I won’t force you.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D061.text: No, no, no. It’s fine Captain.

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D062.text: It’s not like I’m crying right now...

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D063.text: I’m just a tiny bit sad, that’s all...

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D064.text: Don’t worry about me... You’re a busy person after all...

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D068.text: So I can meet up with you?!

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D070.text: Actually, let me think it over...

TEXT_TALK_027_5_D072.text: I emptied out my entire schedule this evening! Don’t ghost me!

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D003.text: Jack? Surprised to receive a message from you.

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D008.text: Do you, by any chance, have ANYTHING...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D009.text: That you can donate to me...?

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D012.text: The thing is, I’m running low on money...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D013.text: Who am I kidding, I don’t have a dime to my name right now...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D014.text: I’m unable to pay off my debt...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D015.text: So I can’t buy anything for myself until I do...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D016.text: I thought you got a part time job?

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D017.text: Where did you spend your paycheck?

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D019.text: I worked hard at my new job...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D022.text: Did you get scammed or something?

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D025.text: Wow, Captain. You sure are a person of justice...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D026.text: If what you are saying is true, we have to find a way for you to get your money.

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D028.text: I can report this to the labor office for you.

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D030.text: I’m grateful that you care so much...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D031.text: But it really isn’t what you are thinking...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D033.text: I had to return it to my boss... hehe

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D039.text: I ended up owing him more money than I get paid...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D040.text: So we ended up on an agreement, that I’ll work for free until I pay off all the damages I caused...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D044.text: I ended up causing even more unrepairable damage...

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D053.text: Of course! I make sure to visit her daily and thank her.

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D054.text: I had to make a lot of sacrifices, but I was able to keep up paying off the debt...!

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D056.text: So do you perhaps have any extra toothbrushes lying around...?

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D057.text: I would be soooo thankful if you can spare me any.

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D059.text: If you don’t have anything to give me, it’s okay!

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D062.text: I can provide you with some hygiene products.

TEXT_TALK_028_1_D065.text: No problem. Just let me know if you need anything.

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D001.text: Captain, I have something to ask you...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D003.text: What a coincidence, I was just about to message you

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D004.text: I have something to ask you, too

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D008.text: I was just passing by the Orchard,

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D009.text: and I saw Lenny using a purple rake.

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D010.text: I was wondering if it belongs to you.

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D011.text: It even had your trademark sticker on it.

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D013.text: Or did Lenny scam you again?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D018.text: I sold it to Lenny on Kraigslist

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D020.text: I’m selling my stuff to pay off my debt...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D021.text: Lenny happens to have been looking for new gardening tools...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D023.text: I thought you cherished your gardening tool.

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D024.text: Yeah, but... I really need money right now...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D026.text: How will you take care of your flowers and other plants?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D027.text: It’s okay... I can use my fork...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D028.text: Jack, just what kind of life are you living right now?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D029.text: What do you even have left?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D032.text: Your place must be infested with mosquitoes

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D033.text: I’m a plant, so mosquitoes don’t bother me...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D034.text: But I do wake up with various insects tangled up in my hair every morning... hehe...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D037.text: do you want to buy anything from me, Captain...?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D040.text: but who knows, you might find interest in something...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D041.text: Are you perhaps in need of a new towel...?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D042.text: The one I have is soft and it dries up quickly...!

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D043.text: But it’s not just a plain old towel...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D044.text: It has ‘Hasla Mercenary Group 5th Anniversary’ embroidered on it...

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D052.text: But do you still want to buy it...?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D054.text: If you buy this towel, I can probably last another day...!

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D055.text: Since you are the one that gave it to me, you probably know just how great this towel is...!

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D061.text: Oh and I almost forgot. You messaged me first.

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D062.text: So why did you text me?

TEXT_TALK_028_2_D064.text: I wanted to ask you if you wanted a new towel... hehe

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D002.text: I know it’s a bit late,

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D003.text: but I wanted to thank you for buying my towel from before...!

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D005.text: Thank you so much... I hope you stay a regular customer...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D006.text: Oh... but I don’t have anything left to sell... hehe

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D007.text: You gave me just enough joy to last... one more day...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D010.text: Lednas told me that you have been looking gloomy lately.

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D014.text: It’s probably because I’m often tired!

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D017.text: Hmm... maybe because I’m not as energetic anymore...?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D018.text: But really, that’s it! I’m just... not energetic...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D020.text: Have you been taking your vitamins and minerals?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D021.text: Do you get enough energy from photosynthesis alone? Since you’re a Dryad?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D023.text: What you’re saying is true... for normal cases...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D024.text: But right now, I’m in the form of a demon...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D027.text: But I have no money for such a luxury...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D028.text: I have been eating grass from the garden...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D031.text: It’s not too bad if you imagine it as a very healthy salad...!

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D032.text: No...! It’s just that I have no choice...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D036.text: Isn’t that kind of like... cannibalism?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D039.text: Fishes eat other fish at sea, right...?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D041.text: Yeah... so it’s completely morally okay for me to eat plants...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D043.text: So you never done it before...?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D044.text: What do you mean by that?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D046.text: So you never just decided to feast on someone...?

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D049.text: Well anyways, you don’t have to worry about me...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D053.text: I kind of feel bad seeing how much you’re worrying about me...

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D055.text: I can’t ignore your situation anymore.

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D056.text: I’ll find a job opening for you.

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D058.text: If you continue to live like this,

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D059.text: you are going to become a shriveled up Dryad

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D061.text: I’m already in talks with an employer right now.

TEXT_TALK_028_3_D062.text: You will most likely get a call this week.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D009.text: I know you didn’t do anything with ill intent.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D013.text: Hng... what if I was laid off for causing so much trouble...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D014.text: Don’t stress out, there might be another reason

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D015.text: Don’t let it bring you down, okay?

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D026.text: It was a lot better than working at the super market in the Demon Realm...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D027.text: The Demon Market is a battlefield...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D030.text: We worked 12 hours a day, 7 days a week...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D031.text: We had so much work, and the customers weren’t exactly noble citizens...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D032.text: I even paid money out of my own pockets whenever some items were stolen or missing...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D034.text: You were going through such a hard time...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D035.text: Though the last thing you said about the mart is probably... your fault.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D036.text: The work you introduced me to was miles better...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D037.text: Though it saddens me that I was fired...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D038.text: The boss was also very nice to me from start to finish...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D043.text: “You’re smashing it,” or “You’re a devil at its core!”

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D044.text: They only said nice things to me...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D051.text: I’m always indebted to you. You’re so kind to me...!

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D053.text: I’ll need to start looking for another job.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D056.text: I’m used to this lifestyle now. Hehe...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D058.text: I know a few other places that are looking to hire.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D064.text: There’s an open position for a waitress, doll making, circus clown...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D065.text: How about package delivery? You’re really physically strong, so it should be okay.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D070.text: I knew I could rely on you, Captain!

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D071.text: Or you meet the same people...?

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D072.text: It just happened naturally because I’ve been protecting Hasla for so long...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D073.text: Anyways, I’ll give you the numbers of the employers later.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D075.text: And let them know I’m the one that introduced you.

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D076.text: Hng... thank you so much, Captain...

TEXT_TALK_028_4_D079.text: You are not hiding anything from me, right?

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D008.text: I figured it’s the right thing to do to tell you...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D010.text: All the jobs you introduced me to...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D011.text: I got fired from all of them...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D012.text: I thought I should let you know...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D014.text: In that short span of time?

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D016.text: To be exact, I got fired from all of them... at the same time.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D017.text: Huh? At the same time? How does that make sense?

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D018.text: This is not something you should strive to become efficient at.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D021.text: So I was doing the waitress job and the doll-making job at the same time...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D022.text: And I accidentally sewed a pair of eyeballs on the food...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D023.text: Then I tripped over a doll and flung spaghetti all over a customer...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D024.text: I didn’t want to keep the customer waiting, so I gave the customer a clean, empty plate

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D025.text: to hold onto before the food can be done again...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D026.text: The customer thought I was mocking him... it was all a misunderstanding...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D029.text: There’s more to it, but... I’ll stop talking.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D035.text: As long as you worked sincerely.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D037.text: Nevermind Jack, I think it’s totally your fault...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D040.text: I thought working hard was what mattered the most...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D043.text: Why are you overworking yourself so much?

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D044.text: You should’ve taken one job at a time.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D045.text: I’m in dire need of money...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D047.text: I can’t pay my bills... the water company is going to shut off my water supply...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D048.text: Then all my babies at home will shrivel and die...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D050.text: As for me, I can just dip my feet at a lake to get my daily water... but ordinary plants can’t do that...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D051.text: I’m fine with collecting and drinking rain water, so I didn’t prepare anything...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D052.text: That’s why I’m trying to make as much money as possible...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D053.text: But now that I’m unemployed again, it’s going to be hard...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D054.text: I guess I will visit the town fountain every morning to collect some water.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D058.text: can you collect your tears in a container and give it to me...?

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D059.text: I need to water my babies... hehe...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D061.text: I’ll just create a new job opening at my mercenary group.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D062.text: I’ll make a part time position for you.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D066.text: That means I have to do a job interview, right...?

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D070.text: It’s not like I don’t know you, Jack...

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D072.text: Just come see me next week.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D079.text: I feel like I need to “rescue” you as fast as I can.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D080.text: I won’t be able to sleep well, knowing you’re living like that.

TEXT_TALK_028_5_D081.text: Okay then, Captain! I’ll see you tomorrow...!
